<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover" />
<title>RIFT // 2D Competitive Space Arena</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg-void: #000000;
    --hud-glass: rgba(6, 14, 26, 0.90);
    --hud-border: rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.38);
    --cyan: #00F5D4;
    --yellow: #FFE800;
    --red: #FF3B4E;
    --gold: #FFB800;
    --blue: #29B6F6;
    --text-main: #E6F4FF;
    --text-dim: #7C9BB5;
  }

  * {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  html, body {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #000000;
    color: var(--text-main);
    font-family: "JetBrains Mono", "Roboto Mono", "Courier New", monospace;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
    -webkit-touch-callout: none;
    touch-action: none;
  }

  #app-root {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #000000;
    transform-origin: center center;
  }

  #app-root.rotated-90 {
    width: 100vh;
    height: 100vw;
    top: calc((100vh - 100vw) / 2);
    left: calc((100vw - 100vh) / 2);
    transform: rotate(90deg);
  }

  #game-canvas {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
    background: #000000;
  }

  /* SINGLE TOP PILL BAR (MAX-HEIGHT: 36px, CENTERED, ZERO PC KEY LABELS) */
  #top-pill-bar {
    position: absolute;
    top: 8px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    max-height: 36px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    background: rgba(3, 12, 22, 0.94);
    border: 1px solid var(--hud-border);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 2px 10px;
    z-index: 25;
    pointer-events: auto;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  }

  .pill-btn {
    background: rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.08);
    color: var(--text-main);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.28);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    transition: transform 0.1s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease;
    white-space: nowrap;
    min-height: 28px;
  }

  .pill-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.95);
    background: rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.25);
    border-color: var(--cyan);
  }

  .pill-btn.accent-yellow {
    border-color: rgba(255, 232, 0, 0.55);
    color: var(--yellow);
    background: rgba(255, 232, 0, 0.08);
  }

  .pill-stat {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--cyan);
    padding: 0 6px;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* SINGLE 1-LINE PRIZE CRATE TOAST (POSITIONED AT bottom: 150px ABOVE RADAR) */
  #prize-toast {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 150px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: rgba(4, 14, 26, 0.94);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--cyan);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 4px 16px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #00FF88;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.35);
    display: none;
    z-index: 25;
    pointer-events: none;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* CONVERGENCE 30s EMERGENCY BANNER */
  #convergence-banner {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: rgba(45, 4, 12, 0.94);
    border: 2px solid var(--red);
    box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(255, 59, 78, 0.85);
    color: #FFFFFF;
    padding: 5px 16px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-align: center;
    z-index: 32;
    display: none;
    pointer-events: none;
    animation: pulse-alert 0.7s infinite alternate;
  }

  @keyframes pulse-alert {
    from { opacity: 0.8; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.98); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1.02); }
  }

  /* COMPACT & UNOBTRUSIVE RESPAWN OVERLAY */
  #death-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    top: 38%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    background: rgba(10, 16, 28, 0.94);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--red);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 8px 18px;
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 3px;
    z-index: 40;
    pointer-events: none;
    box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(255, 59, 78, 0.55);
  }

  #death-overlay .death-title {
    color: var(--red);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  }

  #death-overlay .death-countdown {
    color: var(--yellow);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }

  /* LEFT FLIGHT STICK (BLUE - SNAP-BACK AUTO-BRAKE) AT left: 13vw, bottom: 22vh */
  #left-stick-zone {
    position: absolute;
    left: 13vw;
    bottom: 22vh;
    width: 118px;
    height: 118px;
    margin-left: -59px;
    margin-bottom: -59px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid rgba(41, 182, 246, 0.5);
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(41, 182, 246, 0.16) 0%, rgba(6, 16, 32, 0.55) 75%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(41, 182, 246, 0.28);
    z-index: 15;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  #left-stick-afterburner-ring {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1.5px dashed rgba(255, 184, 0, 0.45);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  #left-stick-puck {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: 50%;
    width: 46px;
    height: 46px;
    margin-left: -23px;
    margin-top: -23px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #80D8FF, #0288D1);
    border: 2px solid #E1F5FE;
    box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(41, 182, 246, 0.85);
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: background 0.1s;

  #left-stick-puck.afterburner {
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #FFF59D, #FF6D00);
    border-color: #FFE800;
    box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(255, 145, 0, 0.95);
  }

  /* RIGHT-SIDE ERGONOMIC THUMB ARC BUTTON CLUSTER (SOLID CIRCULAR BUTTONS) */
  /* 1. Primary Red [FIRE] Stick (84px circle at right: 11vw, bottom: 28vh) */
  #btn-fire-stick {
    position: absolute;
    right: 11vw;
    bottom: 28vh;
    width: 84px;
    height: 84px;
    margin-right: -42px;
    margin-bottom: -42px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 3px solid #FF8A80;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #FF5252, #D50000 70%, #8A0000 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 59, 78, 0.65);
    z-index: 18;
    pointer-events: auto;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 900;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
    transition: transform 0.08s ease;
  }

  #btn-fire-stick:active {
    transform: scale(0.94);
  }

  /* 2. Amber/Yellow [BOMB] Stick (72px circle at right: 22vw, bottom: 21vh) */
  #btn-bomb-stick {
    position: absolute;
    right: 22vw;
    bottom: 21vh;
    width: 72px;
    height: 72px;
    margin-right: -36px;
    margin-bottom: -36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2.5px solid #FFE082;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #FFE082, #FFA000 70%, #E65100 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255, 232, 0, 0.6);
    z-index: 18;
    pointer-events: auto;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #1A1300;
    font-weight: 900;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.08s ease;
  }

  #btn-bomb-stick.low-energy {
    opacity: 0.35 !important;
  }

  #btn-bomb-stick:active {
    transform: scale(0.93);
  }

  .btn-label-title {
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }

  .btn-label-cost {
    font-size: 9px;
    opacity: 0.9;
  }

  /* 3. Red/Crimson [BURST] Circle (60px circle at right: 21vw, bottom: 8vh) */
  #btn-burst-circle {
    position: absolute;
    right: 21vw;
    bottom: 8vh;
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
    margin-right: -30px;
    margin-bottom: -30px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid #FFAB91;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #FF7043, #D84315 80%, #BF360C 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(255, 112, 67, 0.55);
    z-index: 18;
    pointer-events: auto;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 900;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.08s ease;
  }

  #btn-burst-circle.visible {
    display: flex;
  }

  #btn-burst-circle.low-energy {
    opacity: 0.35 !important;
  }

  #btn-burst-circle:active {
    transform: scale(0.93);
  }

  /* 4. Blue [REPEL] Circle (60px circle at right: 13vw, bottom: 9vh) */
  #btn-repel-circle {
    position: absolute;
    right: 13vw;
    bottom: 9vh;
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
    margin-right: -30px;
    margin-bottom: -30px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid #81D4FA;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #29B6F6, #0288D1 80%, #01579B 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(41, 182, 246, 0.55);
    z-index: 18;
    pointer-events: auto;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #FFFFFF;
    font-weight: 900;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.08s ease;
  }

  #btn-repel-circle.visible {
    display: flex;
  }

  #btn-repel-circle.low-energy {
    opacity: 0.35 !important;
  }

  #btn-repel-circle:active {
    transform: scale(0.93);
  }

  /* 5. Gold/Cyan [THOR] Circle (60px circle at right: 30vw, bottom: 13vh) */
  #btn-thor-circle {
    position: absolute;
    right: 30vw;
    bottom: 13vh;
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
    margin-right: -30px;
    margin-bottom: -30px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid #FFE800;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #00F5D4, #00897B 80%, #004D40 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.55);
    z-index: 18;
    pointer-events: auto;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #02121A;
    font-weight: 900;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.08s ease;
  }

  #btn-thor-circle.visible {
    display: flex;
  }

  #btn-thor-circle.low-energy {
    opacity: 0.35 !important;
  }

  #btn-thor-circle:active {
    transform: scale(0.93);
  }

  /* INTEGRATED BOTTOM-CENTER CONSOLE (EVE ECHOES RADAR + ROUNDED WINGS) */
  #bottom-center-console {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 10px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    z-index: 20;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* Left Wing Pill */
  .console-wing-left {
    background: rgba(3, 12, 22, 0.94);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--hud-border);
    border-right: none;
    border-radius: 26px 0 0 26px;
    padding: 6px 14px 6px 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    pointer-events: auto;
    box-shadow: -4px 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  }

  /* Circular [WARP SAFE] Button */
  .circular-console-btn {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.15);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--cyan);
    color: var(--cyan);
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 900;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.1s ease, background 0.15s ease;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.35);
    white-space: nowrap;
    line-height: 1.05;
  }

  .circular-console-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.92);
    background: rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.35);
  }

  .console-readouts {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    font-size: 10px;
  }

  .console-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .console-lbl {
    color: var(--text-dim);
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 9px;
  }

  .console-val {
    color: var(--text-main);
    font-weight: 800;
  }

  /* 130px Circular Radar Frame with Smart Elastic Panning */
  #radar-frame {
    width: 130px;
    height: 130px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(2, 10, 18, 0.95);
    border: 2.5px solid var(--cyan);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.35);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    pointer-events: auto;
    cursor: crosshair;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  #radar-canvas {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
    border-radius: 50%;
  }

  /* Right Wing Pill */
  .console-wing-right {
    background: rgba(3, 12, 22, 0.94);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--hud-border);
    border-left: none;
    border-radius: 0 26px 26px 0;
    padding: 6px 8px 6px 14px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    pointer-events: auto;
    box-shadow: 4px 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  }

  .energy-large-box {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 1px;
  }

  .energy-large-num {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 900;
    color: #00FF88;
    line-height: 1;
    font-family: inherit;
  }

  /* Circular [MULTI ON/OFF] Toggle Button */
  #btn-multi-toggle {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
    color: var(--text-dim);
    font-size: 8px;
    font-weight: 900;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.1s ease, background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
    line-height: 1.05;
  }

  #btn-multi-toggle.active {
    background: rgba(255, 232, 0, 0.22);
    border-color: var(--yellow);
    color: var(--yellow);
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 232, 0, 0.45);
  }

  /* MODALS (COMPACT, SCROLLABLE, PINNED FOOTER) */
  .modal-backdrop {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: rgba(2, 6, 14, 0.92);
    z-index: 50;
    display: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 12px;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  .modal-backdrop.open {
    display: flex;
  }

  .modal-card {
    width: min(96vw, 860px);
    max-height: 88vh;
    background: rgba(7, 16, 30, 0.96);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--cyan);
    border-radius: 14px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 36px rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.28);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .modal-header {
    padding: 10px 16px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.25);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    background: rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.08);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .modal-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 900;
    color: var(--cyan);
    letter-spacing: 0.8px;
  }

  .modal-body {
    padding: 10px 14px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    max-height: 62vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    flex: 1;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  .mode-selector-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .mode-tabs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .mode-tab {
    background: rgba(12, 26, 46, 0.9);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.3);
    color: var(--text-dim);
    padding: 5px 10px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  .mode-tab.active {
    background: rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.2);
    border-color: var(--cyan);
    color: var(--text-main);
  }

  .callsign-box {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  /* EDITABLE CALLSIGN & SYNDICATE INPUTS (OPEN MOBILE KEYBOARD CLEANLY) */
  .callsign-input {
    user-select: text !important;
    -webkit-user-select: text !important;
    pointer-events: auto !important;
    touch-action: manipulation !important;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--hud-border);
    color: var(--yellow);
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 800;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .callsign-input:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--cyan);
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.4);
  }

  /* HANGAR GRID (ALL 8 SHIPS VISIBLE IN A 4x2 GRID, ZERO HORIZONTAL OVERFLOW) */
  .ship-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 8px;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  .ship-card {
    background: rgba(11, 22, 40, 0.85);
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(124, 155, 181, 0.28);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 6px 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 3px;
    transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .ship-card.selected {
    border-color: var(--yellow);
    background: rgba(255, 232, 0, 0.12);
    box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255, 232, 0, 0.25);
  }

  .ship-card-top {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .ship-preview-canvas {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    background: #02060D;
    border-radius: 5px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .ship-foundry-tag {
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--cyan);
    font-weight: 700;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .ship-name {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: var(--text-main);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }

  .ship-role {
    font-size: 8.5px;
    color: var(--yellow);
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }

  .ship-desc-short {
    font-size: 9px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    line-height: 1.2;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .stat-mini-bars {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    margin-top: 1px;
  }

  .stat-line {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--text-dim);
  }

  .stat-bar-bg {
    width: 52%;
    height: 3px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .stat-bar-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: var(--cyan);
  }

  /* PINNED FOOTER BAR (NEVER CLIPPED) */
  .modal-pinned-footer {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    background: rgba(4, 10, 20, 0.98);
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.25);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .deploy-btn {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00F5D4, #00E676);
    color: #021018;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 9px 24px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: 0.8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.45);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .deploy-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.96);
  }

  .guest-btn {
    background: rgba(255, 232, 0, 0.12);
    color: var(--yellow);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--yellow);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 9px 18px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
    transition: transform 0.1s ease, background 0.15s ease;
  }

  .guest-btn:active {
    transform: scale(0.96);
    background: rgba(255, 232, 0, 0.28);
  }

  /* LEADERBOARD TABLE */
  .lb-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .lb-table th, .lb-table td {
    padding: 6px 8px;
    text-align: left;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  }

  .lb-table th {
    color: var(--cyan);
    font-size: 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app-root">
  <canvas id="game-canvas"></canvas>

  <!-- SINGLE TOP PILL BAR (ZERO PC KEYS) -->
  <div id="top-pill-bar">
    <button id="btn-hangar" class="pill-btn accent-yellow">🚀 HANGAR: <span id="pill-ship-name">VIPER</span></button>
    <button id="btn-dossier" class="pill-btn">📊 DOSSIER &amp; LEAGUES</button>
    <button id="btn-fullscreen" class="pill-btn">⛶ FULLSCREEN</button>
    <button id="btn-rotate" class="pill-btn">🔄 ROTATE 90°</button>
    <button id="btn-audio" class="pill-btn">🔊 SFX ON</button>
    <span class="pill-stat" id="pill-fps">60 FPS</span>
  </div>

  <!-- SINGLE 1-LINE PRIZE TOAST (ABOVE RADAR AT bottom: 150px) -->
  <div id="prize-toast"></div>

  <!-- CONVERGENCE EMERGENCY BANNER -->
  <div id="convergence-banner">
    SECTOR INSTABILITY DETECTED. CONVERGENCE IN <span id="convergence-alert-sec">30</span>s.
  </div>

  <!-- COMPACT & UNOBTRUSIVE RESPAWN OVERLAY -->
  <div id="death-overlay">
    <div class="death-title">HULL DESTROYED // SAFE WARP</div>
    <div class="death-countdown" id="death-countdown-text">RESPAWNING IN 3.0s...</div>
  </div>

  <!-- LEFT FLIGHT STICK (BLUE - SNAP-BACK AUTO-BRAKE) -->
  <div id="left-stick-zone">
    <div id="left-stick-afterburner-ring"></div>
    <div id="left-stick-puck"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- RIGHT-HAND ERGONOMIC CIRCULAR BUTTON CLUSTER -->
  <!-- 1. Primary Red [FIRE] Stick (84px circle at right: 11vw, bottom: 28vh) -->
  <div id="btn-fire-stick">
    <span>FIRE</span>
  </div>

  <!-- 2. Amber/Yellow [BOMB] Stick (72px circle at right: 22vw, bottom: 21vh) -->
  <div id="btn-bomb-stick">
    <span class="btn-label-title" id="bomb-stick-title">BOMB</span>
    <span class="btn-label-cost" id="bomb-stick-cost">170E</span>
  </div>

  <!-- 3. Red/Crimson [BURST] Circle (60px circle at right: 21vw, bottom: 8vh) -->
  <div id="btn-burst-circle">
    <span class="btn-label-title">BURST</span>
    <span class="btn-label-cost" id="burst-circle-cost">1-180E</span>
  </div>

  <!-- 4. Blue [REPEL] Circle (60px circle at right: 13vw, bottom: 9vh) -->
  <div id="btn-repel-circle">
    <span class="btn-label-title">REPEL</span>
    <span class="btn-label-cost" id="repel-circle-cost">2-250E</span>
  </div>

  <!-- 5. Gold/Cyan [THOR] Circle (60px circle at right: 30vw, bottom: 13vh) -->
  <div id="btn-thor-circle">
    <span class="btn-label-title">THOR</span>
    <span class="btn-label-cost" id="thor-circle-cost">1-300E</span>
  </div>

  <!-- INTEGRATED BOTTOM-CENTER CONSOLE (RADAR + WINGS) -->
  <div id="bottom-center-console">
    <!-- Left Console Wing -->
    <div class="console-wing-left">
      <div id="btn-warp-safe" class="circular-console-btn" title="Emergency Warp to Safe Zone">
        <span>WARP</span>
        <span>SAFE</span>
      </div>
      <div class="console-readouts">
        <div class="console-row">
          <span class="console-lbl">SPEED</span>
          <span class="console-val" id="hud-speed">0 m/s</span>
        </div>
        <div class="console-row">
          <span class="console-lbl">SECTOR</span>
          <span class="console-val" id="hud-sector" style="color: var(--cyan);">C-3</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 130px Circular Radar Frame with Smart Elastic Panning -->
    <div id="radar-frame" title="Tactical Radar (Triangles = Humans, Circles = Bots)">
      <canvas id="radar-canvas" width="130" height="130"></canvas>
    </div>

    <!-- Right Console Wing -->
    <div class="console-wing-right">
      <div class="energy-large-box">
        <div class="console-lbl">ENERGY</div>
        <div class="energy-large-num" id="hud-energy-num">1150</div>
      </div>
      <div class="console-readouts" style="min-width: 58px;">
        <div class="console-row">
          <span class="console-lbl">BOUNTY</span>
          <span class="console-val" id="hud-bounty" style="color: var(--yellow);">100</span>
        </div>
        <div class="console-row">
          <span class="console-lbl">WARZONE</span>
          <span class="console-val" id="hud-queue-tag" style="color: var(--cyan);">10v10</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <!-- Circular [MULTI ON/OFF] Toggle Button -->
      <div id="btn-multi-toggle" title="Toggle Multifire Spread">
        <span>MULTI</span>
        <span id="multi-state-text">OFF</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- FOUNDRY HANGAR & MODE SELECTOR MODAL (4x2 GRID, FULLY VISIBLE, EDITABLE INPUTS) -->
  <div id="hangar-modal" class="modal-backdrop open">
    <div class="modal-card">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <span class="modal-title">⚙️ RIFT FOUNDRY HANGAR &amp; ARENA QUEUE SELECTOR</span>
        <span id="hangar-status-tag" style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--yellow); font-weight: 700;">READY FOR DEPLOYMENT</span>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-body">
        <div class="mode-selector-row">
          <div class="mode-tabs">
            <button class="mode-tab active" data-mode="warzone_10v10">🌐 10v10 WARZONE</button>
            <button class="mode-tab" data-mode="ranked_3v3">⚔️ 3v3 RANKED</button>
            <button class="mode-tab" data-mode="ranked_5v5">🛡️ 5v5 RANKED</button>
          </div>
          <div class="callsign-box">
            <span style="color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 10px;">TAG:</span>
            <input id="input-syndicate" class="callsign-input" type="text" maxlength="4" placeholder="NOVA" value="NOVA" style="width: 52px;" />
            <span style="color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 10px;">CALLSIGN:</span>
            <input id="input-callsign" class="callsign-input" type="text" maxlength="14" placeholder="COMMANDER" value="COMMANDER" style="width: 115px;" />
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- 4x2 GRID OF ALL 8 SHIPS -->
        <div id="ship-grid" class="ship-grid"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- PINNED FOOTER BAR (NEVER CLIPPED) -->
      <div class="modal-pinned-footer">
        <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-dim); max-width: 320px;">

  // ============================================================================
  // 2. WEB AUDIO SYNTHESIZER
  // ============================================================================
  class SoundEngine {
    constructor() {
      this.ctx = null;
      this.enabled = true;
    }

    init() {
      if (!this.ctx) {
        const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        if (AudioCtx) this.ctx = new AudioCtx();
      }
      if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === "suspended") {
        this.ctx.resume();
      }
    }

    playLaser(shipId) {
      if (!this.enabled) return;
      this.init();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = shipId === 1 ? "sawtooth" : "triangle";
      const baseFreq = shipId === 1 ? 950 : 680 - shipId * 25;
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(baseFreq, now);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(110, now + 0.11);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.11);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 0.11);
    }

    playBomb(type) {
      if (!this.enabled) return;
      this.init();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = type === "EMP" ? "sine" : "sawtooth";
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(type === "EMP" ? 540 : 260, now);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(50, now + 0.22);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.16, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.22);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 0.22);
    }

    playWallBounce(speedRatio = 0.6) {
      if (!this.enabled) return;
      this.init();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = "sine";
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(130, now);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(42, now + 0.08);
      const vol = Math.min(0.20, Math.max(0.04, speedRatio * 0.16));
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.08);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 0.08);
    }

    playWarp() {
      if (!this.enabled) return;
      this.init();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = "sine";
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(220, now);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(880, now + 0.25);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.25);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 0.25);
    }

    playPrize() {
      if (!this.enabled) return;
      this.init();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = "triangle";
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(523.25, now);
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(659.25, now + 0.06);
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(783.99, now + 0.12);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.2);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc.start(now);
      osc.stop(now + 0.2);
    }

    playExplosion() {
      if (!this.enabled) return;
      this.init();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime;
      const bufferSize = Math.floor(this.ctx.sampleRate * 0.35);
      const buffer = this.ctx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, this.ctx.sampleRate);
      const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
      for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
        data[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.exp(-i / (bufferSize * 0.32));
      }
      const noise = this.ctx.createBufferSource();
      noise.buffer = buffer;
      const filter = this.ctx.createBiquadFilter();
      filter.type = "lowpass";
      filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(400, now);
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.26, now);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 0.35);
      noise.connect(filter);
      filter.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      noise.start(now);
    }
  }

  const sfx = new SoundEngine();

  // ============================================================================
  // 3. AUTHENTIC 1997 SUBSPACE 3D METALLIC SPRITE BAKER (36x36px)
  // ============================================================================
  class SpriteBaker {
    constructor() {
      this.shipSprites = new Map();
      this.wallTile = this.bakeWallTile();
      this.hazardBorderTile = this.bakeHazardBorderTile();
      this.bakeAllShips();
    }

    bakeWallTile() {
      // 32x32 dark steel grid blocks divided into 4x4 metallic sub-panels (8x8px each)
      const c = document.createElement("canvas");
      c.width = 32;
      c.height = 32;
      const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
      for (let gy = 0; gy < 4; gy++) {
        for (let gx = 0; gx < 4; gx++) {
          const x = gx * 8;
          const y = gy * 8;
          const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x + 8, y + 8);
          grad.addColorStop(0, "#3E4C5E");
          grad.addColorStop(0.5, "#25303D");
          grad.addColorStop(1, "#141B24");
          ctx.fillStyle = grad;
          ctx.fillRect(x, y, 8, 8);

          ctx.strokeStyle = "#0E1520";
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.strokeRect(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, 7, 7);

          // Top/Left bevel highlight
          ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
          ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, 6, 1);
          ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, 1, 6);

          // Corner rivet
          ctx.fillStyle = "#8FA6BF";
          ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y + 2, 1, 1);
        }
      }
      return c;
    }

    bakeHazardBorderTile() {
      // Crisp 45° yellow-and-black hazard stripe border tile
      const c = document.createElement("canvas");
      c.width = 16;
      c.height = 16;
      const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
      ctx.fillStyle = "#111111";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 16, 16);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#FFE800";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0); ctx.lineTo(8, 0); ctx.lineTo(0, 8); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(8, 0); ctx.lineTo(16, 0); ctx.lineTo(0, 16); ctx.lineTo(0, 8); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(16, 8); ctx.lineTo(16, 16); ctx.lineTo(8, 16); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      return c;
    }

    bakeAllShips() {
      SHIP_ROSTER.forEach(ship => {
        const c = document.createElement("canvas");
        c.width = 72;
        c.height = 72;
        const ctx = c.getContext("2d");
        this.render3DMetallicShip(ctx, 36, 36, 26, ship);
        this.shipSprites.set(ship.id, c);
      });
    }

    render3DMetallicShip(ctx, cx, cy, r, ship) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(cx, cy);

      // Glowing engine plumes at rear
      const plumeGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-r * 0.75, 0, 1, -r * 0.75, 0, r * 0.55);
      plumeGrad.addColorStop(0, "#FFFFFF");
      plumeGrad.addColorStop(0.35, ship.color);
      plumeGrad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0, 245, 212, 0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = plumeGrad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(-r * 0.75, 0, r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // Multi-stop 3D metallic gradient
      const metalGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-r, -r * 0.8, r, r * 0.8);
      if (ship.foundry === "Aurelia") {
        metalGrad.addColorStop(0, "#FFF9C4");
        metalGrad.addColorStop(0.25, "#FFD54F");
        metalGrad.addColorStop(0.65, "#B58105");
        metalGrad.addColorStop(1, "#4E3200");
      } else if (ship.foundry === "Vortex") {
        metalGrad.addColorStop(0, "#B2EBF2");
        metalGrad.addColorStop(0.3, "#00ACC1");
        metalGrad.addColorStop(0.7, "#006064");
        metalGrad.addColorStop(1, "#002B2E");
      } else if (ship.foundry === "Rustweld") {
        metalGrad.addColorStop(0, "#FFCCBC");
        metalGrad.addColorStop(0.3, "#D84315");
        metalGrad.addColorStop(0.75, "#4E1A0C");
        metalGrad.addColorStop(1, "#210B05");
      } else {
        metalGrad.addColorStop(0, "#F1F5F9");
        metalGrad.addColorStop(0.28, "#94A3B8");
        metalGrad.addColorStop(0.72, "#334155");
        metalGrad.addColorStop(1, "#0F172A");
      }

      ctx.fillStyle = metalGrad;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#08101C";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.8;

      ctx.beginPath();
      switch (ship.id) {
        case 1: // Viper (Warbird Angular Needle Sniper)
          ctx.moveTo(r * 1.3, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.2, -r * 0.35);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.75, -r * 0.85);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.45, -r * 0.22);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.85, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.45, r * 0.22);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.75, r * 0.85);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.2, r * 0.35);
          ctx.closePath();
          break;
        case 2: // Ricochet (Javelin Pronged Strike Bomber)
          ctx.moveTo(r * 1.15, -r * 0.35);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.45, -r * 0.12);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.45, r * 0.12);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 1.15, r * 0.35);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.65, r * 0.92);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.85, r * 0.3);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.55, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.85, -r * 0.3);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.65, -r * 0.92);
          ctx.closePath();
          break;
        case 3: // Suppressor (Spider Gold Crescent Fighter)
          ctx.arc(0, 0, r * 0.95, -Math.PI * 0.75, Math.PI * 0.75, false);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-r * 0.25, 0, Math.cos(-Math.PI * 0.75) * r * 0.95, Math.sin(-Math.PI * 0.75) * r * 0.95);
          ctx.closePath();
          break;
        case 4: // Goliath (Leviathan Cathedral Dreadnought)
          ctx.moveTo(r * 1.15, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.55, -r * 0.65);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.3, -r * 0.95);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.95, -r * 0.55);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.7, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.95, r * 0.55);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.3, r * 0.95);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.55, r * 0.65);
          ctx.closePath();
          break;
        case 5: // Twinfang (Terrier Dual-Boom Gunner)
          ctx.moveTo(r * 1.15, -r * 0.45);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.25, -r * 0.18);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.75, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.25, r * 0.18);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 1.15, r * 0.45);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.8, r * 0.85);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.6, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.8, -r * 0.85);
          ctx.closePath();
          break;
        case 6: // Disruptor (Weasel EMP Stingray)
          ctx.moveTo(r * 1.2, 0);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.15, -r * 1.05, -r * 0.75, -r * 0.8);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.45, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.75, r * 0.8);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.15, r * 1.05, r * 1.2, 0);
          ctx.closePath();
          break;
        case 7: // Valkyrie (Lancaster X-Frame Gunship)
          ctx.moveTo(r * 1.0, -r * 0.72);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.3, -r * 0.18);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.92, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.3, r * 0.18);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 1.0, r * 0.72);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.25, r * 0.35);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.95, r * 0.8);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.55, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.95, -r * 0.8);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.25, -r * 0.35);
          ctx.closePath();
          break;
        case 8: // Manta (Shark Pincer Mine-Layer)
        default:
          ctx.moveTo(r * 1.15, -r * 0.38);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.35, -r * 0.12);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.35, r * 0.12);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 1.15, r * 0.38);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.15, r * 0.9);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.9, r * 0.6);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.6, 0);
          ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.9, -r * 0.6);
          ctx.lineTo(r * 0.15, -r * 0.9);
          ctx.closePath();
          break;
      }
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();

      // Recessed longitudinal groove highlight
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.0;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-r * 0.4, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(r * 0.65, 0);
      ctx.stroke();

      // Specular Cockpit Canopy
      const glassGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(r * 0.05, -r * 0.15, r * 0.35, r * 0.15);
      glassGrad.addColorStop(0, "#E0F7FA");
      glassGrad.addColorStop(0.3, ship.accent);
      glassGrad.addColorStop(1, "#006064");
      ctx.fillStyle = glassGrad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(r * 0.16, 0, r * 0.3, r * 0.14, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  const baker = new SpriteBaker();

  // ============================================================================
  // 4. ARENA MAP WITH RIVETED WALLS & SAFE ZONE PADS
  // ============================================================================
  const WORLD_SIZE = 4000;
  const CAMERA_SCALE = 0.65; // 0.65x Tactical Camera Scale

  class SectorMap {
    constructor() {
      this.seed = Math.floor(Date.now() / 3600000);
      this.walls = [];
      this.safeZone = { x: 1760, y: 1760, w: 480, h: 480 };
      this.greens = [];
      this.generate(this.seed);
    }

    seededRandom() {
      this.rngState = (this.rngState * 1664525 + 1013904223) % 4294967296;
      return this.rngState / 4294967296;
    }

    generate(seed) {
      this.seed = seed;
      this.rngState = seed >>> 0;
      this.walls = [];
      const B = 64;

      // Outer Arena Perimeter Walls
      this.walls.push({ x: 0, y: 0, w: WORLD_SIZE, h: B });
      this.walls.push({ x: 0, y: WORLD_SIZE - B, w: WORLD_SIZE, h: B });
      this.walls.push({ x: 0, y: B, w: B, h: WORLD_SIZE - B * 2 });
      this.walls.push({ x: WORLD_SIZE - B, y: B, w: B, h: WORLD_SIZE - B * 2 });

      // Center Base Trench Pillars
      const cx = WORLD_SIZE / 2;
      const cy = WORLD_SIZE / 2;
      this.walls.push({ x: cx - 440, y: cy - 440, w: 260, h: 64 });
      this.walls.push({ x: cx + 180, y: cy - 440, w: 260, h: 64 });
      this.walls.push({ x: cx - 440, y: cy + 376, w: 260, h: 64 });
      this.walls.push({ x: cx + 180, y: cy + 376, w: 260, h: 64 });

      this.walls.push({ x: cx - 440, y: cy - 376, w: 64, h: 200 });
      this.walls.push({ x: cx - 440, y: cy + 176, w: 64, h: 200 });
      this.walls.push({ x: cx + 376, y: cy - 376, w: 64, h: 200 });
      this.walls.push({ x: cx + 376, y: cy + 176, w: 64, h: 200 });

      // Symmetric Rogue-Like Sector Trenches
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
        const rx = 360 + Math.floor(this.seededRandom() * 1050);
        const ry = 360 + Math.floor(this.seededRandom() * 1050);
        const horizontal = this.seededRandom() > 0.5;
        const w = horizontal ? 256 : 64;
        const h = horizontal ? 64 : 256;

        this.walls.push({ x: rx, y: ry, w, h });
        this.walls.push({ x: WORLD_SIZE - rx - w, y: ry, w, h });
        this.walls.push({ x: rx, y: WORLD_SIZE - ry - h, w, h });
        this.walls.push({ x: WORLD_SIZE - rx - w, y: WORLD_SIZE - ry - h, w, h });
      }

      // 22 Spinning 3D Green Prize Crates
      this.greens = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
        this.spawnGreen();
      }

      this.bakeRadarBackground();
    }

    bakeRadarBackground() {
      const rw = 130;
      const rh = 130;
      const c = document.createElement("canvas");
      c.width = rw;
      c.height = rh;
      const rCtx = c.getContext("2d");
      const mapDrawSize = rw * 0.84;
      const originX = (rw - mapDrawSize) / 2;
      const originY = (rh - mapDrawSize) / 2;
      const scale = mapDrawSize / WORLD_SIZE;

      rCtx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.45)";
      rCtx.lineWidth = 1.2;
      rCtx.strokeRect(originX, originY, mapDrawSize, mapDrawSize);

      const sz = this.safeZone;
      rCtx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.15)";
      rCtx.fillRect(originX + sz.x * scale, originY + sz.y * scale, sz.w * scale, sz.h * scale);

      rCtx.fillStyle = "rgba(124, 155, 181, 0.45)";
      for (let i = 0; i < this.walls.length; i++) {
        const w = this.walls[i];
        rCtx.fillRect(originX + w.x * scale, originY + w.y * scale, Math.max(1.5, w.w * scale), Math.max(1.5, w.h * scale));
      }
      this.radarBg = c;
    }

    spawnGreen() {
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 25; attempt++) {
        const x = 180 + Math.random() * (WORLD_SIZE - 360);
        const y = 180 + Math.random() * (WORLD_SIZE - 360);
        if (!this.circleIntersectsWalls(x, y, 36)) {
          this.greens.push({
            x,
            y,
            spin: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
          });
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    circleIntersectsWalls(x, y, radius) {
      for (let i = 0; i < this.walls.length; i++) {
        const w = this.walls[i];
        const closestX = Math.max(w.x, Math.min(x, w.x + w.w));
        const closestY = Math.max(w.y, Math.min(y, w.y + w.h));
        const dx = x - closestX;
        const dy = y - closestY;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy < radius * radius) return true;
      }
      return false;
    }

    isInsideSafeZone(x, y) {
      const s = this.safeZone;
      return x >= s.x && x <= s.x + s.w && y >= s.y && y <= s.y + s.h;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // 5. WORLD STATE & ENTITIES
  // ============================================================================
  const BOT_CALLSIGNS = [
    "KESTREL_AI", "VOID_REAPER", "NOVA_PULSE", "IRON_VANGUARD", "AURELIA_07",
    "STAR_VIPER", "MANTA_ZERO", "CRESCENT_X", "ORBIT_HAWK", "ION_LANCE",
    "SOLAR_FANG", "GRAV_LOCK", "VECTOR_9", "HYPER_DRIFT", "APEX_RAIL",
    "CHRONO_WING", "NEBULA_SIX", "DARK_THOR", "PULSE_SPECTRE", "RIFT_WARDEN"
  ];

  const world = {
    map: new SectorMap(),
    mode: "warzone_10v10",
    teamSize: 10,
    scoreYellow: 0,
    scoreRed: 0,
    convergenceOverrideEndMs: null,
    convergenceAlertTriggered: false,
    ships: [],
    bullets: [],
    bombs: [],
    particles: [],
    shockwaves: [],
    floatingTexts: [],
    cloudLeaderboard: [],
    remotePilots: new Map(),
    leaderboardTab: "PVP"
  };

  // Load saved Callsign & Syndicate Tag from localStorage
  const savedSyndicate = localStorage.getItem("rift_syndicate") || "NOVA";
  const savedCallsign = localStorage.getItem("rift_callsign") || "COMMANDER";

  const playerStats = {
    userId: "local_pilot",
    syndicate: savedSyndicate,
    callsign: savedCallsign,
    preferredShipId: 1,
    pvpKills: 0,
    pvpDeaths: 0,
    pvpBountyPeak: 100,
    allTimeKills: 0,
    allTimeDeaths: 0,
    allTimeBountyPeak: 100,
    convergencesWon: 0
  };

  function createShipEntity({ id, callsign, syndicate, shipId, freq, isHuman, isLocalPlayer }) {
    const spec = SHIP_ROSTER.find(s => s.id === shipId) || SHIP_ROSTER[0];
    const spawnPos = getGateSpawnPosition(freq);
    return {
      id,
      callsign,
      syndicate: syndicate || "",
      shipId: spec.id,
      spec,
      freq, // 0 = Yellow Friendly, 1 = Red Enemy
      isHuman: !!isHuman,
      isLocalPlayer: !!isLocalPlayer,
      x: spawnPos.x,
      y: spawnPos.y,
      vx: 0,
      vy: 0,
      angle: freq === 0 ? 0 : Math.PI,
      radius: 20,
      energy: spec.maxEnergy,
      maxEnergy: spec.maxEnergy,
      bounty: 100,
      kills: 0,
      deaths: 0,
      gunTimer: 0,
      bombTimer: 0,
      empDisabledTimer: 0,
      respawnTimer: 0,
      deathX: spawnPos.x,
      deathY: spawnPos.y,
      afterburning: false,
      multifireOn: false,
      repels: spec.repels,
      mines: spec.mines,
      bursts: spec.bursts,
      thors: spec.thors,
      aiSeed: Math.random() * 100
    };
  }

  function getGateSpawnPosition(freq) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
      const baseX = freq === 0 ? 520 : WORLD_SIZE - 520;
      const baseY = WORLD_SIZE / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1400;
      const x = baseX + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 280;
      const y = Math.max(180, Math.min(WORLD_SIZE - 180, baseY));
      if (!world.map.circleIntersectsWalls(x, y, 36)) {
        return { x, y };
      }
    }
    return { x: WORLD_SIZE / 2, y: WORLD_SIZE / 2 };
  }

  let localPlayer = createShipEntity({
    id: "local_player",
    callsign: playerStats.callsign,
    syndicate: playerStats.syndicate,
    shipId: 1,
    freq: 0,
    isHuman: true,
    isLocalPlayer: true
  });

  function rebuildRosterForMode(mode) {
    world.mode = mode;
    world.teamSize = mode === "ranked_3v3" ? 3 : mode === "ranked_5v5" ? 5 : 10;

    const newShips = [localPlayer];
    let yellowCount = 1;
    let redCount = 0;

    world.remotePilots.forEach(rp => {
      if (rp.sectorId === mode && rp.id !== localPlayer.id) {
        newShips.push(rp);
        if (rp.freq === 0) yellowCount++;
        else redCount++;
      }
    });

    let botIdx = 0;
    while (yellowCount < world.teamSize) {
      const shipId = ((botIdx * 3) % 8) + 1;
      newShips.push(createShipEntity({
        id: "bot_y_" + botIdx,
        callsign: BOT_CALLSIGNS[botIdx % BOT_CALLSIGNS.length],
        shipId,
        freq: 0,
        isHuman: false,
        isLocalPlayer: false
      }));
      yellowCount++;
      botIdx++;
    }

    while (redCount < world.teamSize) {
      const shipId = ((botIdx * 5 + 1) % 8) + 1;
      newShips.push(createShipEntity({
        id: "bot_r_" + botIdx,
        callsign: BOT_CALLSIGNS[(botIdx + 7) % BOT_CALLSIGNS.length],
        shipId,
        freq: 1,
        isHuman: false,
        isLocalPlayer: false
      }));
      redCount++;
      botIdx++;
    }

    world.ships = newShips;
    document.getElementById("hud-queue-tag").textContent =
      mode === "ranked_3v3" ? "3v3" : mode === "ranked_5v5" ? "5v5" : "10v10";
  }

  function applyShipChange(ship, newShipId) {
    const spec = SHIP_ROSTER.find(s => s.id === newShipId) || SHIP_ROSTER[0];
    ship.shipId = spec.id;
    ship.spec = spec;
    ship.maxEnergy = spec.maxEnergy;
    ship.energy = spec.maxEnergy;
    ship.repels = spec.repels;
    ship.mines = spec.mines;
    ship.bursts = spec.bursts;
    ship.thors = spec.thors;
    ship.multifireOn = false;
    if (ship.isLocalPlayer) {
      playerStats.preferredShipId = spec.id;
      document.getElementById("pill-ship-name").textContent = spec.name.toUpperCase();
      updateDynamicButtonCluster();
      syncStatsToCloud();
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // 6. CLOUD BRIDGE & BROADCASTCHANNEL (DECOUPLED FROM GOOGLE ACCOUNT IDENTITY)
  // ============================================================================
  const bcChannel = typeof BroadcastChannel !== "undefined" ? new BroadcastChannel("rift_sector_sync_v1") : null;
  if (bcChannel) {
    bcChannel.onmessage = (ev) => {
      const msg = ev.data;
      if (!msg || msg.senderId === playerStats.userId) return;
      if (msg.type === "TELEMETRY") {
        upsertRemotePilot(msg.payload);
      }
    };
  }

  function upsertRemotePilot(p) {
    const id = "human_" + (p.userId || p.callsign);
    let ship = world.remotePilots.get(id);
    if (!ship) {
      ship = createShipEntity({
        id,
        callsign: p.callsign || "ALLY_PILOT",
        syndicate: p.syndicate || "",
        shipId: Number(p.shipId) || 1,
        freq: Number(p.freq) || 0,
        isHuman: true,
        isLocalPlayer: false
      });
      world.remotePilots.set(id, ship);
      rebuildRosterForMode(world.mode);
    }
    ship.sectorId = p.sectorId || "warzone_10v10";
    ship.callsign = p.callsign || ship.callsign;
    ship.syndicate = p.syndicate || ship.syndicate;
    ship.x = Number(p.x) || ship.x;
    ship.y = Number(p.y) || ship.y;
    ship.vx = Number(p.vx) || 0;
    ship.vy = Number(p.vy) || 0;
    ship.angle = Number(p.angle) || 0;
    ship.energy = Number(p.energy) || ship.maxEnergy;
    ship.bounty = Number(p.bounty) || 100;
  }

  window.onRiftCloudUpdate = function(rawJson) {
    try {
      const data = typeof rawJson === "string" ? JSON.parse(rawJson) : rawJson;
      if (!data) return;
      if (data.userId) playerStats.userId = data.userId;

      // DO NOT overwrite the player's custom local callsign or syndicate tag!
      if (data.dossier) {
        const d = data.dossier;
        playerStats.pvpKills = Math.max(playerStats.pvpKills, Number(d.pvpKills) || 0);
        playerStats.pvpDeaths = Math.max(playerStats.pvpDeaths, Number(d.pvpDeaths) || 0);
        playerStats.pvpBountyPeak = Math.max(playerStats.pvpBountyPeak, Number(d.pvpBountyPeak) || 100);
        playerStats.allTimeKills = Math.max(playerStats.allTimeKills, Number(d.allTimeKills) || 0);
        playerStats.allTimeDeaths = Math.max(playerStats.allTimeDeaths, Number(d.allTimeDeaths) || 0);
        playerStats.allTimeBountyPeak = Math.max(playerStats.allTimeBountyPeak, Number(d.allTimeBountyPeak) || 100);
        playerStats.convergencesWon = Math.max(playerStats.convergencesWon, Number(d.convergencesWon) || 0);
      }

      if (Array.isArray(data.leaderboard)) {
        world.cloudLeaderboard = data.leaderboard;
        if (document.getElementById("dossier-modal").classList.contains("open")) {
          renderLeaderboardTable();
        }
      }
      if (Array.isArray(data.remotePilots)) {
        data.remotePilots.forEach(rp => upsertRemotePilot(rp));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Cloud update parse warning:", e);
    }
  };

  function syncStatsToCloud() {
    const spec = localPlayer.spec;
    const fullCallsign = localPlayer.syndicate ? `[${localPlayer.syndicate}]${localPlayer.callsign}` : localPlayer.callsign;
    const payload = {
      callsign: fullCallsign,
      shipId: localPlayer.shipId,
      foundry: spec.foundry,
      mode: world.mode,
      pvpKills: playerStats.pvpKills,
      pvpDeaths: playerStats.pvpDeaths,
      pvpBountyPeak: playerStats.pvpBountyPeak,
      allTimeKills: playerStats.allTimeKills,
      allTimeDeaths: playerStats.allTimeDeaths,
      allTimeBountyPeak: playerStats.allTimeBountyPeak,
      convergencesWon: playerStats.convergencesWon
    };
    if (window.RiftCloudBridge && window.RiftCloudBridge.syncStats) {
      window.RiftCloudBridge.syncStats(JSON.stringify(payload));
    }
  }

  function syncTelemetryToCloud() {
    const fullCallsign = localPlayer.syndicate ? `[${localPlayer.syndicate}]${localPlayer.callsign}` : localPlayer.callsign;
    const payload = {
      userId: playerStats.userId,
      sectorId: world.mode,
      callsign: fullCallsign,
      syndicate: localPlayer.syndicate,
      shipId: localPlayer.shipId,
      freq: localPlayer.freq,
      x: Math.round(localPlayer.x * 10) / 10,
      y: Math.round(localPlayer.y * 10) / 10,
      vx: Math.round(localPlayer.vx * 10) / 10,
      vy: Math.round(localPlayer.vy * 10) / 10,
      angle: Math.round(localPlayer.angle * 100) / 100,
      energy: Math.round(localPlayer.energy),
      maxEnergy: Math.round(localPlayer.maxEnergy),
      bounty: Math.round(localPlayer.bounty)
    };
    if (bcChannel) {
      bcChannel.postMessage({ senderId: playerStats.userId, type: "TELEMETRY", payload });
    }
    if (window.RiftCloudBridge && window.RiftCloudBridge.syncTelemetry) {
      window.RiftCloudBridge.syncTelemetry(JSON.stringify(payload));
    }
  }

  setInterval(() => {
    if (localPlayer.respawnTimer <= 0) syncTelemetryToCloud();
  }, 2500);

  // ============================================================================
  // 7. INPUT CONTROLS & ERGONOMIC TOUCH HANDLERS
  // ============================================================================
  let isRotated90 = false;
  const appRoot = document.getElementById("app-root");

  function mapClientPoint(clientX, clientY) {
    if (!isRotated90) {
      return { x: clientX, y: clientY, w: window.innerWidth, h: window.innerHeight };
    }
    return {
      x: clientY,
      y: window.innerWidth - clientX,
      w: window.innerHeight,
      h: window.innerWidth
    };
  }

  const controls = {
    leftTouchId: null,
    leftOriginX: 0,
    leftOriginY: 0,
    leftMag: 0,
    leftAngle: 0,
    autoBraking: false,

    fireTouchId: null,
    fireOriginX: 0,
    fireOriginY: 0,
    firing: false,

    bombTouchId: null,
    bombOriginX: 0,
    bombOriginY: 0,
    bombAiming: false,
    bombMag: 0,
    bombAngle: 0
  };

  const leftZoneEl = document.getElementById("left-stick-zone");
  const leftPuckEl = document.getElementById("left-stick-puck");
  const btnFireEl = document.getElementById("btn-fire-stick");
  const btnBombEl = document.getElementById("btn-bomb-stick");
  const btnBurstEl = document.getElementById("btn-burst-circle");
  const btnRepelEl = document.getElementById("btn-repel-circle");
  const btnThorEl = document.getElementById("btn-thor-circle");

  function getElementCenterMapped(el) {
    const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cx = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
    const cy = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
    return mapClientPoint(cx, cy);
  }

  // TOUCH EVENT FIX: Ensure input text fields, buttons, and modals are NOT blocked!
  window.addEventListener("touchstart", (e) => {
    if (e.target.tagName === "INPUT" || e.target.tagName === "BUTTON" ||
        e.target.closest("input") || e.target.closest("button") ||
        e.target.closest(".modal-card") || e.target.closest(".modal-backdrop") ||
        e.target.closest("#top-pill-bar") || e.target.closest("#bottom-center-console")) {
      return;
    }
    sfx.init();

    for (let i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) {
      const t = e.changedTouches[i];
      const pt = mapClientPoint(t.clientX, t.clientY);

      // Check Circular Tactical Action Buttons
      if (btnBurstEl.classList.contains("visible")) {
        const bc = getElementCenterMapped(btnBurstEl);
        if (Math.hypot(pt.x - bc.x, pt.y - bc.y) <= 36) {
          activateUtility("BURST");
          continue;
        }
      }
      if (btnRepelEl.classList.contains("visible")) {
        const rc = getElementCenterMapped(btnRepelEl);
        if (Math.hypot(pt.x - rc.x, pt.y - rc.y) <= 36) {
          activateUtility("REPEL");
          continue;
        }
      }
      if (btnThorEl.classList.contains("visible")) {
        const tc = getElementCenterMapped(btnThorEl);
        if (Math.hypot(pt.x - tc.x, pt.y - tc.y) <= 36) {
          activateUtility("THOR");
          continue;
        }
      }

      // Check Amber/Yellow [BOMB] Stick
      if (btnBombEl.style.display !== "none" && controls.bombTouchId === null) {
        const sc = getElementCenterMapped(btnBombEl);
        if (Math.hypot(pt.x - sc.x, pt.y - sc.y) <= 44) {
          controls.bombTouchId = t.identifier;
          controls.bombOriginX = sc.x;
          controls.bombOriginY = sc.y;
          controls.bombMag = 0;
          controls.bombAngle = localPlayer.angle;
          controls.bombAiming = true;
          continue;
        }
      }

      // Check Primary Red [FIRE] Stick
      if (controls.fireTouchId === null) {
        const fc = getElementCenterMapped(btnFireEl);
        if (Math.hypot(pt.x - fc.x, pt.y - fc.y) <= 52 || (pt.x > pt.w * 0.58 && pt.y > pt.h * 0.45)) {
          controls.fireTouchId = t.identifier;
          controls.fireOriginX = fc.x;
          controls.fireOriginY = fc.y;
          controls.firing = true;
          const dx = pt.x - fc.x;
          const dy = pt.y - fc.y;
          if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 8) {
            localPlayer.angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
          }
          continue;
        }
      }

      // Left Quadrant Flight Stick
      if (controls.leftTouchId === null && pt.x <= pt.w * 0.52) {
        const lc = getElementCenterMapped(leftZoneEl);
        controls.leftTouchId = t.identifier;
        controls.leftOriginX = lc.x;
        controls.leftOriginY = lc.y;
        controls.autoBraking = false;
        updateLeftStick(pt.x, pt.y);
      }
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  window.addEventListener("touchmove", (e) => {
    if (e.target.tagName === "INPUT" || e.target.closest("input")) return;

    for (let i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) {
      const t = e.changedTouches[i];
      const pt = mapClientPoint(t.clientX, t.clientY);

      if (t.identifier === controls.leftTouchId) {
        updateLeftStick(pt.x, pt.y);
      } else if (t.identifier === controls.fireTouchId) {
        const dx = pt.x - controls.fireOriginX;
        const dy = pt.y - controls.fireOriginY;
        if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 4) {
          localPlayer.angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
        }
      } else if (t.identifier === controls.bombTouchId) {
        const maxR = 40;
        const dx = pt.x - controls.bombOriginX;
        const dy = pt.y - controls.bombOriginY;
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        controls.bombAngle = dist > 4 ? Math.atan2(dy, dx) : localPlayer.angle;
        controls.bombMag = Math.min(1, dist / maxR);
        localPlayer.angle = controls.bombAngle;
      }
    }
  }, { passive: true });

  function handleTouchEnd(e) {
    if (e.target.tagName === "INPUT" || e.target.closest("input")) return;

    for (let i = 0; i < e.changedTouches.length; i++) {
      const t = e.changedTouches[i];
      if (t.identifier === controls.leftTouchId) {
        // Snap stick to center and trigger smooth frame-rate independent retro-damping
        controls.leftTouchId = null;
        controls.leftMag = 0;
        controls.autoBraking = true;
        leftPuckEl.style.transform = "translate(0px, 0px)";
        leftPuckEl.classList.remove("afterburner");
      } else if (t.identifier === controls.fireTouchId) {
        controls.fireTouchId = null;
        controls.firing = false;
      } else if (t.identifier === controls.bombTouchId) {
        const fireAngle = controls.bombMag > 0.1 ? controls.bombAngle : localPlayer.angle;
        localPlayer.angle = fireAngle;
        fireSecondaryBomb(localPlayer);
        controls.bombTouchId = null;
        controls.bombAiming = false;
        controls.bombMag = 0;
      }
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener("touchend", handleTouchEnd, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener("touchcancel", handleTouchEnd, { passive: true });

  function updateLeftStick(px, py) {
    const maxR = 48;
    const dx = px - controls.leftOriginX;
    const dy = py - controls.leftOriginY;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    const clamped = Math.min(maxR, dist);
    const ang = dist > 2 ? Math.atan2(dy, dx) : localPlayer.angle;
    controls.leftAngle = ang;
    controls.leftMag = Math.min(1, dist / maxR);
    if (controls.leftMag > 0.08) {
      localPlayer.angle = ang;
    }
    leftPuckEl.style.transform = `translate(${Math.cos(ang) * clamped}px, ${Math.sin(ang) * clamped}px)`;
    if (controls.leftMag > 0.8) {
      leftPuckEl.classList.add("afterburner");
    } else {
      leftPuckEl.classList.remove("afterburner");
    }
  }

  // Mouse emulation for desktop/browser testing
  btnFireEl.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    sfx.init();
    controls.firing = true;
  });
  btnBombEl.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    sfx.init();
    controls.bombAiming = true;
    controls.bombAngle = localPlayer.angle;
  });
  window.addEventListener("mouseup", () => {
    if (controls.bombAiming) {
      fireSecondaryBomb(localPlayer);
      controls.bombAiming = false;
    }
    controls.firing = false;
  });

  // ============================================================================
  // 8. WEAPONS, ENERGY CAPACITOR & BOUNCE TRAJECTORY
  // ============================================================================
  function selfDrainEnergy(ship, cost) {
    // Self-drain floors at 1 Energy (cannot self-annihilate)
    ship.energy = Math.max(1, ship.energy - cost);
  }

  function firePrimaryGun(ship) {
    if (ship.respawnTimer > 0) return;
    const spec = ship.spec;
    const multifireMult = (ship.multifireOn && spec.hasMultifire) ? 1.85 : 1.0;
    const totalCost = spec.gunCost * multifireMult;
    if (ship.gunTimer > 0 || ship.energy <= totalCost) return;

    selfDrainEnergy(ship, totalCost);
    ship.gunTimer = spec.gunCooldown;
    if (ship.isLocalPlayer) sfx.playLaser(ship.shipId);

    const spreadCount = (ship.multifireOn && spec.hasMultifire) ? spec.gunSpread + 2 : spec.gunSpread;
    const arcStep = 0.14;
    const startOffset = -((spreadCount - 1) * arcStep) / 2;

    for (let i = 0; i < spreadCount; i++) {
      const a = ship.angle + startOffset + i * arcStep;
      const lateral = spreadCount === 2 ? (i === 0 ? -8 : 8) : 0;
      const bx = ship.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * 24 - Math.sin(ship.angle) * lateral;
      const by = ship.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * 24 + Math.cos(ship.angle) * lateral;

      world.bullets.push({
        ownerId: ship.id,
        ownerCallsign: ship.callsign,
        ownerIsHuman: ship.isHuman,
        freq: ship.freq,
        x: bx,
        y: by,
        vx: ship.vx * 0.35 + Math.cos(a) * spec.gunSpeed,
        vy: ship.vy * 0.35 + Math.sin(a) * spec.gunSpeed,
        damage: spec.gunDamage / (spreadCount > 1 ? 1.3 : 1),
        color: ship.freq === 0 ? spec.color : "#FF3B4E",
        life: 1.5,
        bouncesLeft: ship.shipId === 2 ? 1 : 0
      });
    }
  }

  function fireSecondaryBomb(ship) {
    if (ship.respawnTimer > 0) return;
    const spec = ship.spec;
    if (!spec.hasBomb && ship.thors <= 0) return;
    const cost = spec.hasBomb ? spec.bombCost : 300;
    if (ship.bombTimer > 0 || ship.energy <= cost) return;

    const isThor = !spec.hasBomb && ship.thors > 0;
    if (isThor) ship.thors--;

    selfDrainEnergy(ship, cost);
    ship.bombTimer = spec.hasBomb ? spec.bombCooldown : 1.2;
    if (ship.isLocalPlayer) {
      sfx.playBomb(spec.bombType);
      updateDynamicButtonCluster();
    }

    const speed = 640;
    world.bombs.push({
      ownerId: ship.id,
      ownerCallsign: ship.callsign,
      ownerIsHuman: ship.isHuman,
      freq: ship.freq,
      type: isThor ? "THOR" : spec.bombType,
      x: ship.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * 26,
      y: ship.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * 26,
      vx: ship.vx * 0.25 + Math.cos(ship.angle) * speed,
      vy: ship.vy * 0.25 + Math.sin(ship.angle) * speed,
      damage: isThor ? 980 : spec.bombDamage,
      bouncesLeft: isThor ? 0 : spec.bombBounces,
      passWalls: isThor,
      life: 2.6,
      radius: isThor ? 11 : 8
    });
  }

  function computeBounceTrajectoryPoints(ship, angle, maxSteps = 50) {
    const pts = [{ x: ship.x, y: ship.y }];
    let x = ship.x + Math.cos(angle) * 26;
    let y = ship.y + Math.sin(angle) * 26;
    const speed = 640;
    let vx = ship.vx * 0.25 + Math.cos(angle) * speed;
    let vy = ship.vy * 0.25 + Math.sin(angle) * speed;
    let bouncesLeft = Math.max(1, ship.spec.bombBounces || 2);
    const dt = 0.032;

    for (let s = 0; s < maxSteps; s++) {
      const nx = x + vx * dt;
      const ny = y + vy * dt;
      let hitWall = false;

      for (let i = 0; i < world.map.walls.length; i++) {
        const w = world.map.walls[i];
        if (nx >= w.x && nx <= w.x + w.w && ny >= w.y && ny <= w.y + w.h) {
          hitWall = true;
          const prevInX = x >= w.x && x <= w.x + w.w;
          if (!prevInX) vx = -vx * 0.85;
          else vy = -vy * 0.85;
          pts.push({ x, y, bounce: true });
          bouncesLeft--;
          break;
        }
      }

      if (!hitWall) {
        x = nx;
        y = ny;
      }
      if (bouncesLeft < 0) break;
    }
    pts.push({ x, y });
    return pts;
  }

  function activateUtility(utilName) {
    if (localPlayer.respawnTimer > 0) return;
    sfx.init();

    if (utilName === "REPEL" && localPlayer.repels > 0 && localPlayer.energy > 250) {
      localPlayer.repels--;
      selfDrainEnergy(localPlayer, 250);
      sfx.playWarp();
      world.shockwaves.push({ x: localPlayer.x, y: localPlayer.y, r: 12, maxR: 280, color: "#00F5D4" });
      const R = 280;
      world.ships.forEach(s => {
        if (s.id !== localPlayer.id && s.freq !== localPlayer.freq && s.respawnTimer <= 0) {
          const dx = s.x - localPlayer.x;
          const dy = s.y - localPlayer.y;
          const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          if (d > 1 && d < R) {
            const push = ((R - d) / R) * 680;
            s.vx += (dx / d) * push;
            s.vy += (dy / d) * push;
          }
        }
      });
      world.bullets.forEach(b => {
        if (b.freq !== localPlayer.freq) {
          const dx = b.x - localPlayer.x;
          const dy = b.y - localPlayer.y;
          const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          if (d > 1 && d < R) {
            b.vx = (dx / d) * 780;
            b.vy = (dy / d) * 780;
          }
        }
      });
      world.bombs.forEach(b => {
        if (b.freq !== localPlayer.freq) {
          const dx = b.x - localPlayer.x;
          const dy = b.y - localPlayer.y;
          const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          if (d > 1 && d < R) {
            b.vx = (dx / d) * 640;
            b.vy = (dy / d) * 640;
          }
        }
      });
    } else if (utilName === "BURST" && localPlayer.bursts > 0 && localPlayer.energy > 180) {
      localPlayer.bursts--;
      selfDrainEnergy(localPlayer, 180);
      sfx.playLaser(1);
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        const a = (i / 16) * Math.PI * 2;
        world.bullets.push({
          ownerId: localPlayer.id,
          ownerCallsign: localPlayer.callsign,
          ownerIsHuman: true,
          freq: localPlayer.freq,
          x: localPlayer.x + Math.cos(a) * 20,
          y: localPlayer.y + Math.sin(a) * 20,
          vx: Math.cos(a) * 920,
          vy: Math.sin(a) * 920,
          damage: 240,
          color: "#FFE800",
          life: 1.4,
          bouncesLeft: 2
        });
      }
    } else if (utilName === "THOR" && localPlayer.thors > 0 && localPlayer.energy > 300) {
      localPlayer.thors--;
      selfDrainEnergy(localPlayer, 300);
      sfx.playBomb("THOR");
      world.bombs.push({
        ownerId: localPlayer.id,
        ownerCallsign: localPlayer.callsign,
        ownerIsHuman: true,
        freq: localPlayer.freq,
        type: "THOR",
        x: localPlayer.x + Math.cos(localPlayer.angle) * 28,
        y: localPlayer.y + Math.sin(localPlayer.angle) * 28,
        vx: Math.cos(localPlayer.angle) * 720,
        vy: Math.sin(localPlayer.angle) * 720,
        damage: 1050,
        bouncesLeft: 0,
        passWalls: true,
        life: 2.8,
        radius: 12
      });
    }

    updateDynamicButtonCluster();
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // 9. NEWTONIAN PHYSICS (FRAME-RATE INDEPENDENT SNAP-BACK BRAKING)
  // ============================================================================
  const WALL_ELASTICITY = 0.65; // Elastic wall bounce with zero wall damage

  function resolveShipWallBounce(ship) {
    for (let i = 0; i < world.map.walls.length; i++) {
      const w = world.map.walls[i];
      const closestX = Math.max(w.x, Math.min(ship.x, w.x + w.w));
      const closestY = Math.max(w.y, Math.min(ship.y, w.y + w.h));
      const dx = ship.x - closestX;
      const dy = ship.y - closestY;
      const distSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;

      if (distSq < ship.radius * ship.radius) {
        const dist = Math.sqrt(distSq) || 0.001;
        const nx = dx / dist;
        const ny = dy / dist;
        const penetration = ship.radius - dist;
        ship.x += nx * (penetration + 0.5);
        ship.y += ny * (penetration + 0.5);

        const dot = ship.vx * nx + ship.vy * ny;
        if (dot < 0) {
          ship.vx = (ship.vx - 2 * dot * nx) * WALL_ELASTICITY;
          ship.vy = (ship.vy - 2 * dot * ny) * WALL_ELASTICITY;
          if (ship.isLocalPlayer) {
            const speedRatio = Math.hypot(ship.vx, ship.vy) / ship.spec.maxSpeed;
            sfx.playWallBounce(speedRatio);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  function spawnExplosion(x, y, color) {
    world.shockwaves.push({ x, y, r: 8, maxR: 140, color });
    if (world.particles.length > 80) {
      world.particles.splice(0, world.particles.length - 60);
    }
    const count = 18;
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const sp = 60 + Math.random() * 300;
      world.particles.push({
        x,
        y,
        vx: Math.cos(a) * sp,
        vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
        life: 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.45,
        maxLife: 0.8,
        size: 2.0 + Math.random() * 2.2,
        color: i % 2 === 0 ? color : "#FFE800"
      });
    }
  }

  // 1-LINE PRIZE TOAST ABOVE RADAR (MAX 1 AT A TIME)
  let prizeToastTimer = null;
  function showPrizeToast(msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById("prize-toast");
    if (!el) return;
    el.textContent = msg;
    el.style.display = "block";
    if (prizeToastTimer) clearTimeout(prizeToastTimer);
    prizeToastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      el.style.display = "none";
    }, 1500);
  }

  function applyProjectileDamage(target, attackerId, attackerCallsign, attackerIsHuman, damage, isEmp = false) {
    if (target.respawnTimer > 0) return;
    if (world.map.isInsideSafeZone(target.x, target.y)) return;

    if (isEmp) target.empDisabledTimer = 3.5;
    target.energy -= damage;

    if (target.energy <= 0) {
      target.energy = 0;
      target.respawnTimer = 3.0;
      target.deathX = target.x;
      target.deathY = target.y;
      target.deaths++;
      spawnExplosion(target.x, target.y, target.freq === 0 ? "#00F5D4" : "#FF3B4E");
      if (target.isLocalPlayer || attackerId === localPlayer.id) {
        sfx.playExplosion();
      }

      const attacker = world.ships.find(s => s.id === attackerId);
      const bountyGain = Math.max(25, Math.floor(target.bounty * 0.35));
      if (attacker) {
        attacker.kills++;
        attacker.bounty += bountyGain;
        attacker.energy = Math.min(attacker.maxEnergy, attacker.energy + 300);
      }

      if (target.freq === 0) world.scoreRed++;
      else world.scoreYellow++;

      // Small canvas floating text popup directly at world (x, y) coordinates
      world.floatingTexts.push({
        x: target.x,
        y: target.y,
        text: `+${bountyGain}`,
        color: attackerId === localPlayer.id ? "#00FF88" : "#FFE800",
        life: 1.1,
        maxLife: 1.1,
        vy: -32
      });

      if (attackerId === localPlayer.id) {
        playerStats.allTimeKills++;
        playerStats.allTimeBountyPeak = Math.max(playerStats.allTimeBountyPeak, localPlayer.bounty);
        if (target.isHuman) {
          playerStats.pvpKills++;
          playerStats.pvpBountyPeak = Math.max(playerStats.pvpBountyPeak, localPlayer.bounty);
        }
        syncStatsToCloud();
      } else if (target.isLocalPlayer) {
        playerStats.allTimeDeaths++;
        if (attackerIsHuman) playerStats.pvpDeaths++;
        syncStatsToCloud();
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // 10. AI BOT BEHAVIOR
  // ============================================================================
  function updateAiBot(bot, dt) {
    if (bot.respawnTimer > 0) return;

    let nearestEnemy = null;
    let nearestDist = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < world.ships.length; i++) {
      const other = world.ships[i];
      if (other.freq !== bot.freq && other.respawnTimer <= 0 && !world.map.isInsideSafeZone(other.x, other.y)) {
        const d = Math.hypot(other.x - bot.x, other.y - bot.y);
        if (d < nearestDist) {
          nearestDist = d;
          nearestEnemy = other;
        }
      }
    }

    let desiredAngle = bot.angle;
    if (nearestEnemy && nearestDist < 950) {
      const leadT = Math.min(0.8, nearestDist / bot.spec.gunSpeed);
      const tx = nearestEnemy.x + nearestEnemy.vx * leadT;
      const ty = nearestEnemy.y + nearestEnemy.vy * leadT;
      desiredAngle = Math.atan2(ty - bot.y, tx - bot.x);

      if (nearestDist < 680 && bot.energy > bot.maxEnergy * 0.28) {
        firePrimaryGun(bot);
      }
      if (bot.spec.hasBomb && nearestDist > 250 && nearestDist < 750 && bot.energy > bot.maxEnergy * 0.55) {
        fireSecondaryBomb(bot);
      }
    } else {
      const gx = WORLD_SIZE / 2 + Math.cos(performance.now() * 0.0004 + bot.aiSeed) * 900;
      const gy = WORLD_SIZE / 2 + Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.0005 + bot.aiSeed) * 900;
      desiredAngle = Math.atan2(gy - bot.y, gx - bot.x);
    }

    let diff = ((desiredAngle - bot.angle + Math.PI * 3) % (Math.PI * 2)) - Math.PI;
    bot.angle += Math.max(-bot.spec.turnSpeed * dt, Math.min(bot.spec.turnSpeed * dt, diff));
    bot.vx += Math.cos(bot.angle) * bot.spec.thrust * 0.72 * dt;
    bot.vy += Math.sin(bot.angle) * bot.spec.thrust * 0.72 * dt;
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // 11. THE CONVERGENCE (1-HOUR CYCLE WITH 30s ALERT)
  // ============================================================================
  function updateConvergenceClock() {
    const now = Date.now();
    let remainingSec;

    if (world.convergenceOverrideEndMs !== null) {
      remainingSec = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((world.convergenceOverrideEndMs - now) / 1000));
    } else {
      const secIntoHour = Math.floor((now / 1000) % 3600);
      remainingSec = 3600 - secIntoHour;
    }

    const banner = document.getElementById("convergence-banner");
    if (remainingSec <= 30 && remainingSec > 0) {
      banner.style.display = "block";
      document.getElementById("convergence-alert-sec").textContent = String(remainingSec);
      if (!world.convergenceAlertTriggered) {
        world.convergenceAlertTriggered = true;
      }
    } else {
      banner.style.display = "none";
    }

    if (remainingSec <= 0) {
      executeSectorConvergence();
    }
  }

  function executeSectorConvergence() {
    world.convergenceOverrideEndMs = null;
    world.convergenceAlertTriggered = false;
    document.getElementById("convergence-banner").style.display = "none";

    const winner = world.scoreYellow >= world.scoreRed ? "YELLOW TEAM" : "RED TEAM";
    if (world.scoreYellow >= world.scoreRed) playerStats.convergencesWon++;

    showPrizeToast(`👑 CONVERGENCE: ${winner} VICTORIOUS!`);
    sfx.playExplosion();

    world.map.generate(Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000));
    world.scoreYellow = 0;
    world.scoreRed = 0;
    world.bullets = [];
    world.bombs = [];

    world.ships.forEach(s => {
      const pos = getGateSpawnPosition(s.freq);
      s.x = pos.x;
      s.y = pos.y;
      s.vx = 0;
      s.vy = 0;
      s.bounty = 100;
      s.energy = s.maxEnergy;
      s.respawnTimer = 0;
    });

    syncStatsToCloud();
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // 12. SIMULATION UPDATE (FRAME-RATE INDEPENDENT NEWTONIAN BRAKING)
  // ============================================================================
  function updateSimulation(dt) {
    updateConvergenceClock();

    // Local player movement & afterburners
    if (localPlayer.respawnTimer <= 0) {
      localPlayer.afterburning = false;
      if (controls.leftMag > 0.08) {
        controls.autoBraking = false;
        const isAfterburner = controls.leftMag > 0.8 && localPlayer.energy > 12;
        const accel = localPlayer.spec.thrust * (isAfterburner ? 1.45 : controls.leftMag);
        localPlayer.vx += Math.cos(localPlayer.angle) * accel * dt;
        localPlayer.vy += Math.sin(localPlayer.angle) * accel * dt;

        if (isAfterburner) {
          localPlayer.afterburning = true;
          selfDrainEnergy(localPlayer, 185 * dt);
        }

        if (Math.random() < (isAfterburner ? 0.6 : 0.25)) {
          if (world.particles.length > 90) {
            world.particles.splice(0, 15);
          }
          const exAngle = localPlayer.angle + Math.PI + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.35;
          world.particles.push({
            x: localPlayer.x - Math.cos(localPlayer.angle) * 20,
            y: localPlayer.y - Math.sin(localPlayer.angle) * 20,
            vx: Math.cos(exAngle) * (isAfterburner ? 240 : 120),
            vy: Math.sin(exAngle) * (isAfterburner ? 240 : 120),
            life: isAfterburner ? 0.25 : 0.16,
            maxLife: 0.26,
            size: isAfterburner ? 3.2 : 2.0,
            color: isAfterburner ? "#FF9100" : "#00F5D4"
          });
        }
      } else if (controls.autoBraking) {
        // Authentic SubSpace gentle gliding auto-brake over ~2s using dt
        const brakeDamping = Math.pow(0.4, dt);
        localPlayer.vx *= brakeDamping;
        localPlayer.vy *= brakeDamping;
        if (Math.hypot(localPlayer.vx, localPlayer.vy) < 3.5) {
          localPlayer.vx = 0;
          localPlayer.vy = 0;
          controls.autoBraking = false;
        }
      }

      if (controls.firing) {
        firePrimaryGun(localPlayer);
      }
    }

    // Update all ships
    for (let i = 0; i < world.ships.length; i++) {
      const s = world.ships[i];

      if (s.respawnTimer > 0) {
        s.respawnTimer -= dt;
        if (s.respawnTimer <= 0) {
          s.respawnTimer = 0;
          const sz = world.map.safeZone;
          s.x = sz.x + 80 + Math.random() * (sz.w - 160);
          s.y = sz.y + 80 + Math.random() * (sz.h - 160);
          s.vx = 0;
          s.vy = 0;
          s.bounty = 100;
          s.energy = s.maxEnergy;
