        }
        continue;
      }

      if (!s.isHuman) {
        updateAiBot(s, dt);
      }

      if (s.gunTimer > 0) s.gunTimer = Math.max(0, s.gunTimer - dt);
      if (s.bombTimer > 0) s.bombTimer = Math.max(0, s.bombTimer - dt);
      if (s.empDisabledTimer > 0) {
        s.empDisabledTimer = Math.max(0, s.empDisabledTimer - dt);
      } else {
        const safeBonus = world.map.isInsideSafeZone(s.x, s.y) ? 2.5 : 1.0;
        s.energy = Math.min(s.maxEnergy, s.energy + s.spec.recharge * safeBonus * dt);
      }

      const maxSp = s.afterburning ? s.spec.afterburnerSpeed : s.spec.maxSpeed;
      const curSp = Math.hypot(s.vx, s.vy);
      if (curSp > maxSp) {
        s.vx = (s.vx / curSp) * maxSp;
        s.vy = (s.vy / curSp) * maxSp;
      }

      s.x += s.vx * dt;
      s.y += s.vy * dt;

      resolveShipWallBounce(s);

      // Collect Spinning 3D Green Prize Crates
      for (let g = world.map.greens.length - 1; g >= 0; g--) {
        const gr = world.map.greens[g];
        if (Math.hypot(s.x - gr.x, s.y - gr.y) < s.radius + 14) {
          world.map.greens.splice(g, 1);
          world.map.spawnGreen();
          s.bounty += 15;
          s.energy = s.maxEnergy;
          if (s.isLocalPlayer) {
            sfx.playPrize();
            const roll = Math.random();
            let prizeMsg = "FULL ENERGY // +15 BOUNTY";
            if (roll < 0.28) { s.repels = Math.min(5, s.repels + 1); prizeMsg = "PRIZE: +1 REPEL UNLOCKED"; }
            else if (roll < 0.56) { s.bursts = Math.min(3, s.bursts + 1); prizeMsg = "PRIZE: +1 BURST UNLOCKED"; }
            else if (roll < 0.84) { s.thors = Math.min(3, s.thors + 1); prizeMsg = "PRIZE: +1 THOR CORE UNLOCKED"; }
            showPrizeToast(prizeMsg);
            updateDynamicButtonCluster();
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Update Bullets
    for (let i = world.bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = world.bullets[i];
      b.life -= dt;
      if (b.life <= 0) {
        world.bullets.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      const nx = b.x + b.vx * dt;
      const ny = b.y + b.vy * dt;
      let hitWall = false;

      for (let wIdx = 0; wIdx < world.map.walls.length; wIdx++) {
        const w = world.map.walls[wIdx];
        if (nx >= w.x && nx <= w.x + w.w && ny >= w.y && ny <= w.y + w.h) {
          hitWall = true;
          if (b.bouncesLeft > 0) {
            b.bouncesLeft--;
            const prevInX = b.x >= w.x && b.x <= w.x + w.w;
            if (!prevInX) b.vx = -b.vx;
            else b.vy = -b.vy;
          } else {
            world.bullets.splice(i, 1);
          }
          break;
        }
      }
      if (hitWall) continue;
      b.x = nx;
      b.y = ny;

      // Check Ship Hit (Ships pass cleanly through each other, only hit projectiles)
      for (let sIdx = 0; sIdx < world.ships.length; sIdx++) {
        const s = world.ships[sIdx];
        if (s.id !== b.ownerId && s.freq !== b.freq && s.respawnTimer <= 0) {
          if (Math.hypot(s.x - b.x, s.y - b.y) < s.radius + 4) {
            applyProjectileDamage(s, b.ownerId, b.ownerCallsign, b.ownerIsHuman, b.damage);
            world.bullets.splice(i, 1);
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Update Bombs
    for (let i = world.bombs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const b = world.bombs[i];
      b.life -= dt;
      if (b.life <= 0) {
        world.bombs.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      const nx = b.x + b.vx * dt;
      const ny = b.y + b.vy * dt;
      let hitWall = false;

      if (!b.passWalls) {
        for (let wIdx = 0; wIdx < world.map.walls.length; wIdx++) {
          const w = world.map.walls[wIdx];
          if (nx >= w.x && nx <= w.x + w.w && ny >= w.y && ny <= w.y + w.h) {
            hitWall = true;
            if (b.bouncesLeft > 0) {
              b.bouncesLeft--;
              const prevInX = b.x >= w.x && b.x <= w.x + w.w;
              if (!prevInX) b.vx = -b.vx * 0.85;
              else b.vy = -b.vy * 0.85;
            } else {
              world.bombs.splice(i, 1);
              spawnExplosion(b.x, b.y, b.type === "EMP" ? "#B388FF" : "#FFB800");
            }
            break;
          }
        }
      }
      if (hitWall) continue;
      b.x = nx;
      b.y = ny;

      for (let sIdx = 0; sIdx < world.ships.length; sIdx++) {
        const s = world.ships[sIdx];
        if (s.id !== b.ownerId && s.freq !== b.freq && s.respawnTimer <= 0) {
          if (Math.hypot(s.x - b.x, s.y - b.y) < s.radius + b.radius) {
            applyProjectileDamage(s, b.ownerId, b.ownerCallsign, b.ownerIsHuman, b.damage, b.type === "EMP");
            spawnExplosion(b.x, b.y, b.type === "EMP" ? "#B388FF" : "#FFB800");
            world.bombs.splice(i, 1);
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Particles & Shockwaves
    for (let i = world.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = world.particles[i];
      p.life -= dt;
      if (p.life <= 0) {
        world.particles.splice(i, 1);
        continue;
      }
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
    }

    for (let i = world.shockwaves.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const sw = world.shockwaves[i];
      sw.r += 480 * dt;
      if (sw.r >= sw.maxR) world.shockwaves.splice(i, 1);
    }

    // Floating text popups (+50)
    for (let i = world.floatingTexts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const ft = world.floatingTexts[i];
      ft.life -= dt;
      ft.y += ft.vy * dt;
      if (ft.life <= 0) world.floatingTexts.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // 13. RENDERER (SUB-PANEL WALLS, 3D CRATES, RAZOR RINGS, 3D SPRITES)
  // ============================================================================
  const canvas = document.getElementById("game-canvas");
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const radarCanvas = document.getElementById("radar-canvas");
  const radarCtx = radarCanvas.getContext("2d");
  let wallPattern = null;
  let hazardBorderPattern = null;

  function resizeCanvas() {
    const w = isRotated90 ? window.innerHeight : window.innerWidth;
    const h = isRotated90 ? window.innerWidth : window.innerHeight;
    canvas.width = w;
    canvas.height = h;
    wallPattern = ctx.createPattern(baker.wallTile, "repeat");
    hazardBorderPattern = ctx.createPattern(baker.hazardBorderTile, "repeat");
  }
  window.addEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas);
  resizeCanvas();

  function getCameraCoordinates() {
    if (localPlayer.respawnTimer > 0) {
      return { x: localPlayer.deathX, y: localPlayer.deathY };
    }
    return { x: localPlayer.x, y: localPlayer.y };
  }

  function renderWorld() {
    const W = canvas.width;
    const H = canvas.height;

    // Pitch-black void with ZERO grid lines in open space
    ctx.fillStyle = "#000000";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    const cam = getCameraCoordinates();
    const camX = cam.x;
    const camY = cam.y;

    // Multi-layer parallax starfield
    const layers = [
      { factor: 0.12, count: 48, size: 1.2, color: "rgba(160, 205, 255, 0.42)" },
      { factor: 0.28, count: 36, size: 1.8, color: "rgba(220, 240, 255, 0.68)" },
      { factor: 0.52, count: 24, size: 2.3, color: "rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.75)" }
    ];

    layers.forEach((layer, lIdx) => {
      ctx.fillStyle = layer.color;
      for (let i = 0; i < layer.count; i++) {
        const sx = (((i * 397 + lIdx * 131) - camX * layer.factor) % W + W) % W;
        const sy = (((i * 613 + lIdx * 257) - camY * layer.factor) % H + H) % H;
        ctx.fillRect(sx, sy, layer.size, layer.size);
      }
    });

    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(W / 2, H / 2);
    ctx.scale(CAMERA_SCALE, CAMERA_SCALE);
    ctx.translate(-camX, -camY);

    // View frustum in world coordinates with generous margin for seamless scrolling
    const halfViewW = (W * 0.5) / CAMERA_SCALE + 64;
    const halfViewH = (H * 0.5) / CAMERA_SCALE + 64;
    const minX = camX - halfViewW;
    const maxX = camX + halfViewW;
    const minY = camY - halfViewH;
    const maxY = camY + halfViewH;

    // Subtle Safe Zone Pad (Dotted outline + corner brackets, NOT green graph paper)
    const sz = world.map.safeZone;
    if (sz.x + sz.w >= minX && sz.x <= maxX && sz.y + sz.h >= minY && sz.y <= maxY) {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.03)";
      ctx.fillRect(sz.x, sz.y, sz.w, sz.h);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.45)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.setLineDash([8, 6]);
      ctx.strokeRect(sz.x, sz.y, sz.w, sz.h);
      ctx.setLineDash([]);

      const bracketSize = 24;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#00F5D4";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sz.x, sz.y + bracketSize); ctx.lineTo(sz.x, sz.y); ctx.lineTo(sz.x + bracketSize, sz.y); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sz.x + sz.w - bracketSize, sz.y); ctx.lineTo(sz.x + sz.w, sz.y); ctx.lineTo(sz.x + sz.w, sz.y + bracketSize); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sz.x, sz.y + sz.h - bracketSize); ctx.lineTo(sz.x, sz.y + sz.h); ctx.lineTo(sz.x + bracketSize, sz.y + sz.h); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sz.x + sz.w - bracketSize, sz.y + sz.h); ctx.lineTo(sz.x + sz.w, sz.y + sz.h); ctx.lineTo(sz.x + sz.w, sz.y + sz.h - bracketSize); ctx.stroke();

      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.6)";
      ctx.font = "bold 14px monospace";
      ctx.fillText("SAFE ZONE // SHIP SWAP & REPAIR", sz.x + 90, sz.y + 24);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // 32x32 Riveted Metallic Walls with 45° Hazard Borders (culled to visible viewport)
    for (let i = 0; i < world.map.walls.length; i++) {
      const w = world.map.walls[i];
      if (w.x + w.w < minX || w.x > maxX || w.y + w.h < minY || w.y > maxY) continue;

      if (hazardBorderPattern) {
        ctx.fillStyle = hazardBorderPattern;
        ctx.fillRect(w.x - 4, w.y - 4, w.w + 8, w.h + 8);
      }

      ctx.fillStyle = wallPattern || "#2A3441";
      ctx.fillRect(w.x, w.y, w.w, w.h);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#647D98";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.strokeRect(w.x, w.y, w.w, w.h);
    }

    // Rotating 3D Diamond/Square Emerald-Green Crate (14x14px) with White Cross (+)
    const tNow = performance.now() * 0.0035;
    for (let i = 0; i < world.map.greens.length; i++) {
      const g = world.map.greens[i];
      if (g.x < minX - 20 || g.x > maxX + 20 || g.y < minY - 20 || g.y > maxY + 20) continue;

      const spin = tNow + g.spin;
      const cosS = Math.cos(spin);

      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(g.x, g.y);

      const cw = Math.max(4, Math.abs(cosS) * 14);
      const ch = 14;

      // Dark green beveled border
      ctx.fillStyle = "#004D20";
      ctx.fillRect(-cw / 2 - 1, -ch / 2 - 1, cw + 2, ch + 2);

      // Emerald green face
      ctx.fillStyle = "#00E676";
      ctx.fillRect(-cw / 2, -ch / 2, cw, ch);

      // Beveled inner highlight
      ctx.fillStyle = "#69F0AE";
      ctx.fillRect(-cw / 2 + 1, -ch / 2 + 1, cw - 2, 2);

      // Crisp bright white/mint cross (+)
      ctx.fillStyle = "#FFFFFF";
      const crossT = 2;
      ctx.fillRect(-crossT / 2, -ch / 2 + 2, crossT, ch - 4);
      ctx.fillRect(-cw / 2 + 2, -crossT / 2, cw - 4, crossT);

      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Aiming Guides & Bounce Trajectory Line
    if (localPlayer.respawnTimer <= 0) {
      if (controls.firing) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 59, 78, 0.4)";
        ctx.setLineDash([8, 8]);
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(localPlayer.x, localPlayer.y);
        ctx.lineTo(
          localPlayer.x + Math.cos(localPlayer.angle) * 520,
          localPlayer.y + Math.sin(localPlayer.angle) * 520
        );
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      if (controls.bombAiming && (localPlayer.spec.hasBomb || localPlayer.thors > 0)) {
        const pts = computeBounceTrajectoryPoints(localPlayer, localPlayer.angle);
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#FFE800";
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.setLineDash([10, 6]);
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {
          if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
          else ctx.lineTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.setLineDash([]);
        for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
          if (pts[i].bounce) {
            ctx.fillStyle = "#FF9100";
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(pts[i].x, pts[i].y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
          }
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }

    // Bullets
    for (let i = 0; i < world.bullets.length; i++) {
      const b = world.bullets[i];
      if (b.x < minX || b.x > maxX || b.y < minY || b.y > maxY) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 3.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Bombs
    for (let i = 0; i < world.bombs.length; i++) {
      const b = world.bombs[i];
      if (b.x < minX - 20 || b.x > maxX + 20 || b.y < minY - 20 || b.y > maxY + 20) continue;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(b.x, b.y);
      ctx.fillStyle = b.type === "EMP" ? "#B388FF" : b.type === "THOR" ? "#00F5D4" : "#FFB800";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(0, 0, b.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#FFFFFF";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // Ships + Razor-Sharp 1.5px Energy Capacitor Rings + Clean Bottom-Right Labels
    for (let i = 0; i < world.ships.length; i++) {
      const s = world.ships[i];
      if (s.respawnTimer > 0) continue;
      if (s.x < minX - 60 || s.x > maxX + 60 || s.y < minY - 60 || s.y > maxY + 60) continue;

      // Subtle velocity drift vector line
      const speed = Math.hypot(s.vx, s.vy);
      if (speed > 10) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.freq === 0 ? "rgba(0, 245, 212, 0.45)" : "rgba(255, 59, 78, 0.45)";
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + s.vx * 0.20, s.y + s.vy * 0.20);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      // Razor-Sharp 1.5px Energy Capacitor Ring (radius: 22px, ZERO BLUR)
      const ringRadius = 22;
      const energyRatio = Math.max(0.02, Math.min(1, s.energy / s.maxEnergy));

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, ringRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, ringRadius, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI * 2 * energyRatio);
      ctx.strokeStyle = s.isLocalPlayer ? "#00FF88" : s.freq === 0 ? "#00F5D4" : "#FF4444";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.stroke();

      // EMP disruption halo
      if (s.empDisabledTimer > 0) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#B388FF";
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.setLineDash([3, 3]);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, ringRadius + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.setLineDash([]);
      }

      // Pre-Rendered 3D Bitmap Ship Sprite (Scaled to 36x36px at 0.65x zoom)
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
      ctx.rotate(s.angle);
      const sprite = baker.shipSprites.get(s.shipId);
      if (sprite) {
        ctx.drawImage(sprite, -36, -36);
      }
      ctx.restore();

      // Compact crisp 11px monospace Callsign(Bounty) strictly to bottom-right (x + 18, y + 18)
      ctx.font = "bold 11px monospace";
      ctx.fillStyle = s.isLocalPlayer ? "#00FF88" : s.freq === 0 ? "#FFE800" : "#FF4444";
      const tag = s.syndicate ? `[${s.syndicate}]${s.callsign}(${s.bounty})` : `${s.callsign}(${s.bounty})`;
      ctx.fillText(tag, s.x + 18, s.y + 18);
    }

    // Particles & Shockwaves
    for (let i = 0; i < world.particles.length; i++) {
      const p = world.particles[i];
      if (p.x < minX || p.x > maxX || p.y < minY || p.y > maxY) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
      ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    for (let i = 0; i < world.shockwaves.length; i++) {
      const sw = world.shockwaves[i];
      if (sw.x < minX - sw.r || sw.x > maxX + sw.r || sw.y < minY - sw.r || sw.y > maxY + sw.r) continue;
      ctx.strokeStyle = sw.color;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - sw.r / sw.maxR);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sw.x, sw.y, sw.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    // Small canvas text popups (+50) at world explosion coordinates
    for (let i = 0; i < world.floatingTexts.length; i++) {
      const ft = world.floatingTexts[i];
      if (ft.x < minX || ft.x > maxX || ft.y < minY || ft.y > maxY) continue;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.font = "bold 13px monospace";
      ctx.fillStyle = ft.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, ft.life / ft.maxLife);
      ctx.fillText(ft.text, ft.x - 12, ft.y);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    ctx.restore();

    renderRadar(cam);
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // 14. 130px CIRCULAR RADAR (SMART ELASTIC PANNING, TRIANGLES & CIRCLES)
  // ============================================================================
  function renderRadar(focusPos) {
    const rw = radarCanvas.width;
    const rh = radarCanvas.height;
    radarCtx.clearRect(0, 0, rw, rh);

    radarCtx.fillStyle = "rgba(3, 12, 24, 0.94)";
    radarCtx.fillRect(0, 0, rw, rh);

    const normX = (focusPos.x / WORLD_SIZE) - 0.5;
    const normY = (focusPos.y / WORLD_SIZE) - 0.5;
    const mapDrawSize = rw * 0.84;
    const elasticShiftX = -normX * 22;
    const elasticShiftY = -normY * 22;
    const originX = (rw - mapDrawSize) / 2 + elasticShiftX;
    const originY = (rh - mapDrawSize) / 2 + elasticShiftY;
    const scale = mapDrawSize / WORLD_SIZE;

    // Blit pre-baked static radar map (zero array loop per frame)
    if (world.map.radarBg) {
      radarCtx.drawImage(world.map.radarBg, elasticShiftX, elasticShiftY);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < world.ships.length; i++) {
      const s = world.ships[i];
      if (s.respawnTimer > 0) continue;
      const sx = originX + s.x * scale;
      const sy = originY + s.y * scale;
      const color = s.isLocalPlayer ? "#00FF88" : s.freq === 0 ? "#FFE800" : "#FF3B4E";

      if (s.isHuman) {
        radarCtx.save();
        radarCtx.translate(sx, sy);
        radarCtx.rotate(s.angle);
        radarCtx.fillStyle = color;
        radarCtx.beginPath();
        radarCtx.moveTo(5.5, 0);
        radarCtx.lineTo(-4, -3.8);
        radarCtx.lineTo(-4, 3.8);
        radarCtx.closePath();
        radarCtx.fill();
        radarCtx.restore();
      } else {
        radarCtx.fillStyle = color;
        radarCtx.beginPath();
        radarCtx.arc(sx, sy, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        radarCtx.fill();
      }
    }
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // 15. DYNAMIC BUTTON CLUSTER & TELEMETRY UPDATES (ZERO DOM THRASHING)
  // ============================================================================
  const domHud = {
    energyNum: document.getElementById("hud-energy-num"),
    bounty: document.getElementById("hud-bounty"),
    speed: document.getElementById("hud-speed"),
    sector: document.getElementById("hud-sector"),
    deathOverlay: document.getElementById("death-overlay"),
    deathCountdown: document.getElementById("death-countdown-text"),
    bombTitle: document.getElementById("bomb-stick-title"),
    bombCost: document.getElementById("bomb-stick-cost"),
    burstCost: document.getElementById("burst-circle-cost"),
    repelCost: document.getElementById("repel-circle-cost"),
    thorCost: document.getElementById("thor-circle-cost")
  };

  const hudCache = {
    energy: -1,
    bounty: -1,
    speed: -1,
    sector: "",
    deathOverlayVisible: false,
    deathSec: -1,
    bombVisible: null,
    bombTitle: "",
    bombCost: -1,
    bombLowEnergy: null,
    burstCount: -1,
    burstLowEnergy: null,
    repelCount: -1,
    repelLowEnergy: null,
    thorCount: -1,
    thorLowEnergy: null
  };

  function updateDynamicButtonCluster() {
    const spec = localPlayer.spec;
    const canBomb = spec.hasBomb || localPlayer.thors > 0;

    // Pure gunships (1-Viper, 3-Suppressor, 5-Twinfang) NEVER show the Bomb button!
    if (!canBomb) {
      if (hudCache.bombVisible !== false) {
        btnBombEl.style.display = "none";
        hudCache.bombVisible = false;
      }
    } else {
      if (hudCache.bombVisible !== true) {
        btnBombEl.style.display = "flex";
        hudCache.bombVisible = true;
      }
      const bTitle = spec.bombType === "MINE" ? "MINE" : "BOMB";
      if (hudCache.bombTitle !== bTitle) {
        domHud.bombTitle.textContent = bTitle;
        hudCache.bombTitle = bTitle;
      }
      if (hudCache.bombCost !== spec.bombCost) {
        domHud.bombCost.textContent = `${spec.bombCost}E`;
        hudCache.bombCost = spec.bombCost;
      }
      const low = localPlayer.energy < spec.bombCost;
      if (hudCache.bombLowEnergy !== low) {
        btnBombEl.classList.toggle("low-energy", low);
        hudCache.bombLowEnergy = low;
      }
    }

    // Action buttons hidden when count is 0
    if (localPlayer.bursts > 0) {
      if (hudCache.burstCount !== localPlayer.bursts) {
        btnBurstEl.classList.add("visible");
        domHud.burstCost.textContent = `${localPlayer.bursts}-180E`;
        hudCache.burstCount = localPlayer.bursts;
      }
      const low = localPlayer.energy < 180;
      if (hudCache.burstLowEnergy !== low) {
        btnBurstEl.classList.toggle("low-energy", low);
        hudCache.burstLowEnergy = low;
      }
    } else if (hudCache.burstCount !== 0) {
      btnBurstEl.classList.remove("visible");
      hudCache.burstCount = 0;
    }

    if (localPlayer.repels > 0) {
      if (hudCache.repelCount !== localPlayer.repels) {
        btnRepelEl.classList.add("visible");
        domHud.repelCost.textContent = `${localPlayer.repels}-250E`;
        hudCache.repelCount = localPlayer.repels;
      }
      const low = localPlayer.energy < 250;
      if (hudCache.repelLowEnergy !== low) {
        btnRepelEl.classList.toggle("low-energy", low);
        hudCache.repelLowEnergy = low;
      }
    } else if (hudCache.repelCount !== 0) {
      btnRepelEl.classList.remove("visible");
      hudCache.repelCount = 0;
    }

    if (localPlayer.thors > 0) {
      if (hudCache.thorCount !== localPlayer.thors) {
        btnThorEl.classList.add("visible");
        domHud.thorCost.textContent = `${localPlayer.thors}-300E`;
        hudCache.thorCount = localPlayer.thors;
      }
      const low = localPlayer.energy < 300;
      if (hudCache.thorLowEnergy !== low) {
        btnThorEl.classList.toggle("low-energy", low);
        hudCache.thorLowEnergy = low;
      }
    } else if (hudCache.thorCount !== 0) {
      btnThorEl.classList.remove("visible");
      hudCache.thorCount = 0;
    }
  }

  function updateHudDOM() {
    const eNow = Math.round(localPlayer.energy);
    if (hudCache.energy !== eNow) {
      domHud.energyNum.textContent = String(eNow);
      hudCache.energy = eNow;
    }

    if (hudCache.bounty !== localPlayer.bounty) {
      domHud.bounty.textContent = String(localPlayer.bounty);
      hudCache.bounty = localPlayer.bounty;
    }

    const sp = Math.round(Math.hypot(localPlayer.vx, localPlayer.vy));
    if (hudCache.speed !== sp) {
      domHud.speed.textContent = `${sp} m/s`;
      hudCache.speed = sp;
    }

    const col = String.fromCharCode(65 + Math.min(7, Math.floor((localPlayer.x / WORLD_SIZE) * 8)));
    const row = 1 + Math.min(7, Math.floor((localPlayer.y / WORLD_SIZE) * 8));
    const sec = `${col}-${row}`;
    if (hudCache.sector !== sec) {
      domHud.sector.textContent = sec;
      hudCache.sector = sec;
    }

    // Compact death overlay
    if (localPlayer.respawnTimer > 0) {
      if (!hudCache.deathOverlayVisible) {
        domHud.deathOverlay.style.display = "flex";
        hudCache.deathOverlayVisible = true;
      }
      const roundedSec = Math.ceil(localPlayer.respawnTimer * 10) / 10;
      if (hudCache.deathSec !== roundedSec) {
        domHud.deathCountdown.textContent = `RESPAWNING IN ${roundedSec.toFixed(1)}s...`;
        hudCache.deathSec = roundedSec;
      }
    } else {
      if (hudCache.deathOverlayVisible) {
        domHud.deathOverlay.style.display = "none";
        hudCache.deathOverlayVisible = false;
        hudCache.deathSec = -1;
      }
    }

    updateDynamicButtonCluster();
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // 16. HANGAR MODAL (ALL 8 SHIPS VISIBLE IN 4x2 GRID) & LEADERBOARD
  // ============================================================================
  function buildHangarCards() {
    const grid = document.getElementById("ship-grid");
    grid.innerHTML = "";
    SHIP_ROSTER.forEach(ship => {
      const card = document.createElement("div");
      card.className = "ship-card" + (ship.id === localPlayer.shipId ? " selected" : "");
      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="ship-card-top">
          <canvas class="ship-preview-canvas" width="32" height="32" id="preview-ship-${ship.id}"></canvas>
          <div style="min-width: 0;">
            <div class="ship-foundry-tag">${ship.foundry}</div>
            <div class="ship-name">${ship.id}. ${ship.name}</div>
            <div class="ship-role">${ship.role}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="ship-desc-short">${ship.desc}</div>
        <div class="stat-mini-bars">
          <div class="stat-line"><span>NRG ${ship.maxEnergy}</span><div class="stat-bar-bg"><div class="stat-bar-fill" style="width:${Math.round((ship.maxEnergy/1850)*100)}%"></div></div></div>
          <div class="stat-line"><span>SPD ${ship.maxSpeed}</span><div class="stat-bar-bg"><div class="stat-bar-fill" style="width:${Math.round((ship.maxSpeed/550)*100)}%"></div></div></div>
        </div>
      `;
      card.addEventListener("click", () => {
        sfx.init();
        attemptInMatchShipSwitch(ship.id, true);
        document.querySelectorAll(".ship-card").forEach(c => c.classList.remove("selected"));
        card.classList.add("selected");
      });
      grid.appendChild(card);

      const pCanvas = card.querySelector("canvas");
      const pCtx = pCanvas.getContext("2d");
      baker.render3DMetallicShip(pCtx, 16, 16, 12, ship);
    });
  }

  function attemptInMatchShipSwitch(newShipId, fromHangarModal = false) {
    const atFullEnergy = localPlayer.energy >= localPlayer.maxEnergy * 0.98;
    const inSafe = world.map.isInsideSafeZone(localPlayer.x, localPlayer.y);
    const hangarOpen = document.getElementById("hangar-modal").classList.contains("open");

    if (fromHangarModal || hangarOpen || atFullEnergy || inSafe) {
      applyShipChange(localPlayer, newShipId);
      const statusTag = document.getElementById("hangar-status-tag");
      if (statusTag) {
        statusTag.textContent = `SELECTED: ${localPlayer.spec.name.toUpperCase()} (${localPlayer.spec.foundry.toUpperCase()})`;
      }
      showPrizeToast(`HULL SWAPPED TO ${localPlayer.spec.name.toUpperCase()}`);
    } else {
      showPrizeToast("MUST BE AT 100% ENERGY OR IN SAFE ZONE TO SWAP HULL!");
    }
  }

  function renderLeaderboardTable() {
    const summaryEl = document.getElementById("personal-dossier-summary");
    const displayCallsign = localPlayer.syndicate ? `[${localPlayer.syndicate}]${localPlayer.callsign}` : localPlayer.callsign;
    summaryEl.innerHTML = `
      <span>PILOT: <strong style="color:var(--yellow)">${displayCallsign}</strong></span>
      <span>⚔️ PVP: <strong style="color:var(--cyan)">${playerStats.pvpKills}K / ${playerStats.pvpDeaths}D</strong> (PEAK: ${playerStats.pvpBountyPeak})</span>
      <span>🌐 ALL-TIME: <strong>${playerStats.allTimeKills}K / ${playerStats.allTimeDeaths}D</strong> (PEAK: ${playerStats.allTimeBountyPeak})</span>
      <span>👑 CONVERGENCES: <strong style="color:var(--yellow)">${playerStats.convergencesWon}</strong></span>
    `;

    const rows = [];
    const seenIds = new Set();

    world.cloudLeaderboard.forEach(entry => {
      seenIds.add(entry.userId);
      rows.push({
        callsign: entry.callsign,
        isHuman: true,
        foundryHull: `${entry.foundry || "Kestrel"} #${entry.shipId || 1}`,
        kills: world.leaderboardTab === "PVP" ? entry.pvpKills : entry.allTimeKills,
        deaths: world.leaderboardTab === "PVP" ? entry.pvpDeaths : entry.allTimeDeaths,
        bounty: world.leaderboardTab === "PVP" ? entry.pvpBounty : entry.allTimeBounty
      });
    });

    if (!seenIds.has(playerStats.userId)) {
      rows.push({
        callsign: displayCallsign,
        isHuman: true,
        foundryHull: `${localPlayer.spec.foundry} / ${localPlayer.spec.name}`,
        kills: world.leaderboardTab === "PVP" ? playerStats.pvpKills : playerStats.allTimeKills,
        deaths: world.leaderboardTab === "PVP" ? playerStats.pvpDeaths : playerStats.allTimeDeaths,
        bounty: world.leaderboardTab === "PVP" ? playerStats.pvpBountyPeak : playerStats.allTimeBountyPeak
      });
    }

    if (world.leaderboardTab === "ALL") {
      world.ships.forEach(s => {
        if (!s.isHuman) {
          rows.push({
            callsign: s.callsign,
            isHuman: false,
            foundryHull: `${s.spec.foundry} / ${s.spec.name}`,
            kills: s.kills,
            deaths: s.deaths,
            bounty: s.bounty
          });
        }
      });
    }

    rows.sort((a, b) => (b.kills * 100 + b.bounty) - (a.kills * 100 + a.bounty));

    const tbody = document.getElementById("lb-tbody");
    tbody.innerHTML = rows.slice(0, 14).map((r, idx) => `
      <tr>
        <td>${idx + 1}</td>
        <td style="color:${r.isHuman ? 'var(--yellow)' : 'var(--text-dim)'}; font-weight:700;">${r.callsign}</td>
        <td>${r.isHuman ? '▲ HUMAN' : '● BOT'}</td>
        <td>${r.foundryHull}</td>
        <td style="color:var(--cyan); font-weight:800;">${r.kills}</td>
        <td>${r.deaths}</td>
        <td style="color:var(--yellow); font-weight:800;">${r.bounty}</td>
      </tr>
    `).join("");
  }

  // ============================================================================
  // 17. BUTTON WIRING & INPUT HANDLING
  // ============================================================================
  const inputSyndicate = document.getElementById("input-syndicate");
  const inputCallsign = document.getElementById("input-callsign");

  // Load from localStorage
  inputSyndicate.value = savedSyndicate;
  inputCallsign.value = savedCallsign;

  inputSyndicate.addEventListener("input", () => {
    const clean = inputSyndicate.value.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, "").slice(0, 4);
    localPlayer.syndicate = clean;
    playerStats.syndicate = clean;
    localStorage.setItem("rift_syndicate", clean);
    syncStatsToCloud();
  });

  inputCallsign.addEventListener("input", () => {
    const clean = inputCallsign.value.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9_\-]/g, "").slice(0, 14);
    if (clean) {
      localPlayer.callsign = clean;
      playerStats.callsign = clean;
      localStorage.setItem("rift_callsign", clean);
      syncStatsToCloud();
    }
  });

  document.getElementById("btn-hangar").addEventListener("click", () => {
    sfx.init();
    buildHangarCards();
    document.getElementById("hangar-modal").classList.add("open");
  });

  document.getElementById("btn-guest-bypass").addEventListener("click", () => {
    sfx.init();
    const randNum = Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000);
    const guestCall = "GUEST_" + randNum;
    const guestTag = "GUEST";
    localPlayer.syndicate = guestTag;
    localPlayer.callsign = guestCall;
    playerStats.syndicate = guestTag;
    playerStats.callsign = guestCall;
    localStorage.setItem("rift_syndicate", guestTag);
    localStorage.setItem("rift_callsign", guestCall);
    inputSyndicate.value = guestTag;
    inputCallsign.value = guestCall;

    document.getElementById("hangar-modal").classList.remove("open");
    showPrizeToast(`⚡ PLAYING AS GUEST: [${guestTag}] ${guestCall}`);
  });

  document.getElementById("btn-deploy").addEventListener("click", () => {
    sfx.init();
    const cleanTag = inputSyndicate.value.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, "").slice(0, 4);
    const cleanCall = inputCallsign.value.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9_\-]/g, "").slice(0, 14);
    if (cleanCall) {
      localPlayer.callsign = cleanCall;
      playerStats.callsign = cleanCall;
      localStorage.setItem("rift_callsign", cleanCall);
    }
    localPlayer.syndicate = cleanTag;
    playerStats.syndicate = cleanTag;
    localStorage.setItem("rift_syndicate", cleanTag);

    document.getElementById("hangar-modal").classList.remove("open");
    syncStatsToCloud();
    syncTelemetryToCloud();
  });

  document.querySelectorAll(".mode-tab[data-mode]").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      document.querySelectorAll(".mode-tab[data-mode]").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
      btn.classList.add("active");
      rebuildRosterForMode(btn.getAttribute("data-mode"));
    });
  });

  document.getElementById("btn-dossier").addEventListener("click", () => {
    sfx.init();
    renderLeaderboardTable();
    document.getElementById("dossier-modal").classList.add("open");
  });

  document.getElementById("btn-close-dossier").addEventListener("click", () => {
    document.getElementById("dossier-modal").classList.remove("open");
  });

  document.getElementById("tab-pvp-only").addEventListener("click", () => {
    world.leaderboardTab = "PVP";
    document.getElementById("tab-pvp-only").classList.add("active");
    document.getElementById("tab-all-time").classList.remove("active");
    renderLeaderboardTable();
  });

  document.getElementById("tab-all-time").addEventListener("click", () => {
    world.leaderboardTab = "ALL";
    document.getElementById("tab-all-time").classList.add("active");
    document.getElementById("tab-pvp-only").classList.remove("active");
    renderLeaderboardTable();
  });

  document.getElementById("btn-test-convergence").addEventListener("click", () => {
    world.convergenceOverrideEndMs = Date.now() + 30000;
    world.convergenceAlertTriggered = false;
    document.getElementById("dossier-modal").classList.remove("open");
  });

  document.getElementById("btn-warp-safe").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (localPlayer.respawnTimer > 0) return;
    sfx.playWarp();
    const sz = world.map.safeZone;
    localPlayer.x = sz.x + sz.w / 2;
    localPlayer.y = sz.y + sz.h / 2;
    localPlayer.vx = 0;
    localPlayer.vy = 0;
    showPrizeToast("⚡ WARPED TO SAFE ZONE");
    syncTelemetryToCloud();
  });

  document.getElementById("btn-multi-toggle").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!localPlayer.spec.hasMultifire) {
      showPrizeToast("MULTIFIRE NOT SUPPORTED ON THIS HULL");
      return;
    }
    localPlayer.multifireOn = !localPlayer.multifireOn;
    document.getElementById("btn-multi-toggle").classList.toggle("active", localPlayer.multifireOn);
    document.getElementById("multi-state-text").textContent = localPlayer.multifireOn ? "ON" : "OFF";
    showPrizeToast(`MULTIFIRE: ${localPlayer.multifireOn ? "ACTIVE" : "OFF"}`);
  });

  document.getElementById("btn-fullscreen").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
      document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(() => {});
    } else {
      document.exitFullscreen().catch(() => {});
    }
  });

  document.getElementById("btn-rotate").addEventListener("click", () => {
    isRotated90 = !isRotated90;
    appRoot.classList.toggle("rotated-90", isRotated90);
    resizeCanvas();
  });

  document.getElementById("btn-audio").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    sfx.enabled = !sfx.enabled;
    e.currentTarget.textContent = sfx.enabled ? "🔊 SFX ON" : "🔇 SFX OFF";
  });

  window.onRiftBackButton = function() {
    const dossier = document.getElementById("dossier-modal");
    const hangar = document.getElementById("hangar-modal");
    if (dossier.classList.contains("open")) {
      dossier.classList.remove("open");
    } else if (hangar.classList.contains("open")) {
      hangar.classList.remove("open");
    } else {
      buildHangarCards();
      hangar.classList.add("open");
    }
  };

  // FPS Counter
  let frameCount = 0;
  let lastFpsTime = performance.now();
  const fpsEl = document.getElementById("pill-fps");

  rebuildRosterForMode("warzone_10v10");
  updateDynamicButtonCluster();
  buildHangarCards();

  if (window.RiftCloudBridge && window.RiftCloudBridge.getCloudSnapshot) {
    try {
      window.onRiftCloudUpdate(window.RiftCloudBridge.getCloudSnapshot());
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Initial cloud snapshot error:", e);
    }
  }

  // 60FPS / 120Hz Adaptive Game Loop
  let lastTime = performance.now();
  let lastHudTime = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    const rawDt = (now - lastTime) / 1000;
    lastTime = now;
    const dt = Math.min(0.033, Math.max(0.001, rawDt));

    frameCount++;
    if (now - lastFpsTime >= 1000) {
      fpsEl.textContent = `${frameCount} FPS`;
      frameCount = 0;
      lastFpsTime = now;
    }

    updateSimulation(dt);
    renderWorld();

    // Throttle DOM HUD text updates to every 100ms to guarantee 60+ FPS
    if (now - lastHudTime >= 100) {
      updateHudDOM();
      lastHudTime = now;
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

```
package com.example

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.util.Log
import com.google.firebase.FirebaseApp
import com.google.firebase.appcheck.FirebaseAppCheck
import com.google.firebase.appcheck.debug.DebugAppCheckProviderFactory
import com.google.firebase.appcheck.recaptcha.RecaptchaAppCheckProviderFactory

private const val TAG = "AppCheckInit"

// App Check contract keys defined by the Firebase SDK and runtime harness.
private const val DEBUG_TOKEN_EXTRA = "FIREBASE_APPCHECK_DEBUG_TOKEN"
private const val DEBUG_STORE_PREFIX = "com.google.firebase.appcheck.debug.store."
private const val DEBUG_SECRET_KEY = "com.google.firebase.appcheck.debug.DEBUG_SECRET"
private const val RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY_RES = "recaptcha_site_key"

fun configureAppCheck(context: Context, intent: Intent?) {
  try {
    // 1. Ensure FirebaseApp is initialized before configuring App Check
    if (FirebaseApp.getApps(context).isEmpty()) {
      FirebaseApp.initializeApp(context)
    }

    if (BuildConfig.DEBUG) {
      // 2. Debug: Read debug token from launch Intent extra
      val debugToken = intent?.getStringExtra(DEBUG_TOKEN_EXTRA)

      if (!debugToken.isNullOrEmpty()) {
        val persistenceKey = FirebaseApp.getInstance().persistenceKey
        val prefs =
          context.getSharedPreferences(
            "$DEBUG_STORE_PREFIX$persistenceKey",
            Context.MODE_PRIVATE,
          )
        // CRITICAL: Use synchronous commit() so DebugAppCheckProviderFactory reads the token immediately.
        prefs
          .edit()
          .putString(DEBUG_SECRET_KEY, debugToken)
          .commit()
        Log.d(TAG, "App Check debug secret configured successfully.")
      } else {
        Log.w(TAG, "No debug token found in Intent extra.")
      }

      FirebaseAppCheck.getInstance().installAppCheckProviderFactory(
        DebugAppCheckProviderFactory.getInstance()
      )
      Log.d(TAG, "DebugAppCheckProviderFactory installed.")
    } else {
      // 3. Release: Look up recaptcha_site_key safely without throwing Resources.NotFoundException
      val resId =
        context.resources.getIdentifier(RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY_RES, "string", context.packageName)
      if (resId != 0) {
        val siteKey = context.getString(resId)
        if (siteKey.isNotBlank()) {
          FirebaseAppCheck.getInstance().installAppCheckProviderFactory(
            RecaptchaAppCheckProviderFactory.getInstance(siteKey)
          )
          Log.d(TAG, "RecaptchaAppCheckProviderFactory installed.")
        } else {
          Log.e(TAG, "recaptcha_site_key resource string is blank.")
        }
      } else {
        Log.e(TAG, "recaptcha_site_key string resource not found in package.")
      }
    }
  } catch (e: Exception) {
    Log.e(TAG, "Failed to initialize Firebase App Check", e)
  }
}

internal fun FirebaseAuth.authStateFlow(): Flow<FirebaseUser?> = callbackFlow {
  val listener = FirebaseAuth.AuthStateListener { auth -> trySend(auth.currentUser) }
  addAuthStateListener(listener)
  awaitClose { removeAuthStateListener(listener) }
}

}

class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {

    super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
    configureAppCheck(this, intent)
    enableEdgeToEdge()
    hideSystemBars()
    // P0: Native Landscape Enforcement (SCREEN_ORIENTATION_SENSOR_LANDSCAPE)
    requestedOrientation = ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_SENSOR_LANDSCAPE

    setContent {
      MyApplicationTheme {
        AppNavigation()
      }
    }
  }

  override fun onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus: Boolean) {
    super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus)
    if (hasFocus) {
      hideSystemBars()
    }
  }

  private fun hideSystemBars() {
    val windowInsetsController = WindowCompat.getInsetsController(window, window.decorView)
    windowInsetsController.systemBarsBehavior =
      WindowInsetsControllerCompat.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
    windowInsetsController.hide(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars())
  }
}

@Composable
fun AppNavigation(
  auth: FirebaseAuth = Firebase.auth,
) {
  val context = LocalContext.current
  val localPrefs = remember { LocalPilotPrefs(context) }
  val permanentDeviceUid = remember { localPrefs.getOrCreatePermanentDeviceUid() }

  val currentUser by auth.authStateFlow().collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = auth.currentUser)
  var isGuestMode by remember { mutableStateOf(localPrefs.isGuestBypassEnabled()) }
  var lastSeenBuild by remember { mutableIntStateOf(localPrefs.getLastSeenChangelogBuild()) }
  var showChangelogBeforeAuth by remember {
    mutableStateOf(lastSeenBuild < CURRENT_RIFT_BUILD_VERSION)
  }
  var manualChangelogOpen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
  val user = currentUser

  if (showChangelogBeforeAuth) {
    RiftChangelogModal(
      lastSeenBuild = lastSeenBuild,
      onAcknowledgeAndContinue = {
        localPrefs.setLastSeenChangelogBuild(CURRENT_RIFT_BUILD_VERSION)
        lastSeenBuild = CURRENT_RIFT_BUILD_VERSION
        showChangelogBeforeAuth = false
        manualChangelogOpen = false
      },
    )
  } else {
    Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
      if (user == null && !isGuestMode) {
        AuthScreen(
          onAuthSuccess = {},
          onPlayAsGuest = {
            localPrefs.setGuestBypassEnabled(true)
            if (localPrefs.getCallsign() == "COMMANDER") {
              localPrefs.setCallsign("GUEST_${(1000..9999).random()}")
            }
            isGuestMode = true
          },
          onOpenChangelog = { manualChangelogOpen = true },
        )
      } else {
        val uid = user?.uid ?: permanentDeviceUid
        val initialCallsign = localPrefs.getCallsign()

        key(uid) {
          RiftArenaScreen(
            currentUserId = uid,
            initialCallsign = initialCallsign,
            isGoogleAuthenticated = user != null,
            localPrefs = localPrefs,
            onOpenChangelog = { manualChangelogOpen = true },
          )
        }
      }

      if (manualChangelogOpen) {
        RiftChangelogModal(
          lastSeenBuild = lastSeenBuild,
          onAcknowledgeAndContinue = {
            localPrefs.setLastSeenChangelogBuild(CURRENT_RIFT_BUILD_VERSION)
            lastSeenBuild = CURRENT_RIFT_BUILD_VERSION
            showChangelogBeforeAuth = false
            manualChangelogOpen = false
          },
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
fun RiftArenaScreen(
  currentUserId: String,
  initialCallsign: String,
  isGoogleAuthenticated: Boolean,
  localPrefs: LocalPilotPrefs = LocalPilotPrefs(LocalContext.current),
  onOpenChangelog: () -> Unit = {},
) {
  val context = LocalContext.current
  val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
  val credentialManager = remember { CredentialManager.create(context) }

  val viewModel: RiftViewModel =
    viewModel(
      key = "${currentUserId}_$isGoogleAuthenticated",
      factory =
        viewModelFactory {
          initializer {
            val app =
              checkNotNull(this[APPLICATION_KEY]) {
                "APPLICATION_KEY missing from CreationExtras"
              }
            RiftViewModel(
              repository = RiftRepository(app),
              currentUserId = currentUserId,
              initialCallsign = initialCallsign,
              isGoogleAuthenticated = isGoogleAuthenticated,
            )
          }
        },
    )

  val dossierState by viewModel.dossierState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
  val leaderboardState by viewModel.leaderboardState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
  val sectorPilotsState by viewModel.sectorPilotsState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
  val cloudSyndicatesState by viewModel.cloudSyndicatesState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
  val sectorCommsState by viewModel.sectorCommsState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

  val nexusViewModel: NexusAiViewModel = viewModel(key = "nexus_$currentUserId")
  val nexusMessages by nexusViewModel.messages.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
  val nexusStreamState by nexusViewModel.streamState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
  val isNexusStreaming =
    nexusStreamState is NexusStreamState.Loading || nexusStreamState is NexusStreamState.Streaming

  val sfx = remember { RiftSoundSynthesizer() }
  var sfxEnabled by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
  var currentFps by remember { mutableIntStateOf(60) }
  var frameTick by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
  var toastMessage by remember {
    mutableStateOf<String?>("⚡ RIFT FFA ARENA ONLINE // 360° AIM & NAMED ARMADAS ACTIVE")
  }
  var toastVersion by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
  var unreadCommsCount by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }

  var bootToNexusHub by remember { mutableStateOf(localPrefs.getBootToNexusHub()) }
  var showStartupChangelogQuickJoin by remember {
    mutableStateOf(!localPrefs.getBootToNexusHub())
  }
  var activeModal by remember {
    mutableStateOf(if (localPrefs.getBootToNexusHub()) ActiveModal.NEXUS else ActiveModal.NONE)
  }
  var previousModalBeforeStore by remember { mutableStateOf(ActiveModal.DOSSIER) }
  var previousModalBeforeNexus by remember { mutableStateOf(ActiveModal.NONE) }
  var callsign by remember { mutableStateOf(localPrefs.getCallsign()) }
  var syndicateTag by remember { mutableStateOf(localPrefs.getSyndicateTag()) }
  var syndicateName by remember { mutableStateOf(localPrefs.getSyndicateName()) }
  var selectedShipId by remember { mutableIntStateOf(localPrefs.getPreferredShipId().coerceIn(1, 10)) }
  var selectedMode by remember { mutableStateOf("FFA") }
  var activeCustomSlotId by remember(currentUserId) {
    mutableStateOf(localPrefs.getActiveCustomSlotId(currentUserId))
  }
  var activeCustomSlot by remember(currentUserId, activeCustomSlotId) {
    val loaded = localPrefs.getCustomShipSlot(activeCustomSlotId, currentUserId)
    com.example.engine.RiftCodex.updateActiveCustomShipSlot(loaded)
    mutableStateOf(loaded)
  }
  var slot9BUnlocked by remember(currentUserId) {
    mutableStateOf(localPrefs.isCustomSlotUnlocked("Frame B", currentUserId))
  }
  var slot9CUnlocked by remember(currentUserId) {
    mutableStateOf(localPrefs.isCustomSlotUnlocked("Frame C", currentUserId))
  }
  var cameraZoom by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(localPrefs.getCameraZoom()) }
  var playfieldTextScale by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(localPrefs.getPlayfieldTextScale()) }
  var syndicateStatusBanner by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
  var armadaStatusBanner by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
  var friendsRefreshKey by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
  var syndicateChannelsRefreshKey by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
  var blockedPilotUids by remember(currentUserId) {
    mutableStateOf(localPrefs.getBlockedPilotUids())
  }
  var allTimePeakSnapshot by remember(currentUserId) {
    mutableStateOf(localPrefs.getAllTimePeakBountySnapshot(currentUserId))
  }
  var pvpPeakSnapshot by remember(currentUserId) {
    mutableStateOf(localPrefs.getPvpPeakBountySnapshot(currentUserId))
  }
  var syndicateHistory by remember(currentUserId) {
    mutableStateOf(localPrefs.getSyndicateServiceHistory(currentUserId))
  }

  // Syndicate Chat Messages State (starts clean; populated by real player Comms & Armada Recruit banners)
  val chatMessages = remember { mutableStateListOf<SyndicateChatMessage>() }

  val engine = remember {
    RiftGameEngine(
      sfx = sfx,
      onStatsUpdated = {},
      onPrizeToast = { msg ->
        toastMessage = msg
        toastVersion++
      },
      onArmadaTierKill = { tierSize, bounty ->
        localPrefs.recordArmadaTierStat(tierSize, 1L, bounty)
      },
    ).apply {
      pvpKills = localPrefs.getPvpKills()
      pvpDeaths = localPrefs.getPvpDeaths()
      pvpBountyPeak = localPrefs.getPvpBountyPeak()
      allTimeKills = localPrefs.getAllTimeKills()
      allTimeDeaths = localPrefs.getAllTimeDeaths()
      allTimeBountyPeak = localPrefs.getAllTimeBountyPeak()
      convergencesWon = localPrefs.getConvergencesWon()
      hvtEliminations = localPrefs.getHvtEliminations()
      greensCollected = localPrefs.getGreensCollected()
      xpFromBuffs = localPrefs.getXpFromBuffs(currentUserId).toFloat()
      xpFromDamage = localPrefs.getXpFromDamage(currentUserId).toFloat()
      xpFromAccuracy = localPrefs.getXpFromAccuracy(currentUserId).toFloat()
      xpFromBountyEarned = localPrefs.getXpFromBountyEarned(currentUserId).toFloat()
      xpFromBountyKilled = localPrefs.getXpFromBountyKilled(currentUserId).toFloat()
      pilotLevel = localPrefs.getPilotLevel(currentUserId)
      riftShards = localPrefs.getRiftShards(currentUserId)
      highestMilestoneLevelClaimed = localPrefs.getHighestMilestoneLevelClaimed(currentUserId)
      spentCustomizationPoints = localPrefs.getSpentCustomizationPoints(currentUserId)
      unlockedExtraSlots = localPrefs.getUnlockedExtraSlots(currentUserId)
      aiShipDesignTokens = localPrefs.getAiShipDesignTokens(currentUserId)
      this.cameraZoom = localPrefs.getCameraZoom()
      this.playfieldTextScale = localPrefs.getPlayfieldTextScale()

      localPlayer.callsign = callsign
      localPlayer.syndicateTag = syndicateTag
      val savedArmada = localPrefs.getActiveArmadaName()
      if (savedArmada.isNotEmpty()) {
        formOrJoinArmada(savedArmada, localPrefs.getFriendsList().take(2))
      }
      switchLocalPlayerShip(selectedShipId, forceFromHangar = true)
      rebuildRosterForMode(selectedMode)
    }
  }

  // Bind engine stats callback to persist locally and sync to cloud
  DisposableEffect(engine, viewModel) {
    engine.onStatsUpdated = {
      localPrefs.setActiveArmadaName(engine.activeArmadaName)
      localPrefs.saveCombatStats(
        pvpKills = engine.pvpKills,
        pvpDeaths = engine.pvpDeaths,
        pvpBountyPeak = engine.pvpBountyPeak,
        allTimeKills = engine.allTimeKills,
        allTimeDeaths = engine.allTimeDeaths,
        allTimeBountyPeak = engine.allTimeBountyPeak,
        convergencesWon = engine.convergencesWon,
        hvtEliminations = engine.hvtEliminations,
        greensCollected = engine.greensCollected,
      )
      localPrefs.savePilotProgression(
        uid = currentUserId,
        xpFromBuffs = engine.xpFromBuffs.toLong(),
        xpFromDamage = engine.xpFromDamage.toLong(),
        xpFromAccuracy = engine.xpFromAccuracy.toLong(),
        xpFromBountyEarned = engine.xpFromBountyEarned.toLong(),
        xpFromBountyKilled = engine.xpFromBountyKilled.toLong(),
        riftShards = engine.riftShards,
        highestMilestoneLevelClaimed = engine.highestMilestoneLevelClaimed,
      )
      localPrefs.setSpentCustomizationPoints(engine.spentCustomizationPoints, currentUserId)
      localPrefs.setUnlockedExtraSlots(engine.unlockedExtraSlots, currentUserId)
      localPrefs.setAiShipDesignTokens(engine.aiShipDesignTokens, currentUserId)
      if (engine.localPlayer.respawnTimer <= 0f) {
        localPrefs.maybeRecordPeakBountySnapshot(
          snapshot = engine.currentLifeStats.toSnapshot(),
          hadPvp = engine.currentLifeHadPvp,
          isFinalizedLifeEnd = false,
          uid = currentUserId,
        )
        allTimePeakSnapshot = localPrefs.getAllTimePeakBountySnapshot(currentUserId)
        pvpPeakSnapshot = localPrefs.getPvpPeakBountySnapshot(currentUserId)
      }
      if (isGoogleAuthenticated) {
        viewModel.syncNativePilotStats(
          callsign = engine.localPlayer.callsign,
          shipId = engine.localPlayer.shipId,
          foundry = engine.localPlayer.spec.role,
          mode = engine.mode,
          pvpKills = engine.pvpKills,
          pvpDeaths = engine.pvpDeaths,
          pvpBountyPeak = engine.pvpBountyPeak,
          allTimeKills = engine.allTimeKills,
          allTimeDeaths = engine.allTimeDeaths,
          allTimeBountyPeak = engine.allTimeBountyPeak,
          convergencesWon = engine.convergencesWon,
          syndicateTag = engine.localPlayer.syndicateTag,
          armadaTag = engine.activeArmadaName.ifBlank { "SOLO" },
          armadaTierSize = engine.getCurrentArmadaSize(),
        )
      }
      frameTick++
    }
    engine.onLifeRunEnded = { finalizedSnapshot, hadPvp ->
      localPrefs.maybeRecordPeakBountySnapshot(
        snapshot = finalizedSnapshot,
        hadPvp = hadPvp,
        isFinalizedLifeEnd = true,
        uid = currentUserId,
      )
      allTimePeakSnapshot = localPrefs.getAllTimePeakBountySnapshot(currentUserId)
      pvpPeakSnapshot = localPrefs.getPvpPeakBountySnapshot(currentUserId)
    }
    engine.onSyndicateContribution = { killsDelta, currentBounty, winsDelta ->
      localPrefs.recordSyndicateContribution(
        addKills = killsDelta,
        currentBounty = currentBounty,
        addPublicWins = winsDelta,
        uid = currentUserId,
      )
      syndicateHistory = localPrefs.getSyndicateServiceHistory(currentUserId)
    }
    engine.onSyndicateWarFinished = { won, delta ->
      localPrefs.recordSyndicateWarOutcome(syndicateTag, won, delta)
      syndicateChannelsRefreshKey++
    }
    onDispose {
      sfx.release()
    }
  }

  // Load persisted HUD layout offsets, Calibration overrides, and AI-Forged Buffs on startup
  LaunchedEffect(Unit) {
    com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.loadPersistedLayout(context)
    com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine, null)
  }

  // P1: Non-Blocking Tactical Toasts auto-fade after 1.5s
  LaunchedEffect(toastVersion) {
    if (toastMessage != null) {
      delay(1500L)
      toastMessage = null
    }
  }

  // Sync cloud dossier if higher than local stats
  LaunchedEffect(dossierState) {
    val cloudDossier = (dossierState as? UiState.Success)?.data ?: return@LaunchedEffect
    if (cloudDossier.allTimeKills > engine.allTimeKills) {
      engine.allTimeKills = cloudDossier.allTimeKills
      engine.allTimeDeaths = cloudDossier.allTimeDeaths
      engine.allTimeBountyPeak = cloudDossier.allTimeBountyPeak
      engine.pvpKills = cloudDossier.pvpKills
      engine.pvpDeaths = cloudDossier.pvpDeaths
      engine.pvpBountyPeak = cloudDossier.pvpBountyPeak
      engine.convergencesWon = cloudDossier.convergencesWon
    }
  }

  // Push remote sector pilots from Firestore into engine
  LaunchedEffect(sectorPilotsState) {
    val remoteList = (sectorPilotsState as? UiState.Success)?.data ?: return@LaunchedEffect
    engine.updateRemotePilots(remoteList, currentUserId)
  }

  // Merge cloud-registered Syndicates across devices
  LaunchedEffect(cloudSyndicatesState) {
    val cloudList = (cloudSyndicatesState as? UiState.Success)?.data ?: return@LaunchedEffect
    localPrefs.mergeCloudSyndicates(cloudList)
  }

  // Merge live Sector Comms & Armada Recruit Banners across devices
  LaunchedEffect(sectorCommsState) {
    val remoteComms = (sectorCommsState as? UiState.Success)?.data ?: return@LaunchedEffect
    val existingIds = chatMessages.map { it.id }.toSet()
    var newIncomingCount = 0
    for (msg in remoteComms) {
      if (msg.id.isNotEmpty() && msg.id !in existingIds) {
        chatMessages.add(msg)
        if (msg.senderUid != currentUserId && activeModal != ActiveModal.CHAT) {
          newIncomingCount++
        }
      }
    }
    if (newIncomingCount > 0) {
      unreadCommsCount += newIncomingCount
    }
  }

  // Live telemetry heartbeat for Google Authenticated sessions
  LaunchedEffect(currentUserId, isGoogleAuthenticated) {
    if (!isGoogleAuthenticated) return@LaunchedEffect
    while (true) {
      delay(350L)
      val p = engine.localPlayer
      viewModel.syncNativeLiveState(
        sectorId = engine.mode,
        callsign = p.callsign,
        syndicateTag = p.syndicateTag,
        armadaName = p.armadaName,
        shipId = p.shipId,
        freq = p.freq,
        x = p.x,
        y = p.y,
        vx = p.vx,
        vy = p.vy,
        angle = p.angle,
        weaponAngle = p.weaponAngle,
        isFiringPrimary = engine.fireStickActive && !engine.isCancelActive && p.canFire,
        isAfterburning = p.afterburning,
        isCloaked = p.isCloaked,
        flux = p.flux,
        maxFlux = p.maxFlux,
        bounty = p.bounty,
      )
    }
  }

  var arenaViewRef by remember { mutableStateOf<RiftArenaView?>(null) }
  val topNavModals = remember {
    listOf(
      ActiveModal.HANGAR,
      ActiveModal.CODEX,
      ActiveModal.SYNDICATES,
      ActiveModal.ARMADA,
      ActiveModal.CHAT,
      ActiveModal.DOSSIER,
      ActiveModal.SETTINGS,
    )
  }

  LaunchedEffect(activeModal, com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.isCalibrationModalOpen) {
    if (
      activeModal == ActiveModal.NONE &&
        !com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.isCalibrationModalOpen
    ) {
      arenaViewRef?.requestFocus()
    }
  }

  BackHandler {
    if (com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.isCalibrationModalOpen) {
      com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.isCalibrationModalOpen = false
    } else if (activeModal == ActiveModal.NEXUS) {
      activeModal = previousModalBeforeNexus
      previousModalBeforeNexus = ActiveModal.NONE
    } else if (activeModal != ActiveModal.NONE) {
      activeModal = ActiveModal.NONE
    } else {
      activeModal = ActiveModal.HANGAR
    }
  }

  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        .background(Color.Black)
        .onPreviewKeyEvent { keyEvent ->
          val native = keyEvent.nativeKeyEvent
          if (native.action == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN && native.repeatCount == 0) {
            when (native.keyCode) {
              KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_START -> {
                com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.gamepadConnected = true
                activeModal =
                  if (activeModal == ActiveModal.HANGAR) ActiveModal.NONE else ActiveModal.HANGAR
                sfx.playMutedClick()
                true
              }

              KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_SELECT -> {
                com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.gamepadConnected = true
                com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.isCalibrationModalOpen =
                  !com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.isCalibrationModalOpen
                sfx.playMutedClick()
                true
              }

              KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L1 -> {
                if (activeModal != ActiveModal.NONE) {
                  com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.gamepadConnected = true
                  val curIdx = topNavModals.indexOf(activeModal)
                  val nextIdx =
                    if (curIdx <= 0) topNavModals.lastIndex else curIdx - 1
                  val nextModal = topNavModals[nextIdx]
                  if (nextModal == ActiveModal.CHAT) unreadCommsCount = 0
                  activeModal = nextModal
                  sfx.playMutedClick()
                  true
                } else {
                  false
                }
              }

              KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R1 -> {
                if (activeModal != ActiveModal.NONE) {
                  com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.gamepadConnected = true
                  val curIdx = topNavModals.indexOf(activeModal)
                  val nextIdx =
                    if (curIdx < 0 || curIdx >= topNavModals.lastIndex) 0 else curIdx + 1
                  val nextModal = topNavModals[nextIdx]
                  if (nextModal == ActiveModal.CHAT) unreadCommsCount = 0
                  activeModal = nextModal
                  sfx.playMutedClick()
                  true
                } else {
                  false
                }
              }

              KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_B -> {
                if (com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.isCalibrationModalOpen) {
                  com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.gamepadConnected = true
                  com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.isCalibrationModalOpen = false
                  sfx.playMutedClick()
                  true
                } else if (
                  activeModal != ActiveModal.NONE && activeModal != ActiveModal.HANGAR
                ) {
                  com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.gamepadConnected = true
                  if (activeModal == ActiveModal.NEXUS) {
                    activeModal = previousModalBeforeNexus
                    previousModalBeforeNexus = ActiveModal.NONE
                  } else if (activeModal == ActiveModal.RIFT_SHARDS_STORE) {
                    activeModal = previousModalBeforeStore
                  } else {
                    activeModal = ActiveModal.NONE
                  }
                  sfx.playMutedClick()
                  true
                } else {
                  false
                }
              }

              else -> false
            }
          } else {
            false
          }
        }
        .onKeyEvent { keyEvent ->
          val native = keyEvent.nativeKeyEvent
          if (
            native.action == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN &&
              native.repeatCount == 0 &&
              native.keyCode == KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_B &&
              activeModal != ActiveModal.NONE
          ) {
            com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.gamepadConnected = true
            activeModal = ActiveModal.NONE
            sfx.playMutedClick()
            true
          } else {
            false
          }
        }
        .testTag("rift_arena_native_container")
  ) {
    // 1. High-Performance 60+ FPS Native Canvas View
    AndroidView(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().testTag("rift_arena_canvas_view"),
      factory = { ctx ->
        RiftArenaView(
          context = ctx,
          engine = engine,
          onHudTelemetryTick = { fps ->
            currentFps = fps
            frameTick++
          },
          onGamepadCycleCameraZoom = { deltaSteps ->
            val nextZoom = (cameraZoom + deltaSteps * 0.15f).coerceIn(0.50f, 1.50f)
            cameraZoom = nextZoom
            engine.cameraZoom = nextZoom
            localPrefs.setCameraZoom(nextZoom)
          },
          onGamepadToggleHangar = {
            activeModal =
              if (activeModal == ActiveModal.HANGAR) ActiveModal.NONE else ActiveModal.HANGAR
            sfx.playMutedClick()
          },
          onGamepadToggleCalibration = {
            com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.isCalibrationModalOpen =
              !com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.isCalibrationModalOpen
            sfx.playMutedClick()
          },
          onGamepadOpenNexus = {
            previousModalBeforeNexus = ActiveModal.NONE
            activeModal = ActiveModal.NEXUS
            sfx.playMutedClick()
          },
        ).apply {
          layoutParams =
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams(
              ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
              ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            )
          arenaViewRef = this
        }
      },
    )

    // 2. Native Fullscreen HUD Overlay (7 Decoupled Top Navigation Tabs + Centered Active Powerups Dock)
    RiftHudOverlay(
      engine = engine,
      fps = currentFps,
      sfxEnabled = sfxEnabled,
      unreadCommsCount = unreadCommsCount,
      toastMessage = toastMessage,
      frameTick = frameTick,
      cameraZoom = cameraZoom,
      onOpenHangar = { activeModal = ActiveModal.HANGAR },
      onOpenCodex = { activeModal = ActiveModal.CODEX },
      onOpenSyndicateCommand = {
        syndicateStatusBanner = null
        activeModal = ActiveModal.SYNDICATES
      },
      onOpenArmadaFleet = {
        armadaStatusBanner = null
        activeModal = ActiveModal.ARMADA
      },
      onOpenComms = {
        unreadCommsCount = 0
        activeModal = ActiveModal.CHAT
      },
      onOpenDossier = { activeModal = ActiveModal.DOSSIER },
      onOpenSettings = { activeModal = ActiveModal.SETTINGS },
      onCycleCameraZoom = {
        val nextZoom =
          when {
            cameraZoom < 0.70f -> 0.75f
            cameraZoom < 0.95f -> 1.0f
            cameraZoom < 1.20f -> 1.25f
            cameraZoom < 1.45f -> 1.5f
            else -> 0.5f
          }
        cameraZoom = nextZoom
        engine.cameraZoom = nextZoom
        localPrefs.setCameraZoom(nextZoom)
        toastMessage = String.format(Locale.US, "🔍 CAMERA ZOOM SET TO %.2fx", nextZoom)
        toastVersion++
      },
      isNexusStreaming = isNexusStreaming,
      onOpenNexus = {
        previousModalBeforeNexus = ActiveModal.NONE
        activeModal = ActiveModal.NEXUS
      },
      onEngageBrake = {
        engine.engageManualBrake()
        frameTick++
      },
      onToggleMultifire = {
        engine.toggleMultifire()
        frameTick++
      },
    )

    // 3. Dedicated Windows (Hangar, Codex, Syndicate Command, Armada Fleet Deck, Comms Drawer, Dossier, Settings)
    when (activeModal) {
      ActiveModal.HANGAR -> {
        val (_, _, hangarLvlFrac) = remember(frameTick) { engine.getXpProgressInCurrentLevel() }
        HangarModal(
          initialCallsign = callsign,
          syndicateTag = syndicateTag,
          syndicateName = syndicateName,
          selectedShipId = selectedShipId,
          selectedMode = selectedMode,
          pilotLevel = engine.pilotLevel,
          xpProgressFraction = hangarLvlFrac,
          customizationPointsTotal = engine.getCustomizationPointsTotal(),
          spentCustomizationPoints = activeCustomSlot.totalAllocatedPoints(),
          riftShards = engine.riftShards,
          unlockFullNinthShipOverride =
            com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.unlockFullNinthShipOverride,
          activeCustomSlot = activeCustomSlot,
          slot9BUnlocked = slot9BUnlocked,
          slot9CUnlocked = slot9CUnlocked,
          onOpenRiftShardsStore = {
            previousModalBeforeStore = ActiveModal.HANGAR
            activeModal = ActiveModal.RIFT_SHARDS_STORE
          },
          onOpenSyndicatesModal = {
            syndicateStatusBanner = null
            activeModal = ActiveModal.SYNDICATES
          },
          onSaveCustomSlot = { updatedSlot ->
            activeCustomSlot = updatedSlot
            localPrefs.saveCustomShipSlot(updatedSlot, currentUserId)
            com.example.engine.RiftCodex.updateActiveCustomShipSlot(updatedSlot)
            engine.spentCustomizationPoints = updatedSlot.totalAllocatedPoints()
            engine.syncLocalPlayerCustomShipSpec()
          },
          onSwitchCustomSlot = { targetSlotId ->
            activeCustomSlotId = targetSlotId
            localPrefs.setActiveCustomSlotId(targetSlotId, currentUserId)
            val loaded = localPrefs.getCustomShipSlot(targetSlotId, currentUserId)
            activeCustomSlot = loaded
            com.example.engine.RiftCodex.updateActiveCustomShipSlot(loaded)
            engine.spentCustomizationPoints = loaded.totalAllocatedPoints()
            engine.syncLocalPlayerCustomShipSpec()
            sfx.playPrize()
          },
          onUnlockCustomSlot = { targetSlotId ->
            if (engine.riftShards >= 300L) {
              engine.riftShards -= 300L
              engine.unlockedExtraSlots++
              localPrefs.setCustomSlotUnlocked(targetSlotId, true, currentUserId)
              slot9BUnlocked = localPrefs.isCustomSlotUnlocked("Frame B", currentUserId)
              slot9CUnlocked = localPrefs.isCustomSlotUnlocked("Frame C", currentUserId)
              activeCustomSlotId = targetSlotId
              localPrefs.setActiveCustomSlotId(targetSlotId, currentUserId)
              val loaded = localPrefs.getCustomShipSlot(targetSlotId, currentUserId)
              activeCustomSlot = loaded
              com.example.engine.RiftCodex.updateActiveCustomShipSlot(loaded)
              engine.spentCustomizationPoints = loaded.totalAllocatedPoints()
              engine.syncLocalPlayerCustomShipSpec()
              sfx.playPrize()
              true
            } else {
              false
            }
          },
          onRespecCustomSlot = {
            if (engine.riftShards >= 50L && activeCustomSlot.totalAllocatedPoints() > 0) {
              engine.riftShards -= 50L
              val zeroed =
                activeCustomSlot.copy(
                  speedPts = 0,
                  thrustPts = 0,
                  turnPts = 0,
                  maxFluxPts = 0,
                  rechargePts = 0,
                  primaryArchetype = "LIGHT_PULSE",
                  secondaryType = "NONE",
                )
              activeCustomSlot = zeroed
              localPrefs.saveCustomShipSlot(zeroed, currentUserId)
              com.example.engine.RiftCodex.updateActiveCustomShipSlot(zeroed)
              engine.spentCustomizationPoints = 0
              engine.syncLocalPlayerCustomShipSpec()
              sfx.playPrize()
              true
            } else {
              false
            }
          },
          onForgeAiHullDesign = { promptText, hullTitle ->
            val isFirstFree = activeCustomSlot.aiGenerationsCount == 0
            val canAfford = isFirstFree || engine.aiShipDesignTokens > 0 || engine.riftShards >= 150L
            if (!canAfford) {
              Pair(false, "⚠️ NEED 150❖ RIFT SHARDS FOR AI HULL RE-DESIGN (TAP [+ GET RIFT SHARDS]).")
            } else {
              if (!isFirstFree) {
                if (engine.aiShipDesignTokens > 0) {
                  engine.aiShipDesignTokens--
                } else {
                  engine.riftShards -= 150L
                }
              }
              val nextGenCount = activeCustomSlot.aiGenerationsCount + 1
              val baseRecipe =
                com.example.engine.CustomHullVisualRecipe.synthesizeFromPrompt(
                  rawPrompt = promptText,
                  variationSalt = nextGenCount,
                )
              val finalTitle =
                hullTitle.trim().uppercase(Locale.US).take(18).ifEmpty { baseRecipe.hullName }
              val finalRecipe = baseRecipe.copy(hullName = finalTitle)
              val updatedSlot =
                activeCustomSlot.copy(
                  customName = finalTitle,
                  visualRecipe = finalRecipe,
                  aiGenerationsCount = nextGenCount,
                )
              activeCustomSlot = updatedSlot
              localPrefs.saveCustomShipSlot(updatedSlot, currentUserId)
              com.example.engine.RiftCodex.updateActiveCustomShipSlot(updatedSlot)
              engine.syncLocalPlayerCustomShipSpec()
              sfx.playPrize()
              val costNote = if (isFirstFree) "FREE 1ST DESIGN" else "-150❖ SHARDS"
              Pair(
                true,
                "🎨 AI HULL FORGED ($costNote): [$finalTitle] (${finalRecipe.silhouette} • ${finalRecipe.toJsonString().length}B JSON)",
              )
            }
          },
          onToggleDevLevel20Or100 = {
            com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.unlockFullNinthShipOverride =
              !com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.unlockFullNinthShipOverride
            com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState.savePersistedLayout(context)
            engine.syncLocalPlayerCustomShipSpec()
            sfx.playPrize()
          },
          isNexusStreaming = isNexusStreaming,
          onOpenNexus = {
            previousModalBeforeNexus = ActiveModal.HANGAR
            activeModal = ActiveModal.NEXUS
          },
          onDeployPilot = { newCallsign, newShipId, _, asGuest ->
            if (asGuest) {
              localPrefs.setGuestBypassEnabled(true)
            }
            val cleanCallsign = localPrefs.setCallsign(newCallsign)
            val clampedShipId = newShipId.coerceIn(1, 10)
            callsign = cleanCallsign
            selectedShipId = clampedShipId
            selectedMode = "FFA"
            syndicateTag = localPrefs.getSyndicateTag()
            syndicateName = localPrefs.getSyndicateName()

            localPrefs.setPreferredShipId(clampedShipId)
            localPrefs.setPreferredMode("FFA")

            engine.localPlayer.callsign = cleanCallsign
            engine.localPlayer.syndicateTag = syndicateTag
            engine.syncLocalArmadaSelfSlot()
            engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(clampedShipId, forceFromHangar = true)
            engine.onStatsUpdated()
            activeModal = ActiveModal.NONE
          },
          onCloseModal = { activeModal = ActiveModal.NONE },
        )
      }

              engine.onStatsUpdated()
              true
            } else {
              false

          onAllocateCustomizationPoint = {
            if (engine.getCustomizationPointsAvailable() > 0) {
              engine.spentCustomizationPoints++
              sfx.playPrize()
              engine.onStatsUpdated()
              true
            } else {
              false
            }
          },

            if (engine.riftShards >= 300L) {
              engine.riftShards -= 300L
              engine.unlockedExtraSlots++
              if (!slot9BUnlocked) {
                localPrefs.setCustomSlotUnlocked("Frame B", true, currentUserId)
                slot9BUnlocked = true

                localPrefs.setCustomSlotUnlocked("Frame C", true, currentUserId)

              engine.onStatsUpdated()
              true

              engine.onStatsUpdated()
