        val topLiveShip = engine.ships.maxByOrNull { it.bounty }
        val highestBountySummary =
          remember(cloudLeaderboard, engine.allTimeBountyPeak, frameTick) {
            val cloudMax = topCloudEntry?.allTimeBounty ?: 0L
            val localMax =
              maxOf(engine.allTimeBountyPeak, allTimePeakSnapshot?.bountyReached?.toLong() ?: 0L)
            val liveMax = (topLiveShip?.bounty ?: 0).toLong()
            when {
              cloudMax >= localMax && cloudMax >= liveMax && topCloudEntry != null ->
                "[${RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(topCloudEntry.syndicateTag)}] ${topCloudEntry.callsign} (${topCloudEntry.allTimeBounty})"
              localMax >= liveMax && localMax > 0L ->
                "[$syndicateTag] $callsign ($localMax)"
              topLiveShip != null ->
                "[${topLiveShip.syndicateTag}] ${topLiveShip.callsign} (${topLiveShip.bounty})"
              else -> "[$syndicateTag] $callsign (${engine.localPlayer.bounty})"
            }
          }

        val activeShipTitle =
          remember(engine.localPlayer.shipId, activeCustomSlot, frameTick) {
            engine.formatShipLabel(engine.localPlayer)
          }

        val buildLiveSnapshot: () -> String = {
          RiftNexusKnowledge.compileLiveSnapshot(
            engine = engine,
            localPrefs = localPrefs,
            currentUserId = currentUserId,
            callsign = callsign,
            syndicateTag = syndicateTag,
            syndicateName = syndicateName,
            cloudLeaderboard = cloudLeaderboard,
            allTimePeakSnapshot = localPrefs.getAllTimePeakBountySnapshot(currentUserId) ?: allTimePeakSnapshot,
            pvpPeakSnapshot = localPrefs.getPvpPeakBountySnapshot(currentUserId) ?: pvpPeakSnapshot,
            syndicateHistory = localPrefs.getSyndicateServiceHistory(currentUserId).ifEmpty { syndicateHistory },
          )
        }

        val bestShipId =
          remember(currentUserId, selectedShipId, allTimePeakSnapshot, pvpPeakSnapshot, frameTick) {
            localPrefs.getBestShipId(currentUserId, selectedShipId)
          }
        val canAccessSyndicate =
          remember(syndicateTag, callsign, syndicateChannelsRefreshKey) {
            localPrefs.canAccessSyndicateChannels(syndicateTag, callsign, syndicateTag)
          }
        val customSyndicateChannels =
          remember(syndicateTag, syndicateChannelsRefreshKey) {
            localPrefs.getSyndicateCustomChannels(syndicateTag)
          }
        val invitedSyndicateGuests =
          remember(syndicateTag, syndicateChannelsRefreshKey) {
            localPrefs.getSyndicateInvitedGuests(syndicateTag)
          }
        val syndicateWarRecord =
          remember(syndicateTag, syndicateChannelsRefreshKey, frameTick) {
            localPrefs.getSyndicateWarRecord(syndicateTag)
          }
        val syndicateFriends =
          remember(syndicateTag, frameTick, friendsRefreshKey) {
            localPrefs.getFriendsList()
          }
        val humanPilotsOnline =
          remember(frameTick) { engine.getHumanPilotCountForMode(engine.activeRankedMode) }
        val syndicateOnlineCount =
          remember(syndicateTag, frameTick, friendsRefreshKey) {
            val cleanSyn = RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(syndicateTag)
            if (cleanSyn == "GUEST" || cleanSyn == "FREE" || cleanSyn.isEmpty()) {
              1
            } else {
              val inArena =
                engine.ships.count {
                  it.isHuman && RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(it.syndicateTag) == cleanSyn
                }
              val onlineFriends =
                syndicateFriends.count {
                  it.isOnline && RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(it.syndicateTag) == cleanSyn
                }
              maxOf(1, inArena + onlineFriends)
            }
          }
        val presetArmadasReadyCount =
          remember(frameTick, friendsRefreshKey) {
            val activeArmadaCount = if (engine.activeArmadaName.isNotBlank()) 1 else 0
            val friendArmadas =
              syndicateFriends
                .filter { it.isOnline && it.currentArmadaName.isNotBlank() }
                .map { it.currentArmadaName }
                .distinct()
                .size
            activeArmadaCount + friendArmadas
          }

        NexusAiConsoleModal(
          messages = nexusMessages,
          streamState = nexusStreamState,
          lastFailedQuestion = nexusViewModel.lastFailedQuestion,
          activeShipSummary = activeShipTitle,
          pilotLevel = engine.pilotLevel,
          pointBudget = engine.getCustomizationPointsTotal(),
          highestBountySummary = highestBountySummary,
          onSendQuestion = { query ->
            nexusViewModel.askNexus(
              rawQuestion = query,
              liveTelemetrySnapshot = buildLiveSnapshot(),
            )
          },
          onRetryLastQuestion = {
            nexusViewModel.retryLastQuestion(
              liveTelemetrySnapshot = buildLiveSnapshot(),
            )
          },
          onClearHistory = {
            nexusViewModel.clearConversation()
          },
          onCloseModal = {
            val target = previousModalBeforeNexus
            previousModalBeforeNexus = ActiveModal.NONE
            activeModal = target
          },
          callsign = callsign,
          syndicateTag = syndicateTag,
          syndicateName = syndicateName,
          activeShipId = selectedShipId,
          bestShipId = bestShipId,
          bootToNexusHub = bootToNexusHub,
          onToggleBootToNexusHub = { enabled ->
            bootToNexusHub = enabled
            localPrefs.setBootToNexusHub(enabled)
            showStartupChangelogQuickJoin = !enabled
            toastMessage =
              if (enabled) {
                "⚙️ STARTUP PREFERENCE: OPEN NEXUS COMMAND HUB ON LOGIN"
              } else {
                "⚡ STARTUP PREFERENCE: FAST-BOOT TO ARENA + QUICK-JOIN BAR"
              }
            toastVersion++
          },
          totalOnlinePilots = humanPilotsOnline,
          syndicateOnlineCount = syndicateOnlineCount,
          presetArmadasReadyCount = presetArmadasReadyCount,
          activeArmadaName = engine.activeArmadaName,
          armadaSlots = engine.activeArmadaSlots.toList(),
          onResolvePilotBestShipId = { uid, fallbackShip ->
            if (uid == currentUserId || uid == "local_self") {
              localPrefs.getBestShipId(currentUserId, fallbackShip)
            } else {
              localPrefs.getBestShipId(uid, fallbackShip)
            }
          },
          activeRankedMode = engine.activeRankedMode,
          activeTeamSizeBracket = engine.activeTeamSizeBracket,
          humanPilotCountByMode = { mode -> engine.getHumanPilotCountForMode(mode) },
          canQueueSyndicateWars = engine.canQueueSyndicateWars(),
          syndicateWarRecord = syndicateWarRecord,
          onDeployToRankedMode = { mode, bracket ->
            engine.deployToRankedMode(mode, bracket)
            selectedMode = mode.id
            showStartupChangelogQuickJoin = false
            activeModal = ActiveModal.NONE
          },
          onOpenArmadaModal = {
            armadaStatusBanner = null
            activeModal = ActiveModal.ARMADA
          },
          onQuickFormSyndicateArmada = {
            val synMates =
              syndicateFriends
                .filter {
                  it.isOnline &&
                    RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(it.syndicateTag) ==
                      RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(syndicateTag)
                }
                .take(4)
            val prefix =
              RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(syndicateTag).let {
                if (it == "GUEST" || it.isEmpty()) callsign.take(6) else it
              }
            val fleetTag = "${prefix}_FLEET"
            engine.formOrJoinArmada(
              fleetTag,
              if (synMates.isNotEmpty()) synMates else syndicateFriends.take(2),
            )
            friendsRefreshKey++
            toastMessage =
              "🛡️ SYNDICATE ARMADA [$fleetTag] STAGED (${engine.getCurrentArmadaSize()}/5 PILOTS)"
            toastVersion++
          },
          onOpenSyndicatesModal = {
            syndicateStatusBanner = null
            activeModal = ActiveModal.SYNDICATES
          },
          onOpenHangarForShip = { targetShipId ->
            val clamped = targetShipId.coerceIn(1, 10)
            selectedShipId = clamped
            localPrefs.setPreferredShipId(clamped)
            engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(clamped, forceFromHangar = true)
            engine.onStatsUpdated()
            toastMessage = "🚀 EQUIPPED HULL #$clamped FOR SECTOR DEPLOYMENT"
            toastVersion++
          },
          canAccessSyndicateServer = canAccessSyndicate,
          syndicateCustomChannels = customSyndicateChannels,
          syndicateInvitedGuests = invitedSyndicateGuests,
          onAddSyndicateChannel = { rawChannel ->
            val currentChannels = localPrefs.getSyndicateCustomChannels(syndicateTag)
            if (currentChannels.size >= 5) {
              toastMessage = "⚠️ MAXIMUM 5 CHANNELS REACHED FOR [$syndicateTag]"
              toastVersion++
            } else {
              localPrefs.setSyndicateCustomChannels(syndicateTag, currentChannels + rawChannel)
              syndicateChannelsRefreshKey++
              toastMessage = "✓ CREATED SYNDICATE CHANNEL IN [$syndicateTag]"
              toastVersion++
            }
          },
          onDeleteSyndicateChannel = { rawChannel ->
            val currentChannels = localPrefs.getSyndicateCustomChannels(syndicateTag)
            val filtered = currentChannels.filterNot { it.equals(rawChannel, ignoreCase = true) }
            localPrefs.setSyndicateCustomChannels(syndicateTag, filtered)
            syndicateChannelsRefreshKey++
            toastMessage = "✕ REMOVED CHANNEL $rawChannel"
            toastVersion++
          },
          onInviteSyndicateGuest = { guestCallsign ->
            localPrefs.inviteGuestToSyndicateChannels(syndicateTag, guestCallsign)
            syndicateChannelsRefreshKey++
            toastMessage = "🎟️ GRANTED [$syndicateTag] SERVER GUEST PASS TO $guestCallsign"
            toastVersion++
          },
          onRevokeSyndicateGuest = { guestCallsign ->
            localPrefs.revokeGuestFromSyndicateChannels(syndicateTag, guestCallsign)
            syndicateChannelsRefreshKey++
            toastMessage = "✕ REVOKED GUEST PASS FOR $guestCallsign"
            toastVersion++
          },
          lobbyMessages = chatMessages,
          onSendChannelMessage = { channelKey, messageText ->
            val safeText = com.example.data.UgcModeration.sanitizeUgcText(messageText)
            val newMsg =
              SyndicateChatMessage(
                id = "msg_${System.currentTimeMillis()}",
                senderUid = currentUserId,
                senderCallsign = callsign,
                senderSyndicateTag = syndicateTag,
                timestampLabel = channelKey.uppercase(Locale.US),
                messageText = safeText,
              )
            chatMessages.add(newMsg)
            viewModel.sendSectorComm(newMsg)
          },
          onSubmitBugReport = { category, description ->
            val safeDesc = com.example.data.UgcModeration.sanitizeUgcText(description)
            localPrefs.reportPilot(
              uid = "BUG_${category.take(10)}",
              callsign = category,
              reason = safeDesc,
            )
            toastMessage = "🛠️ BUG REPORT LOGGED TO SECTOR TELEMETRY [$category]"
            toastVersion++
          },
        )
      }

      ActiveModal.NONE -> {
        if (showStartupChangelogQuickJoin) {
          StartupChangelogQuickJoinBar(
            activeMode = engine.activeRankedMode,
            onQuickJoinMode = { mode ->
              val defaultBracket =
                when (mode) {
                  RankedGameMode.RIFT_SKIRMISH -> maxOf(2, engine.getCurrentArmadaSize())
                  RankedGameMode.SYNDICATE_WARS -> 3
                  else -> engine.getCurrentArmadaSize()
                }
              engine.deployToRankedMode(mode, defaultBracket)
              selectedMode = mode.id
              showStartupChangelogQuickJoin = false
            },
            onOpenNexusHub = {
              showStartupChangelogQuickJoin = false
              previousModalBeforeNexus = ActiveModal.NONE
              activeModal = ActiveModal.NEXUS
            },
            onOpenFullChangelog = onOpenChangelog,
            onDismiss = { showStartupChangelogQuickJoin = false },
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

```
package com.example.data

import android.util.Log
import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestoreException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject

enum class OperationType(val value: String) {
  CREATE("create"),
  UPDATE("update"),
  DELETE("delete"),
  LIST("list"),
  GET("get"),
  WRITE("write"),
}

fun handleFirestoreError(exception: Throwable, operationType: OperationType, path: String?): String {
  val causes = generateSequence(exception) { it.cause }
  val rootError =
    causes.firstOrNull { it is FirebaseFirestoreException }
      ?: causes.firstOrNull { it !is CancellationException }
      ?: exception

  val auth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance()
  val currentUser = auth.currentUser

  val providerInfoList =
    currentUser?.providerData?.map { provider ->
      JSONObject().apply {
        put("providerId", provider.providerId)
        put("email", provider.email)
      }
    } ?: emptyList()

  val authInfoJson =
    JSONObject().apply {
      put("userId", currentUser?.uid)
      put("email", currentUser?.email)
      put("emailVerified", currentUser?.isEmailVerified)
      put("tenantId", currentUser?.tenantId)
      put("providerInfo", JSONArray(providerInfoList))
    }

  val errorInfoJson =
    JSONObject().apply {
      put("error", rootError.message ?: rootError.toString())
      put("operationType", operationType.value)
      put("path", path)
      put("authInfo", authInfoJson)
    }

  val jsonString = errorInfoJson.toString()
  Log.e("FirestoreError", "Firestore Error: $jsonString")
  return jsonString
}

```
package com.example.data

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.UUID
import kotlin.math.ceil
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject

class LocalPilotPrefs(context: Context) {
  private val prefs: SharedPreferences =
    context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
  private val userSettingsPrefs: SharedPreferences =
    context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(USER_SETTINGS_PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)

  /**
   * Returns a permanent device-bound UID stored in local storage so guest stats and leaderboard
   * identity follow the player forever across app launches without requiring Google OAuth popups.
   */
  fun getOrCreatePermanentDeviceUid(): String {
    val existing = prefs.getString(KEY_DEVICE_UID, null)
    if (!existing.isNullOrBlank()) return existing
    val generated = "dev_" + UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "").take(16)
    prefs.edit().putString(KEY_DEVICE_UID, generated).apply()
    return generated
  }

  fun isGuestBypassEnabled(): Boolean = prefs.getBoolean(KEY_GUEST_BYPASS, false)

  fun setGuestBypassEnabled(enabled: Boolean) {
    val editor = prefs.edit().putBoolean(KEY_GUEST_BYPASS, enabled)
    if (enabled && !prefs.contains(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG)) {
      editor.putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, "")
      editor.putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, "Unaffiliated")
    }
    editor.apply()
  }

  fun getCallsign(): String {
    return prefs.getString(KEY_CALLSIGN, "COMMANDER") ?: "COMMANDER"
  }

  fun setCallsign(rawCallsign: String): String {
    val sanitizedRaw =
      rawCallsign
        .trim()
        .uppercase()
        .replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_\\-]"), "")
        .take(14)
    val cleaned =
      if (sanitizedRaw.isEmpty() || UgcModeration.containsProfanity(sanitizedRaw)) {
        "COMMANDER"
      } else {
        sanitizedRaw
      }
    prefs.edit().putString(KEY_CALLSIGN, cleaned).apply()
    return cleaned
  }

  fun getSyndicateTag(): String {
    val raw = (prefs.getString(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, "") ?: "").trim().uppercase()
    return if (raw in setOf("GUEST", "UNAFFILIATED", "NONE", "SOLO", "KSTL", "AURL", "VRTX", "RUST")) {
      ""
    } else {
      raw
    }
  }

  fun getSyndicateName(): String {
    val tag = getSyndicateTag()
    if (tag.isBlank()) return "Unaffiliated"
    val raw = (prefs.getString(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, "Unaffiliated") ?: "Unaffiliated").trim()
    return if (
      raw.isEmpty() ||
        raw.equals("Guest Tracking Framework", ignoreCase = true) ||
        raw.contains("Kestrel", ignoreCase = true) ||
        raw.contains("Aurelia", ignoreCase = true) ||
        raw.contains("Vortex", ignoreCase = true) ||
        raw.contains("Rustweld", ignoreCase = true)
    ) {
      "Unaffiliated"
    } else {
      raw
    }
  }

  fun getSyndicateLockUntilMs(): Long {
    return prefs.getLong(KEY_SYNDICATE_LOCK_UNTIL_MS, 0L)
  }

  fun getRemainingSyndicateLockDays(nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): Int {
    val lockUntil = getSyndicateLockUntilMs()
    if (lockUntil <= nowMs) return 0
    val diffMs = lockUntil - nowMs
    return ceil(diffMs.toDouble() / (24.0 * 3600.0 * 1000.0)).toInt()
  }

  fun getRemainingSyndicateLockFormatted(nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): String {
    val lockUntil = getSyndicateLockUntilMs()
    if (lockUntil <= nowMs) return "00d 00h"
    val diffMs = lockUntil - nowMs
    val totalHours = ceil(diffMs.toDouble() / (3600.0 * 1000.0)).toInt()
    val days = totalHours / 24
    val hours = totalHours % 24
    return String.format(Locale.US, "%02dd %02dh", days, hours)
  }

  fun joinOfficialSyndicate(
    tag: String,
    name: String,
    apply15DayLock: Boolean = true,
    role: String = "Pilot",
  ): Boolean {
    if (apply15DayLock && getRemainingSyndicateLockDays() > 0) {
      return false
    }
    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
    val cleanTag = tag.trim().uppercase().take(4)
    val cleanName = name.trim().take(28).ifEmpty { if (cleanTag.isEmpty()) "Unaffiliated" else "$cleanTag Syndicate" }
    val lockUntil =
      if (apply15DayLock) {
        now + FIFTEEN_DAYS_MS
      } else {
        getSyndicateLockUntilMs()
      }
    prefs
      .edit()
      .putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, cleanTag)
      .putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, cleanName)
      .putLong(KEY_SYNDICATE_LOCK_UNTIL_MS, lockUntil)
      .apply()
    appendSyndicateServiceTransition(
      newTag = cleanTag.ifEmpty { "UNAFFILIATED" },
      newName = cleanName,
      newRole = role,
      nowMs = now,
    )
    return true
  }

  fun leaveSyndicate(): Boolean {
    if (getRemainingSyndicateLockDays() > 0) {
      return false
    }
    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
    val lockUntil = now + FIFTEEN_DAYS_MS
    prefs
      .edit()
      .putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, "")
      .putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, "Unaffiliated")
      .putLong(KEY_SYNDICATE_LOCK_UNTIL_MS, lockUntil)
      .apply()
    appendSyndicateServiceTransition(
      newTag = "UNAFFILIATED",
      newName = "Unaffiliated",
      newRole = "Pilot",
      nowMs = now,
    )
    return true
  }

  fun getCameraZoom(): Float {
    val fallback = prefs.getFloat(KEY_CAMERA_ZOOM, 1.0f)

  fun getMySyndicateRoster(
    currentUid: String,
    callsign: String,
    shipId: Int,
    bounty: Long,
    kills: Long,
  ): List<SyndicateMemberEntry> {
    val tag = getSyndicateTag()
    if (tag.isBlank()) return emptyList()
    val localEntry =
      SyndicateMemberEntry(
        uid = currentUid,
        callsign = callsign,
        tag = tag,
        shipId = shipId,
        shipName = cleanShipNameForId(shipId),
        role = "SYNDICATE COMMANDER (YOU)",
        bountyContribution = bounty.coerceAtLeast(getAllTimeBountyPeak()),
        kills = kills,
        isOnline = true,
        isLocalPlayer = true,
      )
    val realSyndicateFriends =
      getFriendsList()
        .filter {
          it.syndicateTag.equals(tag, ignoreCase = true) &&
            !it.callsign.equals(callsign, ignoreCase = true)
        }
        .map { friend ->
          SyndicateMemberEntry(
            uid = friend.uid,
            callsign = friend.callsign,
            tag = tag,
            shipId = friend.shipId,
            shipName = cleanShipNameForId(friend.shipId),
            role = "SYNDICATE WINGMAN",
            bountyContribution = friend.bounty.toLong(),
            kills = 0L,
            isOnline = friend.isOnline,
            isLocalPlayer = false,
          )
        }
    return listOf(localEntry) + realSyndicateFriends
  }

  /**
   * Best Ship Avatar Calculator:
   * Returns the ship ID (1..10) from the pilot's PvP Peak Bounty Snapshot or All-Time Peak Bounty Snapshot
   * (whichever has the higher bountyReached), falling back to getLastShipId() / fallbackShipId (1..10).
   */
  fun getBestShipId(uid: String? = null, fallbackShipId: Int = getLastShipId()): Int {
    val pvpSnap = getPvpPeakBountySnapshot(uid)
    val allSnap = getAllTimePeakBountySnapshot(uid)
    val bestSnap =
      when {
        pvpSnap != null && allSnap != null ->
          if (pvpSnap.bountyReached >= allSnap.bountyReached) pvpSnap else allSnap
        pvpSnap != null -> pvpSnap
        allSnap != null -> allSnap
        else -> null
      }
    val resolvedId = bestSnap?.shipId?.takeIf { it in 1..10 } ?: fallbackShipId.takeIf { it in 1..10 } ?: getLastShipId()
    return resolvedId.coerceIn(1, 10)
  }

    val activeUid = uid?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: getOrCreatePermanentDeviceUid()
    return "${baseKey}_$activeUid"
  }

  // Custom Modular Ship Loadout Slots (Frame A, Frame B, Frame C) with seamless legacy migration
  fun normalizeCustomSlotId(rawSlotId: String?): String =
    when (rawSlotId?.trim()?.uppercase(Locale.US)) {
      "FRAME B", "9B", "B" -> "Frame B"
      "FRAME C", "9C", "C" -> "Frame C"
      else -> "Frame A"
    }

  private fun legacySlotKeySuffix(cleanSlotId: String): String =
    when (cleanSlotId) {
      "Frame B" -> "9B"
      "Frame C" -> "9C"
      else -> "9A"
    }

  fun getActiveCustomSlotId(uid: String? = null): String {
    val raw =
      prefs.getString(
        uidKey(KEY_ACTIVE_CUSTOM_SLOT_ID, uid),
        prefs.getString(KEY_ACTIVE_CUSTOM_SLOT_ID, "Frame A"),
      ) ?: "Frame A"
    return normalizeCustomSlotId(raw)
  }

  fun setActiveCustomSlotId(slotId: String, uid: String? = null) {
    val clean = normalizeCustomSlotId(slotId)
    prefs
      .edit()
      .putString(KEY_ACTIVE_CUSTOM_SLOT_ID, clean)
      .putString(uidKey(KEY_ACTIVE_CUSTOM_SLOT_ID, uid), clean)
      .apply()
  }

  fun isCustomSlotUnlocked(slotId: String, uid: String? = null): Boolean {
    return when (normalizeCustomSlotId(slotId)) {
      "Frame A" -> true
      "Frame B" ->
        prefs.getBoolean(uidKey(KEY_SLOT_B_UNLOCKED, uid), prefs.getBoolean(KEY_SLOT_B_UNLOCKED, false)) ||
          getUnlockedExtraSlots(uid) >= 1
      "Frame C" ->
        prefs.getBoolean(uidKey(KEY_SLOT_C_UNLOCKED, uid), prefs.getBoolean(KEY_SLOT_C_UNLOCKED, false)) ||
          getUnlockedExtraSlots(uid) >= 2
      else -> true
    }
  }

  fun setCustomSlotUnlocked(slotId: String, unlocked: Boolean, uid: String? = null) {
    val key =
      when (normalizeCustomSlotId(slotId)) {
        "Frame B" -> KEY_SLOT_B_UNLOCKED
        "Frame C" -> KEY_SLOT_C_UNLOCKED
        else -> return
      }
    prefs
      .edit()
      .putBoolean(key, unlocked)
      .putBoolean(uidKey(key, uid), unlocked)
      .apply()
  }

  fun getCustomShipSlot(slotId: String, uid: String? = null): com.example.engine.CustomShipLoadoutSlot {
    val cleanId = normalizeCustomSlotId(slotId)
    val baseKey = "${KEY_CUSTOM_SLOT_PREFIX}_$cleanId"
    val legacyBaseKey = "${KEY_CUSTOM_SLOT_PREFIX}_${legacySlotKeySuffix(cleanId)}"
    val raw =
      prefs.getString(uidKey(baseKey, uid), prefs.getString(baseKey, null))
        ?: prefs.getString(uidKey(legacyBaseKey, uid), prefs.getString(legacyBaseKey, null))
    return com.example.engine.CustomShipLoadoutSlot.fromJsonString(raw, cleanId)
  }

  fun saveCustomShipSlot(slot: com.example.engine.CustomShipLoadoutSlot, uid: String? = null) {
    val cleanId = normalizeCustomSlotId(slot.slotId)
    val normalizedSlot = slot.copy(slotId = cleanId)
    val baseKey = "${KEY_CUSTOM_SLOT_PREFIX}_$cleanId"
    val json = normalizedSlot.toJsonString()
    prefs
      .edit()
      .putString(baseKey, json)
      .putString(uidKey(baseKey, uid), json)
      .apply()
  }

  fun getFriendsList(): List<FriendPilotEntry> {
    val tag = getSyndicateTag()
    val customRaw = prefs.getString(KEY_CUSTOM_FRIENDS_JSON, "[]") ?: "[]"
    val customList = mutableListOf<FriendPilotEntry>()
    try {
      val arr = JSONArray(customRaw)
      for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
        val obj = arr.getJSONObject(i)
        customList.add(
          FriendPilotEntry(
            uid = obj.optString("uid", "friend_custom_$i"),
            callsign = obj.optString("callsign", "WINGMAN_$i"),
            syndicateTag = obj.optString("syndicateTag", tag),
            shipId = obj.optInt("shipId", 1),
            statusText = obj.optString("statusText", "In Rift (Sector E5) • [SOLO] Online"),
            isOnline = true,
            currentArmadaName = obj.optString("currentArmadaName", ""),
            currentArmadaCount = obj.optInt("currentArmadaCount", 1),
            bounty = obj.optInt("bounty", 140),
          )
        )
      }
    } catch (_: Exception) {}

    return customList
  }

  fun addFriendByCallsign(rawCallsign: String): FriendPilotEntry? {
    val clean =
      rawCallsign
        .trim()
        .uppercase()
        .replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_\\-]"), "")
        .take(14)
    if (clean.length < 3 || UgcModeration.containsProfanity(clean)) return null
    val existing = getFriendsList()
    if (existing.any { it.callsign.equals(clean, ignoreCase = true) }) {
      return existing.first { it.callsign.equals(clean, ignoreCase = true) }
    }

    val created =
      FriendPilotEntry(
        uid = "friend_custom_${System.currentTimeMillis()}",
        callsign = clean,
        syndicateTag = getSyndicateTag(),
        shipId = ((clean.hashCode().and(0x7FFFFFFF)) % 9) + 1,
        statusText = "In Rift (Sector B4) • [SOLO] Ready for Armada",
        isOnline = true,
        currentArmadaName = "",
        currentArmadaCount = 1,
        bounty = 160,
      )

    val customRaw = prefs.getString(KEY_CUSTOM_FRIENDS_JSON, "[]") ?: "[]"
    val arr =
      try {
        JSONArray(customRaw)
      } catch (_: Exception) {
        JSONArray()
      }
    arr.put(
      JSONObject().apply {
        put("uid", created.uid)
        put("callsign", created.callsign)
        put("syndicateTag", created.syndicateTag)
        put("shipId", created.shipId)
        put("statusText", created.statusText)
        put("currentArmadaName", created.currentArmadaName)
        put("currentArmadaCount", created.currentArmadaCount)
        put("bounty", created.bounty)
      }
    )
    prefs.edit().putString(KEY_CUSTOM_FRIENDS_JSON, arr.toString()).apply()
    return created
  }

  fun getAllSyndicates(): List<SyndicateInfo> {
    val customRaw = prefs.getString(KEY_CUSTOM_SYNDICATES_JSON, "[]") ?: "[]"
    val customList = mutableListOf<SyndicateInfo>()
    try {
      val arr = JSONArray(customRaw)
      for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
        val obj = arr.getJSONObject(i)
        val parsedTag = obj.optString("tag", "").trim().uppercase()
        if (parsedTag.isNotEmpty()) {
          customList.add(
            SyndicateInfo(
              id = obj.optString("id", "syn_custom_$i"),
              tag = parsedTag,
              name = obj.optString("name", "$parsedTag Syndicate"),
              foundryOrigin = obj.optString("foundryOrigin", "Player Registered Syndicate"),
              motto = obj.optString("motto", "Forged in the Convergence"),
              memberCount = obj.optInt("memberCount", 1),
              combinedBounty = obj.optLong("combinedBounty", 1000L),
              isCustom = true,
            )
          )
        }
      }
    } catch (_: Exception) {}

    return customList
  }

  fun getSyndicatesList(): List<SyndicateInfo> = getAllSyndicates()

  fun mergeCloudSyndicates(cloudSyndicates: List<SyndicateInfo>) {
    if (cloudSyndicates.isEmpty()) return
    val mergedByTag = linkedMapOf<String, SyndicateInfo>()
    for (local in getAllSyndicates()) {
      mergedByTag[local.tag.uppercase()] = local
    }
    for (cloud in cloudSyndicates) {
      val cleanTag = cloud.tag.trim().uppercase()
      if (cleanTag.length in 2..4) {
        mergedByTag[cleanTag] =
          cloud.copy(
            id = cloud.id.ifBlank { "syn_cloud_$cleanTag" },
            tag = cleanTag,
            isCustom = true,
          )
      }
    }
    val arr = JSONArray()
    for (syn in mergedByTag.values) {
      arr.put(
        JSONObject().apply {
          put("id", syn.id)
          put("tag", syn.tag)
          put("name", syn.name)
          put("foundryOrigin", syn.foundryOrigin)
          put("motto", syn.motto)
          put("memberCount", syn.memberCount)
          put("combinedBounty", syn.combinedBounty)
        }
      )
    }
    prefs.edit().putString(KEY_CUSTOM_SYNDICATES_JSON, arr.toString()).apply()
  }

  fun createCustomSyndicate(tag: String, name: String, motto: String): Result<SyndicateInfo> {
    val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
    val remainingDays = getRemainingSyndicateLockDays(now)
    if (remainingDays > 0) {
      return Result.failure(
        IllegalStateException(
          "15-Day Syndicate Lock active (${getRemainingSyndicateLockFormatted(now)} remaining)."
        )
      )
    }

    val cleanTag = tag.trim().uppercase().replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9]"), "")
    if (cleanTag.length !in 3..4) {
      return Result.failure(IllegalArgumentException("Syndicate Tag must be 3 to 4 letters/digits."))
    }
    if (UgcModeration.containsProfanity(cleanTag)) {
      return Result.failure(IllegalArgumentException("Syndicate Tag contains prohibited language."))
    }
    val cleanName = name.trim().replace(Regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9 _\\-]"), "").take(26)
    if (cleanName.length < 3) {
      return Result.failure(IllegalArgumentException("Syndicate Name must be at least 3 characters."))
    }
    if (UgcModeration.containsProfanity(cleanName)) {
      return Result.failure(IllegalArgumentException("Syndicate Name contains prohibited language."))
    }

    val existing = getAllSyndicates()
    if (existing.any { it.tag.equals(cleanTag, ignoreCase = true) }) {
      return Result.failure(IllegalArgumentException("Tag [$cleanTag] is already registered."))
    }

    val cleanMotto = UgcModeration.sanitizeUgcText(motto.trim().take(60)).ifEmpty { "Forged in the RIFT Convergence" }

    val newSyndicate =
      SyndicateInfo(
        id = "syn_custom_$now",
        tag = cleanTag,
        name = cleanName,
        foundryOrigin = "Player Founded Syndicate",
        motto = cleanMotto,
        memberCount = 1,
        combinedBounty = getAllTimeBountyPeak().coerceAtLeast(250L),
        isCustom = true,
      )

    val customRaw = prefs.getString(KEY_CUSTOM_SYNDICATES_JSON, "[]") ?: "[]"
    val arr =
      try {
        JSONArray(customRaw)
      } catch (_: Exception) {
        JSONArray()
      }
    arr.put(
      JSONObject().apply {
        put("id", newSyndicate.id)
        put("tag", newSyndicate.tag)
        put("name", newSyndicate.name)
        put("foundryOrigin", newSyndicate.foundryOrigin)
        put("motto", newSyndicate.motto)
        put("memberCount", newSyndicate.memberCount)
        put("combinedBounty", newSyndicate.combinedBounty)
      }
    )

    prefs.edit().putString(KEY_CUSTOM_SYNDICATES_JSON, arr.toString()).apply()
    joinOfficialSyndicate(cleanTag, cleanName, apply15DayLock = true, role = "Founder / Commander")
    return Result.success(newSyndicate)
  }

  fun getAllTimePeakBountySnapshot(uid: String? = null): PeakBountyRunSnapshot? {
    val raw = prefs.getString(uidKey(KEY_ALL_TIME_PEAK_SNAPSHOT, uid), prefs.getString(KEY_ALL_TIME_PEAK_SNAPSHOT, null))

  /**
   * Evaluates a completed (or live milestone) life snapshot against historical All-Time and PvP-Only
   * peak bounty snapshots, saving whenever it sets or updates the record (including Executioner telemetry on death).
   */
  fun maybeRecordPeakBountySnapshot(
    snapshot: PeakBountyRunSnapshot,
    hadPvp: Boolean,
    isFinalizedLifeEnd: Boolean = true,
    uid: String? = null,
  ) {
    val existingAll = getAllTimePeakBountySnapshot(uid)
    val shouldSaveAll =
      existingAll == null ||
        snapshot.bountyReached > existingAll.bountyReached ||
        (isFinalizedLifeEnd &&
          snapshot.bountyReached == existingAll.bountyReached &&
          existingAll.executioner.killerCallsign.isBlank() &&
          !existingAll.executioner.survivedToConvergence)
    if (shouldSaveAll) {
      saveAllTimePeakBountySnapshot(snapshot, uid)
    }

    if (hadPvp || snapshot.pvpKills > 0) {
      val existingPvp = getPvpPeakBountySnapshot(uid)
      val shouldSavePvp =
        existingPvp == null ||
          snapshot.bountyReached > existingPvp.bountyReached ||
          (isFinalizedLifeEnd &&
            snapshot.bountyReached == existingPvp.bountyReached &&
            existingPvp.executioner.killerCallsign.isBlank() &&
            !existingPvp.executioner.survivedToConvergence)
      if (shouldSavePvp) {
        savePvpPeakBountySnapshot(snapshot, uid)
      }
    }
  }

  fun getSyndicateServiceHistory(uid: String? = null): List<SyndicateServiceEntry> {
    val raw =
      prefs.getString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_HISTORY_JSON, uid), prefs.getString(KEY_SYNDICATE_HISTORY_JSON, null))
    val parsed = mutableListOf<SyndicateServiceEntry>()
    if (!raw.isNullOrBlank()) {
      try {
        val arr = JSONArray(raw)
        for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
          parsed.add(SyndicateServiceEntry.fromJson(arr.getJSONObject(i)))
        }
      } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }
    if (parsed.isEmpty()) {
      val currentTag = getSyndicateTag()
      val currentName = getSyndicateName()
      val isCustomFounder =
        getAllSyndicates().any { it.isCustom && it.tag.equals(currentTag, ignoreCase = true) }
      val seed =
        SyndicateServiceEntry(
          syndicateTag = currentTag,
          syndicateName = currentName,
          role = if (isCustomFounder) "Founder / Commander" else "Pilot",
          joinedTimestamp = prefs.getLong(KEY_FIRST_COMMISSION_MS, 0L).let {
            if (it > 0L) it else {
              val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
              prefs.edit().putLong(KEY_FIRST_COMMISSION_MS, now).apply()
              now
            }
          },
          leftTimestamp = 0L,
          totalKills = getAllTimeKills(),
          peakBountyAchieved = getAllTimeBountyPeak(),
          publicGameWins = getConvergencesWon(),
        )
      saveSyndicateServiceHistory(listOf(seed), uid)
      return listOf(seed)
    }
    return parsed
  }

  fun saveSyndicateServiceHistory(entries: List<SyndicateServiceEntry>, uid: String? = null) {
    val arr = JSONArray()
    entries.forEach { arr.put(it.toJson()) }
    val json = arr.toString()
    prefs
      .edit()
      .putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_HISTORY_JSON, json)
      .putString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_HISTORY_JSON, uid), json)
      .apply()
  }

  private fun appendSyndicateServiceTransition(
    newTag: String,
    newName: String,
    newRole: String,
    nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
    uid: String? = null,
  ) {
    val currentList = getSyndicateServiceHistory(uid).toMutableList()
    val activeIdx = currentList.indexOfLast { it.leftTimestamp <= 0L }
    if (activeIdx >= 0) {
      val active = currentList[activeIdx]
      if (active.syndicateTag.equals(newTag, ignoreCase = true) && active.role == newRole) {
        return
      }
      currentList[activeIdx] = active.copy(leftTimestamp = nowMs)
    }
    currentList.add(
      SyndicateServiceEntry(
        syndicateTag = newTag,
        syndicateName = newName,
        role = newRole,
        joinedTimestamp = nowMs,
        leftTimestamp = 0L,
        totalKills = 0L,
        peakBountyAchieved = 100L,
        publicGameWins = 0L,
      )
    )
    saveSyndicateServiceHistory(currentList, uid)
  }

  fun recordSyndicateContribution(
    addKills: Long = 0L,
    currentBounty: Long = 100L,
    addPublicWins: Long = 0L,
    uid: String? = null,
  ) {
    val currentList = getSyndicateServiceHistory(uid).toMutableList()
    val activeIdx = currentList.indexOfLast { it.leftTimestamp <= 0L }
    if (activeIdx >= 0) {
      val active = currentList[activeIdx]
      currentList[activeIdx] =
        active.copy(
          totalKills = (active.totalKills + addKills).coerceAtLeast(0L),
          peakBountyAchieved = kotlin.math.max(active.peakBountyAchieved, currentBounty),
          publicGameWins = (active.publicGameWins + addPublicWins).coerceAtLeast(0L),
        )
      saveSyndicateServiceHistory(currentList, uid)
    }
  }

  fun getBlockedPilotUids(): Set<String> {
    val raw = prefs.getString(KEY_BLOCKED_PILOT_UIDS, "") ?: ""
    return raw.split(",").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.toSet()
  }

  fun blockPilot(uid: String) {
    if (uid.isBlank()) return
    val next = getBlockedPilotUids() + uid.trim()
    prefs.edit().putString(KEY_BLOCKED_PILOT_UIDS, next.joinToString(",")).apply()
  }

  fun unblockPilot(uid: String) {
    val next = getBlockedPilotUids() - uid.trim()
    prefs.edit().putString(KEY_BLOCKED_PILOT_UIDS, next.joinToString(",")).apply()
  }

  fun reportPilot(uid: String, callsign: String, reason: String = "In-Game Comms / Conduct"): Int {
    val raw = prefs.getString(KEY_REPORTED_PILOTS_JSON, "[]") ?: "[]"
    val arr =
      try {
        JSONArray(raw)
      } catch (_: Exception) {
        JSONArray()
      }
    arr.put(
      JSONObject().apply {
        put("uid", uid)
        put("callsign", callsign)
        put("reason", reason)
        put("timestampMs", System.currentTimeMillis())
      }
    )
    prefs.edit().putString(KEY_REPORTED_PILOTS_JSON, arr.toString()).apply()
    return arr.length()
  }

  /**
   * Returns up to 5 private custom channels for [syndicateTag], always starting with "#general" at index 0.
   * Defaults to listOf("#general", "#tactics", "#war-room").
   */
  fun getSyndicateCustomChannels(syndicateTag: String = getSyndicateTag()): List<String> {
    val cleanTag = syndicateTag.trim().uppercase()
    if (cleanTag.isEmpty() || cleanTag == "SOLO") {
      return listOf("#general", "#tactics", "#war-room")
    }
    val raw = prefs.getString("${KEY_SYNDICATE_CHANNELS_PREFIX}$cleanTag", null)
    if (raw.isNullOrBlank()) {
      return listOf("#general", "#tactics", "#war-room")
    }
    val parsed = mutableListOf<String>()
    try {
      val arr = JSONArray(raw)
      for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
        val ch = normalizeChannelName(arr.optString(i, ""))
        if (ch.isNotEmpty() && parsed.none { it.equals(ch, ignoreCase = true) }) {
          parsed.add(ch)
        }
      }
    } catch (_: Exception) {}
    parsed.removeAll { it.equals("#general", ignoreCase = true) }
    parsed.add(0, "#general")
    return parsed.take(5)
  }

  /**
   * Saves up to 5 clean `#channel-name` strings for [syndicateTag], always keeping `"#general"` at index 0.
   */
  fun setSyndicateCustomChannels(syndicateTag: String, channels: List<String>) {
    val cleanTag = syndicateTag.trim().uppercase()
    if (cleanTag.isEmpty()) return
    val sanitized = mutableListOf("#general")
    for (raw in channels) {
      val norm = normalizeChannelName(raw)
      if (norm.isNotEmpty() && sanitized.none { it.equals(norm, ignoreCase = true) }) {
        sanitized.add(norm)
      }
      if (sanitized.size >= 5) break
    }
    val arr = JSONArray()
    sanitized.forEach { arr.put(it) }
    prefs.edit().putString("${KEY_SYNDICATE_CHANNELS_PREFIX}$cleanTag", arr.toString()).apply()
  }

  private fun normalizeChannelName(raw: String): String {
    val stripped =
      raw
        .trim()
        .lowercase()
        .removePrefix("#")
        .replace(Regex("[^a-z0-9_-]"), "-")
        .replace(Regex("-+"), "-")
        .trim('-')
        .take(18)
    return if (stripped.isEmpty()) "" else "#$stripped"
  }

  fun getSyndicateInvitedGuests(syndicateTag: String = getSyndicateTag()): Set<String> {
    val cleanTag = syndicateTag.trim().uppercase()
    if (cleanTag.isEmpty() || cleanTag == "SOLO") return emptySet()
    val raw = prefs.getString("${KEY_SYNDICATE_GUESTS_PREFIX}$cleanTag", "") ?: ""
    return raw.split(",").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.toSet()
  }

  fun inviteGuestToSyndicateChannels(syndicateTag: String, guestCallsign: String) {
    val cleanTag = syndicateTag.trim().uppercase()
    val cleanGuest = guestCallsign.trim().take(20)
    if (cleanTag.isEmpty() || cleanTag == "SOLO" || cleanGuest.isEmpty()) return
    val existing = getSyndicateInvitedGuests(cleanTag).toMutableList()
    if (existing.none { it.equals(cleanGuest, ignoreCase = true) }) {
      existing.add(cleanGuest)
      prefs.edit().putString("${KEY_SYNDICATE_GUESTS_PREFIX}$cleanTag", existing.joinToString(",")).apply()
    }
  }

  fun revokeGuestFromSyndicateChannels(syndicateTag: String, guestCallsign: String) {
    val cleanTag = syndicateTag.trim().uppercase()
    val cleanGuest = guestCallsign.trim()
    if (cleanTag.isEmpty() || cleanGuest.isEmpty()) return
    val remaining =
      getSyndicateInvitedGuests(cleanTag).filterNot { it.equals(cleanGuest, ignoreCase = true) }
    prefs.edit().putString("${KEY_SYNDICATE_GUESTS_PREFIX}$cleanTag", remaining.joinToString(",")).apply()
  }

  fun canAccessSyndicateChannels(
    pilotSyndicateTag: String,
    pilotCallsign: String,
    targetSyndicateTag: String,
  ): Boolean {
    val targetClean = targetSyndicateTag.trim().uppercase()
    if (targetClean.isEmpty() || targetClean == "SOLO") return false
    if (pilotSyndicateTag.trim().equals(targetClean, ignoreCase = true)) return true
    return getSyndicateInvitedGuests(targetClean).any {
      it.equals(pilotCallsign.trim(), ignoreCase = true)
    }
  }

  fun getSyndicateWarRecord(tag: String = getSyndicateTag()): SyndicateWarRecord {
    val cleanTag = tag.trim().uppercase().ifEmpty { "SOLO" }
    val raw = prefs.getString(KEY_SYNDICATE_WAR_RECORDS_JSON, "{}") ?: "{}"
    try {
      val root = JSONObject(raw)
      val obj = root.optJSONObject(cleanTag)
      if (obj != null) {
        return SyndicateWarRecord.fromJson(cleanTag, obj)
      }
    } catch (_: Exception) {}
    return when (cleanTag) {
      "AEX" -> SyndicateWarRecord("AEX", warTrophies = 1480, warWins = 42, warLosses = 14, warStreak = 4)
      "VTX" -> SyndicateWarRecord("VTX", warTrophies = 1390, warWins = 38, warLosses = 17, warStreak = 2)
      "KST" -> SyndicateWarRecord("KST", warTrophies = 1315, warWins = 35, warLosses = 19, warStreak = 1)
      "OBS" -> SyndicateWarRecord("OBS", warTrophies = 1260, warWins = 31, warLosses = 20, warStreak = 3)
      "SOL" -> SyndicateWarRecord("SOL", warTrophies = 1195, warWins = 29, warLosses = 22, warStreak = 0)
      "RFT" -> SyndicateWarRecord("RFT", warTrophies = 1140, warWins = 26, warLosses = 21, warStreak = 1)
      else -> SyndicateWarRecord(cleanTag, warTrophies = 1000, warWins = 0, warLosses = 0, warStreak = 0)
    }
  }

  fun recordSyndicateWarOutcome(
    tag: String = getSyndicateTag(),
    won: Boolean,
    trophyDelta: Int = if (won) 25 else -15,
  ): SyndicateWarRecord {
    val cleanTag = tag.trim().uppercase().ifEmpty { "SOLO" }
    val current = getSyndicateWarRecord(cleanTag)
    val signedDelta = if (won) kotlin.math.abs(trophyDelta) else -kotlin.math.abs(trophyDelta)
    val updated =
      SyndicateWarRecord(
        tag = cleanTag,
        warTrophies = (current.warTrophies + signedDelta).coerceAtLeast(0),
        warWins = current.warWins + (if (won) 1 else 0),
        warLosses = current.warLosses + (if (won) 0 else 1),
        warStreak = if (won) current.warStreak + 1 else 0,
      )
    val raw = prefs.getString(KEY_SYNDICATE_WAR_RECORDS_JSON, "{}") ?: "{}"
    val root =
      try {
        JSONObject(raw)
      } catch (_: Exception) {
        JSONObject()
      }
    root.put(cleanTag, updated.toJson())
    prefs.edit().putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_WAR_RECORDS_JSON, root.toString()).apply()
    return updated
  }

  /**
   * Master Fresh-Start Wipe:
   * Clears all combat stats, 5 XP sources, peak bounty snapshots, Armada tiers, active Armada,
   * custom friends, custom Syndicates, Syndicate service history, custom Syndicate channels/guests,
   * Syndicate War H2H records, and custom modular ship slots (Frame A/B/C) while resetting Rift Shards to 150❖.
   */
  fun wipeAllStatsArmadasAndSyndicates(uid: String? = null) {
    val dynamicKeysToRemove =
      prefs.all.keys.filter { key ->
        key.startsWith(KEY_SYNDICATE_CHANNELS_PREFIX) ||
          key.startsWith("syndicate_channels_") ||
          key.startsWith(KEY_SYNDICATE_GUESTS_PREFIX) ||
          key.startsWith("syndicate_guests_") ||
          key.startsWith("syndicate_war_record_") ||
          key.startsWith(KEY_CUSTOM_SLOT_PREFIX)
      }

    val editor = prefs.edit()
    for (k in dynamicKeysToRemove) {
      editor.remove(k)
    }

    // Combat stats
    editor
      .putLong(KEY_PVP_KILLS, 0L)
      .putLong(KEY_PVP_DEATHS, 0L)
      .putLong(KEY_PVP_BOUNTY_PEAK, 100L)
      .putLong(KEY_ALL_KILLS, 0L)
      .putLong(KEY_ALL_DEATHS, 0L)
      .putLong(KEY_ALL_BOUNTY_PEAK, 100L)
      .putLong(KEY_CONVERGENCES_WON, 0L)
      .putLong(KEY_HVT_ELIMINATIONS, 0L)
      .putLong(KEY_GREENS_COLLECTED, 0L)

    // 5 XP sources + progression + Rift Shards (150❖)
    editor
      .putLong(KEY_XP_BUFFS, 0L)
      .putLong(uidKey(KEY_XP_BUFFS, uid), 0L)
      .putLong(KEY_XP_DAMAGE, 0L)
      .putLong(uidKey(KEY_XP_DAMAGE, uid), 0L)
      .putLong(KEY_XP_ACCURACY, 0L)
      .putLong(uidKey(KEY_XP_ACCURACY, uid), 0L)
      .putLong(KEY_XP_BOUNTY_EARNED, 0L)
      .putLong(uidKey(KEY_XP_BOUNTY_EARNED, uid), 0L)
      .putLong(KEY_XP_BOUNTY_KILLED, 0L)
      .putLong(uidKey(KEY_XP_BOUNTY_KILLED, uid), 0L)
      .putLong(KEY_RIFT_SHARDS, 150L)
      .putLong(uidKey(KEY_RIFT_SHARDS, uid), 150L)
      .putInt(KEY_HIGHEST_MILESTONE_LVL, 1)
      .putInt(uidKey(KEY_HIGHEST_MILESTONE_LVL, uid), 1)
      .putInt(KEY_SPENT_CUSTOM_POINTS, 0)
      .putInt(uidKey(KEY_SPENT_CUSTOM_POINTS, uid), 0)
      .putInt(KEY_UNLOCKED_EXTRA_SLOTS, 0)
      .putInt(uidKey(KEY_UNLOCKED_EXTRA_SLOTS, uid), 0)
      .putInt(KEY_AI_DESIGN_TOKENS, 0)
      .putInt(uidKey(KEY_AI_DESIGN_TOKENS, uid), 0)

    // Peak bounty snapshots
    editor
      .remove(KEY_ALL_TIME_PEAK_SNAPSHOT)
      .remove(uidKey(KEY_ALL_TIME_PEAK_SNAPSHOT, uid))
      .remove(KEY_PVP_PEAK_SNAPSHOT)
      .remove(uidKey(KEY_PVP_PEAK_SNAPSHOT, uid))

    // Armada Tier 1..5 kills and bounty peaks
    for (tier in 1..5) {
      editor.putLong("armada_tier_${tier}_kills", 0L)
      editor.putLong("armada_tier_${tier}_bounty", 100L)
    }

    // Active Armada, custom friends, custom Syndicates, Syndicate history, Syndicate War records
    editor
      .putString(KEY_ARMADA_NAME, "")
      .putString(KEY_CUSTOM_FRIENDS_JSON, "[]")
      .putString(KEY_CUSTOM_SYNDICATES_JSON, "[]")
      .putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_HISTORY_JSON, "[]")
      .putString(uidKey(KEY_SYNDICATE_HISTORY_JSON, uid), "[]")
      .putLong(KEY_SYNDICATE_LOCK_UNTIL_MS, 0L)
      .putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_TAG, "GUEST")
      .putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_NAME, "Independent Pilot")
      .putString(KEY_SYNDICATE_WAR_RECORDS_JSON, "{}")
      .putBoolean(KEY_SLOT_B_UNLOCKED, false)
      .putBoolean(uidKey(KEY_SLOT_B_UNLOCKED, uid), false)
      .putBoolean(KEY_SLOT_C_UNLOCKED, false)
      .putBoolean(uidKey(KEY_SLOT_C_UNLOCKED, uid), false)
      .putString(KEY_ACTIVE_CUSTOM_SLOT_ID, "Frame A")
      .putString(uidKey(KEY_ACTIVE_CUSTOM_SLOT_ID, uid), "Frame A")
      .apply()

    // Reset Custom Modular Ship Slots (Frame A, Frame B, Frame C) to default unallocated state
    for (slotId in listOf("Frame A", "Frame B", "Frame C")) {
      saveCustomShipSlot(com.example.engine.CustomShipLoadoutSlot(slotId = slotId), uid)
    }
  }

  /**
   * Resets all local pilot progression, combat stats, Syndicate/Armada affiliation, custom friends,
   * and Rift Shards back to a clean Level 1, 0 XP, 0 Kills, 0 Shards, Solo, Unaffiliated state.
   */
  fun resetAllLocalPilotData() {
    val seenBuild = getLastSeenChangelogBuild()
    val guestBypass = isGuestBypassEnabled()
    prefs.edit().clear().apply()
    userSettingsPrefs.edit().clear().apply()
    setLastSeenChangelogBuild(seenBuild)
    setGuestBypassEnabled(guestBypass)
    getOrCreatePermanentDeviceUid()
  }

  private fun cleanShipNameForId(shipId: Int): String =
    when (shipId) {
      1 -> "Viper"
      2 -> "Ricochet"
      3 -> "Suppressor"
      4 -> "Goliath"
      5 -> "Twinfang"
      6 -> "Disruptor"
      7 -> "Valkyrie"
      8 -> "Manta"
      9 -> "Interdictor"
      else -> "Rift Frame"
    }

    private const val KEY_ALL_TIME_PEAK_SNAPSHOT = "all_time_peak_bounty_snapshot_json"
    private const val KEY_PVP_PEAK_SNAPSHOT = "pvp_peak_bounty_snapshot_json"
    private const val KEY_SYNDICATE_HISTORY_JSON = "syndicate_service_history_json"
    private const val KEY_FIRST_COMMISSION_MS = "pilot_first_commission_ms"

    const val FIFTEEN_DAYS_MS = 15L * 24L * 3600L * 1000L

    /**
     * Cumulative XP required to reach the start of Level [level] (1..100).
     * Level 1 starts at 0 XP; Level 2 requires 250 XP; each subsequent level step requires +50 XP more.
     */
    fun xpForLevelStart(level: Int): Long {
      val clamped = level.coerceIn(1, 100)
      if (clamped <= 1) return 0L
      val n = (clamped - 1).toLong()
      return n * 250L + (n * (n - 1L) / 2L) * 50L
    }

    /**
     * Computes Pilot Level (1..100) from cumulative total XP.
     */
    fun computeLevelFromTotalXp(totalXp: Long): Int {
      val cleanXp = totalXp.coerceAtLeast(0L)
      for (lvl in 100 downTo 1) {
        if (cleanXp >= xpForLevelStart(lvl)) {
          return lvl
        }
      }
      return 1
    }

    /**
     * Returns (xpIntoCurrentLevel, xpSpanForCurrentLevel, progressFraction 0f..1f).
     */
    fun getXpProgressInLevel(totalXp: Long): Triple<Long, Long, Float> {
      val cleanXp = totalXp.coerceAtLeast(0L)
      val lvl = computeLevelFromTotalXp(cleanXp)
      if (lvl >= 100) {
        val capXp = xpForLevelStart(100)
        return Triple(cleanXp - capXp, 0L, 1.0f)
      }
      val startXp = xpForLevelStart(lvl)
      val nextXp = xpForLevelStart(lvl + 1)
      val span = (nextXp - startXp).coerceAtLeast(1L)
      val into = (cleanXp - startXp).coerceAtLeast(0L)
      val frac = (into.toFloat() / span.toFloat()).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
      return Triple(into, span, frac)
    }
  }
}

  val bountyReached: Int = 100,
  val shipId: Int = 1,
  val shipFlown: String = "Viper",
  val timeSurvivedSec: Float = 0f,
  val pvpKills: Int = 0,
  val botKills: Int = 0,
  val hvtShutdowns: Int = 0,
  val damageDealt: Float = 0f,
  val damageTaken: Float = 0f,
  val shotsFired: Int = 0,
  val shotsHit: Int = 0,
  val buffsCollected: Int = 0,
  val recordedAtMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
  val executioner: ExecutionerTelemetry = ExecutionerTelemetry(),
) {
  fun accuracyPercent(): Int {
    if (shotsFired <= 0) return 0
    return ((shotsHit.toFloat() / shotsFired.toFloat()) * 100f).toInt().coerceIn(0, 100)
  }

  fun formattedDuration(): String {
    val totalSec = timeSurvivedSec.toInt().coerceAtLeast(0)
    val mins = totalSec / 60
    val secs = totalSec % 60
    return java.util.Locale.US.let { String.format(it, "%dm %02ds", mins, secs) }
  }

  fun toJsonString(): String =
    org.json.JSONObject().apply {
      put("bountyReached", bountyReached)
      put("shipId", shipId)
      put("shipFlown", shipFlown)
      put("timeSurvivedSec", timeSurvivedSec.toDouble())
      put("pvpKills", pvpKills)
      put("botKills", botKills)
      put("hvtShutdowns", hvtShutdowns)
      put("damageDealt", damageDealt.toDouble())
      put("damageTaken", damageTaken.toDouble())
      put("shotsFired", shotsFired)
      put("shotsHit", shotsHit)
      put("buffsCollected", buffsCollected)
      put("recordedAtMs", recordedAtMs)
      put("executioner", executioner.toJson())
    }.toString()

  companion object {
    fun fromJsonString(raw: String?): PeakBountyRunSnapshot? {
      if (raw.isNullOrBlank()) return null
      return try {
        val obj = org.json.JSONObject(raw)
        PeakBountyRunSnapshot(
          bountyReached = obj.optInt("bountyReached", 100),
          shipId = obj.optInt("shipId", 1),
          shipFlown = stripShipNumberPrefix(obj.optString("shipFlown", "Viper")).ifEmpty { "Viper" },
          timeSurvivedSec = obj.optDouble("timeSurvivedSec", 0.0).toFloat(),
          pvpKills = obj.optInt("pvpKills", 0),
          botKills = obj.optInt("botKills", 0),
          hvtShutdowns = obj.optInt("hvtShutdowns", 0),
          damageDealt = obj.optDouble("damageDealt", 0.0).toFloat(),
          damageTaken = obj.optDouble("damageTaken", 0.0).toFloat(),
          shotsFired = obj.optInt("shotsFired", 0),
          shotsHit = obj.optInt("shotsHit", 0),
          buffsCollected = obj.optInt("buffsCollected", 0),
          recordedAtMs = obj.optLong("recordedAtMs", System.currentTimeMillis()),
          executioner = ExecutionerTelemetry.fromJson(obj.optJSONObject("executioner")),
        )
      } catch (_: Exception) {
        null
      }
    }
  }
}

data class SyndicateServiceEntry(
  val syndicateTag: String,
  val syndicateName: String,
  val role: String = "Pilot", // "Founder / Commander", "Officer", or "Pilot"
  val joinedTimestamp: Long,
  val leftTimestamp: Long = 0L, // 0L = ACTIVE
  val totalKills: Long = 0L,
  val peakBountyAchieved: Long = 100L,
  val publicGameWins: Long = 0L,
) {
  val isActive: Boolean
    get() = leftTimestamp <= 0L

  fun formatTenure(nowMs: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): String {
    val endMs = if (leftTimestamp > 0L) leftTimestamp else nowMs
    val elapsedMs = (endMs - joinedTimestamp).coerceAtLeast(0L)
    val totalMinutes = elapsedMs / 60_000L
    val days = totalMinutes / (24L * 60L)
    val hours = (totalMinutes / 60L) % 24L
    val mins = totalMinutes % 60L
    return String.format(java.util.Locale.US, "%dd %dh %dm", days, hours, mins)
  }

  fun toJson(): org.json.JSONObject =
    org.json.JSONObject().apply {
      put("syndicateTag", syndicateTag)
      put("syndicateName", syndicateName)
      put("role", role)
      put("joinedTimestamp", joinedTimestamp)
      put("leftTimestamp", leftTimestamp)
      put("totalKills", totalKills)
      put("peakBountyAchieved", peakBountyAchieved)
      put("publicGameWins", publicGameWins)
    }

  companion object {
    fun fromJson(obj: org.json.JSONObject): SyndicateServiceEntry {
      val rawTag = obj.optString("syndicateTag", "GUEST").uppercase()
      val cleanTag = if (rawTag in setOf("KSTL", "AURL", "VRTX", "RUST", "")) "GUEST" else rawTag
      val rawName = obj.optString("syndicateName", "Guest Tracking Framework")
      val cleanName =
        if (
          rawName.contains("Kestrel", ignoreCase = true) ||
            rawName.contains("Aurelia", ignoreCase = true) ||
            rawName.contains("Vortex", ignoreCase = true) ||
            rawName.contains("Rustweld", ignoreCase = true)
        ) {
          "Guest Tracking Framework"
        } else {
          rawName
        }
      return SyndicateServiceEntry(
        syndicateTag = cleanTag,
        syndicateName = cleanName,
        role = obj.optString("role", "Pilot"),
        joinedTimestamp = obj.optLong("joinedTimestamp", System.currentTimeMillis()),
        leftTimestamp = obj.optLong("leftTimestamp", 0L),
        totalKills = obj.optLong("totalKills", 0L),
        peakBountyAchieved = obj.optLong("peakBountyAchieved", 100L),
        publicGameWins = obj.optLong("publicGameWins", 0L),
      )
    }
  }
}

package com.example.data

import android.content.Context
import com.example.R
import com.google.firebase.Firebase
import com.google.firebase.auth.auth
import com.google.firebase.firestore.DocumentSnapshot
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FieldValue
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestoreException
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestoreSettings
import com.google.firebase.firestore.MemoryCacheSettings
import com.google.firebase.firestore.snapshots
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.catch
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.tasks.await

class RiftRepository(private val dbProvider: () -> FirebaseFirestore) {

  constructor(db: FirebaseFirestore) : this({ db })

  constructor(context: Context) : this({
    val appContext = context.applicationContext
    val db =
      FirebaseFirestore.getInstance(
        appContext.getString(R.string.firestore_database_id)
      )
    try {
      db.firestoreSettings =
        FirebaseFirestoreSettings.Builder()
          .setLocalCacheSettings(MemoryCacheSettings.newBuilder().build())
          .build()
    } catch (_: Exception) {
      // Settings already applied on this instance
    }
    db
  })

  private val db: FirebaseFirestore by lazy { dbProvider() }

  private val auth = Firebase.auth

  private fun requireUserId(): String {
    val uid = auth.currentUser?.uid?.trim()
    if (uid.isNullOrEmpty() || uid.startsWith("dev_")) {
      throw IllegalStateException("User must be signed in with Google before accessing Firestore.")
    }
    return uid
  }

  private fun isAuthenticatedNonGuest(): Boolean {
    val uid = auth.currentUser?.uid?.trim()
    return !uid.isNullOrEmpty() && !uid.startsWith("dev_")
  }

  private fun sanitizeCallsign(raw: String): String {
    val cleaned = raw.trim().replace(Regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9_\\- ]"), "")
    return when {
      cleaned.length < 2 -> "PILOT_01"
      cleaned.length > 24 -> cleaned.take(24)
      else -> cleaned
    }
  }

  private fun sanitizeTag(raw: String): String {
    return raw.trim().uppercase().replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_]"), "").take(12)
  }

  private fun sanitizeFoundry(raw: String): String {
    val clean = raw.trim()
    return if (clean.isEmpty()) "Independent" else clean.take(32)
  }

  private fun sanitizeMode(raw: String): String {
    val allowed =
      setOf(
        "FFA",
        "SECTOR_CONVERGENCE",
        "RIFT_SKIRMISH",
        "FLUX_CORE",
        "STASIS_BREACH",
        "SYNDICATE_WARS",
        "warzone_10v10",
        "ranked_3v3",
        "ranked_5v5",
      )
    return if (raw in allowed) raw else "FFA"
  }

  suspend fun getPilotDossier(userId: String = requireUserId()): Result<PilotDossier?> = runCatching {
    val callerUid = requireUserId()
    val resolvedUid = userId.trim().ifEmpty { callerUid }
    if (resolvedUid.startsWith("dev_")) {
      return@runCatching null
    }
    val path = "users/$resolvedUid"
    try {
      val snapshot = db.collection("users").document(resolvedUid).get().await()
      if (snapshot.exists()) {
        snapshot.toObject(PilotDossier::class.java, DocumentSnapshot.ServerTimestampBehavior.ESTIMATE)
      } else {
        null
      }
    } catch (e: CancellationException) {
      throw e
    } catch (e: Exception) {
      if (isAuthenticatedNonGuest()) {
        handleFirestoreError(e, OperationType.GET, path)
      }
      throw e
    }
  }

  fun observePilotDossier(userId: String): Flow<PilotDossier?> {
    val path = "users/$userId"
    return db.collection("users")
      .document(userId)
      .snapshots()
      .map { snapshot ->
        if (snapshot.exists()) {
          snapshot.toObject(PilotDossier::class.java, DocumentSnapshot.ServerTimestampBehavior.ESTIMATE)
        } else {
          null
        }
      }
      .catch { error ->
        val firestoreError =
          generateSequence(error) { it.cause }
            .filterIsInstance<FirebaseFirestoreException>()
            .firstOrNull()
        if (firestoreError == null && error is CancellationException) throw error
        val exceptionToLog = firestoreError ?: (error as? Exception)
        if (exceptionToLog != null && isAuthenticatedNonGuest() && auth.currentUser?.uid == userId) {
          handleFirestoreError(exceptionToLog, OperationType.GET, path)
        }
        throw error
      }
  }

  suspend fun savePilotDossier(dossier: PilotDossier): Result<Unit> = runCatching {
    val uid = requireUserId()
    val docRef = db.collection("users").document(uid)
    val safeCallsign = sanitizeCallsign(dossier.callsign)
    val safeShipId = dossier.preferredShipId.coerceIn(1L, 10L)
    val safeFoundry = sanitizeFoundry(dossier.preferredFoundry)
    val safeMode = sanitizeMode(dossier.preferredMode)

    try {
      val existingSnap = docRef.get().await()
      if (!existingSnap.exists()) {
        val createPayload =
          mapOf(
            "userId" to uid,
            "callsign" to safeCallsign,
            "preferredShipId" to safeShipId,
            "preferredFoundry" to safeFoundry,
            "preferredMode" to safeMode,
            "pvpKills" to dossier.pvpKills.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "pvpDeaths" to dossier.pvpDeaths.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "pvpBountyPeak" to dossier.pvpBountyPeak.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "allTimeKills" to dossier.allTimeKills.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "allTimeDeaths" to dossier.allTimeDeaths.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "allTimeBountyPeak" to dossier.allTimeBountyPeak.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "convergencesWon" to dossier.convergencesWon.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "createdAt" to FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
            "updatedAt" to FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          )
        docRef.set(createPayload).await()
      } else {
        val updatePayload =
          mapOf(
            "callsign" to safeCallsign,
            "preferredShipId" to safeShipId,
            "preferredFoundry" to safeFoundry,
            "preferredMode" to safeMode,
            "pvpKills" to dossier.pvpKills.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "pvpDeaths" to dossier.pvpDeaths.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "pvpBountyPeak" to dossier.pvpBountyPeak.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "allTimeKills" to dossier.allTimeKills.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "allTimeDeaths" to dossier.allTimeDeaths.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "allTimeBountyPeak" to dossier.allTimeBountyPeak.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "convergencesWon" to dossier.convergencesWon.coerceAtLeast(0L),
            "updatedAt" to FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          )
        docRef.update(updatePayload).await()
      }
    } catch (e: CancellationException) {
      throw e
    } catch (e: Exception) {
      if (isAuthenticatedNonGuest()) {
        handleFirestoreError(e, OperationType.WRITE, docRef.path)
      }
      throw e
    }
  }

  suspend fun saveLeaderboardEntry(entry: LeaderboardEntry): Result<Unit> = runCatching {
    val uid = requireUserId()
    val docRef = db.collection("leaderboard").document(uid)
    val safeCallsign = sanitizeCallsign(entry.callsign)
    val safeShipId = entry.shipId.coerceIn(1L, 10L)

            DocumentSnapshot.ServerTimestampBehavior.ESTIMATE

  suspend fun saveCloudSyndicate(syndicate: SyndicateInfo): Result<Unit> = runCatching {
    val uid = requireUserId()
    val cleanTag = sanitizeTag(syndicate.tag).take(4)
    if (cleanTag.length < 2) {
      throw IllegalArgumentException("Syndicate tag must be at least 2 characters.")
    }
    val docRef = db.collection("syndicates").document(cleanTag)
    try {
      val existingSnap = docRef.get().await()
      if (!existingSnap.exists()) {
        val createPayload =
          mapOf(
            "ownerId" to uid,
            "tag" to cleanTag,
            "name" to syndicate.name.trim().take(36).ifEmpty { "$cleanTag Syndicate" },
            "foundryOrigin" to sanitizeFoundry(syndicate.foundryOrigin),
            "motto" to syndicate.motto.trim().take(64).ifEmpty { "Independent Rift Syndicate" },
            "memberCount" to syndicate.memberCount.coerceAtLeast(1),
            "combinedBounty" to syndicate.combinedBounty.coerceAtLeast(100L),
            "isCustom" to true,
            "createdAt" to FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
            "updatedAt" to FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          )
        docRef.set(createPayload).await()
      } else {
        val updatePayload =
          mapOf(
            "name" to syndicate.name.trim().take(36).ifEmpty { "$cleanTag Syndicate" },
            "foundryOrigin" to sanitizeFoundry(syndicate.foundryOrigin),
            "motto" to syndicate.motto.trim().take(64).ifEmpty { "Independent Rift Syndicate" },
            "memberCount" to syndicate.memberCount.coerceAtLeast(1),
            "combinedBounty" to syndicate.combinedBounty.coerceAtLeast(100L),
            "updatedAt" to FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
          )
        docRef.update(updatePayload).await()
      }
    } catch (e: CancellationException) {
      throw e
    } catch (e: Exception) {
      if (isAuthenticatedNonGuest()) {
        handleFirestoreError(e, OperationType.WRITE, docRef.path)
      }
      throw e
    }
  }

  suspend fun postSectorCommMessage(msg: SyndicateChatMessage): Result<Unit> = runCatching {
    val uid = requireUserId()
    val rawId = msg.id.trim().replace(Regex("[^a-zA-Z0-9_\\-]"), "")
    val docId = rawId.ifEmpty { "comm_${System.currentTimeMillis()}" }
    val docRef = db.collection("sector_comms").document(docId)
    val payload =
      mapOf(
        "senderUid" to uid,
        "visibility" to "public",
        "senderCallsign" to sanitizeCallsign(msg.senderCallsign),
        "senderSyndicateTag" to sanitizeTag(msg.senderSyndicateTag),
        "timestampLabel" to msg.timestampLabel.trim().take(24).ifEmpty { "JUST NOW" },
        "messageText" to UgcModeration.sanitizeUgcText(msg.messageText).take(240),
        "isArmadaRecruitBanner" to msg.isArmadaRecruitBanner,
        "armadaName" to sanitizeTag(msg.armadaName),
        "armadaCurrentSize" to msg.armadaCurrentSize.coerceIn(1, 5),
        "armadaMaxSize" to msg.armadaMaxSize.coerceIn(1, 5),
        "armadaObjective" to UgcModeration.sanitizeUgcText(msg.armadaObjective).take(120),
        "requestSent" to msg.requestSent,
        "createdAtMs" to msg.createdAtMs.coerceAtLeast(0L),
        "createdAt" to FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      )
    try {
      docRef.set(payload).await()
    } catch (e: CancellationException) {
      throw e
    } catch (e: Exception) {
      if (isAuthenticatedNonGuest()) {
        handleFirestoreError(e, OperationType.WRITE, docRef.path)
      }
      throw e
    }
  }

```
package com.example.data

import java.util.Locale

/**
 * Lightweight on-device UGC moderation helper for pilot callsigns, Syndicate metadata,
 * Armada tags, and Syndicate Comms chat messages.
 */
object UgcModeration {
  private val BLOCKED_WORDS =
    listOf(
      "fuck",
      "shit",
      "bitch",
      "asshole",
      "bastard",
      "cunt",
      "dickhead",
      "motherfucker",
      "nigger",
      "nigga",
      "faggot",
      "retard",
      "slut",
      "whore",
      "nazi",
      "hitler",
      "kys",
    )

  private val WHOLE_WORD_REGEX =
    Regex(
      "\\b(${BLOCKED_WORDS.joinToString("|") { Regex.escape(it) }})\\b",
      RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE,
    )

  private val COMPACT_TOKEN_REGEX =
    Regex(
      "(${BLOCKED_WORDS.filter { it.length >= 4 }.joinToString("|") { Regex.escape(it) }})",
      RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE,
    )

  fun containsProfanity(raw: String): Boolean {
    if (raw.isBlank()) return false
    if (WHOLE_WORD_REGEX.containsMatchIn(raw)) return true
    val stripped = raw.lowercase(Locale.US).replace(Regex("[^a-z]"), "")
    return BLOCKED_WORDS.any { word ->
      word.length >= 4 && stripped.contains(word)
    }
  }

  fun sanitizeUgcText(raw: String): String {
    if (raw.isBlank()) return raw
    var cleaned = WHOLE_WORD_REGEX.replace(raw) { match -> "*".repeat(match.value.length.coerceAtLeast(3)) }
    if (containsProfanity(cleaned)) {
      cleaned = COMPACT_TOKEN_REGEX.replace(cleaned) { match -> "*".repeat(match.value.length.coerceAtLeast(3)) }
    }
    return cleaned
  }

  fun sanitizeIdentifier(raw: String, fallback: String): String {
    if (raw.isBlank() || containsProfanity(raw)) return fallback
    return raw
  }
}

  private val shipMatrix = Matrix()

  private var dpDensity: Float = resources.displayMetrics.density
  private var cancelDeadzonePx: Float = 32f

  // Dynamic Circular Touch Button Coordinates (calculated per layout size)
  private var leftStickBaseX = 0f
  private var leftStickBaseY = 0f
  private var leftStickRadius = 0f

  private var fireBtnX = 0f
  private var fireBtnY = 0f
  private var fireBtnRadius = 0f

  private var bombBtnX = 0f
  private var bombBtnY = 0f
  private var bombBtnRadius = 0f

  private var utilBtnRadius = 0f
  private var arcDistBomb = 0f
  private var arcDistUtil = 0f

  // UI Unlock drag state for canvas controls
  private var uiDragPointerId: Int = MotionEvent.INVALID_POINTER_ID
  private var uiDraggedControl: String? = null
  private var uiDragLastX: Float = 0f
  private var uiDragLastY: Float = 0f

  private val unlockDashPaint =
    Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
      style = Paint.Style.STROKE
      strokeWidth = 3.0f
      color = Color.parseColor("#FACC15")
      pathEffect = DashPathEffect(floatArrayOf(10f, 6f), 0f)
    }

  private fun effLeftBaseX(): Float = leftStickBaseX + RiftCalibrationState.leftStickOffset.x
  private fun effLeftBaseY(): Float = leftStickBaseY + RiftCalibrationState.leftStickOffset.y
  private fun effLeftRadius(): Float = leftStickRadius * RiftCalibrationState.leftStickScale

  private fun effFireBtnX(): Float =
    fireBtnX + RiftCalibrationState.combatArcOffset.x + RiftCalibrationState.fireStickOffset.x
  private fun effFireBtnY(): Float =
    fireBtnY + RiftCalibrationState.combatArcOffset.y + RiftCalibrationState.fireStickOffset.y
  private fun effFireRadius(): Float = fireBtnRadius * RiftCalibrationState.combatArcScale

  private fun effBombBtnX(): Float =
    bombBtnX + RiftCalibrationState.combatArcOffset.x + RiftCalibrationState.bombBtnOffset.x
  private fun effBombBtnY(): Float =
    bombBtnY + RiftCalibrationState.combatArcOffset.y + RiftCalibrationState.bombBtnOffset.y
  private fun effBombRadius(): Float = bombBtnRadius * RiftCalibrationState.combatArcScale

  override fun onSizeChanged(w: Int, h: Int, oldw: Int, oldh: Int) {
    super.onSizeChanged(w, h, oldw, oldh)
    dpDensity = resources.displayMetrics.density
    cancelDeadzonePx = 32f * dpDensity
    val wf = w.toFloat()
    val hf = h.toFloat()

    // Left Floating Virtual Joystick base anchor (permanently visible at 0.55 idle opacity)
    leftStickRadius = max(42f * dpDensity, min(wf, hf) * 0.115f)
    leftStickBaseX = max(78f * dpDensity, wf * 0.125f)
    leftStickBaseY = hf - max(94f * dpDensity, hf * 0.26f)
    if (leftPointerId == MotionEvent.INVALID_POINTER_ID) {
      leftOriginX = effLeftBaseX()
      leftOriginY = effLeftBaseY()
      leftCurX = effLeftBaseX()
      leftCurY = effLeftBaseY()
    }

    // Primary Right [FIRE] Joystick anchored cleanly in bottom-right corner
    fireBtnRadius = max(40f * dpDensity, min(wf, hf) * 0.098f)
    fireBtnX = wf - max(82f * dpDensity, wf * 0.11f)
    fireBtnY = hf - max(84f * dpDensity, hf * 0.24f)
    if (firePointerId == MotionEvent.INVALID_POINTER_ID) {
      fireCurX = effFireBtnX()
      fireCurY = effFireBtnY()
    }

    bombBtnRadius = max(25f * dpDensity, min(wf, hf) * 0.058f)
    utilBtnRadius = max(21.5f * dpDensity, min(wf, hf) * 0.049f)
    // Ergonomic thumb arc around the Fire stick with ~10dp clean breathing room between buttons
    arcDistBomb = fireBtnRadius + bombBtnRadius + 20f * dpDensity
    arcDistUtil = fireBtnRadius + utilBtnRadius + 24f * dpDensity

    // 188° (Left-Slightly-Up in Canvas coordinates) -> [BOMB / MINE]
    val angle188 = (188.0 * PI / 180.0).toFloat()
    bombBtnX = fireBtnX + cos(angle188) * arcDistBomb
    bombBtnY = fireBtnY + sin(angle188) * arcDistBomb
  }

  /**
   * Computes the active non-zero utility button slots for the 4-Input Right-Hand Combat Cluster:
   * - Special Buff Weapon Button (Burst, Shotgun, or Lock-On Bouncing Missile)
   * - Repel Button (Defensive repulsion shockwave)
   */
  private fun rebuildActiveUtilitySlots(p: ShipEntity) {
    activeUtilitySlots.clear()
    val showAll = RiftCalibrationState.forceAllButtonsVisible || RiftCalibrationState.isUiUnlockedForDragging
    val hasBombEffective = p.spec.hasBomb || showAll
    val startDeg = if (hasBombEffective) 227.0 else 194.0
    val stepDeg = 38.0
    var slotIndex = 0
    val arcScale = RiftCalibrationState.combatArcScale
    val baseArcX = fireBtnX + RiftCalibrationState.combatArcOffset.x
    val baseArcY = fireBtnY + RiftCalibrationState.combatArcOffset.y
    val scaledDist = arcDistUtil * arcScale
    val scaledR = utilBtnRadius * arcScale

    if (p.specialWeaponCharges > 0 || showAll) {
      val rad = ((startDeg + slotIndex * stepDeg) * PI / 180.0).toFloat()
      val count = if (p.specialWeaponCharges > 0) p.specialWeaponCharges else 1
      val activeType =
        if (p.specialWeaponCharges > 0 && p.specialWeaponType != "NONE") {
          p.specialWeaponType
        } else {
          "NOVA_RING"
        }
      val reg = RiftCodex.getBuffRegistryEntry(activeType) ?: RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY.getValue("NOVA_RING")
      activeUtilitySlots.add(
        UtilityButtonSlot(
          type = "SPECIAL",
          title = "${reg.shortLabel} [$count]",
          sub = "0⚡",
          cx = baseArcX + cos(rad) * scaledDist + RiftCalibrationState.burstBtnOffset.x,
          cy = baseArcY + sin(rad) * scaledDist + RiftCalibrationState.burstBtnOffset.y,
          r = scaledR,
          strokeColor = reg.strokeColorInt,
          fillColor = reg.fillColorArgb,
          enabled = p.canFire && p.specialWeaponCharges > 0,
        )
      )
      slotIndex++
    }

    if (p.repels > 0 || showAll) {
      val rad = ((startDeg + slotIndex * stepDeg) * PI / 180.0).toFloat()
      val count = if (p.repels > 0) p.repels else 3
      val rCost = RiftCalibrationState.repelCost
      activeUtilitySlots.add(
        UtilityButtonSlot(
          type = "REPEL",
          title = "REPEL [$count]",
          sub = "${rCost.toInt()}⚡",
          cx = baseArcX + cos(rad) * scaledDist + RiftCalibrationState.repelBtnOffset.x,
          cy = baseArcY + sin(rad) * scaledDist + RiftCalibrationState.repelBtnOffset.y,
          r = scaledR,
          strokeColor = Color.parseColor("#38BDF8"),
          fillColor = Color.argb(155, 10, 48, 82),
          enabled = p.canFire && p.repels > 0 && (p.flux - rCost >= 1f),
        )
      )
      slotIndex++
    }
  }

  override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
    super.onDraw(canvas)

    val vw = width.toFloat()
    val vh = height.toFloat()

    // Native Landscape Enforcement Guard
    if (vh > vw) {
      canvas.drawColor(Color.parseColor("#030712"))
      hudLabelPaint.textSize = 18f * dpDensity
      hudLabelPaint.color = Color.parseColor("#38BDF8")
      canvas.drawText("PLEASE ROTATE DEVICE TO LANDSCAPE", vw * 0.5f, vh * 0.48f, hudLabelPaint)
      hudLabelPaint.textSize = 12f * dpDensity
      hudLabelPaint.color = Color.parseColor("#94A3B8")
      canvas.drawText("RIFT WIDESCREEN ARENA REQUIRES LANDSCAPE VIEWPORT", vw * 0.5f, vh * 0.54f, hudLabelPaint)
      postInvalidateOnAnimation()
      return
    }

    // 1. Delta-time step
    val nowNs = System.nanoTime()
    val dt = ((nowNs - lastFrameNs) / 1_000_000_000f).coerceIn(0.001f, 0.033f)
    lastFrameNs = nowNs

    fpsFrameCount++
    fpsAccumSec += dt
    if (fpsAccumSec >= 0.35f) {
      currentFps = ((fpsFrameCount / fpsAccumSec).toInt()).coerceIn(30, 120)
      fpsFrameCount = 0
      fpsAccumSec = 0f
      onHudTelemetryTick(currentFps)
    }

    engine.stepSimulation(dt)

    val p = engine.localPlayer
    rebuildActiveUtilitySlots(p)

    // Stationary Death Camera: anchor at deathX, deathY on death
    if (p.respawnTimer > 0f) {
      camX = p.deathX
      camY = p.deathY
    } else {
      camX = p.x
      camY = p.y
    }

    // Non-Linear Camera Trauma Shake (Offset = Trauma^2 * MaxOffset * Noise(t))
    val traumaSq = engine.cameraTrauma * engine.cameraTrauma
    val tSec = engine.traumaTimeSec
    val shakeOffsetX = if (traumaSq > 0.0001f) traumaSq * 14f * sin(tSec * 47.0f) else 0f
    val shakeOffsetY = if (traumaSq > 0.0001f) traumaSq * 14f * cos(tSec * 53.0f) else 0f
    val shakeAngleDeg =
      if (traumaSq > 0.0001f) (traumaSq * 0.035f * sin(tSec * 39.0f)) * (180f / PI.toFloat()) else 0f

    val effectiveCamX = camX + shakeOffsetX
    val effectiveCamY = camY + shakeOffsetY

    // [Z-0] Obsidian Void (#030712) + [Z-1] 3-Tier Parallax Background
    canvas.drawColor(Color.parseColor("#030712"))

    // Tier 3: Volumetric Nebula Radial Gradient Blobs (Pre-rendered offscreen Bitmaps)
    for (nb in nebulaBlobs) {
      val nx = ((nb.x - effectiveCamX * nb.parallax) % vw + vw) % vw
      val ny = ((nb.y - effectiveCamY * nb.parallax) % vh + vh) % vh
      nebulaDstRect.set(nx - nb.radius, ny - nb.radius, nx + nb.radius, ny + nb.radius)
      val stamp = if (nb.isCyan) RiftSpriteBaker.nebulaCyanStamp else RiftSpriteBaker.nebulaIndigoStamp
      canvas.drawBitmap(stamp, null, nebulaDstRect, null)
    }

    // Tier 1 & Tier 2: 200 Distant Stars (drift 0.05) + 30 Dust Motes (drift 0.15)
    for (st in stars) {
      val sx = ((st.x - effectiveCamX * st.parallax) % vw + vw) % vw
      val sy = ((st.y - effectiveCamY * st.parallax) % vh + vh) % vh
      starPaint.color = st.color
      canvas.drawRect(sx, sy, sx + st.size, sy + st.size, starPaint)
    }

    // 3. World-Space Camera Transform (Base 0.65x * Real-Time Camera Zoom Slider [0.5x..1.5x] + Non-Linear Trauma Shake)
    val worldScale = engine.effectiveCameraScale()
    canvas.save()
    canvas.translate(vw * 0.5f, vh * 0.5f)
    if (shakeAngleDeg != 0f) {
      canvas.rotate(shakeAngleDeg)
    }
    canvas.scale(worldScale, worldScale)
    canvas.translate(-effectiveCamX, -effectiveCamY)

    val halfWorldW = (vw / worldScale) * 0.56f
    val halfWorldH = (vh / worldScale) * 0.56f
    val viewLeft = effectiveCamX - halfWorldW
    val viewRight = effectiveCamX + halfWorldW
    val viewTop = effectiveCamY - halfWorldH
    val viewBottom = effectiveCamY + halfWorldH

    // Subtle Tactical Sector Coordinate Ticks (rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.35))
    val firstTickX = ((viewLeft / 500f).toInt()) * 500f
    val firstTickY = ((viewTop / 500f).toInt()) * 500f
    var tx = firstTickX
    while (tx <= viewRight) {
      var ty = firstTickY
      while (ty <= viewBottom) {
        canvas.drawLine(tx - 6f, ty, tx + 6f, ty, sectorTickPaint)
        canvas.drawLine(tx, ty - 6f, tx, ty + 6f, sectorTickPaint)
        ty += 500f
      }
      tx += 500f
    }

    // 4. Center Safe Zone Pad (Subtle dotted pad + corner brackets) scaled by calibration
    val szBase = engine.safeZone
    val szScale = RiftCalibrationState.safeZoneScale
    val szW = (szBase.right - szBase.left) * szScale
    val szH = (szBase.bottom - szBase.top) * szScale
    val szCX = szBase.centerX()
