    return true
  }

  private fun getCenteredAxis(event: MotionEvent, axis: Int): Float {
    val range = event.device?.getMotionRange(axis, event.source)
    val value = event.getAxisValue(axis)
    if (range != null) {
      val flat = range.flat
      if (abs(value) <= flat) return 0f
    }
    return value
  }

  private fun isGamepadSource(source: Int): Boolean {
    return (source and InputDevice.SOURCE_GAMEPAD) == InputDevice.SOURCE_GAMEPAD ||
      (source and InputDevice.SOURCE_JOYSTICK) == InputDevice.SOURCE_JOYSTICK ||
      (source and InputDevice.SOURCE_DPAD) == InputDevice.SOURCE_DPAD
  }

  private fun handleBoundControllerInput(bindCode: Int, isPressed: Boolean) {
    val p = engine.localPlayer
    val normCode =
      when (bindCode) {
        KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L2 -> RiftCalibrationState.BIND_LT
        KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R2 -> RiftCalibrationState.BIND_RT
        else -> bindCode
      }

    // Keep weaponAngle aligned to Right Stick (if active) or Left Stick heading (p.angle)
    val aimAngle = if (engine.fireStickHasAimVector) engine.fireStickAimAngle else p.angle

    if (normCode == RiftCalibrationState.bindPrimaryFire) {
      if (isPressed) {
        engine.fireStickActive = true
        engine.isCancelActive = false
        p.weaponAngle = aimAngle
        engine.firePrimaryGun(p)
      } else {
        if (firePointerId == MotionEvent.INVALID_POINTER_ID) {
          engine.fireStickActive = false
        }
      }
    }

    if (normCode == RiftCalibrationState.bindSecondaryAbility && isPressed) {
      p.weaponAngle = aimAngle
      engine.fireSecondaryBomb(p, aimAngle)
    }

    if (normCode == RiftCalibrationState.bindSpecialBuff && isPressed) {
      p.weaponAngle = aimAngle
      engine.activateUtility("SPECIAL")
    }

    if (normCode == RiftCalibrationState.bindRetroBrake) {
      if (isPressed) {
        engine.autoBraking = true
        engine.leftStickActive = false
        engine.leftStickMag = 0f
        engine.sfx.playMutedClick()
      } else {
        engine.autoBraking = false
      }
    }

    if (normCode == RiftCalibrationState.bindRepel && isPressed) {
      engine.activateUtility("REPEL")
    }

    if (normCode == RiftCalibrationState.bindMultiToggle && isPressed) {
      if (p.spec.supportsNativeMultifire) {
        p.multifireOn = !p.multifireOn
        engine.sfx.playMutedClick()
        engine.buffVersion++
      }
    }
  }

  override fun onGenericMotionEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {
    if ((event.source and InputDevice.SOURCE_JOYSTICK) != InputDevice.SOURCE_JOYSTICK ||
      event.action != MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE
    ) {
      return super.onGenericMotionEvent(event)
    }

    RiftCalibrationState.gamepadConnected = true
    val p = engine.localPlayer

    // 1. Left Stick (AXIS_X, AXIS_Y) -> Permanently locked to 360° Flight Thrust, >80% Afterburner & Zero-Friction Drift on Release
    val lx = getCenteredAxis(event, MotionEvent.AXIS_X)
    val ly = getCenteredAxis(event, MotionEvent.AXIS_Y)
    val lMagRaw = hypot(lx, ly)
    val dzL = RiftCalibrationState.gamepadDeadzoneLeft
    if (lMagRaw >= dzL) {
      gamepadLeftStickActive = true
      val normMag = ((lMagRaw - dzL) / (1f - dzL).coerceAtLeast(0.1f)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
      val ang = atan2(ly, lx)
      engine.leftStickActive = true
      engine.leftStickAngle = ang
      engine.leftStickMag = normMag
      engine.autoBraking = false
      p.angle = ang
      leftOriginX = effLeftBaseX()
      leftOriginY = effLeftBaseY()
      leftCurX = effLeftBaseX() + cos(ang) * normMag * effLeftRadius()
      leftCurY = effLeftBaseY() + sin(ang) * normMag * effLeftRadius()
    } else if (gamepadLeftStickActive && leftPointerId == MotionEvent.INVALID_POINTER_ID) {
      gamepadLeftStickActive = false
      engine.leftStickActive = false
      engine.leftStickMag = 0f
      leftCurX = effLeftBaseX()
      leftCurY = effLeftBaseY()
      // Zero-friction Newtonian drift: NEVER set engine.autoBraking = true on Left Stick release!
    }

    // 2. Right Stick (AXIS_Z, AXIS_RZ) -> Permanently locked to 360° Independent Turret Aiming (or fallback to Left-Stick heading p.angle)
    val rx = getCenteredAxis(event, MotionEvent.AXIS_Z)
    val ry = getCenteredAxis(event, MotionEvent.AXIS_RZ)
    val rMagRaw = hypot(rx, ry)
    val dzR = RiftCalibrationState.gamepadDeadzoneRight
    if (rMagRaw >= dzR) {
      gamepadRightStickActive = true
      val normMag = ((rMagRaw - dzR) / (1f - dzR).coerceAtLeast(0.1f)).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
      val aimA = atan2(ry, rx)
      engine.fireStickHasAimVector = true
      engine.fireStickAimAngle = aimA
      p.independentAimActive = true
      p.weaponAngle = aimA
      fireCurX = effFireBtnX() + cos(aimA) * normMag * effFireRadius() * 0.68f
      fireCurY = effFireBtnY() + sin(aimA) * normMag * effFireRadius() * 0.68f
    } else if (firePointerId == MotionEvent.INVALID_POINTER_ID) {
      if (gamepadRightStickActive) {
        gamepadRightStickActive = false
        fireCurX = effFireBtnX()
        fireCurY = effFireBtnY()
      }
      engine.fireStickHasAimVector = false
      p.independentAimActive = false
      p.weaponAngle = p.angle
    }

    // 3. Right Trigger (AXIS_RTRIGGER / AXIS_GAS / AXIS_THROTTLE) -> BIND_RT
    val rt =
      max(
        event.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_RTRIGGER),
        max(
          event.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_GAS),
          event.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_THROTTLE),
        ),
      )
    if (rt > 0.30f) {
      if (!gamepadRightTriggerHeld) {
        gamepadRightTriggerHeld = true
        handleBoundControllerInput(RiftCalibrationState.BIND_RT, isPressed = true)
      } else if (RiftCalibrationState.bindPrimaryFire == RiftCalibrationState.BIND_RT) {
        p.weaponAngle = if (engine.fireStickHasAimVector) engine.fireStickAimAngle else p.angle
        engine.firePrimaryGun(p)
      }
    } else if (gamepadRightTriggerHeld) {
      gamepadRightTriggerHeld = false
      handleBoundControllerInput(RiftCalibrationState.BIND_RT, isPressed = false)
    }

    // 4. Left Trigger (AXIS_LTRIGGER / AXIS_BRAKE) -> BIND_LT
    val lt = max(event.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_LTRIGGER), event.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_BRAKE))
    if (lt > 0.35f) {
      if (!gamepadLeftTriggerHeld) {
        gamepadLeftTriggerHeld = true
        handleBoundControllerInput(RiftCalibrationState.BIND_LT, isPressed = true)
      } else if (RiftCalibrationState.bindPrimaryFire == RiftCalibrationState.BIND_LT) {
        p.weaponAngle = if (engine.fireStickHasAimVector) engine.fireStickAimAngle else p.angle
        engine.firePrimaryGun(p)
      }
    } else if (gamepadLeftTriggerHeld) {
      gamepadLeftTriggerHeld = false
      handleBoundControllerInput(RiftCalibrationState.BIND_LT, isPressed = false)
    }

    // 5. Hat Switch D-Pad (AXIS_HAT_X, AXIS_HAT_Y) -> Camera Zoom Step (unless bound to a custom combat action)
    val hatY = event.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_HAT_Y)
    if (hatY < -0.5f && !lastDpadUpPressed) {
      lastDpadUpPressed = true
      if (RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP) != null) {
        handleBoundControllerInput(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP, isPressed = true)
      } else {
        onGamepadCycleCameraZoom(1)
      }
    } else if (hatY > 0.5f && !lastDpadDownPressed) {
      lastDpadDownPressed = true
      if (RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN) != null) {
        handleBoundControllerInput(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN, isPressed = true)
      } else {
        onGamepadCycleCameraZoom(-1)
      }
    } else if (abs(hatY) <= 0.3f) {
      if (lastDpadUpPressed) {
        lastDpadUpPressed = false
        handleBoundControllerInput(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP, isPressed = false)
      }
      if (lastDpadDownPressed) {
        lastDpadDownPressed = false
        handleBoundControllerInput(KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN, isPressed = false)
      }
    }

    return true
  }

  override fun onKeyDown(keyCode: Int, event: KeyEvent): Boolean {
    if (isGamepadSource(event.source)) {
      RiftCalibrationState.gamepadConnected = true
    }

    when (keyCode) {
      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_START -> {
        if (event.repeatCount == 0) {
          onGamepadToggleHangar()
        }
        return true
      }

      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_SELECT -> {
        if (event.repeatCount == 0) {
          onGamepadToggleCalibration()
        }
        return true
      }
    }

    val normCode =
      when (keyCode) {
        KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L2 -> RiftCalibrationState.BIND_LT
        KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R2 -> RiftCalibrationState.BIND_RT
        else -> keyCode
      }

    // If this button/trigger is mapped to one of the 6 combat actions, execute via handleBoundControllerInput
    if (RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(normCode) != null) {
      if (normCode == RiftCalibrationState.BIND_LT && gamepadLeftTriggerHeld) return true
      if (normCode == RiftCalibrationState.BIND_RT && gamepadRightTriggerHeld) return true
      if (event.repeatCount == 0 || normCode == RiftCalibrationState.bindPrimaryFire) {
        handleBoundControllerInput(normCode, isPressed = true)
      }
      return true
    }

    // Unbound utility / navigation keys
    when (keyCode) {
      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP -> {
        if (event.repeatCount == 0) {
          onGamepadCycleCameraZoom(1)
        }
        return true
      }

      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN -> {
        if (event.repeatCount == 0) {
          onGamepadCycleCameraZoom(-1)
        }
        return true
      }

      KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT -> {
        if (event.repeatCount == 0) {
          onGamepadOpenNexus()
        }
        return true
      }
    }
    return super.onKeyDown(keyCode, event)
  }

  override fun onKeyUp(keyCode: Int, event: KeyEvent): Boolean {
    if (isGamepadSource(event.source)) {
      RiftCalibrationState.gamepadConnected = true
    }
    val normCode =
      when (keyCode) {
        KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L2 -> RiftCalibrationState.BIND_LT
        KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R2 -> RiftCalibrationState.BIND_RT
        else -> keyCode
      }
    if (RiftCalibrationState.getActionForBinding(normCode) != null) {
      if (normCode == RiftCalibrationState.BIND_LT && gamepadLeftTriggerHeld) return true
      if (normCode == RiftCalibrationState.BIND_RT && gamepadRightTriggerHeld) return true
      handleBoundControllerInput(normCode, isPressed = false)
      return true
    }
    return super.onKeyUp(keyCode, event)
  }
}

package com.example.engine

import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.roundToInt
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject

enum class LabelPlacement(val label: String) {
  TOP("TOP"),
  BOTTOM("BOTTOM"),
  LEFT("LEFT"),
  RIGHT("RIGHT"),
  CONSOLIDATED_TOP("CONSOLIDATED TOP"),
  CONSOLIDATED_BOTTOM("CONSOLIDATED BOTTOM"),
}

data class CalibrationParamDescriptor(
  val key: String,
  val tabIndex: Int, // 0..7 (Tab 8 = AI Buff & Mechanic Forge)
  val shipIdFilter: Int = 0, // 0 = global, 1..9 = per-ship
  val title: String,
  val unit: String,
  val description: String,
  val min: Float,
  val max: Float,
  val step: Float,
  val decimals: Int = 2,
  val getter: () -> Float,
  val setter: (Float) -> Unit,
) {
  fun formatValue(v: Float = getter()): String {
    return when {
      unit == "%" && max <= 2.5f -> String.format(Locale.US, "%d%%", (v * 100f).roundToInt())
      decimals <= 0 -> String.format(Locale.US, "%d%s", v.roundToInt(), if (unit.isNotEmpty()) " $unit" else "")
      decimals == 1 -> String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f%s", v, if (unit.isNotEmpty()) " $unit" else "")
      else -> String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f%s", v, if (unit.isNotEmpty()) " $unit" else "")
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Centralized 100% live-wired Calibration & Game Balance Configuration for RIFT.
 * Every physics loop, weapon trigger, Special Buff, Playfield Rift, AI bot controller,
 * and Canvas/HUD renderer reads directly from this singleton in real time.
 */
object RiftCalibrationState {
  private const val PREFS_NAME = "rift_ui_layout_prefs"
  private const val KEY_HIDDEN_SET = "hidden_calibration_keys_csv"
  private const val KEY_FORGED_BUFFS_JSON = "custom_forged_buffs_json"
  private const val KEY_SAVED_CONFIG_JSON = "saved_calibration_values_json"

  // UI Modal & Live Peek States
  var isCalibrationModalOpen by mutableStateOf(false)
  var isDraggingAnySlider by mutableStateOf(false)
  var activeDraggingParamKey by mutableStateOf<String?>(null)
  var showHiddenParameters by mutableStateOf(false)
  var hiddenCalibrationKeys by mutableStateOf<Set<String>>(emptySet())
  var calibrationRevision by mutableIntStateOf(0)

  // 1. Camera, HUD & 1:1 Physical Screen-Pixel Text Sizes (Tab 0)
  var cameraZoomScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)     // Multiplier on base 0.65f camera zoom (0.35x .. 2.2x)
  var nametagFontSizePx by mutableFloatStateOf(15.0f)  // True 1:1 physical screen pixels for ship [TAG] Callsign
  var bountyFontSizePx by mutableFloatStateOf(16.0f)   // True 1:1 physical screen pixels for ship Bounty readout
  var fctFontSizePx by mutableFloatStateOf(14.0f)      // True 1:1 physical screen pixels for Floating Combat Text
  var shipScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)           // In-world ship sprite scale (0.5x .. 2.0x)
  var anomalyScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)        // Spatial anomaly visual scale (0.3x .. 2.0x)
  var crateScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)          // Supply Crate visual scale (0.5x .. 2.0x)
  var safeZoneScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)       // Safe Zone pad & boundary bracket scale (0.5x .. 2.0x)
  var aimTelegraphScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)   // Turret reticle & aim telegraph cone length (0.5x .. 2.0x)
  var projectileScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)     // Bullet beam width & bomb/mine radius (0.5x .. 2.0x)
  var fctScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)            // Floating combat text rise & scale multiplier (0.5x .. 2.0x)

  // Ship Label Clock Positioning
  var bountyPlacement by mutableStateOf(LabelPlacement.TOP)
  var tagPlacement by mutableStateOf(LabelPlacement.BOTTOM)
  var namePlacement by mutableStateOf(LabelPlacement.BOTTOM)
  var labelTextScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)
  var labelDistanceOffset by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)

  // HUD Element Scales
  var topBarScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)
  var buffBarScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)
  var killLogScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)
  var bottomConsoleScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)
  var combatArcScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)
  var leftStickScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)
  var idleWarningBannerScale by mutableFloatStateOf(1.0f)

  // Testing Feature Flags & Hardware Gamepad State
  var forceAllButtonsVisible by mutableStateOf(false)
  var isUiUnlockedForDragging by mutableStateOf(false)
  var unlockFullNinthShipOverride by mutableStateOf(false)
  var gamepadConnected by mutableStateOf(false)
  var gamepadDeadzoneLeft by mutableFloatStateOf(0.12f)
  var gamepadDeadzoneRight by mutableFloatStateOf(0.18f)
  var gamepadIdleTouchOpacity by mutableFloatStateOf(0.28f)

  // Virtual Keycodes & Ergonomic Default Controller Bindings (WoW-Style Live Remapper)
  const val BIND_LT = 1001 // Left Trigger (AXIS_LTRIGGER / AXIS_BRAKE / KEYCODE_BUTTON_L2)
  const val BIND_RT = 1002 // Right Trigger (AXIS_RTRIGGER / AXIS_GAS / AXIS_THROTTLE / KEYCODE_BUTTON_R2)

  var bindPrimaryFire by mutableIntStateOf(BIND_RT)
  var bindSpecialBuff by mutableIntStateOf(android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R1)
  var bindRetroBrake by mutableIntStateOf(BIND_LT)
  var bindSecondaryAbility by mutableIntStateOf(android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_X)
  var bindRepel by mutableIntStateOf(android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_A)
  var bindMultiToggle by mutableIntStateOf(android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_Y)

  fun getBindingLabel(code: Int): String {
    return when (code) {
      BIND_LT, android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L2 -> "LT / L2"
      BIND_RT, android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R2 -> "RT / R2"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R1 -> "R1 / RB"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L1 -> "L1 / LB"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_A -> "A BTN"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_B -> "B BTN"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_X -> "X BTN"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_Y -> "Y BTN"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_THUMBL -> "L3"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_THUMBR -> "R3"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP -> "D-UP"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_DOWN -> "D-DOWN"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_LEFT -> "D-LEFT"
      android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT -> "D-RIGHT"
      else -> "KEY $code"
    }
  }

  fun getActionForBinding(code: Int): String? {
    val norm =
      when (code) {
        android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L2 -> BIND_LT
        android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R2 -> BIND_RT
        else -> code
      }
    return when (norm) {
      bindPrimaryFire -> "MAIN ATK"
      bindSpecialBuff -> "BUFF ATK"
      bindRetroBrake -> "BRAKE"
      bindSecondaryAbility -> "SECONDARY"
      bindRepel -> "REPEL"
      bindMultiToggle -> "MULTI"
      else -> null
    }
  }

  fun getBindingForActionSlot(actionSlot: String): Int {
    return when (actionSlot) {
      "PRIMARY_FIRE" -> bindPrimaryFire
      "SPECIAL_BUFF" -> bindSpecialBuff
      "RETRO_BRAKE" -> bindRetroBrake
      "SECONDARY_ABILITY" -> bindSecondaryAbility
      "REPEL" -> bindRepel
      "MULTI_TOGGLE" -> bindMultiToggle
      else -> BIND_RT
    }
  }

  fun assignControllerBinding(actionSlot: String, newCode: Int, context: Context? = null) {
    val normalizedNew =
      when (newCode) {
        android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_L2 -> BIND_LT
        android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R2 -> BIND_RT
        else -> newCode
      }
    val oldCode = getBindingForActionSlot(actionSlot)
    if (oldCode == normalizedNew) return

    // Swap if another slot already uses normalizedNew so bindings never duplicate
    when {
      actionSlot != "PRIMARY_FIRE" && bindPrimaryFire == normalizedNew -> bindPrimaryFire = oldCode
      actionSlot != "SPECIAL_BUFF" && bindSpecialBuff == normalizedNew -> bindSpecialBuff = oldCode
      actionSlot != "RETRO_BRAKE" && bindRetroBrake == normalizedNew -> bindRetroBrake = oldCode
      actionSlot != "SECONDARY_ABILITY" && bindSecondaryAbility == normalizedNew -> bindSecondaryAbility = oldCode
      actionSlot != "REPEL" && bindRepel == normalizedNew -> bindRepel = oldCode
      actionSlot != "MULTI_TOGGLE" && bindMultiToggle == normalizedNew -> bindMultiToggle = oldCode
    }

    when (actionSlot) {
      "PRIMARY_FIRE" -> bindPrimaryFire = normalizedNew
      "SPECIAL_BUFF" -> bindSpecialBuff = normalizedNew
      "RETRO_BRAKE" -> bindRetroBrake = normalizedNew
      "SECONDARY_ABILITY" -> bindSecondaryAbility = normalizedNew
      "REPEL" -> bindRepel = normalizedNew
      "MULTI_TOGGLE" -> bindMultiToggle = normalizedNew
    }

    calibrationRevision++
    if (context != null) {
      savePersistedLayout(context)
    }
  }

  fun resetControllerBindingsToDefault(context: Context? = null) {
    bindPrimaryFire = BIND_RT
    bindSpecialBuff = android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R1
    bindRetroBrake = BIND_LT
    bindSecondaryAbility = android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_X
    bindRepel = android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_A
    bindMultiToggle = android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_Y
    calibrationRevision++
    if (context != null) {
      savePersistedLayout(context)
    }
  }

  /**
   * Converts any camelCase or snake_case variable name into a clean Plain-English Title.
   */
  fun camelCaseToPlainEnglish(rawKey: String): String {
    return rawKey
      .replace("_", " ")
      .replace(Regex("([a-z])([A-Z0-9])"), "$1 $2")
      .split(" ")
      .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
      .joinToString(" ") { word ->
        when (word.uppercase(Locale.US)) {
          "FFA" -> "FFA"
          "HVT" -> "HVT"
          "FCT" -> "Floating Text"
          "EMP" -> "EMP"
          "HUD" -> "HUD"
          "AI" -> "AI"
          "PCT" -> "Percent"
          "SEC" -> "Duration"
          "PX" -> "Size"
          "MULT" -> "Multiplier"
          else -> word.replaceFirstChar { if (it.isLowerCase()) it.titlecase(Locale.US) else it.toString() }
        }
      }
  }

      min = 2000f, max = 20000f, step = 500f, decimals = 0,

    return list
  }

  /**
   * Deep-frozen baseline snapshot of all factory default numeric calibration parameters.
   */
  val DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG: Map<String, Float> by lazy {
    val snapshot = LinkedHashMap<String, Float>()
    buildAllParameterDescriptors()
      .filter { !it.key.startsWith("forged_") }
      .forEach { snapshot[it.key] = it.getter() }
    snapshot
  }

  fun ensureBaselineCaptured() {
    DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG.size
  }

  /**
   * Immediately propagates any modified Calibration value into active live ships, match timers,
   * and registry entries so zero sliders require a respawn or restart.
   */
  fun applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine: RiftGameEngine?, context: Context? = null) {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["SEEKER_TORPEDO"]?.let {
      it.flightDuration = seekerFlightTime
      it.projectileSpeed = seekerSpeed
      it.damage = seekerDamage
    }
    RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["NOVA_RING"]?.let {
      it.projectileSpeed = novaBoltSpeed
      it.damage = novaBoltDamage
    }
    RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["SHATTER_CONE"]?.let {
      it.damage = shatterPelletDamage
    }
    RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["STASIS_BARRIER"]?.let {
      it.flightDuration = stasisBarrierDuration
      it.blastRadius = stasisBarrierLength
    }
    RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["HYPER_SURGE"]?.let {
      it.flightDuration = hyperSurgeDuration
    }
    RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY["HOLO_PHANTOM"]?.let {
      it.flightDuration = holoPhantomDuration
    }

    if (engine != null) {
      engine.publicMatchCycleLimitSec = publicMatchCycleLimitSec
      for (ship in engine.ships) {
        val updatedSpec = RiftCodex.getShipById(ship.spec.id)
        ship.spec = updatedSpec
        val targetMax = updatedSpec.maxFlux
        if (abs(ship.maxFlux - targetMax) > 0.5f) {
          val ratio = if (ship.maxFlux > 1f) (ship.flux / ship.maxFlux).coerceIn(0.05f, 1f) else 1f
          ship.maxFlux = targetMax
          ship.flux = (targetMax * ratio).coerceIn(1f, targetMax)
        }
      }
      for (anom in engine.anomalies) {
        anom.physicalRadius = riftPhysicalRadius
      }
      for (b in engine.interdictorBubbles) {
        b.radius = interdictorBubbleRadius
      }
    }
    RiftCodex.getShipById(9).bombCooldown = interdictorBubbleCooldown
    calibrationRevision++
    if (context != null) {
      savePersistedLayout(context)
    }
  }

  fun toggleParameterHidden(key: String, hidden: Boolean, context: Context? = null) {
    hiddenCalibrationKeys =
      if (hidden) {
        hiddenCalibrationKeys + key
      } else {
        hiddenCalibrationKeys - key
      }
    calibrationRevision++
    if (context != null) {
      savePersistedLayout(context)
    }
  }

  fun unhideAllParameters(context: Context? = null) {
    hiddenCalibrationKeys = emptySet()
    calibrationRevision++
    if (context != null) {
      savePersistedLayout(context)
    }
  }

  fun loadPersistedLayout(context: Context) {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    fun readOffset(key: String): Offset {
      val x = prefs.getFloat("${key}_x", 0f)
      val y = prefs.getFloat("${key}_y", 0f)
      return Offset(x, y)
    }
    topBarOffset = readOffset("topBar")
    buffBarOffset = readOffset("buffBar")
    killLogOffset = readOffset("killLog")
    bottomConsoleOffset = readOffset("bottomConsole")
    combatArcOffset = readOffset("combatArc")
    leftStickOffset = readOffset("leftStick")
    fireStickOffset = readOffset("fireStick")
    bombBtnOffset = readOffset("bombBtn")
    repelBtnOffset = readOffset("repelBtn")
    burstBtnOffset = readOffset("burstBtn")
    brakeBtnOffset = readOffset("brakeBtn")
    multiBtnOffset = readOffset("multiBtn")
    calibrationBtnOffset = readOffset("calibrationBtn")
    nexusBtnOffset = readOffset("nexusBtn")
    toastContainerOffset = readOffset("toastContainer")
    idleWarningBannerOffset = readOffset("idleWarningBanner")
    unlockFullNinthShipOverride = prefs.getBoolean("unlockFullNinthShipOverride", false)

    bindPrimaryFire = prefs.getInt("bindPrimaryFire", BIND_RT)
    bindSpecialBuff = prefs.getInt("bindSpecialBuff", android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_R1)
    bindRetroBrake = prefs.getInt("bindRetroBrake", BIND_LT)
    bindSecondaryAbility = prefs.getInt("bindSecondaryAbility", android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_X)
    bindRepel = prefs.getInt("bindRepel", android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_A)
    bindMultiToggle = prefs.getInt("bindMultiToggle", android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BUTTON_Y)

    val hiddenCsv = prefs.getString(KEY_HIDDEN_SET, "") ?: ""
    hiddenCalibrationKeys =
      hiddenCsv.split(",").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.toSet()

    // Restore persisted AI-Forged Custom Buffs into BUFF_REGISTRY
    val forgedRaw = prefs.getString(KEY_FORGED_BUFFS_JSON, "[]") ?: "[]"
    try {
      val arr = JSONArray(forgedRaw)
      for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
        val entry = SpecialBuffRegistryEntry.fromJsonObject(arr.getJSONObject(i))
        RiftCodex.registerCustomBuff(entry)
      }
    } catch (_: Exception) {}

    // Restore persisted slider overrides
    val savedConfigRaw = prefs.getString(KEY_SAVED_CONFIG_JSON, null)
    if (!savedConfigRaw.isNullOrBlank()) {
      try {
        val obj = JSONObject(savedConfigRaw)
        val excludedUserSettingKeys =
          setOf(
            "cameraZoomScale",
            "nametagFontSizePx",
            "bountyFontSizePx",
            "fctFontSizePx",
            "labelTextScale",
            "fctScale",
            "ship_6_bombCost",
          )
        val descriptorsByKey = buildAllParameterDescriptors().associateBy { it.key }
        val keys = obj.keys()
        while (keys.hasNext()) {
          val k = keys.next()
          if (k in excludedUserSettingKeys) continue
          val desc = descriptorsByKey[k]
          if (desc != null) {
            val loadedVal = obj.optDouble(k, desc.getter().toDouble()).toFloat()
            if (k == "phaseDashImpulse" && loadedVal <= 650f) {
              desc.setter(1120f)
            } else {
              desc.setter(loadedVal)
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }
    RiftCodex.getShipById(6).bombCost = 0f
    // Keep base constants neutral so user Settings (rift_user_settings) exclusively controls Zoom & Text Size
    cameraZoomScale = 1.0f
    nametagFontSizePx = 15.0f
    bountyFontSizePx = 16.0f
    fctFontSizePx = 14.0f
    labelTextScale = 1.0f
    fctScale = 1.0f
    applyCalibrationChangesLive(null, null)
  }

  fun savePersistedLayout(context: Context) {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    val editor = prefs.edit()
    fun writeOffset(key: String, offset: Offset) {
      editor.putFloat("${key}_x", offset.x)
      editor.putFloat("${key}_y", offset.y)
    }
    writeOffset("topBar", topBarOffset)
    writeOffset("buffBar", buffBarOffset)
    writeOffset("killLog", killLogOffset)
    writeOffset("bottomConsole", bottomConsoleOffset)
    writeOffset("combatArc", combatArcOffset)
    writeOffset("leftStick", leftStickOffset)
    writeOffset("fireStick", fireStickOffset)
    writeOffset("bombBtn", bombBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("repelBtn", repelBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("burstBtn", burstBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("brakeBtn", brakeBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("multiBtn", multiBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("calibrationBtn", calibrationBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("nexusBtn", nexusBtnOffset)
    writeOffset("toastContainer", toastContainerOffset)
    writeOffset("idleWarningBanner", idleWarningBannerOffset)
    editor.putBoolean("unlockFullNinthShipOverride", unlockFullNinthShipOverride)
    editor.putInt("bindPrimaryFire", bindPrimaryFire)
    editor.putInt("bindSpecialBuff", bindSpecialBuff)
    editor.putInt("bindRetroBrake", bindRetroBrake)
    editor.putInt("bindSecondaryAbility", bindSecondaryAbility)
    editor.putInt("bindRepel", bindRepel)
    editor.putInt("bindMultiToggle", bindMultiToggle)
    editor.putString(KEY_HIDDEN_SET, hiddenCalibrationKeys.joinToString(","))

    val forgedArr = JSONArray()
    RiftCodex.getCustomForgedBuffs().forEach { forgedArr.put(it.toJsonObject()) }
    editor.putString(KEY_FORGED_BUFFS_JSON, forgedArr.toString())

    val configObj = JSONObject()
    buildAllParameterDescriptors().forEach { desc ->
      val currentVal = desc.getter()
      val defaultVal = DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]
      if (defaultVal == null || abs(currentVal - defaultVal) > 0.0005f) {
        configObj.put(desc.key, currentVal.toDouble())
      }
    }
    editor.putString(KEY_SAVED_CONFIG_JSON, configObj.toString())
    editor.apply()
  }

  fun resetTab(tabIndex: Int, context: Context? = null, engine: RiftGameEngine? = null) {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    if (tabIndex == 2 || tabIndex == 3) {
      if (tabIndex == 2) {
        // Restore hull stats for ships 1..9
        buildAllParameterDescriptors()
          .filter { it.tabIndex == 2 }
          .forEach { desc -> DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]?.let { desc.setter(it) } }
      } else {
        buildAllParameterDescriptors()
          .filter { it.tabIndex == 3 }
          .forEach { desc -> DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]?.let { desc.setter(it) } }
      }
    } else {
      buildAllParameterDescriptors()
        .filter { it.tabIndex == tabIndex && !it.key.startsWith("forged_") }
        .forEach { desc -> DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]?.let { desc.setter(it) } }
      if (tabIndex == 0) {
        bountyPlacement = LabelPlacement.TOP
        tagPlacement = LabelPlacement.BOTTOM
        namePlacement = LabelPlacement.BOTTOM
      }
    }
    applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine, context)
  }

  fun resetAll(context: Context? = null, engine: RiftGameEngine? = null) {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    RiftCodex.resetShipsToDefaults()
    RiftCodex.resetBuffRegistryToDefaults(preserveCustomForged = false)

    for (desc in buildAllParameterDescriptors()) {
      DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]?.let { desc.setter(it) }
    }

    bountyPlacement = LabelPlacement.TOP
    tagPlacement = LabelPlacement.BOTTOM
    namePlacement = LabelPlacement.BOTTOM

    forceAllButtonsVisible = false
    isUiUnlockedForDragging = false
    unlockFullNinthShipOverride = false

    topBarOffset = Offset.Zero
    buffBarOffset = Offset.Zero
    killLogOffset = Offset.Zero
    bottomConsoleOffset = Offset.Zero
    combatArcOffset = Offset.Zero
    leftStickOffset = Offset.Zero
    fireStickOffset = Offset.Zero
    bombBtnOffset = Offset.Zero
    repelBtnOffset = Offset.Zero
    burstBtnOffset = Offset.Zero
    brakeBtnOffset = Offset.Zero
    multiBtnOffset = Offset.Zero
    calibrationBtnOffset = Offset.Zero
    nexusBtnOffset = Offset.Zero
    toastContainerOffset = Offset.Zero
    idleWarningBannerOffset = Offset.Zero

    buffModeOverride = "FFA"
    buffTargetCountOverride = null
    resetControllerBindingsToDefault(null)

    applyCalibrationChangesLive(engine, context)
  }

  /**
   * Generates a complete 1-click AI Studio prompt containing:
   * - Section A: Modified Settings Diff (`key: oldDefault -> newValue`)
   * - Section B: Complete Replacement Default Objects (`DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG`, `BUFF_REGISTRY`, `hiddenCalibrationKeys`)
   * Returns (promptString, modifiedCount).
   */
  fun generateAiStudioDefaultsPrompt(): Pair<String, Int> {
    ensureBaselineCaptured()
    val descriptors = buildAllParameterDescriptors()
    val diffs = mutableListOf<String>()
    val fullConfigJson = JSONObject()

    for (desc in descriptors) {
      val cur = desc.getter()
      fullConfigJson.put(desc.key, ((cur * 1000f).roundToInt() / 1000.0))
      val def = DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]
      if (def != null && abs(cur - def) > 0.0005f) {
        diffs += "  - ${desc.key} (${desc.title}): ${desc.formatValue(def)} -> ${desc.formatValue(cur)}"
      }
    }

    if (bountyPlacement != LabelPlacement.TOP) {
      diffs += "  - bountyPlacement: TOP -> ${bountyPlacement.name}"
    }
    if (tagPlacement != LabelPlacement.BOTTOM) {
      diffs += "  - tagPlacement: BOTTOM -> ${tagPlacement.name}"
    }
    if (namePlacement != LabelPlacement.BOTTOM) {
      diffs += "  - namePlacement: BOTTOM -> ${namePlacement.name}"
    }

    val customBuffs = RiftCodex.getCustomForgedBuffs()
    for (cb in customBuffs) {
      diffs += "  - [NEW FORGED BUFF] ${cb.id} (${cb.officialName} / ${cb.shortLabel}): ${cb.summary}"
    }

    val registryJson = JSONObject()
    for ((k, v) in RiftCodex.BUFF_REGISTRY) {
      registryJson.put(k, v.toJsonObject())
    }

    val hiddenArr = JSONArray()
    hiddenCalibrationKeys.sorted().forEach { hiddenArr.put(it) }

    val totalModified = diffs.size + (if (hiddenCalibrationKeys.isNotEmpty()) 1 else 0)

    val sb = StringBuilder()
    sb.appendLine("Update RIFT's permanent factory defaults in RiftCalibrationState.kt and ShipSpecs.kt to match my calibrated values below:")
    sb.appendLine()
    sb.appendLine("### SECTION A: MODIFIED SETTINGS DIFF (${diffs.size} Gameplay/UI Changes)")
    if (diffs.isEmpty()) {
      sb.appendLine("  - (All numeric sliders currently match factory defaults)")
    } else {
      diffs.forEach { sb.appendLine(it) }
    }
    if (hiddenCalibrationKeys.isNotEmpty()) {
      sb.appendLine("  - hiddenCalibrationKeys (${hiddenCalibrationKeys.size} hidden): ${hiddenCalibrationKeys.sorted().joinToString(", ")}")
    }
    sb.appendLine()
    sb.appendLine("### SECTION B: COMPLETE REPLACEMENT DEFAULT OBJECTS")
    sb.appendLine("```json")
    val bundle = JSONObject().apply {
      put("DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG", fullConfigJson)
      put("labelPlacements", JSONObject().apply {
        put("bountyPlacement", bountyPlacement.name)
        put("tagPlacement", tagPlacement.name)
        put("namePlacement", namePlacement.name)
      })
      put("BUFF_REGISTRY", registryJson)
      put("hiddenCalibrationKeys", hiddenArr)
    }
    sb.appendLine(bundle.toString(2))
    sb.appendLine("```")

    return Pair(sb.toString(), totalModified)
  }
}

enum class RankedGameMode(
  val id: String,
  val title: String,
  val subtitle: String,
  val teamFormatBadge: String,
) {
  SECTOR_CONVERGENCE(
    "SECTOR_CONVERGENCE",
    "Sector Convergence",
    "Ranked FFA / 1-5 Armada Bounty",
    "20-PILOT SECTOR • 60M",
  ),
  RIFT_SKIRMISH(
    "RIFT_SKIRMISH",
    "Rift Skirmish",
    "Ranked Best-of-3 Team Deathmatch",
    "2v2 / 3v3 / 4v4 / 5v5",
  ),
  FLUX_CORE(
    "FLUX_CORE",
    "Volatile Flux Core",
    "Ranked Singularity Carrier Mode",
    "SOLO / ARMADA • 10 TIERS",
  ),
  STASIS_BREACH(
    "STASIS_BREACH",
    "Stasis Breach",
    "Ranked 10v10 Territory Jailbreak",
    "10v10 • BRIG REACTOR",
  ),
  SYNDICATE_WARS(
    "SYNDICATE_WARS",
    "Syndicate Wars",
    "Ranked Clan-vs-Clan Head-to-Head",
    "3v3 / 5v5 / 10v10 CLAN",
  );

  companion object {
    fun fromId(raw: String): RankedGameMode {
      val clean = raw.trim().uppercase()
      return entries.firstOrNull { it.id == clean }
        ?: when (clean) {
          "FFA", "CONVERGENCE" -> SECTOR_CONVERGENCE
          "SKIRMISH", "TDM", "3V3", "5V5" -> RIFT_SKIRMISH
          "CORE", "JUGGERNAUT" -> FLUX_CORE
          "BREACH", "JAILBREAK", "10V10" -> STASIS_BREACH
          "WARS", "CLAN_WARS" -> SYNDICATE_WARS
          else -> SECTOR_CONVERGENCE
        }
    }
  }
}

class RiftGameEngine(
  val sfx: RiftSoundSynthesizer,
  var onStatsUpdated: () -> Unit = {},
  var onPrizeToast: (String) -> Unit = {},
  var onArmadaTierKill: (tierSize: Int, bounty: Long) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  var onLifeRunEnded: (snapshot: com.example.data.PeakBountyRunSnapshot, hadPvp: Boolean) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  var onSyndicateContribution: (killsDelta: Long, bounty: Long, winsDelta: Long) -> Unit = { _, _, _ -> },
) {
  companion object {
    const val WORLD_SIZE = 8000f
    const val CAMERA_SCALE = 0.65f
    const val BASE_CAMERA_SCALE = 0.65f
    const val WALL_ELASTICITY = 0.65f
    const val SAFE_ZONE_BOT_BAN_MARGIN = 400f
    const val HVT_BOUNTY_THRESHOLD = 250

    private val BOT_CALLSIGNS =
      listOf(
        "APEX ACE",
        "SOLARIS IX",
        "IRON WOLF",
        "NEXUS 7",
        "VIPER 09",
        "CHRONO X",
        "VALKYRIE Z",
        "MANTA RAY",
        "SOLARIS PRIME",
        "DARK STAR",
        "ZERO DRIFT",
        "HYPERION",
        "VOID REAPER",
        "PULSE 88",
        "TITAN 04",
        "ECHO V",
        "STAR VIPER",
        "OMEGA WING",
        "RAVEN SIX",
        "CRYO BLADE",
        "PHANTOM RAY",
        "STORM RIDER",
        "COBALT FANG",
        "SOLAR FLARE",
      )
    val LEGACY_FOUNDRY_TAGS = setOf("KSTL", "AURL", "VRTX", "RUST")
    private val RIVAL_ARMADAS = listOf("", "VOID 3", "CRIMSON 4", "", "IRON DUO", "")

    fun cleanTag(rawTag: String): String {
      val t = rawTag.trim().removeSurrounding("[", "]").trim()
      return when {
        t.isEmpty() || t in LEGACY_FOUNDRY_TAGS -> "GUEST"
        else -> t
      }
    }
  }

  val walls = mutableListOf<WallRect>()
  val brickWalls = mutableListOf<BrickWallEntity>()
  val decoys = mutableListOf<DecoyEntity>()
  private var nextDecoyBrickId: Long = 1L
  val safeZone = RectF(3600f, 3600f, 4400f, 4400f)
  val greens = mutableListOf<GreenCrate>()
  val recentBuffSpawnLocations = ArrayDeque<Pair<Float, Float>>()
  val pendingBuffSpawns = mutableListOf<Float>()
  var radarBgBitmap: Bitmap? = null

  fun getEffectiveBuffCap(): Int {
    RiftCalibrationState.buffTargetCountOverride?.let { return it.coerceAtLeast(0) }
    val modeCap =
      when (RiftCalibrationState.buffModeOverride.uppercase()) {
        "3V3" -> 12
        "5V5" -> 10
        "10V10" -> 20
        else -> RiftCalibrationState.buffCapFfa
      }
    return modeCap.coerceAtLeast(0)
  }

  var mode: String = "SECTOR_CONVERGENCE"
  var activeRankedMode: RankedGameMode = RankedGameMode.SECTOR_CONVERGENCE
  var activeTeamSizeBracket: Int = 3 // 2..5 for RIFT_SKIRMISH, 3/5/10 for SYNDICATE_WARS, 10 for STASIS_BREACH
  var teamSize: Int = 20
  var buffVersion: Int = 0

  // Mode 2 (RIFT_SKIRMISH) & Syndicate Wars TDM Best-of-3 State
  var skirmishRound: Int = 1
  val skirmishCurrentRound: Int
    get() = skirmishRound
  var skirmishWestRoundWins: Int = 0
  var skirmishEastRoundWins: Int = 0
  var skirmishWestKills: Int = 0
  var skirmishEastKills: Int = 0
  var rivalSyndicateWarTag: String = "VTX"
  var onSyndicateWarFinished: (won: Boolean, trophyDelta: Int) -> Unit = { _, _ -> }

  // Mode 3 (FLUX_CORE) Volatile Singularity State
  val fluxCoreOrb = FluxCoreOrbState()
  var fluxCoreCarrierEntityId: String = ""
  private var fluxCoreBountyTickAccum: Float = 0f

  // Mode 4 (STASIS_BREACH) 10v10 Territory Jailbreak & Reactor Assault State
  val westBrigRect = RectF(1100f - 340f, 4000f - 340f, 1100f + 340f, 4000f + 340f)
  val eastBrigRect = RectF(6900f - 340f, 4000f - 340f, 6900f + 340f, 4000f + 340f)
  val westBrigReactorX: Float = 1480f
  val westBrigReactorY: Float = 4000f
  val eastBrigReactorX: Float = 6520f
  val eastBrigReactorY: Float = 4000f
  val brigReactorRadius: Float = 54f
  var westBrigGeneratorHp: Float = 8000f
  var eastBrigGeneratorHp: Float = 8000f

  // Fluid Up-to-5-Man Named Armada State
  var activeArmadaName: String = "" // "" = SOLO
  val activeArmadaSlots = mutableListOf<ArmadaMemberSlot>()
  val armadaMemberSlots: MutableList<ArmadaMemberSlot>
    get() = activeArmadaSlots

  val ships = mutableListOf<ShipEntity>()
  val bullets = mutableListOf<BulletEntity>()
  val bombs = mutableListOf<BombEntity>()
  val particles = mutableListOf<ParticleEntity>()
  val shockwaves = mutableListOf<ShockwaveEntity>()
  val shieldRipples = mutableListOf<ShieldRippleEntity>()
  val phaseAfterimages = mutableListOf<PhaseAfterimageEntity>()
  val interdictorBubbles = mutableListOf<InterdictorBubbleEntity>()
  val anomalies = mutableListOf<SpatialAnomalyEntity>()
  private var nextAnomalyId: Long = 1L

  // Phase 3.4 Object-Pooled Floating Combat Text (FCT)
  private val fctPool = Array(48) { FloatingPopup(active = false) }
  val floatingPopups = mutableListOf<FloatingPopup>()

  // Running Transparent Fade-Out Kill Feed (Top-Right HUD) & >1,000 Bounty Dual Alert Banner
  private var nextKillFeedId: Long = 1L
  val killFeed = mutableListOf<KillFeedEntry>()
  var highBountyShutdownBanner: String? = null
  var highBountyShutdownTimer: Float = 0f

  private val remotePilots = mutableMapOf<String, ShipEntity>()

  // Control states updated by touch subsystem
  var leftStickActive: Boolean = false
  var leftStickMag: Float = 0f
  var leftStickAngle: Float = 0f
  var autoBraking: Boolean = false

  // Right-Side 360-Degree Independent Weapon Aiming Joystick ([FIRE]) + Cancel Deadzone
  var fireStickActive: Boolean = false
  var fireStickHasAimVector: Boolean = false
  var fireStickAimAngle: Float = 0f
  var isCancelActive: Boolean = false

  var bombStickActive: Boolean = false
  var bombStickMag: Float = 0f
  var bombStickAngle: Float = 0f
  var isBombCancelActive: Boolean = false

  // Phase 3.4 Hit-Stop Freeze & Non-Linear Camera Trauma Shake + Requirement 5 Real-Time Camera Zoom (0.5x..1.5x)
  var hitStopTimer: Float = 0f
  var cameraTrauma: Float = 0f
  var traumaTimeSec: Float = 0f
  var cameraZoom: Float = 1.0f
  var playfieldTextScale: Float = 1.0f

  fun effectiveCameraScale(): Float =
    BASE_CAMERA_SCALE * (cameraZoom * RiftCalibrationState.cameraZoomScale).coerceIn(0.2f, 2.5f)

  // Persistent counters tracked by engine
  var pvpKills: Long = 0L
  var pvpDeaths: Long = 0L
  var pvpBountyPeak: Long = 100L
  var allTimeKills: Long = 0L
  var allTimeDeaths: Long = 0L
  var allTimeBountyPeak: Long = 100L
  var convergencesWon: Long = 0L
  var hvtEliminations: Long = 0L
  var greensCollected: Long = 0L
  private var safeZoneToastCooldown: Float = 0f

  // Phase 3: Pilot Level Progression (Levels 1..100), 5 XP Sources, Customization Points & Rift Shards Currency
  var xpFromBuffs: Float = 0f
  var xpFromDamage: Float = 0f
  var xpFromAccuracy: Float = 0f
  var xpFromBountyEarned: Float = 0f
  var xpFromBountyKilled: Float = 0f
  var pilotLevel: Int = 1
  var riftShards: Long = 0L
  var highestMilestoneLevelClaimed: Int = 0
  var spentCustomizationPoints: Int = 0
  var unlockedExtraSlots: Int = 0
  var aiShipDesignTokens: Int = 0

  // Phase 3: Public FFA Match Duration & >50% Presence Ratio Tracking (60-minute public cycle = 3600s)
  var publicMatchDurationSec: Float = 0f
  var publicMatchCycleLimitSec: Float = RiftCalibrationState.publicMatchCycleLimitSec

  // Dossier Upgrade 1: Live Current-Life Telemetry & Peak Bounty Run Snapshot Tracker
  var currentLifeStats: com.example.data.CurrentLifeStats =
    com.example.data.CurrentLifeStats(shipId = 1, shipFlown = "Viper")
  var currentLifeHadPvp: Boolean = false

  fun formatShipLabel(ship: ShipEntity): String =
    if (ship.spec.id == 10) "Rift Frame" else ship.spec.name

  fun resetCurrentLifeStats() {
    currentLifeStats =
      com.example.data.CurrentLifeStats(
        bountyReached = max(100, localPlayer.bounty),
        shipId = localPlayer.spec.id,
        shipFlown = formatShipLabel(localPlayer),
      )
    currentLifeHadPvp = remotePilots.isNotEmpty()
  }

  /**
   * Master Fresh-Start Wipe:
   * Resets all combat stats, 5 XP sources, Rift Shards (to 150❖), Armadas, Syndicates,
   * and live sector state back to a clean Level 1 / GUEST / SOLO state.
   */
  fun performMasterFreshStartWipe(
    localPrefs: com.example.data.LocalPilotPrefs? = null,
    uid: String? = null,
  ) {
    localPrefs?.wipeAllStatsArmadasAndSyndicates(uid)

    pvpKills = 0L
    pvpDeaths = 0L
    pvpBountyPeak = 100L
    allTimeKills = 0L
    allTimeDeaths = 0L
    allTimeBountyPeak = 100L
    convergencesWon = 0L
    hvtEliminations = 0L
    greensCollected = 0L

    xpFromBuffs = 0f
    xpFromDamage = 0f
    xpFromAccuracy = 0f
    xpFromBountyEarned = 0f
    xpFromBountyKilled = 0f
    pilotLevel = 1
    riftShards = 150L
    highestMilestoneLevelClaimed = 1
    spentCustomizationPoints = 0
    unlockedExtraSlots = 0
    aiShipDesignTokens = 0

    activeArmadaName = ""
    activeArmadaSlots.clear()
    localPlayer.armadaName = ""
    localPlayer.syndicateTag = "GUEST"
    localPlayer.bounty = 100
    localPlayer.kills = 0
    localPlayer.deaths = 0
    localPlayer.flux = localPlayer.maxFlux
    localPlayer.isInStasisBrig = false

    for (s in ships) {
      if (!s.isLocalPlayer && !s.isHuman) {
        s.armadaName = ""
        s.syndicateTag = "GUEST"
        s.bounty = 100
        s.isInStasisBrig = false
      }
    }

    RiftCodex.updateActiveCustomShipSlot(com.example.engine.CustomShipLoadoutSlot(slotId = "Frame A"))
    syncLocalPlayerCustomShipSpec()
    resetCurrentLifeStats()
    sfx.playPrize()
    onStatsUpdated()
    onPrizeToast("🧨 MASTER WIPE COMPLETE: ALL STATS, ARMADAS & SYNDICATES RESET!")
  }

  /**
   * Immediately equips a newly synthesized AI-Forged Custom Buff into the local player's
   * 4th Right-Hand Special Buff Slot for instant live arena playtesting.
   */
  fun equipAndTestCustomForgedBuff(entry: SpecialBuffRegistryEntry) {
    RiftCodex.registerCustomBuff(entry)
    localPlayer.specialWeaponType = entry.id.uppercase(java.util.Locale.US)
    localPlayer.specialWeaponCharges = max(2, entry.chargesPerPickup)
    buffVersion++
    sfx.playPrize()
    spawnPooledFct(
      text = "🧪 FORGED: ${entry.shortLabel} [${localPlayer.specialWeaponCharges}]",
      x = localPlayer.x,
      y = localPlayer.y - 32f,
      color = entry.strokeColorInt,
      maxLife = 1.35f,
    )
    onPrizeToast("🧪 AI BUFF FORGED & EQUIPPED: ${entry.officialName} (${localPlayer.specialWeaponCharges} CHARGES)")
  }

  fun getTotalXp(): Long =
    xpFromBuffs.toLong() +
      xpFromDamage.toLong() +
      xpFromAccuracy.toLong() +
      xpFromBountyEarned.toLong() +
      xpFromBountyKilled.toLong()

  fun isNinthShipUnlocked(): Boolean =
    pilotLevel >= 20 || RiftCalibrationState.unlockFullNinthShipOverride

  fun getCustomizationPointsTotal(): Int =
    if (RiftCalibrationState.unlockFullNinthShipOverride) 100 else pilotLevel.coerceIn(1, 100)

  fun getCustomizationPointsAvailable(): Int =
    (getCustomizationPointsTotal() - spentCustomizationPoints).coerceAtLeast(0)

  fun getXpProgressInCurrentLevel(): Triple<Long, Long, Float> =
    com.example.data.LocalPilotPrefs.getXpProgressInLevel(getTotalXp())

  fun getMatchPresenceRatio(ship: ShipEntity = localPlayer): Float {
    if (publicMatchDurationSec <= 0.01f) return 1.0f
    return (ship.matchPresenceTimeSec / publicMatchDurationSec).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
  }

  fun awardPilotXp(
    buffXp: Float = 0f,
    damageXp: Float = 0f,
    accuracyXp: Float = 0f,
    bountyEarnedXp: Float = 0f,
    bountyKilledXp: Float = 0f,
    notifyChange: Boolean = true,
  ) {
    xpFromBuffs += buffXp.coerceAtLeast(0f)
    xpFromDamage += damageXp.coerceAtLeast(0f)
    xpFromAccuracy += accuracyXp.coerceAtLeast(0f)
    xpFromBountyEarned += bountyEarnedXp.coerceAtLeast(0f)
    xpFromBountyKilled += bountyKilledXp.coerceAtLeast(0f)

    val computedLvl = com.example.data.LocalPilotPrefs.computeLevelFromTotalXp(getTotalXp())
    if (computedLvl > pilotLevel) {
      pilotLevel = computedLvl
      var milestoneBonusShards = 0L
      while (highestMilestoneLevelClaimed + 5 <= pilotLevel && highestMilestoneLevelClaimed + 5 <= 100) {
        highestMilestoneLevelClaimed += 5
        milestoneBonusShards += 50L
      }
      if (milestoneBonusShards > 0L) {
        riftShards += milestoneBonusShards
        sfx.playPrize()
        spawnPooledFct(
          text = "★ LVL $pilotLevel! +${milestoneBonusShards}❖ SHARDS",
          x = localPlayer.x,
          y = localPlayer.y - 38f,
          color = Color.parseColor("#FFD700"),
          maxLife = 1.45f,
        )
        onPrizeToast("★ MILESTONE PILOT LVL $pilotLevel: +1 CUSTOM PT & +${milestoneBonusShards}❖ RIFT SHARDS!")
      } else {
        sfx.playPrize()
        spawnPooledFct(
          text = "★ PILOT LVL $pilotLevel (+1 PT)",
          x = localPlayer.x,
          y = localPlayer.y - 36f,
          color = Color.parseColor("#00F0FF"),
          maxLife = 1.25f,
        )
        onPrizeToast("★ PILOT LEVEL UP! LVL $pilotLevel (+1 CUSTOMIZATION POINT • ${pilotLevel}/100 PTS)")
      }
      if (notifyChange) {
        onStatsUpdated()
      }
    } else if (notifyChange) {
      onStatsUpdated()
    }
  }

  fun simulatePilotLevelUp() {
    if (pilotLevel >= 100) {
      onPrizeToast("★ MAX PILOT LEVEL 100 REACHED (100/100 CUSTOMIZATION POINTS)")
      return
    }
    val nextLvl = (pilotLevel + 1).coerceAtMost(100)
    val neededTotal = com.example.data.LocalPilotPrefs.xpForLevelStart(nextLvl)
    val deficit = (neededTotal - getTotalXp()).coerceAtLeast(50L).toFloat()
    val perSource = deficit / 5f
    awardPilotXp(
      buffXp = perSource,
      damageXp = perSource,
      accuracyXp = perSource,
      bountyEarnedXp = perSource,
      bountyKilledXp = perSource,
      notifyChange = true,
    )
  }

  /**
   * Evaluates public FFA match / Sector Convergence conclusion:
   * 1. Awards +100❖ Rift Shards & +1 Public Game Win if the #1 top-bounty player was present for >50% of total match duration.
   * 2. Procedurally resets the sector into a brand-new map (new seed, fresh walls, anomalies, Supply Crates, and radar map),
   *    clears projectiles, resets bounties to 100, restores full Flux, and starts a new 60-minute FFA match cycle.
   */
  fun concludePublicFfaMatchCycle(forceSimulateWinWithPresence: Boolean = false) {
    if (forceSimulateWinWithPresence) {
      publicMatchDurationSec = 3600f // 60-minute public FFA match
      localPlayer.matchPresenceTimeSec = 2280f // 38 minutes present (63.3% > 50% presence rule)
      val highestOtherBounty = ships.filter { !it.isLocalPlayer }.maxOfOrNull { it.bounty } ?: 250
      if (localPlayer.bounty <= highestOtherBounty) {
        localPlayer.bounty = highestOtherBounty + 85
      }
      allTimeBountyPeak = max(allTimeBountyPeak, localPlayer.bounty.toLong())
      pvpBountyPeak = max(pvpBountyPeak, localPlayer.bounty.toLong())
    }

    // Finalize current life telemetry as SURVIVED TO SECTOR CONVERGENCE if player is alive at cycle end
    if (localPlayer.respawnTimer <= 0f) {
      currentLifeStats.bountyReached = max(currentLifeStats.bountyReached, localPlayer.bounty)
      currentLifeStats.shipId = localPlayer.spec.id
      currentLifeStats.shipFlown = formatShipLabel(localPlayer)
      val convergenceSnapshot =
        currentLifeStats.toSnapshot(
          executioner =
            com.example.data.ExecutionerTelemetry(
              survivedToConvergence = true,
              killerCallsign = "SURVIVED TO SECTOR CONVERGENCE",
              killerSyndicateTag = cleanTag(localPlayer.syndicateTag),
              killerShip = formatShipLabel(localPlayer),
              killingWeapon = "Sector Convergence Cycle Complete",
              killerBountyAtKill = localPlayer.bounty,
              bountyEarnedFromYou = 0,
            )
        )
      onLifeRunEnded(convergenceSnapshot, currentLifeHadPvp || remotePilots.isNotEmpty() || forceSimulateWinWithPresence)
    }

    val effectiveDuration = publicMatchDurationSec.coerceAtLeast(1f)
    val presenceRatio = (localPlayer.matchPresenceTimeSec / effectiveDuration).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
    val presencePct = (presenceRatio * 100f).toInt()
    val topShip = ships.maxByOrNull { it.bounty }

    if (topShip != null && (topShip.isLocalPlayer || localPlayer.bounty >= topShip.bounty)) {
      if (presenceRatio > 0.50f) {
        convergencesWon++
        riftShards += 100L
        onSyndicateContribution(0L, localPlayer.bounty.toLong(), 1L)
        sfx.playPrize()
        val bannerMsg =
          "🏆 SECTOR CONVERGENCE VICTORY! #1 BOUNTY (${localPlayer.bounty} BTY • $presencePct% PRESENCE) — +100❖ RIFT SHARDS & NEW FFA MAP!"
        highBountyShutdownBanner = bannerMsg
        highBountyShutdownTimer = 5.5f
        onPrizeToast(bannerMsg)
      } else {
        val bannerMsg =
          "🌀 SECTOR CONVERGENCE: #1 BOUNTY ACHIEVED, BUT PRESENCE ($presencePct%) <= 50% — NEW FFA MAP GENERATED!"
        highBountyShutdownBanner = bannerMsg
        highBountyShutdownTimer = 4.5f
        onPrizeToast(bannerMsg)
      }
    } else {
      val winnerName = topShip?.callsign ?: "SECTOR ACE"
      val winnerBty = topShip?.bounty ?: 100
      val bannerMsg =
        "🌀 SECTOR CONVERGENCE: WINNER $winnerName ($winnerBty BTY) — PROCEDURAL NEW FFA MAP ONLINE!"
      highBountyShutdownBanner = bannerMsg
      highBountyShutdownTimer = 4.5f
      onPrizeToast(bannerMsg)
    }

    // Procedurally regenerate a brand-new arena map for the next 60-minute FFA match
    val newSeed = Random.nextInt(10_000, 999_999)
    generateSectorArena(seed = newSeed)
    bullets.clear()
    bombs.clear()
    decoys.clear()
    brickWalls.clear()
    shockwaves.clear()
    shieldRipples.clear()
    phaseAfterimages.clear()
    interdictorBubbles.clear()

    publicMatchDurationSec = 0f
    for (s in ships) {
      s.matchPresenceTimeSec = 0f
      s.bounty = 100
      s.flux = s.maxFlux
      s.respawnTimer = 0f
      s.vx = 0f
      s.vy = 0f
      s.isCloaked = false
      s.sniperOverchargeReady = false
      s.rocketBoostTimer = 0f
      s.phaseDashTimer = 0f
      s.speedOverchargeStacks = 0
      s.thrustOverchargeStacks = 0
      s.rechargeOverchargeStacks = 0
      s.multiShotCharges = 0
      s.hasBouncingBulletsUpgrade = false
      s.safeZoneStayTimer = 0f
      s.safeZoneLockoutTimer = 0f
      s.playfieldIdleTimer = 0f
      s.isIdleDraining = false
      if (s.isLocalPlayer) {
        val sp = getSafeZoneSpawnPosition()
        s.x = sp.first
        s.y = sp.second
        s.inSafeZone = true
        s.wasInSafeZone = true
        s.weaponsLocked = true
        s.canFire = false
        s.weaponState = "DISARMED"
        s.phaseShieldTimer = RiftCalibrationState.exitPhaseShieldSec
      } else {
        val sp = getOuterGateSpawnPosition(s.freq)
        s.x = sp.first
        s.y = sp.second
        s.inSafeZone = false
        s.wasInSafeZone = false
      }
    }
    resetCurrentLifeStats()
    sfx.playWarp()
    spawnPooledFct(
      text = "🌀 NEW SECTOR MAP CONVERGED",
      x = localPlayer.x,
      y = localPlayer.y - 38f,
      color = Color.parseColor("#00F0FF"),
      maxLife = 1.6f,
    )
    onStatsUpdated()
  }

  var localPlayer: ShipEntity

  init {
    generateSectorArena(seed = (System.currentTimeMillis() / 3600_000L).toInt())
    val initialSpec = RiftCodex.getShipById(1)
    val spawn = getSafeZoneSpawnPosition()
    localPlayer =
      ShipEntity(
        id = "local_player",
        callsign = "COMMANDER",
        syndicateTag = "",
        armadaName = "",
        shipId = initialSpec.id,
        spec = initialSpec,
        freq = 0,
        isHuman = true,
        isLocalPlayer = true,
        x = spawn.first,
        y = spawn.second,
        wasInSafeZone = true,
        inSafeZone = true,
        weaponsLocked = true,
        canFire = false,
        weaponState = "DISARMED",
        phaseShieldTimer = 3.0f,
      )
    syncLocalArmadaSelfSlot()
    rebuildRosterForMode("FFA")
  }

  /**
   * Phase 3.4: Hit-Stop Freeze — scales simulation dt to 0.05 for 32ms (~2 frames at 60Hz).
   */
  fun triggerHitStop(frames: Int = 2) {
    hitStopTimer = max(hitStopTimer, (frames * 0.5f) * RiftCalibrationState.hitStopDurationSec)
  }

  /**
   * Phase 3.4: Non-Linear Camera Trauma Shake (Offset = Trauma^2 * MaxOffset * Noise(t))
   */
  fun addTrauma(amount: Float) {
    cameraTrauma = (cameraTrauma + amount).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
  }

  /**
   * Phase 3.4: Spawn Object-Pooled Floating Combat Text (FCT) with elastic scale overshoot (1.0 -> 1.4 -> 1.0),
   * drifting upward at 48px/s over 750ms with quadratic fade.
   */
  fun spawnPooledFct(text: String, x: Float, y: Float, color: Int, maxLife: Float = 0.75f) {
    val slot =
      fctPool.firstOrNull { !it.active }
        ?: fctPool.minByOrNull { it.maxLife - it.elapsed }
        ?: FloatingPopup()
    slot.active = true
    slot.text = text
    slot.x = x + (Random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 14f
    slot.y = y - 10f
    slot.vy = -48f
    slot.elapsed = 0f
    slot.maxLife = maxLife
    slot.color = color
    slot.scale = 1.0f
    if (!floatingPopups.contains(slot)) {
      floatingPopups.add(slot)
    }
  }

  fun getCurrentArmadaSize(): Int {
    return if (activeArmadaName.isEmpty()) 1 else activeArmadaSlots.size.coerceIn(1, 5)
  }

  fun getCurrentArmadaTierLabel(): String {
    val sz = getCurrentArmadaSize()
    return when {
      activeArmadaName.isEmpty() || sz <= 1 -> "SOLO RIFT"
      sz == 2 -> "2-MAN ARMADA [$activeArmadaName]"
      sz == 3 -> "3-MAN ARMADA [$activeArmadaName]"
      sz == 4 -> "4-MAN ARMADA [$activeArmadaName]"
      else -> "5-MAN ARMADA [$activeArmadaName]"
    }
  }

  fun syncLocalArmadaSelfSlot() {
    if (activeArmadaName.isEmpty()) {
      activeArmadaSlots.clear()
      localPlayer.armadaName = ""
      return
    }
    localPlayer.armadaName = activeArmadaName
    val selfSlot =
      ArmadaMemberSlot(
        uid = localPlayer.id,
        callsign = localPlayer.callsign,
        syndicateTag = localPlayer.syndicateTag,
        shipId = localPlayer.shipId,
        isLeader = true,
      )
    val existingIdx = activeArmadaSlots.indexOfFirst { it.uid == localPlayer.id || it.isLeader }
    if (existingIdx >= 0) {
      activeArmadaSlots[existingIdx] = selfSlot
    } else {
      activeArmadaSlots.add(0, selfSlot)
    }
  }

  fun formOrJoinArmada(rawName: String, initialWingmen: List<FriendPilotEntry> = emptyList()) {
    val cleanName = rawName.trim().uppercase().replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_\\-]"), "").take(10)
    if (cleanName.isEmpty()) return
    activeArmadaName = cleanName
    activeArmadaSlots.clear()
    syncLocalArmadaSelfSlot()
    for (w in initialWingmen) {
      if (activeArmadaSlots.size < 5 && activeArmadaSlots.none { it.callsign == w.callsign }) {
        activeArmadaSlots.add(
          ArmadaMemberSlot(
            uid = w.uid,
            callsign = w.callsign,
            syndicateTag = w.syndicateTag,
            shipId = w.shipId,
            isLeader = false,
          )
        )
      }
    }
    applyArmadaRosterToSectorShips()
    onPrizeToast("🛡️ ARMADA [$activeArmadaName] ACTIVE (${getCurrentArmadaSize()}/5 PILOTS)")
    onStatsUpdated()
  }

  fun addMemberToArmada(friend: FriendPilotEntry): Boolean {
    if (activeArmadaName.isEmpty()) {
      activeArmadaName = "${localPlayer.syndicateTag}_WING"
      syncLocalArmadaSelfSlot()
    }
    if (activeArmadaSlots.size >= 5) {
      onPrizeToast("⚠️ ARMADA [$activeArmadaName] IS AT MAX 5-MAN CAPACITY")
      return false
    }
    if (activeArmadaSlots.any { it.callsign.equals(friend.callsign, ignoreCase = true) }) {
      onPrizeToast("${friend.callsign} IS ALREADY IN ARMADA [$activeArmadaName]")
      return false
    }
    val prevSize = getCurrentArmadaSize()
    activeArmadaSlots.add(
      ArmadaMemberSlot(
        uid = friend.uid,
        callsign = friend.callsign,
        syndicateTag = friend.syndicateTag,
        shipId = friend.shipId,
        isLeader = false,
      )
    )
    val newSize = getCurrentArmadaSize()
    applyArmadaRosterToSectorShips()
    onPrizeToast(
      "⚡ ARMADA ROSTER SHIFT: [$activeArmadaName] ${prevSize}-MAN ➔ ${newSize}-MAN LEADERBOARD TIER"
    )
    onStatsUpdated()
    return true
  }

  fun removeMemberFromArmada(uidOrCallsign: String) {
    if (activeArmadaName.isEmpty()) return
    val prevSize = getCurrentArmadaSize()
    activeArmadaSlots.removeAll {
      !it.isLeader && (it.uid == uidOrCallsign || it.callsign.equals(uidOrCallsign, ignoreCase = true))
    }
    if (activeArmadaSlots.size <= 1) {
      val oldName = activeArmadaName
      activeArmadaName = ""
      activeArmadaSlots.clear()
      localPlayer.armadaName = ""
      applyArmadaRosterToSectorShips()
      onPrizeToast("⚡ ARMADA [$oldName] DISBANDED ➔ SHIFTED TO [SOLO] LEADERBOARD TIER")
    } else {
      val newSize = getCurrentArmadaSize()
      applyArmadaRosterToSectorShips()
      onPrizeToast(
        "⚡ ARMADA ROSTER SHIFT: [$activeArmadaName] ${prevSize}-MAN ➔ ${newSize}-MAN LEADERBOARD TIER"
      )
    }
    onStatsUpdated()
  }

  fun simulateArmadaDropoutToDuo() {
    if (activeArmadaName.isEmpty() || activeArmadaSlots.size <= 2) {
      formOrJoinArmada(
        "APEX_4",
        listOf(
          FriendPilotEntry("f1", "VORTEX_ACE", localPlayer.syndicateTag, 1, "", true, "APEX_4", 4, 320),
          FriendPilotEntry("f2", "CHRONO_X", localPlayer.syndicateTag, 6, "", true, "APEX_4", 4, 210),
          FriendPilotEntry("f3", "VALKYRIE_Z", localPlayer.syndicateTag, 7, "", true, "APEX_4", 4, 180),
        ),
      )
    }
    val before = activeArmadaSlots.size
    while (activeArmadaSlots.size > 2) {
      activeArmadaSlots.removeAt(activeArmadaSlots.lastIndex)
    }
    applyArmadaRosterToSectorShips()
    onPrizeToast(
      "⚡ ROSTER SHIFT DETECTED: [$activeArmadaName] DROPPED ${before}-MAN ➔ 2-MAN DUO TIER!"
    )
    onStatsUpdated()
  }

  fun leaveArmadaToSolo() {
    val old = activeArmadaName
    activeArmadaName = ""
    activeArmadaSlots.clear()
    localPlayer.armadaName = ""
    applyArmadaRosterToSectorShips()
    if (old.isNotEmpty()) {
      onPrizeToast("⚡ LEFT ARMADA [$old] ➔ FLYING [SOLO] IN THE RIFT")
    }
    onStatsUpdated()
  }

  private fun applyArmadaRosterToSectorShips() {
    localPlayer.armadaName = activeArmadaName
    val wingCallsigns = activeArmadaSlots.filter { !it.isLeader }.map { it.callsign }.toSet()
    for (s in ships) {
      if (s.isLocalPlayer) continue
      if (s.callsign in wingCallsigns) {
        s.armadaName = activeArmadaName
      } else if (s.armadaName == activeArmadaName) {
        s.armadaName = ""
      }
    }
    for (slot in activeArmadaSlots) {
      if (slot.isLeader) continue
      if (ships.none { it.callsign == slot.callsign }) {
        val candidate = ships.firstOrNull { !it.isLocalPlayer && it.armadaName != activeArmadaName }
        if (candidate != null) {
          candidate.callsign = slot.callsign
          candidate.syndicateTag = slot.syndicateTag
          candidate.armadaName = activeArmadaName
          candidate.shipId = slot.shipId
          candidate.spec = RiftCodex.getShipById(slot.shipId)
        }
      }
    }
  }

  fun isTeamBasedRankedMode(): Boolean =
    activeRankedMode in
      setOf(
        RankedGameMode.RIFT_SKIRMISH,
        RankedGameMode.STASIS_BREACH,
        RankedGameMode.SYNDICATE_WARS,
      )

  fun isStasisBreachRulesActive(): Boolean =
    activeRankedMode == RankedGameMode.STASIS_BREACH ||
      (activeRankedMode == RankedGameMode.SYNDICATE_WARS && activeTeamSizeBracket >= 10)

  fun isSkirmishRulesActive(): Boolean =
    activeRankedMode == RankedGameMode.RIFT_SKIRMISH ||
      (activeRankedMode == RankedGameMode.SYNDICATE_WARS && activeTeamSizeBracket < 10)

  fun isFluxCoreRulesActive(): Boolean =
    activeRankedMode == RankedGameMode.FLUX_CORE

  /**
   * Returns the count of HUMAN pilots (isHuman == true, NEVER counting AI bots) in the specified mode.
   */
  fun getHumanPilotCountForMode(mode: RankedGameMode = activeRankedMode): Int {
    if (mode == activeRankedMode) {
      return ships.count { it.isHuman }.coerceAtLeast(1)
    }
    val remoteHumans = remotePilots.values.count { it.isHuman }
    return (1 + remoteHumans).coerceIn(1, 20)
  }

  /**
   * Seamless Bot-Replacement Scaling: when a human pilot joins a 20-ship instance,
   * replaces 1 AI bot (!it.isHuman) so total instance ships never exceed capacity.
   */
  fun replaceBotWithHuman(pilotShip: ShipEntity) {
    val existingIdx = ships.indexOfFirst { it.id == pilotShip.id }
    if (existingIdx >= 0) {
      ships[existingIdx] = pilotShip
      return
    }
    val cap =
      when (activeRankedMode) {
        RankedGameMode.RIFT_SKIRMISH -> (activeTeamSizeBracket.coerceIn(2, 5) * 2)
        RankedGameMode.SYNDICATE_WARS -> (activeTeamSizeBracket.coerceIn(3, 10) * 2)
        else -> 20
      }
    if (ships.size >= cap) {
      val botToRemove =
        ships.firstOrNull { !it.isHuman && !it.isLocalPlayer && it.freq == pilotShip.freq }
          ?: ships.firstOrNull { !it.isHuman && !it.isLocalPlayer }
      if (botToRemove != null) {
        ships.remove(botToRemove)
      }
    }
    ships.add(pilotShip)
  }

  /**
   * Validates whether the local pilot and their active Armada wingmen are eligible for Ranked Syndicate Wars.
   */
  fun canQueueSyndicateWars(): Pair<Boolean, String> {
    val myTag = localPlayer.syndicateTag.trim().uppercase()
    if (
      myTag.isEmpty() ||
        myTag in setOf("SOLO", "FREE", "GUEST", "BOT", "UNAFFILIATED")
    ) {
      return false to "Join or found a Syndicate first to queue for Ranked Syndicate Wars."
    }
    val mismatched =
      activeArmadaSlots.firstOrNull {
        !it.isLeader && !it.syndicateTag.trim().equals(myTag, ignoreCase = true)
      }
    if (mismatched != null) {
      return false to "All Armada wingmen must belong to Syndicate [$myTag] (${mismatched.callsign} is [${mismatched.syndicateTag}])."
    }
    return true to "ELIGIBLE FOR [$myTag] SYNDICATE WARS"
  }

  /**
   * Deploys the local pilot (and their active Armada squad on Team 0) into any of the 5 always-open Ranked Modes.
   */
  fun deployToRankedMode(mode: RankedGameMode, teamSizeBracket: Int = 3) {
    if (mode == RankedGameMode.SYNDICATE_WARS) {
      val (eligible, reason) = canQueueSyndicateWars()
      if (!eligible) {
        sfx.playMutedClick()
        onPrizeToast("⚠️ $reason")
        return
      }
    }
    activeRankedMode = mode
    this.mode = mode.id
    activeTeamSizeBracket =
      when (mode) {
        RankedGameMode.RIFT_SKIRMISH -> teamSizeBracket.coerceIn(2, 5)
        RankedGameMode.STASIS_BREACH -> 10
        RankedGameMode.SYNDICATE_WARS ->
          when {
            teamSizeBracket >= 10 -> 10
            teamSizeBracket >= 5 -> 5
            else -> 3
          }
        else -> 20
      }

    // Reset mode-specific state
    skirmishRound = 1
    skirmishWestRoundWins = 0
    skirmishEastRoundWins = 0
    skirmishWestKills = 0
    skirmishEastKills = 0
    val rivalPool = listOf("VTX", "AEX", "KST", "OBS", "SOL", "RFT")
    rivalSyndicateWarTag =
      rivalPool.firstOrNull { !it.equals(localPlayer.syndicateTag, ignoreCase = true) } ?: "VTX"

    resetFluxCoreToCenter()
    westBrigGeneratorHp = RiftCalibrationState.stasisBrigReactorMaxHp
    eastBrigGeneratorHp = RiftCalibrationState.stasisBrigReactorMaxHp

    bullets.clear()
    bombs.clear()
    decoys.clear()
    brickWalls.clear()
    interdictorBubbles.clear()

    rebuildRosterForMode(mode.id)
    sfx.playWarp()
    val humanCount = getHumanPilotCountForMode(mode)
    val botCount = (ships.size - humanCount).coerceAtLeast(0)
    onPrizeToast(
      "🚀 DEPLOYED TO ${mode.title.uppercase()} (${mode.teamFormatBadge}) • $humanCount HUMAN / $botCount AI BOTS"
    )
    onStatsUpdated()
  }

  private fun resetFluxCoreToCenter() {
    fluxCoreCarrierEntityId = ""
    fluxCoreBountyTickAccum = 0f
    fluxCoreOrb.carrierShipId = -1
    fluxCoreOrb.holdDurationSec = 0f
    fluxCoreOrb.overchargeTier = 0
    fluxCoreOrb.ejectDecelTimerSec = 0f
    fluxCoreOrb.pickupImmunitySec = 0.5f
    // Place just outside the North Safe Zone gate so pilots can immediately contest it in open space
    fluxCoreOrb.x = WORLD_SIZE * 0.5f
    fluxCoreOrb.y = safeZone.top - 320f
    fluxCoreOrb.vx = 0f
    fluxCoreOrb.vy = 0f
  }

  private fun ejectFluxCoreFromShip(ship: ShipEntity, reason: String) {
    if (activeRankedMode != RankedGameMode.FLUX_CORE) return
    val isCarrier =
      fluxCoreCarrierEntityId == ship.id ||
        (fluxCoreOrb.carrierShipId != -1 && fluxCoreOrb.carrierShipId == ship.shipId && hypot(ship.x - fluxCoreOrb.x, ship.y - fluxCoreOrb.y) < 180f)
    if (!isCarrier) return

    fluxCoreCarrierEntityId = ""
    fluxCoreOrb.carrierShipId = -1
    fluxCoreOrb.holdDurationSec = 0f
    fluxCoreOrb.overchargeTier = 0
    fluxCoreOrb.ejectDecelTimerSec = 30.0f
    fluxCoreOrb.pickupImmunitySec = 0.75f
    fluxCoreBountyTickAccum = 0f

    // Launch outward at 1,650 px/s away from Safe Zone center
    val cx = WORLD_SIZE * 0.5f
    val cy = WORLD_SIZE * 0.5f
    val baseAng =
      if (hypot(ship.x - cx, ship.y - cy) > 40f) {
        atan2(ship.y - cy, ship.x - cx) + (Random.nextFloat() - 0.5f) * 0.65f
      } else {
        Random.nextFloat() * PI.toFloat() * 2f
      }
    val ejectSp = RiftCalibrationState.fluxCoreEjectSpeed
    fluxCoreOrb.x = ship.x.coerceIn(180f, WORLD_SIZE - 180f)
    fluxCoreOrb.y = ship.y.coerceIn(180f, WORLD_SIZE - 180f)
    if (isInsideSafeZone(fluxCoreOrb.x, fluxCoreOrb.y)) {
      fluxCoreOrb.x = cx + cos(baseAng) * (safeZone.width() * 0.5f + 90f)
      fluxCoreOrb.y = cy + sin(baseAng) * (safeZone.height() * 0.5f + 90f)
    }
    fluxCoreOrb.vx = cos(baseAng) * ejectSp
    fluxCoreOrb.vy = sin(baseAng) * ejectSp

    shockwaves.add(ShockwaveEntity(fluxCoreOrb.x, fluxCoreOrb.y, 20f, 320f, Color.parseColor("#FACC15")))
    shockwaves.add(ShockwaveEntity(fluxCoreOrb.x, fluxCoreOrb.y, 12f, 240f, Color.parseColor("#00F5D4")))
    spawnPooledFct(
      text = "⚡ FLUX CORE EJECTED ($reason)",
      x = fluxCoreOrb.x,
      y = fluxCoreOrb.y - 32f,
      color = Color.parseColor("#FACC15"),
      maxLife = 1.4f,
    )
    if (ship.isLocalPlayer) {
      sfx.playWarp()
      onPrizeToast("⚡ VOLATILE FLUX CORE EJECTED ($reason) — RICOCHETING AT ${ejectSp.toInt()} PX/S!")
    }
  }

  /**
   * Friendly Fire Rule:
   * Strictly disabled between active Armada mates, same-Syndicate mates, and same-Team mates in Team Modes!
   */
  fun areAllied(a: ShipEntity, b: ShipEntity): Boolean {
    if (a.id == b.id) return true
    if (isTeamBasedRankedMode()) return a.freq == b.freq
    if (a.armadaName.isNotEmpty() && a.armadaName == b.armadaName) return true
    if (
      a.syndicateTag.isNotEmpty() &&
        a.syndicateTag != "FREE" &&
        a.syndicateTag != "GUEST" &&
        a.syndicateTag != "BOT" &&
        a.syndicateTag != "UNAFFILIATED" &&
        a.syndicateTag == b.syndicateTag
    ) {
      return true
    }
    return false
  }

  fun isBulletAlliedWithShip(b: BulletEntity, s: ShipEntity): Boolean {
    if (b.ownerId == s.id) return true
    if (isTeamBasedRankedMode()) return b.freq == s.freq
    if (b.ownerArmadaName.isNotEmpty() && b.ownerArmadaName == s.armadaName) return true
    if (
      b.ownerSyndicateTag.isNotEmpty() &&
        b.ownerSyndicateTag != "FREE" &&
        b.ownerSyndicateTag != "GUEST" &&
        b.ownerSyndicateTag != "BOT" &&
        b.ownerSyndicateTag != "UNAFFILIATED" &&
        b.ownerSyndicateTag == s.syndicateTag
    ) {
      return true
    }
    return false
  }

  fun isBombAlliedWithShip(bm: BombEntity, s: ShipEntity): Boolean {
    if (bm.ownerId == s.id) return true
    if (isTeamBasedRankedMode()) return bm.freq == s.freq
    if (bm.ownerArmadaName.isNotEmpty() && bm.ownerArmadaName == s.armadaName) return true
    if (

      return true
    }
    return false
  }

  private fun rectOverlapsProtectedZone(rx: Float, ry: Float, rw: Float, rh: Float): Boolean {
    val rRight = rx + rw
    val rBottom = ry + rh
    // Protect West Warp Gate + West Stasis Brig + West Brig Reactor Core (x: 450..1620, y: 3500..4500)
    val overlapsWestBrig = rRight >= 450f && rx <= 1620f && rBottom >= 3500f && ry <= 4500f
    // Protect East Warp Gate + East Stasis Brig + East Brig Reactor Core (x: 6380..7550, y: 3500..4500)
    val overlapsEastBrig = rRight >= 6380f && rx <= 7550f && rBottom >= 3500f && ry <= 4500f
    // Protect Flux Core initial spawn north of Safe Zone (x: 3800..4200, y: 3150..3580)
    val overlapsFluxSpawn = rRight >= 3800f && rx <= 4200f && rBottom >= 3150f && ry <= 3580f
    return overlapsWestBrig || overlapsEastBrig || overlapsFluxSpawn
  }

  fun generateSectorArena(seed: Int) {
    walls.clear()
    val b = 64f
    // Outer Arena Perimeter Walls
    walls.add(WallRect(0f, 0f, WORLD_SIZE, b))
    walls.add(WallRect(0f, WORLD_SIZE - b, WORLD_SIZE, b))
    walls.add(WallRect(0f, b, b, WORLD_SIZE - b * 2f))
    walls.add(WallRect(WORLD_SIZE - b, b, b, WORLD_SIZE - b * 2f))

    // Center Base Trench Pillars around Safe Zone
    val cx = WORLD_SIZE / 2f
    val cy = WORLD_SIZE / 2f
    walls.add(WallRect(cx - 440f, cy - 440f, 256f, 64f))
    walls.add(WallRect(cx + 184f, cy - 440f, 256f, 64f))
    walls.add(WallRect(cx - 440f, cy + 376f, 256f, 64f))
    walls.add(WallRect(cx + 184f, cy + 376f, 256f, 64f))

    walls.add(WallRect(cx - 440f, cy - 376f, 64f, 192f))
    walls.add(WallRect(cx - 440f, cy + 184f, 64f, 192f))
    walls.add(WallRect(cx + 376f, cy - 376f, 64f, 192f))
    walls.add(WallRect(cx + 376f, cy + 184f, 64f, 192f))

    var rng = seed
    fun nextRand(): Float {
      rng = rng * 1664525 + 1013904223
      return ((rng ushr 8) and 0xFFFFFF).toFloat() / 0x1000000.toFloat()
    }

    for (i in 0 until 18) {
      val rx = 512f + ((nextRand() * 2600f).toInt() / 32) * 32f
      val ry = 512f + ((nextRand() * 2600f).toInt() / 32) * 32f
      val horizontal = nextRand() > 0.5f
      val w = if (horizontal) 288f else 64f
      val h = if (horizontal) 64f else 288f

      val candidates =
        listOf(
          WallRect(rx, ry, w, h),
          WallRect(WORLD_SIZE - rx - w, ry, w, h),
          WallRect(rx, WORLD_SIZE - ry - h, w, h),
          WallRect(WORLD_SIZE - rx - w, WORLD_SIZE - ry - h, w, h),
        )
      for (cand in candidates) {
        if (!rectOverlapsProtectedZone(cand.x, cand.y, cand.w, cand.h)) {
          walls.add(cand)
        }
      }
    }

    greens.clear()
    pendingBuffSpawns.clear()
    recentBuffSpawnLocations.clear()
    interdictorBubbles.clear()
    val initialCap = getEffectiveBuffCap()
    repeat(initialCap) { spawnGreenCrate() }
    spawnInitialSpatialAnomalies()
    bakeStaticRadarBitmap()
  }

  private fun bakeStaticRadarBitmap() {
    val size = 160
    val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(size, size, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
    val c = Canvas(bmp)
    val drawSize = size * 0.84f
    val ox = (size - drawSize) / 2f
    val oy = (size - drawSize) / 2f
    val scale = drawSize / WORLD_SIZE

    val borderPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 1.5f
        color = Color.argb(120, 56, 189, 248)
      }
    c.drawRect(ox, oy, ox + drawSize, oy + drawSize, borderPaint)

    val safePaint =
      Paint().apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = Color.argb(45, 16, 185, 129)
      }
    c.drawRect(
      ox + safeZone.left * scale,
      oy + safeZone.top * scale,
      ox + safeZone.right * scale,
      oy + safeZone.bottom * scale,
      safePaint,
    )

    val wallPaint =
      Paint().apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = Color.argb(135, 148, 163, 184)
      }
    for (w in walls) {
      c.drawRect(
        ox + w.x * scale,
        oy + w.y * scale,
        ox + (w.x + w.w) * scale,
        oy + (w.y + w.h) * scale,
        wallPaint,
      )
    }
    radarBgBitmap = bmp
  }

  fun isInsideSafeZone(x: Float, y: Float): Boolean {
    return x >= safeZone.left && x <= safeZone.right && y >= safeZone.top && y <= safeZone.bottom
  }

  fun isWithinBotBanPerimeter(x: Float, y: Float): Boolean {
    val margin = RiftCalibrationState.botSafeZoneBanMargin
    return x >= safeZone.left - margin &&
      x <= safeZone.right + margin &&
      y >= safeZone.top - margin &&
      y <= safeZone.bottom + margin
  }

  fun circleIntersectsWalls(cx: Float, cy: Float, r: Float): Boolean {
    for (w in walls) {
      val closestX = cx.coerceIn(w.x, w.x + w.w)
      val closestY = cy.coerceIn(w.y, w.y + w.h)
      val dx = cx - closestX
      val dy = cy - closestY
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < r * r) return true
    }
    for (bw in brickWalls) {
      val closestX = cx.coerceIn(bw.x, bw.x + bw.w)
      val closestY = cy.coerceIn(bw.y, bw.y + bw.h)
      val dx = cx - closestX
      val dy = cy - closestY
      if (dx * dx + dy * dy < r * r) return true
    }
    return false
  }

  fun spawnGreenCrate(): Boolean {
    val cap = getEffectiveBuffCap()
    if (greens.size >= cap) return false

    var chosenX = 0f
    var chosenY = 0f
    var found = false

    // Attempt to pick a non-repeating random spot at least 250f away from previous spawn locations and active crates
    for (attempt in 0 until 60) {
      val minSeparation = if (attempt < 40) 250f else 150f
      val x: Float
      val y: Float
      if (Random.nextFloat() < 0.35f) {
        val angle = Random.nextFloat() * (PI.toFloat() * 2f)
        val dist = 600f + Random.nextFloat() * 1400f
        x = (WORLD_SIZE * 0.5f + cos(angle) * dist).coerceIn(180f, WORLD_SIZE - 180f)
        y = (WORLD_SIZE * 0.5f + sin(angle) * dist).coerceIn(180f, WORLD_SIZE - 180f)
      } else {
        x = 180f + Random.nextFloat() * (WORLD_SIZE - 360f)
        y = 180f + Random.nextFloat() * (WORLD_SIZE - 360f)
      }

      if (circleIntersectsWalls(x, y, 44f) || isInsideSafeZone(x, y)) {
        continue
      }

      // Check distance against currently active crates
      var tooClose = false
      for (g in greens) {
        if (hypot(g.x - x, g.y - y) < minSeparation) {
          tooClose = true
          break
        }
      }
      if (tooClose) continue

      // Check distance against previous spawn locations in match memory (never in the same spot)
      for (loc in recentBuffSpawnLocations) {
        if (hypot(loc.first - x, loc.second - y) < minSeparation) {
          tooClose = true
          break
        }
      }
      if (tooClose) continue

      chosenX = x
      chosenY = y
      found = true
      break
    }

    if (!found) {
      chosenX = 240f + Random.nextFloat() * (WORLD_SIZE - 480f)
      chosenY = 240f + Random.nextFloat() * (WORLD_SIZE - 480f)
      if (isInsideSafeZone(chosenX, chosenY)) {
        chosenX += 600f
      }
    }

    // Record in spatial history to guarantee uniqueness during the match
    if (recentBuffSpawnLocations.size >= 64) {
      recentBuffSpawnLocations.removeFirst()
    }
    recentBuffSpawnLocations.addLast(Pair(chosenX, chosenY))

    val customIndices = RiftCodex.getCustomForgedBuffs().map { it.buffTypeIndex }
    val chosenBuffType =
      if (customIndices.isNotEmpty() && Random.nextFloat() < 0.16f) {
        customIndices[Random.nextInt(customIndices.size)]
      } else {
        when (val baseRoll = Random.nextInt(11)) {
          10 ->
            when (Random.nextInt(3)) {
              0 -> -10 // Speed Overcharge (+8% Top Speed)
              1 -> -11 // Thrust Overcharge (+8% Thrust)
              else -> -12 // Reactor Overcharge (+8% Flux Recharge)
            }
          else -> baseRoll
        }
      }

    greens.add(
      GreenCrate(
        x = chosenX,
        y = chosenY,
        spinPhase = Random.nextFloat() * (PI.toFloat() * 2f),
        buffType = chosenBuffType,
      )
    )
    return true
  }

  fun findRandomAnomalyPosition(existingAnomalies: List<SpatialAnomalyEntity> = emptyList()): Pair<Float, Float> {
    for (attempt in 0 until 60) {
