        s.wormholeCooldownTimer = max(0f, s.wormholeCooldownTimer - dt)
      }
    }
    for (b in bullets) {
      if (b.wormholeCooldownTimer > 0f) {
        b.wormholeCooldownTimer = max(0f, b.wormholeCooldownTimer - dt)
      }
    }
    for (bm in bombs) {
      if (bm.wormholeCooldownTimer > 0f) {
        bm.wormholeCooldownTimer = max(0f, bm.wormholeCooldownTimer - dt)
      }
    }

    // 2. Step anomaly life, rotation, physics fields
    val expiredPairsToRespawn = mutableListOf<AnomalyType>()
    val expiredSinglesToRespawn = mutableListOf<AnomalyType>()

    for (aIdx in anomalies.indices.reversed()) {
      val anom = anomalies[aIdx]
      anom.life -= rawDt
      val spinSpeed = when (anom.type) {
        AnomalyType.PLASMA_RIFT -> 2.2f
        AnomalyType.REPULSOR_RIFT -> 1.8f
        AnomalyType.GRAVITY_RIFT -> -1.4f
        AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A -> 2.5f
        AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_B -> -2.5f
      }
      anom.spinAngle = (anom.spinAngle + spinSpeed * dt) % (PI.toFloat() * 2f)

      // Ambient accretion disk particles
      if (Random.nextFloat() < 0.35f && particles.size < 95) {
        val pAngle = Random.nextFloat() * (PI.toFloat() * 2f)
        val pDist = anom.physicalRadius * (0.35f + Random.nextFloat() * 0.75f)
        val pColor = when (anom.type) {
          AnomalyType.PLASMA_RIFT -> if (Random.nextBoolean()) Color.parseColor("#EF4444") else Color.parseColor("#D946EF")
          AnomalyType.REPULSOR_RIFT -> if (Random.nextBoolean()) Color.WHITE else Color.parseColor("#38BDF8")
          AnomalyType.GRAVITY_RIFT -> if (Random.nextBoolean()) Color.parseColor("#C084FC") else Color.parseColor("#6366F1")
          else -> if (Random.nextBoolean()) Color.parseColor("#2DD4BF") else Color.parseColor("#38BDF8")
        }
        val swirlVx = -sin(pAngle) * 55f * (if (anom.type == AnomalyType.GRAVITY_RIFT) -1f else 1f)
        val swirlVy = cos(pAngle) * 55f * (if (anom.type == AnomalyType.GRAVITY_RIFT) -1f else 1f)
        particles.add(
          ParticleEntity(
            x = anom.x + cos(pAngle) * pDist,
            y = anom.y + sin(pAngle) * pDist,
            vx = swirlVx,
            vy = swirlVy,
            life = 0.32f,
            maxLife = 0.32f,
            size = 3.2f,
            color = pColor,
          )
        )
      }

      // Check lifespan expiration (45s)
      if (anom.life <= 0f) {
        // Despawn particle burst
        spawnExplosion(anom.x, anom.y, when (anom.type) {
          AnomalyType.PLASMA_RIFT -> Color.parseColor("#EF4444")
          AnomalyType.REPULSOR_RIFT -> Color.WHITE
          AnomalyType.GRAVITY_RIFT -> Color.parseColor("#818CF8")
          else -> Color.parseColor("#2DD4BF")
        })
        anomalies.removeAt(aIdx)
        if (anom.type == AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A || anom.type == AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_B) {
          if (!expiredPairsToRespawn.contains(AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A)) {
            expiredPairsToRespawn.add(AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A)
          }
        } else {
          expiredSinglesToRespawn.add(anom.type)
        }
        continue
      }

      // Physics fields per Rift type (100% live-wired to RiftCalibrationState)
      when (anom.type) {
        AnomalyType.PLASMA_RIFT -> {
          val tearRadius = anom.physicalRadius
          val dmgPct = RiftCalibrationState.plasmaRiftDamagePct
          for (s in ships) {
            if (s.respawnTimer > 0f || isInsideSafeZone(s.x, s.y)) continue
            val dist = hypot(s.x - anom.x, s.y - anom.y)
            if (dist < tearRadius + s.radius * 0.4f && s.plasmaRiftTickTimer <= 0f) {
              s.plasmaRiftTickTimer = 0.60f
              val dmg = s.maxFlux * dmgPct
              s.flux -= dmg
              shieldRipples.add(
                ShieldRippleEntity(
                  shipId = s.id,
                  impactAngle = atan2(anom.y - s.y, anom.x - s.x),
                  intensity = 1.0f,
                  life = 0.30f,
                )
              )
              if (s.isLocalPlayer) {
                currentLifeStats.damageTaken += dmg
                sfx.playBounce()
                addTrauma(0.24f)
                spawnPooledFct(
                  text = "☢ PLASMA RIFT -${dmg.toInt()}⚡ (${(dmgPct * 100f).toInt()}%)",
                  x = s.x,
                  y = s.y - 28f,
                  color = Color.parseColor("#EF4444"),
                )
              }
              if (s.flux <= 0f) {
                destroyShipFromPlasmaRift(s)
              }
            }
          }
        }

        AnomalyType.REPULSOR_RIFT -> {
          val fieldRadius = RiftCalibrationState.repulsorFieldRadius
          val baseRepulse = RiftCalibrationState.repulsorBaseForce
          for (s in ships) {
            if (s.respawnTimer > 0f) continue
            val dx = s.x - anom.x
            val dy = s.y - anom.y
            val dist = hypot(dx, dy).coerceAtLeast(0.01f)
            if (dist < fieldRadius) {
              val nx = dx / dist
              val ny = dy / dist
              val approachSpeed = -(s.vx * nx + s.vy * ny)
              val slingshotBonus = if (approachSpeed > 0f) approachSpeed * 2.8f else 0f
              val forceMag = (baseRepulse + slingshotBonus) * (1f - dist / fieldRadius).coerceIn(0.2f, 1f)
              s.vx += nx * forceMag * dt
              s.vy += ny * forceMag * dt

              val maxAllowed = s.spec.afterburnerSpeed * 1.35f
              val curSp = hypot(s.vx, s.vy)
              if (curSp > maxAllowed) {
                s.vx = (s.vx / curSp) * maxAllowed
                s.vy = (s.vy / curSp) * maxAllowed
              }
              if (s.isLocalPlayer && approachSpeed > 60f) {
                sfx.playBounce()
              }
            }
          }

          // Deflect incoming projectiles outward
          for (b in bullets) {
            val dx = b.x - anom.x
            val dy = b.y - anom.y
            val dist = hypot(dx, dy).coerceAtLeast(0.01f)
            if (dist < fieldRadius * 0.75f) {
              val nx = dx / dist
              val ny = dy / dist
              val sp = hypot(b.vx, b.vy).coerceAtLeast(300f)
              b.vx += nx * 1400f * dt
              b.vy += ny * 1400f * dt
              val newSp = hypot(b.vx, b.vy).coerceAtLeast(1f)
              b.vx = (b.vx / newSp) * sp
              b.vy = (b.vy / newSp) * sp
            }
          }
          for (bm in bombs) {
            val dx = bm.x - anom.x
            val dy = bm.y - anom.y
            val dist = hypot(dx, dy).coerceAtLeast(0.01f)
            if (dist < fieldRadius * 0.75f) {
              val nx = dx / dist
              val ny = dy / dist
              val sp = hypot(bm.vx, bm.vy).coerceAtLeast(180f)
              bm.vx += nx * 900f * dt
              bm.vy += ny * 900f * dt
              val newSp = hypot(bm.vx, bm.vy).coerceAtLeast(1f)
              bm.vx = (bm.vx / newSp) * sp
              bm.vy = (bm.vy / newSp) * sp
            }
          }
        }

        AnomalyType.GRAVITY_RIFT -> {
          val pullRadius = RiftCalibrationState.gravityPullRadius
          val pullStrength = RiftCalibrationState.gravityPullForce
          val coreRadius = anom.physicalRadius * 0.42f

          for (s in ships) {
            if (s.respawnTimer > 0f) continue
            val dx = anom.x - s.x
            val dy = anom.y - s.y
            val dist = hypot(dx, dy).coerceAtLeast(0.01f)

            if (dist < coreRadius) {
              if (s.blackHoleImmunityTimer <= 0f) {
                s.vx = 0f
                s.vy = 0f
                s.blackHoleImmunityTimer = RiftCalibrationState.gravityStopImmunitySec
                spawnExplosion(s.x, s.y, Color.parseColor("#C084FC"))
                if (s.isLocalPlayer) {
                  sfx.playBounce()
                  spawnPooledFct("⚠️ GRAVITY RIFT: FULL STOP", s.x, s.y - 32f, Color.parseColor("#A855F7"))
                }
              }
            } else if (dist < pullRadius) {
              if (s.blackHoleImmunityTimer <= 0f) {
                val nx = dx / dist
                val ny = dy / dist
                val pullMag = pullStrength * (1f - dist / pullRadius).coerceIn(0.15f, 1f)
                s.vx += nx * pullMag * dt
                s.vy += ny * pullMag * dt
              }
            }
          }

          // Absorbs live projectiles touching the core
          for (bIdx in bullets.indices.reversed()) {
            val b = bullets[bIdx]
            if (hypot(b.x - anom.x, b.y - anom.y) < coreRadius) {
              bullets.removeAt(bIdx)
              spawnExplosion(b.x, b.y, Color.parseColor("#A855F7"))
            }
          }
          for (bmIdx in bombs.indices.reversed()) {
            val bm = bombs[bmIdx]
            if (hypot(bm.x - anom.x, bm.y - anom.y) < coreRadius) {
              bombs.removeAt(bmIdx)
              spawnExplosion(bm.x, bm.y, Color.parseColor("#A855F7"))
            }
          }
        }

        AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A, AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_B -> {
          val portalRadius = anom.physicalRadius * 0.52f
          val phaseCd = RiftCalibrationState.phaseRiftCooldownSec
          val partner = anomalies.firstOrNull { it.id == anom.partnerId }
          if (partner != null) {
            for (s in ships) {
              if (s.respawnTimer > 0f) continue
              if (s.wormholeCooldownTimer <= 0f && hypot(s.x - anom.x, s.y - anom.y) < portalRadius + s.radius * 0.5f) {
                s.x = partner.x
                s.y = partner.y
                s.wormholeCooldownTimer = phaseCd
                spawnExplosion(anom.x, anom.y, Color.parseColor("#2DD4BF"))
                spawnExplosion(partner.x, partner.y, Color.parseColor("#2DD4BF"))
                if (s.isLocalPlayer) {
                  sfx.playWarp()
                  spawnPooledFct("🌌 PHASE RIFT TRANSIT", s.x, s.y - 36f, Color.parseColor("#2DD4BF"))
                }
              }
            }

            for (b in bullets) {
              if (b.wormholeCooldownTimer <= 0f && hypot(b.x - anom.x, b.y - anom.y) < portalRadius) {
                b.x = partner.x
                b.y = partner.y
                b.wormholeCooldownTimer = phaseCd
              }
            }

            for (bm in bombs) {
              if (bm.wormholeCooldownTimer <= 0f && hypot(bm.x - anom.x, bm.y - anom.y) < portalRadius) {
                bm.x = partner.x
                bm.y = partner.y
                bm.wormholeCooldownTimer = phaseCd
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Cleanly respawn expired Rifts on 45s cycles
    for (singleType in expiredSinglesToRespawn) {
      spawnSingleAnomaly(singleType)
    }
    if (expiredPairsToRespawn.isNotEmpty()) {
      // Remove any lingering orphan partner
      anomalies.removeAll { it.type == AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_A || it.type == AnomalyType.PHASE_RIFT_B }
      spawnPhaseRiftPair()
    }
  }
}

    sb.appendLine("- Universal Baseline Hull Floor (0 pts) + Linear Per-Point Scaling (0..30 pts max per stat):")

    sb.appendLine("- Primary Weapon Archetypes (9 choices):")

Silhouettes: RAZOR_INTERCEPTOR, CRESCENT_SCYTHE, BASTION_DREADNOUGHT, MANTA_STINGRAY, X_VALKYRIE, PINCER_MANDIBLE.")

    val activeSlotId = localPrefs.getActiveCustomSlotId(currentUserId)

    sb.appendLine()
    sb.appendLine("[6. HIGHEST BOUNTY RECORDS (GLOBAL CLOUD LEADERBOARD, PILOT DOSSIER & LIVE SECTOR)]")

    val topCloudAllTime = cloudLeaderboard.maxByOrNull { it.allTimeBounty }
    val topCloudPvp = cloudLeaderboard.maxByOrNull { it.pvpBounty }
    val liveTopShip = engine.ships.maxByOrNull { it.bounty }

    // Determine single overall highest recorded bounty across Cloud Leaderboard, Local Dossier Peak, and Live Sector
    data class BountyRecordCandidate(val source: String, val callsign: String, val tag: String, val bounty: Long, val detail: String)
    val candidates = mutableListOf<BountyRecordCandidate>()
    if (topCloudAllTime != null) {
      val sName = RiftCodex.getShipById(topCloudAllTime.shipId.toInt()).name
      candidates +=
        BountyRecordCandidate(
          source = "Cloud Global All-Time Leaderboard",
          callsign = topCloudAllTime.callsign,
          tag = RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(topCloudAllTime.syndicateTag),
          bounty = topCloudAllTime.allTimeBounty,
          detail = "Ship $sName, ${topCloudAllTime.allTimeKills} All-Time Kills, ${topCloudAllTime.convergencesWon} Convergences Won",

    }
    candidates +=
      BountyRecordCandidate(
        source = "Local Pilot All-Time Career Record",
        callsign = callsign,
        tag = syndicateTag,
        bounty = engine.allTimeBountyPeak,
        detail = "${engine.allTimeKills} All-Time Kills, ${engine.convergencesWon} Convergences Won",
      )
    if (liveTopShip != null) {
      candidates +=
        BountyRecordCandidate(
          source = "Current Live Arena Sector Leader",
          callsign = liveTopShip.callsign,
          tag = RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(liveTopShip.syndicateTag),
          bounty = liveTopShip.bounty.toLong(),
          detail = "Flying ${engine.formatShipLabel(liveTopShip)} (${if (liveTopShip.isHuman) "Human Pilot" else "AI Bot"})",
        )
    }
    val overallHighest = candidates.maxByOrNull { it.bounty }
    if (overallHighest != null) {
      sb.appendLine(
        "- OVERALL HIGHEST INDIVIDUAL BOUNTY RECORD KNOWN: [${overallHighest.tag}] ${overallHighest.callsign} with ${overallHighest.bounty} Bounty (${overallHighest.source} — ${overallHighest.detail})."
      )
    }
    if (topCloudPvp != null) {
      val sName = RiftCodex.getShipById(topCloudPvp.shipId.toInt()).name
      sb.appendLine(
        "- Highest Cloud PVP-Only Bounty Record: [${RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(topCloudPvp.syndicateTag)}] ${topCloudPvp.callsign} with ${topCloudPvp.pvpBounty} PVP Bounty (${topCloudPvp.pvpKills} PVP Kills, Ship $sName)."
      )
    } else {
      sb.appendLine(
        "- Cloud Leaderboard Status: ${cloudLeaderboard.size} cloud entries synced (Local PVP Peak = ${engine.pvpBountyPeak} Bounty by [$syndicateTag] $callsign)."
      )
    }
    if (cloudLeaderboard.isNotEmpty()) {
      sb.appendLine("- Top Cloud Global Leaderboard Entries (up to Top 10 by All-Time Bounty):")
      cloudLeaderboard
        .sortedByDescending { it.allTimeBounty }
        .take(10)
        .forEachIndexed { idx, entry ->
          val cleanT = RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(entry.syndicateTag)
          val shipTitle = RiftCodex.getShipById(entry.shipId.toInt()).name
          sb.appendLine(
            "  #${idx + 1}: [$cleanT] ${entry.callsign} — All-Time Peak: ${entry.allTimeBounty} BTY (${entry.allTimeKills}K/${entry.allTimeDeaths}D) | PVP Peak: ${entry.pvpBounty} BTY (${entry.pvpKills}K/${entry.pvpDeaths}D) | Ship: $shipTitle | Armada: ${entry.armadaTag} | Wins: ${entry.convergencesWon}"
          )
        }
    }

    // 7. LOCAL PILOT DOSSIER, PEAK BOUNTY SNAPSHOTS & EXECUTIONER TELEMETRY
    sb.appendLine()
    sb.appendLine("[7. LOCAL PILOT DOSSIER, PROGRESSION, EXECUTIONER SNAPSHOTS & SYNDICATES]")

    val pSpeed = hypot(p.vx, p.vy).roundToInt()

    )
    sb.appendLine(
      "- Career Combat Record: All-Time Peak Bounty=${engine.allTimeBountyPeak}, All-Time K/D=${engine.allTimeKills}/${engine.allTimeDeaths}, PVP Peak Bounty=${engine.pvpBountyPeak}, PVP K/D=${engine.pvpKills}/${engine.pvpDeaths}, HVT Eliminations=${engine.hvtEliminations}, Supply Crates=${engine.greensCollected}, Sector Convergences Won=${engine.convergencesWon}."
    )
    sb.appendLine(
      "- Live Ship Right Now: Flying ${engine.formatShipLabel(p)} in Sector $sectorStr (${p.x.toInt()}, ${p.y.toInt()}), Speed=$pSpeed px/s, Flux=${p.flux.toInt()}/${p.maxFlux.toInt()}⚡, Current Bounty=${p.bounty}, Repels=${p.repels}, SpecialSlot=${p.specialWeaponType}(${p.specialWeaponCharges}), MultiShotCrateShots=${p.multiShotCharges}, BouncingBulletsUpgrade=${p.hasBouncingBulletsUpgrade}, SpeedOvercharge=${p.speedOverchargeStacks}/3, ThrustOvercharge=${p.thrustOverchargeStacks}/3, ReactorOvercharge=${p.rechargeOverchargeStacks}/3."
    )

    fun formatSnapshot(label: String, snap: PeakBountyRunSnapshot?) {
      if (snap == null) {
        sb.appendLine("- $label: No completed run snapshot recorded yet.")
        return
      }
      val exec = snap.executioner
      val execStr =
        when {
          exec.survivedToConvergence -> "SURVIVED TO 1-HOUR SECTOR CONVERGENCE"
          exec.killerCallsign.isNotBlank() ->
            "Terminated by [${exec.killerSyndicateTag}] ${exec.killerCallsign} flying ${exec.killerShip} using ${exec.killingWeapon} (Killer Bounty at kill: ${exec.killerBountyAtKill}, Bounty earned from you: +${exec.bountyEarnedFromYou})"
          else -> "Run still active or unrecorded termination"
        }
      sb.appendLine(
        "- $label: Peak Bounty=${snap.bountyReached} in ${snap.shipFlown}, Survived=${snap.formattedDuration()}, Kills=${snap.pvpKills} PVP / ${snap.botKills} Bot (${snap.hvtShutdowns} HVT shutdowns), Damage=${snap.damageDealt.toInt()}⚡ dealt / ${snap.damageTaken.toInt()}⚡ taken, Accuracy=${snap.accuracyPercent()}% (${snap.shotsHit}/${snap.shotsFired}), Buffs=${snap.buffsCollected} | Executioner: $execStr."
      )
    }
    formatSnapshot("All-Time Peak Bounty Run Snapshot", allTimePeakSnapshot)
    formatSnapshot("PVP-Only Peak Bounty Run Snapshot", pvpPeakSnapshot)

    if (syndicateHistory.isNotEmpty()) {
      val histSummary =
        syndicateHistory.joinToString(" ; ") { h ->
          "[${h.syndicateTag}] ${h.syndicateName} (${h.role}, ${if (h.isActive) "ACTIVE" else "PAST"}, Tenure=${h.formatTenure()}, Kills=${h.totalKills}, PeakBty=${h.peakBountyAchieved}, Wins=${h.publicGameWins})"
        }
      sb.appendLine("- Pilot Syndicate Service History: $histSummary")
    }
    val syndicatesDir =
      localPrefs.getAllSyndicates().joinToString(", ") { s ->
        "[${s.tag}] ${s.name} (${s.memberCount} pilots, ${s.combinedBounty} combined syndicate bounty)"
      }
    sb.appendLine("- Known Sector Syndicates Directory (15-day switch cooldown lock): $syndicatesDir")

    // 8. LIVE SECTOR ROSTER & ACTIVE CALIBRATION OVERRIDES
    sb.appendLine()
    sb.appendLine("[8. LIVE ARENA SECTOR TOP PILOTS & CALIBRATION OVERRIDES]")
    val topLiveShips = engine.ships.sortedByDescending { it.bounty }.take(8)
    sb.appendLine("- Active Ships in Sector (${engine.ships.size} total; HVT >= ${RiftCalibrationState.hvtBountyThreshold} BTY):")
    for ((idx, s) in topLiveShips.withIndex()) {
      val sTag = if (s.armadaName.isNotEmpty()) "[${s.armadaName}]" else "[${RiftGameEngine.cleanTag(s.syndicateTag)}]"
      val hvtFlag = if (s.bounty >= RiftCalibrationState.hvtBountyThreshold) " [👑 HVT]" else ""
      sb.appendLine(
        "  #${idx + 1}: $sTag ${s.callsign} (${if (s.isLocalPlayer) "YOU" else if (s.isHuman) "HUMAN" else "AI BOT"}) — ${s.bounty} BTY$hvtFlag | ${engine.formatShipLabel(s)} | ${s.flux.toInt()}/${s.maxFlux.toInt()}⚡"
      )
    }

    val modifiedCalibrations =
      RiftCalibrationState.buildAllParameterDescriptors().mapNotNull { desc ->
        val cur = desc.getter()
        val def = RiftCalibrationState.DEFAULT_GAME_CONFIG[desc.key]
        if (def != null && abs(cur - def) > 0.0005f) {
          "${desc.title} (${desc.key}): default ${desc.formatValue(def)} -> live ${desc.formatValue(cur)}"
        } else {
          null
        }
      }
    if (modifiedCalibrations.isEmpty()) {
      sb.appendLine("- Live Calibration Status: All sliders currently at factory defaults.")
    } else {
      sb.appendLine("- Live Calibration Overrides Active (${modifiedCalibrations.size}): ${modifiedCalibrations.joinToString(" | ")}")
    }

    return sb.toString()
  }
}

package com.example.engine

import android.media.AudioAttributes
import android.media.AudioFormat
import android.media.AudioTrack
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.exp
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.random.Random

class RiftSoundSynthesizer {
  var enabled: Boolean = true
  private val audioExecutor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
  private val sampleRate = 22050

  private val laserBuffer: ShortArray = buildSweepBuffer(880.0, 210.0, 0.085, 0.25)
  private val bombBuffer: ShortArray = buildSweepBuffer(220.0, 48.0, 0.22, 0.42)
  private val bounceBuffer: ShortArray = buildSweepBuffer(145.0, 42.0, 0.09, 0.35)
  private val prizeBuffer: ShortArray = buildChordArpeggioBuffer()
  private val explosionBuffer: ShortArray = buildNoiseExplosionBuffer(0.36, 0.45)
  private val repelBuffer: ShortArray = buildSweepBuffer(540.0, 95.0, 0.24, 0.38)
  private val warpBuffer: ShortArray = buildSweepBuffer(240.0, 980.0, 0.25, 0.32)
  private val mutedClickBuffer: ShortArray = buildSweepBuffer(180.0, 110.0, 0.04, 0.16)
  private val shotgunBuffer: ShortArray = buildNoiseExplosionBuffer(0.14, 0.38)
  private val missileLockBeepBuffer: ShortArray = buildSweepBuffer(1320.0, 1480.0, 0.065, 0.28)

  private fun buildSweepBuffer(
    startFreq: Double,
    endFreq: Double,
    durationSec: Double,
    volume: Double,
  ): ShortArray {
    val count = (sampleRate * durationSec).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
    val out = ShortArray(count)
    var phase = 0.0
    for (i in 0 until count) {
      val t = i.toDouble() / count.toDouble()
      val freq = startFreq + (endFreq - startFreq) * t
      phase += (2.0 * PI * freq) / sampleRate
      val env = (1.0 - t) * exp(-2.2 * t)
      val sample = (sin(phase) * volume * env * Short.MAX_VALUE).toInt()
      out[i] = sample.coerceIn(Short.MIN_VALUE.toInt(), Short.MAX_VALUE.toInt()).toShort()
    }
    return out
  }

  private fun buildChordArpeggioBuffer(): ShortArray {
    val notes = doubleArrayOf(523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.50)
    val noteSamples = (sampleRate * 0.05).toInt()
    val out = ShortArray(noteSamples * notes.size)
    var idx = 0
    for (freq in notes) {
      var phase = 0.0
      for (i in 0 until noteSamples) {
        val env = 1.0 - (i.toDouble() / noteSamples)
        phase += (2.0 * PI * freq) / sampleRate
        val s = (sin(phase) * 0.28 * env * Short.MAX_VALUE).toInt()
        out[idx++] = s.coerceIn(Short.MIN_VALUE.toInt(), Short.MAX_VALUE.toInt()).toShort()
      }
    }
    return out
  }

  private fun buildNoiseExplosionBuffer(durationSec: Double, volume: Double): ShortArray {
    val count = (sampleRate * durationSec).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
    val out = ShortArray(count)
    var filtered = 0.0
    for (i in 0 until count) {
      val t = i.toDouble() / count.toDouble()
      val white = Random.nextDouble(-1.0, 1.0)
      filtered = filtered * 0.82 + white * 0.18
      val env = (1.0 - t) * exp(-3.0 * t)
      val s = (filtered * volume * env * Short.MAX_VALUE).toInt()
      out[i] = s.coerceIn(Short.MIN_VALUE.toInt(), Short.MAX_VALUE.toInt()).toShort()
    }
    return out
  }

  private fun playPcmAsync(buffer: ShortArray) {
    if (!enabled) return
    audioExecutor.execute {
      try {
        val byteCount = buffer.size * 2
        val track =
          AudioTrack.Builder()
            .setAudioAttributes(
              AudioAttributes.Builder()
                .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_GAME)
                .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
                .build()
            )
            .setAudioFormat(
              AudioFormat.Builder()
                .setEncoding(AudioFormat.ENCODING_PCM_16BIT)
                .setSampleRate(sampleRate)
                .setChannelMask(AudioFormat.CHANNEL_OUT_MONO)
                .build()
            )
            .setBufferSizeInBytes(byteCount)
            .setTransferMode(AudioTrack.MODE_STATIC)
            .build()
        track.write(buffer, 0, buffer.size)
        track.play()
        Thread.sleep((buffer.size * 1000L / sampleRate) + 25L)
        track.release()
      } catch (_: Exception) {}
    }
  }

  fun playLaser() = playPcmAsync(laserBuffer)
  fun playBomb() = playPcmAsync(bombBuffer)
  fun playBounce() = playPcmAsync(bounceBuffer)
  fun playPrize() = playPcmAsync(prizeBuffer)
  fun playExplosion() = playPcmAsync(explosionBuffer)
  fun playRepel() = playPcmAsync(repelBuffer)
  fun playWarp() = playPcmAsync(warpBuffer)
  fun playMutedClick() = playPcmAsync(mutedClickBuffer)
  fun playShotgun() = playPcmAsync(shotgunBuffer)
  fun playMissileLockBeep() = playPcmAsync(missileLockBeepBuffer)

  fun release() {
    try {
      audioExecutor.shutdownNow()
    } catch (_: Exception) {}
  }
}

package com.example.engine

import android.graphics.Bitmap

object RiftSpriteBaker {

  val hazardBorderBitmap: Bitmap

  init {

    hazardShader = BitmapShader(hazardBorderBitmap, Shader.TileMode.REPEAT, Shader.TileMode.REPEAT)

    cyanGlowStamp = createPreRenderedGlow(48, Color.parseColor("#38BDF8"))
    amberGlowStamp = createPreRenderedGlow(48, Color.parseColor("#F59E0B"))
    crimsonGlowStamp = createPreRenderedGlow(48, Color.parseColor("#EF4444"))
    emeraldGlowStamp = createPreRenderedGlow(48, Color.parseColor("#10B981"))
    nebulaCyanStamp = createPreRenderedGlow(256, Color.argb(38, 14, 116, 144))
    nebulaIndigoStamp = createPreRenderedGlow(256, Color.argb(42, 49, 46, 129))

    val allied = mutableMapOf<Int, Bitmap>()
    val hostile = mutableMapOf<Int, Bitmap>()
    val flash = mutableMapOf<Int, Bitmap>()
    for (spec in RiftCodex.SHIPS) {
      allied[spec.id] = bakeShipBitmap(spec, 128, isAllied = true)
      hostile[spec.id] = bakeShipBitmap(spec, 128, isAllied = false)
      flash[spec.id] = bakeSolidWhiteFlashBitmap(allied[spec.id]!!)
    }
    alliedShipBitmaps = allied
    hostileShipBitmaps = hostile
    flashShipBitmaps = flash

    val initialRecipe = RiftCodex.activeCustomShipSlot.visualRecipe
    customShip9AlliedBitmap = bakeCustomShip9Bitmap(initialRecipe, 128, isAllied = true)
    customShip9HostileBitmap = bakeCustomShip9Bitmap(initialRecipe, 128, isAllied = false)
    customShip9FlashBitmap = bakeSolidWhiteFlashBitmap(customShip9AlliedBitmap)

    val buffs = mutableMapOf<Int, Bitmap>()
    for (buffType in 0..10) {
      buffs[buffType] = bakeBuffIconBitmap(buffType, 68)
    }
    buffs[-10] = bakeBuffIconBitmap(-10, 68) // Speed Overcharge
    buffs[-11] = bakeBuffIconBitmap(-11, 68) // Thrust Overcharge
    buffs[-12] = bakeBuffIconBitmap(-12, 68) // Reactor Overcharge
    buffIconBitmaps = buffs

    riftAnomalyIconBitmaps =
      mapOf(
        "plasma_rift" to bakeRiftAnomalyIconBitmap("plasma_rift", 68),
        "repulsor_rift" to bakeRiftAnomalyIconBitmap("repulsor_rift", 68),
        "gravity_rift" to bakeRiftAnomalyIconBitmap("gravity_rift", 68),
        "phase_rift_pair" to bakeRiftAnomalyIconBitmap("phase_rift_pair", 68),
      )
  }

  fun getRiftAnomalyIconBitmap(riftId: String): Bitmap {
    return riftAnomalyIconBitmaps[riftId] ?: riftAnomalyIconBitmaps["plasma_rift"]!!
  }

  fun updateCustomShip9Sprites(recipe: CustomHullVisualRecipe) {
    customShip9AlliedBitmap = bakeCustomShip9Bitmap(recipe, 128, isAllied = true)
    customShip9HostileBitmap = bakeCustomShip9Bitmap(recipe, 128, isAllied = false)
    customShip9FlashBitmap = bakeSolidWhiteFlashBitmap(customShip9AlliedBitmap)
    customShip9Version++
  }

  fun bakeCustomShip9Bitmap(
    recipe: CustomHullVisualRecipe,
    sizePx: Int = 128,
    isAllied: Boolean = true,
  ): Bitmap {
    val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(sizePx, sizePx, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
    val c = Canvas(bmp)
    drawCustomModularShipOnCanvas(c, sizePx / 2f, sizePx / 2f, sizePx * 0.39f, recipe, isAllied)
    return bmp
  }

  /**
   * Phase 3.1: Pre-render ambient radial glow onto an offscreen Bitmap once at startup.
   */
  fun createPreRenderedGlow(size: Int, color: Int): Bitmap {
    val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(size, size, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
    val c = Canvas(bmp)
    val r = size * 0.5f
    val alpha = Color.alpha(color)
    val red = Color.red(color)
    val green = Color.green(color)
    val blue = Color.blue(color)
    val paint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        shader =
          RadialGradient(
            r,
            r,
            r,
            intArrayOf(
              Color.argb(alpha, red, green, blue),
              Color.argb((alpha * 0.45f).toInt(), red, green, blue),
              Color.argb(0, red, green, blue),
            ),
            floatArrayOf(0f, 0.45f, 1f),
            Shader.TileMode.CLAMP,
          )
      }
    c.drawCircle(r, r, r, paint)
    return bmp
  }

  fun getShipSprite(shipId: Int, isAllied: Boolean = true, isHitFlashing: Boolean = false): Bitmap {
    if (shipId == 10 || shipId > 9) {
      if (isHitFlashing) return customShip9FlashBitmap
      return if (isAllied) customShip9AlliedBitmap else customShip9HostileBitmap
    }
    if (isHitFlashing) {
      return flashShipBitmaps[shipId] ?: flashShipBitmaps[1]!!
    }
    val map = if (isAllied) alliedShipBitmaps else hostileShipBitmaps
    return map[shipId] ?: map[1] ?: bakeShipBitmap(RiftCodex.getShipById(shipId), 128, isAllied)
  }

  private val customBuffIconCache = mutableMapOf<Int, Bitmap>()

  fun invalidateCustomBuffIcon(buffType: Int) {
    customBuffIconCache.remove(buffType)
  }

  fun getBuffIconBitmap(buffType: Int): Bitmap {
    if (buffType in 0..10 || buffType in -12..-10) {
      return buffIconBitmaps[buffType] ?: buffIconBitmaps[10]!!
    }
    customBuffIconCache[buffType]?.let { return it }
    val entry = RiftCodex.getBuffRegistryByIndex(buffType)
    if (entry != null) {
      val baked = bakeCustomBuffIconBitmap(entry, 68)
      customBuffIconCache[buffType] = baked
      return baked
    }
    return buffIconBitmaps[buffType.mod(11)] ?: buffIconBitmaps[0]!!
  }

  private fun bakeCustomBuffIconBitmap(entry: SpecialBuffRegistryEntry, sizePx: Int = 68): Bitmap {
    val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(sizePx, sizePx, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
    val c = Canvas(bmp)
    val cx = sizePx * 0.5f
    val cy = sizePx * 0.5f
    val r = sizePx * 0.36f
    val accent = entry.strokeColorInt

    val glowPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        shader =
          RadialGradient(
            cx,
            cy,
            sizePx * 0.48f,
            intArrayOf(
              Color.argb(200, Color.red(accent), Color.green(accent), Color.blue(accent)),
              Color.argb(80, Color.red(accent), Color.green(accent), Color.blue(accent)),
              Color.argb(0, Color.red(accent), Color.green(accent), Color.blue(accent)),
            ),
            floatArrayOf(0f, 0.58f, 1f),
            Shader.TileMode.CLAMP,
          )
      }
    c.drawCircle(cx, cy, sizePx * 0.48f, glowPaint)

    val hexPath = Path()
    for (i in 0 until 6) {
      val a = (Math.PI / 3.0 * i - Math.PI / 6.0).toFloat()
      val hx = cx + kotlin.math.cos(a) * r
      val hy = cy + kotlin.math.sin(a) * r
      if (i == 0) hexPath.moveTo(hx, hy) else hexPath.lineTo(hx, hy)
    }
    hexPath.close()

    val platePaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = Color.argb(235, 10, 18, 32)
      }
    c.drawPath(hexPath, platePaint)

    val borderPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = sizePx * 0.042f
        color = accent
      }
    c.drawPath(hexPath, borderPaint)

    val glyphPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = sizePx * 0.048f
        strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
        color = Color.WHITE
      }
    val corePaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = accent
      }

    when (entry.specialEffect) {
      CustomBuffEffect.PULL -> {
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.24f, corePaint)
        for (i in 0 until 4) {
          val a = (Math.PI / 2.0 * i + Math.PI / 4.0).toFloat()
          c.drawLine(
            cx + kotlin.math.cos(a) * r * 0.62f,
            cy + kotlin.math.sin(a) * r * 0.62f,
            cx + kotlin.math.cos(a + 0.45f) * r * 0.26f,
            cy + kotlin.math.sin(a + 0.45f) * r * 0.26f,
            glyphPaint,
          )
        }
      }
      CustomBuffEffect.PUSH -> {
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.52f, borderPaint)
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.26f, glyphPaint)
      }
      CustomBuffEffect.EMP -> {
        val bolt = Path().apply {
          moveTo(cx + r * 0.12f, cy - r * 0.55f)
          lineTo(cx - r * 0.22f, cy - r * 0.04f)
          lineTo(cx + r * 0.08f, cy + r * 0.02f)
          lineTo(cx - r * 0.14f, cy + r * 0.55f)
        }
        c.drawPath(bolt, glyphPaint)
      }
      CustomBuffEffect.BARRIER -> {
        c.drawLine(cx - r * 0.52f, cy, cx + r * 0.52f, cy, glyphPaint)
        c.drawLine(cx - r * 0.42f, cy - r * 0.24f, cx + r * 0.42f, cy - r * 0.24f, borderPaint)
        c.drawLine(cx - r * 0.42f, cy + r * 0.24f, cx + r * 0.42f, cy + r * 0.24f, borderPaint)
      }
      else -> {
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.34f, corePaint)
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.48f, glyphPaint)
      }
    }
    return bmp
  }

  /**
   * Pre-bakes high-definition item-specific graphical buff icons with glowing halos (0..10):
   * Bucket A (Special Buff Slot Pickups — 0❖ Cost):
   * 0 = Burst (Orange 8-Point Shrapnel Starburst)
   * 1 = Shotgun (Coral-Rose 60° Cone 3-Wave Pellet Blast)
   * 2 = Lock-On Bouncing Missile (Crimson Homing Missile & Target Reticle)
   * 3 = Decoy (Teal Twin Hologram Clone Ships)
   * 4 = Brick (Cyan Solid Energy Barrier Wall)
   * 5 = Rocket (Magenta-Red Hyper-Thruster Boost Plume)
   * Bucket B (Instant Ship & Weapon Enhancers):

   * 8 = Shot-Limited Multi-Shot +25 Shots (Gold Triple-Spread Trident Beams)
   * 9 = Bouncing Bullets +30 Shots (Electric Violet Ricochet Bank-Shot)
   * 10 = Overcharge Surge +8% x3 (Solar Amber Triple Upward Overdrive Chevrons)
   */
  private fun bakeBuffIconBitmap(buffType: Int, sizePx: Int = 68): Bitmap {
    val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(sizePx, sizePx, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
    val c = Canvas(bmp)
    val cx = sizePx * 0.5f
    val cy = sizePx * 0.5f
    val r = sizePx * 0.36f

    val accentColor =
      when (buffType) {
        0 -> Color.parseColor("#F97316") // Burst
        1 -> Color.parseColor("#FB7185") // Shotgun
        2 -> Color.parseColor("#EF4444") // Missile
        3 -> Color.parseColor("#2DD4BF") // Decoy
        4 -> Color.parseColor("#38BDF8") // Brick
        5 -> Color.parseColor("#F43F5E") // Rocket
        6 -> Color.parseColor("#10B981") // Full Flux Charge
        7 -> Color.parseColor("#00F5D4") // Repel Charge
        8 -> Color.parseColor("#FACC15") // Shot-Limited Multi-Shot (+25)
        9 -> Color.parseColor("#A855F7") // Bouncing Bullets (Permanent Life Upgrade)
        -10 -> Color.parseColor("#38BDF8") // Speed Overcharge (+8% x3)
        -11 -> Color.parseColor("#F59E0B") // Thrust Overcharge (+8% x3)
        -12 -> Color.parseColor("#10B981") // Reactor Overcharge (+8% x3)
        else -> Color.parseColor("#38BDF8") // Overcharge Surge (+8% x3)
      }

    // 1. Pre-rendered outer radial halo glow
    val glowPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        shader =
          RadialGradient(
            cx,
            cy,
            sizePx * 0.48f,
            intArrayOf(
              Color.argb(190, Color.red(accentColor), Color.green(accentColor), Color.blue(accentColor)),
              Color.argb(75, Color.red(accentColor), Color.green(accentColor), Color.blue(accentColor)),
              Color.argb(0, Color.red(accentColor), Color.green(accentColor), Color.blue(accentColor)),
            ),
            floatArrayOf(0f, 0.58f, 1f),
            Shader.TileMode.CLAMP,
          )
      }
    c.drawCircle(cx, cy, sizePx * 0.48f, glowPaint)

    // 2. Dark octagonal/hexagonal metallic housing plate with glowing bevel
    val hexPath = Path()
    for (i in 0 until 6) {
      val a = (Math.PI / 3.0 * i - Math.PI / 6.0).toFloat()
      val hx = cx + kotlin.math.cos(a) * r
      val hy = cy + kotlin.math.sin(a) * r
      if (i == 0) hexPath.moveTo(hx, hy) else hexPath.lineTo(hx, hy)
    }
    hexPath.close()

    val platePaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = Color.argb(230, 8, 15, 28)
      }
    val rimPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 2.6f
        color = accentColor
      }
    val innerRimPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 1.1f
        color = Color.argb(175, 255, 255, 255)
      }
    c.drawPath(hexPath, platePaint)
    c.drawPath(hexPath, rimPaint)

    val glyphFillPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = Color.WHITE
      }
    val glyphStrokePaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 3.0f
        strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
        strokeJoin = Paint.Join.ROUND
        color = accentColor
      }
    val glyphCoreStroke =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 1.6f
        strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
        strokeJoin = Paint.Join.ROUND
        color = Color.WHITE
      }

    // 3. Item-specific high-contrast vector icon inside housing
    when (buffType) {
      0 -> {
        // BURST: 8-point radial shrapnel starburst
        for (i in 0 until 4) {
          val a = (Math.PI / 4.0 * i).toFloat()
          val dx = kotlin.math.cos(a) * r * 0.52f
          val dy = kotlin.math.sin(a) * r * 0.52f
          c.drawLine(cx - dx, cy - dy, cx + dx, cy + dy, glyphStrokePaint)
          c.drawLine(cx - dx * 0.7f, cy - dy * 0.7f, cx + dx * 0.7f, cy + dy * 0.7f, glyphCoreStroke)
        }
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.22f, glyphFillPaint)
      }
      1 -> {
        // SHOTGUN: 60-degree cone blast with 3 concentric pellet wave arcs
        c.drawLine(cx, cy + r * 0.45f, cx - r * 0.46f, cy - r * 0.38f, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawLine(cx, cy + r * 0.45f, cx + r * 0.46f, cy - r * 0.38f, glyphStrokePaint)
        for (wave in 1..3) {
          val waveY = cy + r * 0.32f - wave * (r * 0.22f)
          val spreadX = wave * (r * 0.13f)
          c.drawCircle(cx - spreadX, waveY, 2.2f, glyphFillPaint)
          c.drawCircle(cx, waveY - 1.5f, 2.2f, glyphFillPaint)
          c.drawCircle(cx + spreadX, waveY, 2.2f, glyphFillPaint)
        }
      }
      2 -> {
        // LOCK-ON BOUNCING MISSILE: Homing warhead inside target lock reticle
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.48f, innerRimPaint)
        c.drawLine(cx - r * 0.58f, cy, cx - r * 0.32f, cy, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawLine(cx + r * 0.32f, cy, cx + r * 0.58f, cy, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawLine(cx, cy - r * 0.58f, cx, cy - r * 0.32f, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawLine(cx, cy + r * 0.32f, cx, cy + r * 0.58f, glyphStrokePaint)
        val missilePath =
          Path().apply {
            moveTo(cx, cy - r * 0.34f)
            lineTo(cx + r * 0.20f, cy + r * 0.26f)
            lineTo(cx, cy + r * 0.14f)
            lineTo(cx - r * 0.20f, cy + r * 0.26f)
            close()
          }
        c.drawPath(missilePath, glyphFillPaint)
      }
      3 -> {
        // DECOY: Twin mirrored hologram ship chevrons
        for (offsetX in listOf(-r * 0.24f, r * 0.24f)) {
          val holo =
            Path().apply {
              moveTo(cx + offsetX, cy - r * 0.42f)
              lineTo(cx + offsetX + r * 0.20f, cy + r * 0.34f)
              lineTo(cx + offsetX, cy + r * 0.18f)
              lineTo(cx + offsetX - r * 0.20f, cy + r * 0.34f)
              close()
            }
          c.drawPath(holo, glyphStrokePaint)
          c.drawPath(holo, glyphCoreStroke)
        }
      }
      4 -> {
        // BRICK: Solid interlocked energy barrier wall
        c.drawRect(cx - r * 0.52f, cy - r * 0.22f, cx + r * 0.52f, cy + r * 0.22f, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawRect(cx - r * 0.46f, cy - r * 0.16f, cx + r * 0.46f, cy + r * 0.16f, glyphFillPaint)
        c.drawLine(cx, cy - r * 0.22f, cx, cy + r * 0.22f, rimPaint)
      }
      5 -> {
        // ROCKET: Hyper-thruster boost fuselage with twin exhaust flames
        val rocket =
          Path().apply {
            moveTo(cx, cy - r * 0.52f)
            lineTo(cx + r * 0.26f, cy + r * 0.12f)
            lineTo(cx - r * 0.26f, cy + r * 0.12f)
            close()
          }
        c.drawPath(rocket, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawPath(rocket, glyphFillPaint)
        c.drawLine(cx - r * 0.14f, cy + r * 0.18f, cx - r * 0.22f, cy + r * 0.52f, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawLine(cx, cy + r * 0.18f, cx, cy + r * 0.56f, glyphCoreStroke)
        c.drawLine(cx + r * 0.14f, cy + r * 0.18f, cx + r * 0.22f, cy + r * 0.52f, glyphStrokePaint)
      }
      6 -> {
        // FULL FLUX CHARGE: High-voltage lightning bolt
        val bolt =
          Path().apply {
            moveTo(cx + r * 0.12f, cy - r * 0.58f)
            lineTo(cx - r * 0.36f, cy + r * 0.05f)
            lineTo(cx - r * 0.02f, cy + r * 0.05f)
            lineTo(cx - r * 0.16f, cy + r * 0.58f)
            lineTo(cx + r * 0.38f, cy - r * 0.06f)
            lineTo(cx + r * 0.04f, cy - r * 0.06f)
            close()
          }
        c.drawPath(bolt, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawPath(bolt, glyphFillPaint)
      }
      7 -> {
        // REPEL CHARGE: Dual concentric repulsion wave rings + outward arrows
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.50f, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.26f, glyphCoreStroke)
        c.drawLine(cx - r * 0.56f, cy, cx + r * 0.56f, cy, innerRimPaint)
        c.drawLine(cx, cy - r * 0.56f, cx, cy + r * 0.56f, innerRimPaint)
      }
      8 -> {
        // SHOT-LIMITED MULTI-SHOT (+25 SHOTS): Triple-spread diverging laser trident
        c.drawLine(cx, cy + r * 0.46f, cx, cy - r * 0.50f, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawLine(cx, cy + r * 0.46f, cx - r * 0.46f, cy - r * 0.36f, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawLine(cx, cy + r * 0.46f, cx + r * 0.46f, cy - r * 0.36f, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawLine(cx, cy + r * 0.46f, cx, cy - r * 0.50f, glyphCoreStroke)
        c.drawLine(cx, cy + r * 0.46f, cx - r * 0.46f, cy - r * 0.36f, glyphCoreStroke)
        c.drawLine(cx, cy + r * 0.46f, cx + r * 0.46f, cy - r * 0.36f, glyphCoreStroke)
      }
      9 -> {
        // BOUNCING BULLETS (+30 SHOTS): Ricochet V-bank trajectory with wall node
        val ricochet =
          Path().apply {
            moveTo(cx - r * 0.46f, cy + r * 0.36f)
            lineTo(cx - r * 0.05f, cy - r * 0.44f)
            lineTo(cx + r * 0.46f, cy + r * 0.24f)
          }
        c.drawPath(ricochet, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawPath(ricochet, glyphCoreStroke)
        c.drawCircle(cx - r * 0.05f, cy - r * 0.44f, 3.5f, glyphFillPaint)
      }
      -11 -> {
        // THRUST OVERCHARGE (+8% x3): Twin vector thruster nozzles with high-impulse flare
        val nozzle =
          Path().apply {
            moveTo(cx, cy - r * 0.48f)
            lineTo(cx + r * 0.34f, cy + r * 0.14f)
            lineTo(cx + r * 0.12f, cy + r * 0.14f)
            lineTo(cx + r * 0.18f, cy + r * 0.48f)
            lineTo(cx, cy + r * 0.28f)
            lineTo(cx - r * 0.18f, cy + r * 0.48f)
            lineTo(cx - r * 0.12f, cy + r * 0.14f)
            lineTo(cx - r * 0.34f, cy + r * 0.14f)
            close()
          }
        c.drawPath(nozzle, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawPath(nozzle, glyphCoreStroke)
      }
      -12 -> {
        // REACTOR OVERCHARGE (+8% x3): Capacitor diamond ring + central lightning spark
        val diamond =
          Path().apply {
            moveTo(cx, cy - r * 0.50f)
            lineTo(cx + r * 0.46f, cy)
            lineTo(cx, cy + r * 0.50f)
            lineTo(cx - r * 0.46f, cy)
            close()
          }
        c.drawPath(diamond, glyphStrokePaint)
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.18f, glyphFillPaint)
      }
      else -> {
        // SPEED OVERCHARGE (-10 / 10): Double forward supersonic overdrive chevrons
        for (offset in listOf(-r * 0.22f, r * 0.14f)) {
          val chev =
            Path().apply {
              moveTo(cx + offset - r * 0.22f, cy - r * 0.42f)
              lineTo(cx + offset + r * 0.24f, cy)
              lineTo(cx + offset - r * 0.22f, cy + r * 0.42f)
            }
          c.drawPath(chev, glyphStrokePaint)
          c.drawPath(chev, glyphCoreStroke)
        }
      }
    }

    return bmp
  }

  private fun bakeSolidWhiteFlashBitmap(src: Bitmap): Bitmap {
    val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(src.width, src.height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
    val c = Canvas(bmp)
    val whitePaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        colorFilter = PorterDuffColorFilter(Color.WHITE, PorterDuff.Mode.SRC_IN)
      }
    c.drawBitmap(src, 0f, 0f, whitePaint)
    return bmp
  }

  /**
   * Bakes a seamless 64x64 Dark Obsidian Bulkhead Tile with staggered armored hull plates,
   * mitered 45° corner chamfers, recessed dark titanium bolts, and subtle V-cyan conduit seams.
   */
  private fun bakeWallTile(): Bitmap {
    val size = 64
    val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(size, size, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
    val c = Canvas(bmp)

    // 1. Deep void-obsidian recessed channel base
    val abyssPaint =
      Paint().apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = Color.parseColor("#04070D")
      }
    c.drawRect(0f, 0f, size.toFloat(), size.toFloat(), abyssPaint)

    // 2. Subtle glowing cyan energy conduit seams running along recessed channels
    val seamGlowPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 3.2f
        color = Color.argb(46, 0, 240, 255)
      }
    val seamCorePaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 1.0f
        color = Color.argb(115, 56, 189, 248)
      }
    // Horizontal & staggered vertical conduit seams in the recessed grooves (seamless across 64x64 edges)
    c.drawLine(0f, 32f, 64f, 32f, seamGlowPaint)
    c.drawLine(0f, 0f, 64f, 0f, seamGlowPaint)
    c.drawLine(0f, 64f, 64f, 64f, seamGlowPaint)
    c.drawLine(32f, 0f, 32f, 32f, seamGlowPaint)
    c.drawLine(16f, 32f, 16f, 64f, seamGlowPaint)
    c.drawLine(48f, 32f, 48f, 64f, seamGlowPaint)

    c.drawLine(0f, 32f, 64f, 32f, seamCorePaint)
    c.drawLine(0f, 0.5f, 64f, 0.5f, seamCorePaint)
    c.drawLine(32f, 0f, 32f, 32f, seamCorePaint)
    c.drawLine(16f, 32f, 16f, 64f, seamCorePaint)
    c.drawLine(48f, 32f, 48f, 64f, seamCorePaint)

    val plateFillPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { style = Paint.Style.FILL }
    val topBevelPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 1.15f
        color = Color.parseColor("#223452")
      }
    val bottomShadePaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 1.2f
        color = Color.parseColor("#020409")
      }
    val ribGroovePaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 0.9f
        color = Color.parseColor("#060B14")
      }
    val ribHighlightPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 0.8f
        color = Color.argb(95, 56, 189, 248)
      }
    val boltSocketPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = Color.parseColor("#050912")
      }
    val boltPinPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = Color.parseColor("#64748B")
      }
    val nodeSparkPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = Color.argb(145, 0, 240, 255)
      }

    fun drawObsidianPlate(left: Float, top: Float, right: Float, bottom: Float, hasCenterNode: Boolean) {
      val insetL = left + 1.4f
      val insetT = top + 1.4f
      val insetR = right - 1.4f
      val insetB = bottom - 1.4f
      val ch = 3.0f

      val platePath =
        Path().apply {
          moveTo(insetL + ch, insetT)
          lineTo(insetR - ch, insetT)
          lineTo(insetR, insetT + ch)
          lineTo(insetR, insetB - ch)
          lineTo(insetR - ch, insetB)
          lineTo(insetL + ch, insetB)
          lineTo(insetL, insetB - ch)
          lineTo(insetL, insetT + ch)
          close()
        }

      plateFillPaint.shader =
        LinearGradient(
          insetL,
          insetT,
          insetR,
          insetB,
          intArrayOf(
            Color.parseColor("#162338"),
            Color.parseColor("#0C1322"),
            Color.parseColor("#080D17"),
            Color.parseColor("#101A2C"),
          ),
          floatArrayOf(0f, 0.45f, 0.82f, 1f),
          Shader.TileMode.CLAMP,
        )
      c.drawPath(platePath, plateFillPaint)

      // Top/left specular armor bevel
      c.drawLine(insetL + ch, insetT, insetR - ch, insetT, topBevelPaint)
      c.drawLine(insetL, insetT + ch, insetL, insetB - ch, topBevelPaint)
      // Bottom/right recessed shadow bevel
      c.drawLine(insetL + ch, insetB, insetR - ch, insetB, bottomShadePaint)
      c.drawLine(insetR, insetT + ch, insetR, insetB - ch, bottomShadePaint)

      // Recessed internal structural rib + subtle cyan micro-trace
      val midY = (insetT + insetB) * 0.5f
      c.drawLine(insetL + 5f, midY, insetR - 5f, midY, ribGroovePaint)
      if (hasCenterNode) {
        c.drawLine(insetL + 7f, midY - 0.8f, insetR - 7f, midY - 0.8f, ribHighlightPaint)
        val midX = (insetL + insetR) * 0.5f
        c.drawCircle(midX, midY, 1.3f, nodeSparkPaint)
      }

      // Corner titanium micro-bolts
      val bOff = 4.2f
      val corners =
        arrayOf(
          insetL + bOff to insetT + bOff,
          insetR - bOff to insetT + bOff,
          insetL + bOff to insetB - bOff,
          insetR - bOff to insetB - bOff,
        )
      for ((bx, by) in corners) {
        c.drawCircle(bx, by, 1.5f, boltSocketPaint)
        c.drawCircle(bx - 0.25f, by - 0.25f, 0.9f, boltPinPaint)
      }
    }

    // Top row: two 32x32 obsidian bulkhead plates
    drawObsidianPlate(0f, 0f, 32f, 32f, hasCenterNode = true)
    drawObsidianPlate(32f, 0f, 64f, 32f, hasCenterNode = false)
    // Bottom row: staggered brick-bond obsidian bulkhead plates (wraps seamlessly at x=0/64)
    drawObsidianPlate(16f, 32f, 48f, 64f, hasCenterNode = true)
    drawObsidianPlate(-16f, 32f, 16f, 64f, hasCenterNode = false)
    drawObsidianPlate(48f, 32f, 80f, 64f, hasCenterNode = false)

    return bmp
  }

  private fun bakeHazardBorderTile(): Bitmap {
    val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(32, 32, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
    val c = Canvas(bmp)
    val bgPaint =
      Paint().apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = Color.parseColor("#070C16")
      }
    c.drawRect(0f, 0f, 32f, 32f, bgPaint)

    val stripePaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = Color.argb(115, 14, 165, 233) // Subtle dark cyan-slate bulkhead chevron trim
      }

    val p1 =
      Path().apply {
        moveTo(0f, 0f)
        lineTo(10f, 0f)
        lineTo(0f, 10f)
        close()
      }
    val p2 =
      Path().apply {
        moveTo(16f, 0f)
        lineTo(26f, 0f)
        lineTo(0f, 26f)
        lineTo(0f, 16f)
        close()
      }
    val p3 =
      Path().apply {
        moveTo(32f, 16f)
        lineTo(32f, 26f)
        lineTo(16f, 32f)
        lineTo(6f, 32f)
        close()
      }
    c.drawPath(p1, stripePaint)
    c.drawPath(p2, stripePaint)
    c.drawPath(p3, stripePaint)
    return bmp
  }

  private fun bakeRiftAnomalyIconBitmap(riftId: String, sizePx: Int = 68): Bitmap {
    val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(sizePx, sizePx, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
    val c = Canvas(bmp)
    val cx = sizePx * 0.5f
    val cy = sizePx * 0.5f
    val r = sizePx * 0.36f

    when (riftId) {
      "plasma_rift" -> {
        val halo =
          Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            shader =
              RadialGradient(
                cx,
                cy,
                sizePx * 0.48f,
                intArrayOf(
                  Color.argb(235, 255, 240, 245),
                  Color.argb(210, 239, 68, 68),
                  Color.argb(135, 217, 70, 239),
                  Color.argb(0, 239, 68, 68),
                ),
                floatArrayOf(0f, 0.32f, 0.68f, 1f),
                Shader.TileMode.CLAMP,
              )
          }
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, sizePx * 0.48f, halo)
        val arcPaint =
          Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            style = Paint.Style.STROKE
            strokeWidth = 2.6f
            strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
            color = Color.parseColor("#FCA5A5")
          }
        for (i in 0 until 6) {
          val a = (i * Math.PI / 3.0).toFloat()
          val p =
            Path().apply {
              moveTo(cx + kotlin.math.cos(a) * (r * 0.25f), cy + kotlin.math.sin(a) * (r * 0.25f))
              lineTo(cx + kotlin.math.cos(a + 0.28f) * (r * 0.68f), cy + kotlin.math.sin(a + 0.28f) * (r * 0.68f))
              lineTo(cx + kotlin.math.cos(a - 0.14f) * (r * 1.05f), cy + kotlin.math.sin(a - 0.14f) * (r * 1.05f))
            }
          c.drawPath(p, arcPaint)
        }
      }
      "repulsor_rift" -> {
        val halo =
          Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            shader =
              RadialGradient(
                cx,
                cy,
                sizePx * 0.48f,
                intArrayOf(
                  Color.WHITE,
                  Color.argb(190, 56, 189, 248),
                  Color.argb(0, 56, 189, 248),
                ),
                floatArrayOf(0f, 0.45f, 1f),
                Shader.TileMode.CLAMP,
              )
          }
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, sizePx * 0.48f, halo)
        val ringPaint =
          Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            style = Paint.Style.STROKE
            strokeWidth = 2.2f
            color = Color.WHITE
          }
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.55f, ringPaint)
        ringPaint.color = Color.argb(180, 125, 211, 252)
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.92f, ringPaint)
        for (i in 0 until 4) {
          val a = (i * Math.PI / 2.0 + Math.PI / 4.0).toFloat()
          c.drawLine(
            cx + kotlin.math.cos(a) * (r * 0.58f),
            cy + kotlin.math.sin(a) * (r * 0.58f),
            cx + kotlin.math.cos(a) * (r * 1.08f),
            cy + kotlin.math.sin(a) * (r * 1.08f),
            ringPaint,
          )
        }
      }
      "gravity_rift" -> {
        val halo =
          Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            shader =
              RadialGradient(
                cx,
                cy,
                sizePx * 0.48f,
                intArrayOf(
                  Color.BLACK,
                  Color.argb(235, 168, 85, 247),
                  Color.argb(120, 99, 102, 241),
                  Color.argb(0, 99, 102, 241),
                ),
                floatArrayOf(0f, 0.34f, 0.72f, 1f),
                Shader.TileMode.CLAMP,
              )
          }
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, sizePx * 0.48f, halo)
        val corePaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = Color.parseColor("#030008") }
        c.drawCircle(cx, cy, r * 0.42f, corePaint)
        val swirlPaint =
          Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            style = Paint.Style.STROKE
            strokeWidth = 2.2f
            strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
            color = Color.parseColor("#D8B4FE")
          }
        val rect = RectF(cx - r * 0.85f, cy - r * 0.85f, cx + r * 0.85f, cy + r * 0.85f)
        c.drawArc(rect, 15f, 120f, false, swirlPaint)
        c.drawArc(rect, 195f, 120f, false, swirlPaint)
      }
      else -> {
        // Paired Phase Rifts (Node A ⇄ Node B)
        val c1x = sizePx * 0.34f
        val c1y = sizePx * 0.36f
        val c2x = sizePx * 0.66f
        val c2y = sizePx * 0.64f
        val linkPaint =
          Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
            style = Paint.Style.STROKE
            strokeWidth = 2.2f
            color = Color.argb(195, 45, 212, 191)
          }
        c.drawLine(c1x, c1y, c2x, c2y, linkPaint)
        for ((px, py, hex) in listOf(Triple(c1x, c1y, "#2DD4BF"), Triple(c2x, c2y, "#38BDF8"))) {
          val col = Color.parseColor(hex)
          val g =
            Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
              shader =
                RadialGradient(
                  px,
                  py,
                  sizePx * 0.28f,
                  intArrayOf(Color.WHITE, col, Color.argb(0, Color.red(col), Color.green(col), Color.blue(col))),
                  floatArrayOf(0f, 0.52f, 1f),
                  Shader.TileMode.CLAMP,
                )
            }
          c.drawCircle(px, py, sizePx * 0.28f, g)
          val ring =
            Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
              style = Paint.Style.STROKE
              strokeWidth = 1.8f
              color = Color.WHITE
            }
          c.drawCircle(px, py, sizePx * 0.14f, ring)
        }
      }
    }
    return bmp
  }

  fun bakeShipBitmap(spec: ShipSpec, sizePx: Int = 128, isAllied: Boolean = true): Bitmap {
    val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(sizePx, sizePx, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
    val c = Canvas(bmp)
    drawMetallicShipOnCanvas(c, sizePx / 2f, sizePx / 2f, sizePx * 0.39f, spec, isAllied)
    return bmp
  }

  /**
   * High-Definition Multi-Layered 3D Metallic Ship Renderer:
   * - Zero thruster flame plumes (strictly metallic exhaust housings)
   * - Hull-class specific 5-stop metallic armor shading + gold/bronze trim bevels
   * - Protruding weapon barrels, rail prongs, torpedo/mine bays, cockpit glass & V-cyan reactor cores
   * - Crisp team readability outline (#38BDF8 allied / #EF4444 hostile)
   */
  fun drawMetallicShipOnCanvas(
    c: Canvas,
    cx: Float,
    cy: Float,
    r: Float,
    spec: ShipSpec,
    isAllied: Boolean = true,
  ) {
    c.save()
    c.translate(cx, cy)

    // Hull-specific 5-stop 3D metallic gradient across [-r, r]
    val hullColors =
      when (spec.id) {
        9 ->
          intArrayOf(
            Color.parseColor("#0D0B26"),
            Color.parseColor("#1E1B4B"),
            Color.parseColor("#EC4899"),
            Color.parseColor("#1E1B4B"),
            Color.parseColor("#0D0B26"),
          )
        3, 4 ->
          intArrayOf(
            Color.parseColor("#0D0B26"),
            Color.parseColor("#1E1B4B"),
            Color.parseColor("#6366F1"),
            Color.parseColor("#1E1B4B"),
            Color.parseColor("#0D0B26"),
          )
        5, 6 ->
          intArrayOf(
            Color.parseColor("#041924"),
            Color.parseColor("#0E3A4D"),
            Color.parseColor("#38BDF8"),
            Color.parseColor("#0C3142"),
            Color.parseColor("#041924"),
          )
        7, 8 ->
          intArrayOf(
            Color.parseColor("#14110F"),
            Color.parseColor("#292524"),
            Color.parseColor("#78716C"),
            Color.parseColor("#292524"),
            Color.parseColor("#14110F"),
          )
        else -> // Ships 1, 2 Obsidian Rail
          intArrayOf(
            Color.parseColor("#090D16"),
            Color.parseColor("#1E293B"),
            Color.parseColor("#64748B"),
            Color.parseColor("#1E293B"),
            Color.parseColor("#090D16"),
          )
      }

    val trimColors =
      when (spec.id) {
        3, 4, 9 ->
          intArrayOf(
            Color.parseColor("#FEF08A"),
            Color.parseColor("#F59E0B"),
            Color.parseColor("#92400E"),
            Color.parseColor("#FACC15"),
          )
        7, 8 ->
          intArrayOf(
            Color.parseColor("#FDBA74"),
            Color.parseColor("#EA580C"),
            Color.parseColor("#7C2D12"),
            Color.parseColor("#FB923C"),
          )
        else ->
          intArrayOf(
            Color.parseColor("#FDE68A"),
            Color.parseColor("#D97706"),
            Color.parseColor("#78350F"),
            Color.parseColor("#FBBF24"),
          )
      }

    val goldPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        shader =
          LinearGradient(
            -r,
            -r,
            r,
            r,
            trimColors,
            floatArrayOf(0f, 0.38f, 0.72f, 1f),
            Shader.TileMode.CLAMP,
          )
      }

    val hullPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        shader =
          LinearGradient(
            0f,
            -r,
            0f,
            r,
            hullColors,
            floatArrayOf(0.0f, 0.30f, 0.50f, 0.70f, 1.0f),
            Shader.TileMode.CLAMP,
          )
      }

    val upperPlatePaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        shader =
          LinearGradient(
            -r * 0.5f,
            -r * 0.5f,
            r * 0.6f,
            r * 0.5f,
            intArrayOf(
              hullColors[2],
              hullColors[1],
              hullColors[0],
            ),
            floatArrayOf(0f, 0.55f, 1f),
            Shader.TileMode.CLAMP,
          )
      }

    val gunBarrelPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = Color.parseColor("#1E293B")
      }
    val gunBarrelStroke =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 1.6f
        color = Color.parseColor("#94A3B8")
      }
    val muzzleGlowPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        color = spec.accentColorHex
      }

    val readabilityOutlinePaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 2.6f
        strokeJoin = Paint.Join.ROUND
        color = if (isAllied) Color.parseColor("#38BDF8") else Color.parseColor("#EF4444")
      }

    val specularEdgePaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 1.5f
        strokeJoin = Paint.Join.ROUND
        color = Color.argb(200, 255, 255, 255)
      }

    val seamPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 1.5f
        color = Color.parseColor("#020617")
      }

    val canopyPaint =
      Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
        shader =
          LinearGradient(
            -r * 0.2f,
            -r * 0.2f,
            r * 0.5f,
            r * 0.2f,
            intArrayOf(
              Color.parseColor("#E0F2FE"),
              Color.parseColor("#0284C7"),
              Color.parseColor("#082F49"),
            ),
            floatArrayOf(0f, 0.45f, 1f),
            Shader.TileMode.CLAMP,
          )
      }

    val goldWingPath = Path()
    val armorHullPath = Path()
    val upperDeckPath = Path()

    when (spec.id) {
      1 -> {
        // 1-Viper: "Forward-swept obsidian rail-prongs with bronze wing-tips and a narrow V-cyan reactor spine."
        // Protruding twin hyper-velocity railgun barrels inside forward prongs
        c.drawRect(r * 0.30f, -r * 0.22f, r * 1.18f, -r * 0.12f, gunBarrelPaint)
        c.drawRect(r * 0.30f, -r * 0.22f, r * 1.18f, -r * 0.12f, gunBarrelStroke)
        c.drawRect(r * 0.30f, r * 0.12f, r * 1.18f, r * 0.22f, gunBarrelPaint)
