@Composable
fun CodexModal(
  isNexusStreaming: Boolean = false,
  onOpenNexus: () -> Unit = {},
  onCloseModal: () -> Unit,
) {
  val context = LocalContext.current
  var selectedTab by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) } // 0 = Supply Buffs, 1 = Playfield Rifts, 2 = Controller

  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        .background(Color(0xB3000000))
        .padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 10.dp)
        .testTag("codex_modal"),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    Surface(
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxSize()
          .border(1.dp, Color(0x6600F0FF), RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)),
      color = Color(0xE60A0F18),
      shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
    ) {
      Column(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxSize()
            .padding(14.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(9.dp),
      ) {
        // Header + Tab Switcher + NEXUS & Close Actions
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
          Column {
            Text(
              text = "📖 RIFT CODEX: TACTICAL FIELD MANUAL",
              color = Color.White,
              fontSize = 16.5.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              letterSpacing = 0.8.sp,
            )
            Text(
              text = "SUPPLY BUFF POOL • PLAYFIELD RIFT ANOMALIES • TWIN-STICK CONTROLLER & 10-SHIP PARITY",
              color = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
              fontSize = 10.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
          }

          Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
          ) {
            // Segmented Tab Switcher: Supply Buffs | Playfield Rifts | Controller
            Row(
              modifier =
                Modifier.background(Color(0xFF060C16), RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
                  .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF1E3A5F), RoundedCornerShape(9.dp))
                  .padding(3.dp),
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            ) {
              CodexTabPill(
                label = "⚡ SUPPLY BUFFS",
                selected = selectedTab == 0,
                accentColor = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                testTag = "codex_tab_supply_buffs",
                onClick = { selectedTab = 0 },
              )
              CodexTabPill(
                label = "🌀 PLAYFIELD RIFTS",
                selected = selectedTab == 1,
                accentColor = Color(0xFFA855F7),
                testTag = "codex_tab_playfield_rifts",
                onClick = { selectedTab = 1 },
              )
              CodexTabPill(
                label = "🎮 CONTROLLER",
                selected = selectedTab == 2,
                accentColor = Color(0xFF34D399),
                testTag = "codex_tab_controller",
                onClick = { selectedTab = 2 },
              )
            }

            SwirlingRiftHeaderPill(
              onClick = onOpenNexus,
              tag = "btn_codex_nexus_ai",
              isStreaming = isNexusStreaming,
            )

            Button(
              onClick = onCloseModal,
              colors =
                ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                  containerColor = Color(0xFF28111B),
                  contentColor = Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
                ),
              border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color(0xFFFF3B4E)),
              shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              modifier = Modifier.height(36.dp).testTag("codex_close_button"),
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "✕ CLOSE",
                fontSize = 11.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
            }
          }
        }

        when (selectedTab) {
          0 -> {
            // TAB 0: SUPPLY BUFFS
            Row(
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
            ) {
              CodexHighlightCard(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                title = "🎯 BUCKET A: SPECIAL BUFF SLOT (0⚡)",
                body = "Nova Ring, Shatter Cone, Seeker Torpedo, Holo Phantom, Stasis Barrier & Hyper Surge equip to the 4th button at 0⚡ Flux cost. Same-type stacks; new type overwrites.",
                bgColor = Color(0xFF092318),
                borderColor = Color(0xFF10B981),
                bodyColor = Color(0xFFD1FAE5),
              )
              CodexHighlightCard(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                title = "⚡ BUCKET B: HULL UPGRADES & ENHANCERS",
                body = "Bouncing Bullets (+1 bounce until death), Speed / Thrust / Reactor Overcharge (+8% up to 3/3 until death), Multi-Shot (+25 shots), Repel (+1), & Full Flux.",
                bgColor = Color(0xFF261908),
                borderColor = Color(0xFFF59E0B),
                bodyColor = Color(0xFFFEF3C7),
              )
              CodexHighlightCard(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                title = "⚖️ 100-POINT HULL PARITY (10 SHIPS)",
                body = "All 9 standard hulls (Viper..Interdictor) share the Universal Baseline Floor + 100 Pts. Ship #10 (Rift Frame) grows from 20 Pts (Lv 20) to 100 Pts (Lv 100).",
                bgColor = Color(0xFF0D1E36),
                borderColor = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                bodyColor = Color(0xFFE0F2FE),
              )
            }

            LazyColumn(
              modifier =
                Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                  .background(Color(0xFF081426), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF1B3454), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .padding(8.dp),
              verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
            ) {
              itemsIndexed(RiftCodex.POWERUP_CODEX) { _, entry ->
                val buffType = entry.buffTypeIndex
                val accentColor =
                  when (buffType) {
                    0 -> Color(0xFFF59E0B) // Nova Ring
                    1 -> Color(0xFFFB7185) // Shatter Cone
                    2 -> Color(0xFFEF4444) // Seeker Torpedo
                    3 -> Color(0xFF38BDF8) // Holo Phantom
                    4 -> Color(0xFF22D3EE) // Stasis Barrier
                    5 -> Color(0xFFA855F7) // Hyper Surge
                    6 -> Color(0xFF10B981) // Full Flux Charge
                    7 -> Color(0xFF60A5FA) // Repel Charge
                    8 -> Color(0xFFFACC15) // Shot-Limited Multi-Shot
                    9 -> Color(0xFFC084FC) // Permanent Bouncing Bullets
                    -10 -> Color(0xFF38BDF8) // Speed Overcharge
                    -11 -> Color(0xFFF59E0B) // Thrust Overcharge
                    -12 -> Color(0xFF10B981) // Reactor Overcharge
                    else -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
                  }

                Row(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                      .background(Color(0xFF0E1F38), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .border(1.dp, accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.5f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .padding(10.dp),
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
                ) {
                  BuffIconPreview(buffType = buffType, sizeDp = 54, accentColor = accentColor)

                  Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Row(
                      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    ) {
                      Row(
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                      ) {
                        Text(
                          text = entry.title,
                          color = accentColor,
                          fontSize = 13.5.sp,
                          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                          fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                        )
                        Box(
                          modifier =
                            Modifier.background(Color(0x22FFFFFF), RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                              .padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                        ) {
                          Text(
                            text = entry.category,
                            color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                            fontSize = 9.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                          )
                        }
                      }

                      Box(
                        modifier =
                          Modifier.background(Color(0x26FFD700), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                            .border(1.dp, Color(0xFFFFD700), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 3.dp)
                      ) {
                        Text(
                          text = "DROP ${entry.dropRatePercent}%",
                          color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
                          fontSize = 11.sp,
                          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                        )
                      }
                    }

                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(3.dp))

                    Text(
                      text = entry.effectSummary,
                      color = Color.White,
                      fontSize = 11.5.sp,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                    )

                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))

                    Text(
                      text = "TACTICAL ADVICE: ${entry.tacticalNote}",
                      color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                      fontSize = 10.sp,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                      lineHeight = 13.sp,
                    )
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }

          1 -> {
            // TAB 1: PLAYFIELD RIFTS (OBSTACLES & SPATIAL ANOMALIES)
            Row(
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
            ) {
              CodexHighlightCard(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                title = "⏱ 45-SECOND DYNAMIC RIFT CYCLES",
                body = "Playfield Rifts remain active for 45 seconds before collapsing in a particle burst and relocating to fresh open-space coordinates outside the Safe Zone.",
                bgColor = Color(0xFF1B102E),
                borderColor = Color(0xFFA855F7),
                bodyColor = Color(0xFFE9D5FF),
              )
              CodexHighlightCard(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                title = "📐 5x HULL SCALE & ORDNANCE PHYSICS",
                body = "Each Rift spans a 180px physical core (5x ship scale) and directly interacts with both Newtonian ship trajectories and live bullets/warheads.",
                bgColor = Color(0xFF0A2229),
                borderColor = Color(0xFF2DD4BF),
                bodyColor = Color(0xFFCCFBF1),
              )
              CodexHighlightCard(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                title = "📡 MINIMAP RADAR COLOR SIGNATURES",
                body = "Tracked live on your circular radar: Crimson = Plasma Rift, White = Repulsor Rift, Violet = Gravity Rift, Teal & Cyan = Paired Phase Rifts.",
                bgColor = Color(0xFF241016),
                borderColor = Color(0xFFEF4444),
                bodyColor = Color(0xFFFECACA),
              )
            }

            LazyColumn(
              modifier =
                Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                  .background(Color(0xFF081426), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .border(1.dp, Color(0xFF1B3454), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                  .padding(8.dp)
                  .testTag("codex_playfield_rifts_list"),
              verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
            ) {
              items(RiftCodex.RIFT_ANOMALIES_CODEX, key = { it.id }) { rift ->
                val accentColor =
                  runCatching { Color(android.graphics.Color.parseColor(rift.accentHex)) }
                    .getOrDefault(Color(0xFF38BDF8))

                Row(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                      .background(Color(0xFF0E1F38), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .border(1.dp, accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.55f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                      .padding(10.dp),
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
                ) {
                  RiftAnomalyIconPreview(riftId = rift.id, sizeDp = 56, accentColor = accentColor)

                  Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Row(
                      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    ) {
                      Row(
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
                      ) {
                        Text(
                          text = rift.title,
                          color = accentColor,
                          fontSize = 13.5.sp,
                          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                          fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                        )
                        Box(
                          modifier =
                            Modifier.background(Color(0x22FFFFFF), RoundedCornerShape(4.dp))
                              .padding(horizontal = 5.dp, vertical = 2.dp)
                        ) {
                          Text(
                            text = rift.classification,
                            color = Color(0xFFCBD5E1),
                            fontSize = 9.sp,
                            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                          )
                        }
                      }

                      Box(
                        modifier =
                          Modifier.background(accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.16f), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                            .border(1.dp, accentColor, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                            .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 3.dp)
                      ) {
                        Text(
                          text = rift.specBadge,
                          color = accentColor,
                          fontSize = 10.5.sp,
                          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                        )
                      }
                    }

                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(3.dp))

                    Text(
                      text = rift.effectSummary,
                      color = Color.White,
                      fontSize = 11.5.sp,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                    )

                    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))

                    Text(
                      text = "TACTICAL ADVICE: ${rift.tacticalNote}",
                      color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                      fontSize = 10.sp,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                      lineHeight = 13.sp,
                    )
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }

          else -> {
            // TAB 2: TWIN-STICK CONTROLLER SCHEMATIC & LIVE BUTTON REMAPPER
            Column(
              modifier =
                Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                  .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
              verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
            ) {
              Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
              ) {
                CodexHighlightCard(
                  modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                  title = "🕹️ L-STICK: 360° FLIGHT & HEADING AIM",
                  body = "Permanently locked to 360° Newtonian thrust (>80% ignites Afterburners; releasing glides with zero friction). When Right Stick is neutral, all weapons fire along your Left-Stick heading!",
                  bgColor = Color(0xFF082032),
                  borderColor = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
                  bodyColor = Color(0xFFE0F2FE),
                )
                CodexHighlightCard(
                  modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                  title = "🎯 R-STICK: 360° INDEPENDENT TURRET",
                  body = "Deflect the Right Stick at any time to aim your turret 360° independently of your flight vector. Release the Right Stick to return aim to your Left-Stick ship heading.",
                  bgColor = Color(0xFF1E1035),
                  borderColor = Color(0xFFC084FC),
                  bodyColor = Color(0xFFF3E8FF),
                )
                CodexHighlightCard(
                  modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                  title = "⚡ WOW-STYLE LIVE REMAPPER",
                  body = "Default ergonomic layout: RT=Main Attack, R1=Special Buff, LT=Manual Brake, X=Instant Secondary, A=Repel, Y=Multi-Shot. Tap any slot below to rebind!",
                  bgColor = Color(0xFF092318),
                  borderColor = Color(0xFF34D399),
                  bodyColor = Color(0xFFD1FAE5),
                )
              }

              ControllerDiagramAndMapperCard(context = context)
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun CodexTabPill(
  label: String,
  selected: Boolean,
  accentColor: Color,
  testTag: String,
  onClick: () -> Unit,
) {
  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
        .background(if (selected) accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.22f) else Color.Transparent)
        .border(
          width = if (selected) 1.dp else 0.dp,
          color = if (selected) accentColor else Color.Transparent,
          shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
        )
        .clickable(onClick = onClick)
        .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
        .testTag(testTag),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    Text(
      text = label,
      color = if (selected) Color.White else Color(0xFF94A3B8),
      fontSize = 10.5.sp,
      fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
      fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
    )
  }
}

@Composable
private fun CodexHighlightCard(
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  title: String,
  body: String,
  bgColor: Color,
  borderColor: Color,
  bodyColor: Color,
) {
  Box(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .background(bgColor, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .border(1.dp, borderColor, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 7.dp),
  ) {
    Column {
      Text(
        text = title,
        color = borderColor,
        fontSize = 10.5.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
      )
      Text(
        text = body,
        color = bodyColor,
        fontSize = 9.5.sp,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
        lineHeight = 12.5.sp,
      )
    }
  }
}

@Composable
fun BuffIconPreview(buffType: Int, sizeDp: Int, accentColor: Color) {
  val bmp = remember(buffType) { RiftSpriteBaker.getBuffIconBitmap(buffType).asImageBitmap() }
  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.size(sizeDp.dp)
        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .background(Color(0xFF030712))
        .border(1.5.dp, accentColor, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size((sizeDp - 6).dp)) {
      drawImage(
        image = bmp,
        dstOffset = IntOffset.Zero,
        dstSize = IntSize(size.width.toInt(), size.height.toInt()),
      )
    }
  }
}

@Composable
fun RiftAnomalyIconPreview(riftId: String, sizeDp: Int, accentColor: Color) {
  val bmp = remember(riftId) { RiftSpriteBaker.getRiftAnomalyIconBitmap(riftId).asImageBitmap() }
  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.size(sizeDp.dp)
        .clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .background(Color(0xFF030712))
        .border(1.5.dp, accentColor, RoundedCornerShape(8.dp)),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    Canvas(modifier = Modifier.size((sizeDp - 4).dp)) {
      drawImage(
        image = bmp,
        dstOffset = IntOffset.Zero,
        dstSize = IntSize(size.width.toInt(), size.height.toInt()),
      )
    }
  }
}

@Composable
fun DossierModal(
  permanentUid: String,
  callsign: String,
  syndicateTag: String,
  activeArmadaName: String,
  activeArmadaSize: Int,
  shipId: Int,
  pvpKills: Long,
  pvpDeaths: Long,
  pvpBountyPeak: Long,
  allTimeKills: Long,
  allTimeDeaths: Long,
  allTimeBountyPeak: Long,
  convergencesWon: Long,
  pilotLevel: Int = 1,
  currentLevelXp: Long = 0L,
  nextLevelXpSpan: Long = 250L,
  levelProgressFraction: Float = 0f,
  customizationPointsTotal: Int = 1,
  spentCustomizationPoints: Int = 0,
  riftShards: Long = 150L,
  xpFromBuffs: Long = 0L,
  xpFromDamage: Long = 0L,
  xpFromAccuracy: Long = 0L,
  xpFromBountyEarned: Long = 0L,
  xpFromBountyKilled: Long = 0L,
  matchPresencePct: Int = 100,
  fps: Int,
  cloudLeaderboardEntries: List<LeaderboardEntry>,
  allTimePeakSnapshot: PeakBountyRunSnapshot? = null,
  pvpPeakSnapshot: PeakBountyRunSnapshot? = null,
  currentLifeSnapshot: PeakBountyRunSnapshot? = null,
  syndicateServiceHistory: List<SyndicateServiceEntry> = emptyList(),
  onOpenRiftShardsStore: () -> Unit = {},
  onResetLocalPilotData: (() -> Unit)? = null,
  onCloseModal: () -> Unit,
) {
  BackHandler { onCloseModal() }

  // Top-level Dossier view: 0 = LEADERBOARD, 1 = PEAK BOUNTY & EXECUTIONER, 2 = SYNDICATE SERVICE RECORD
  var dossierSection by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
  var activeTab by remember { mutableIntStateOf(1) } // 0 = PVP ONLY, 1 = ALL-TIME
  var selectedArmadaTier by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) } // 0 = ALL, 1 = SOLO, 2..5 = 2..5-MAN ARMADA
  var sortMode by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) } // 0 = BOUNTY, 1 = PUBLIC WINS, 2 = K/D

  // Deduplicate strictly by permanent userId so editing Callsign never creates ghost rows
  val unifiedLeaderboard =
    remember(
      permanentUid,
      callsign,
      syndicateTag,
      activeArmadaName,
      activeArmadaSize,
      shipId,
      pvpKills,
      pvpDeaths,
      pvpBountyPeak,
      allTimeKills,
      allTimeDeaths,
      allTimeBountyPeak,
      convergencesWon,
      cloudLeaderboardEntries,
      activeTab,
      selectedArmadaTier,
      sortMode,
    ) {
      val byUid = linkedMapOf<String, LeaderboardEntry>()
      val shipSpec = RiftCodex.getShipById(shipId)
      val localArmadaBadge = if (activeArmadaName.isNotEmpty()) activeArmadaName else "SOLO"
      val formattedLocalCallsign =
        if (syndicateTag.isNotBlank()) {
          "[$localArmadaBadge] [$syndicateTag] $callsign"
        } else {
          "[$localArmadaBadge] $callsign"
        }
      val localEntry =
        LeaderboardEntry(
          id = permanentUid,
          userId = permanentUid,
          callsign = formattedLocalCallsign,
          syndicateTag = syndicateTag,
          armadaTag = localArmadaBadge,
          armadaTierSize = activeArmadaSize.coerceIn(1, 5),
          shipId = shipId.toLong(),
          foundry = shipSpec.role,
          pvpKills = pvpKills,
          pvpDeaths = pvpDeaths,
          pvpBounty = pvpBountyPeak,
          allTimeKills = allTimeKills,
          allTimeDeaths = allTimeDeaths,
          allTimeBounty = allTimeBountyPeak,
          convergencesWon = convergencesWon,
        )
      byUid[permanentUid] = localEntry

      for (entry in cloudLeaderboardEntries) {
        val uidKey = entry.userId.ifEmpty { entry.id }
        if (uidKey.isNotEmpty() && uidKey != permanentUid) {
          val cleanCallsign =
            if (entry.callsign.startsWith("[")) {
              entry.callsign
            } else {
              val armBadge = entry.armadaTag.ifBlank { "SOLO" }
              if (entry.syndicateTag.isNotBlank()) {
                "[$armBadge] [${entry.syndicateTag}] ${entry.callsign}"
              } else {
                "[$armBadge] ${entry.callsign}"
              }
            }
          byUid[uidKey] = entry.copy(callsign = cleanCallsign)
        }
      }

      byUid.values
        .filter { entry ->
          val isSelf = entry.userId == permanentUid || entry.id == permanentUid
          isSelf || selectedArmadaTier == 0 || entry.armadaTierSize.toInt() == selectedArmadaTier
        }
        .sortedByDescending { entry ->
          val k = if (activeTab == 0) entry.pvpKills else entry.allTimeKills
          val d = (if (activeTab == 0) entry.pvpDeaths else entry.allTimeDeaths).coerceAtLeast(1L)
          val bty = if (activeTab == 0) entry.pvpBounty else entry.allTimeBounty
          when (sortMode) {
            1 -> entry.convergencesWon * 100_000L + bty
            2 -> ((k.toDouble() / d.toDouble()) * 10_000.0).toLong() + k * 100L
            else -> bty + k * 25L
          }
        }
    }

  val availableCustomPts = (customizationPointsTotal - spentCustomizationPoints).coerceAtLeast(0)
  val displayedPeakSnapshot =
    if (activeTab == 0) {
      pvpPeakSnapshot
    } else {
      allTimePeakSnapshot ?: currentLifeSnapshot
    }

  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        .background(Color(0xB3000000))
        .clickable { onCloseModal() }
        .padding(horizontal = 18.dp, vertical = 8.dp)
        .testTag("dossier_modal"),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    Surface(
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxSize()
          .clickable(enabled = false) {}
          .border(1.dp, Color(0x6600F0FF), RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)),
      color = Color(0xE60A0F18),
      shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
    ) {
      Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(12.dp)) {
        // 1. Header Row
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        ) {
          Column {
            Text(
              text = "📋 PILOT DOSSIER, HALL OF FAME & SERVICE RECORD",
              color = Color.White,
              fontSize = 16.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              letterSpacing = 1.0.sp,
            )
            val tierDesc =
              if (activeArmadaName.isEmpty() || activeArmadaSize <= 1) {
                "[SOLO] TIER"
              } else {
                "${activeArmadaSize}-MAN ARMADA [$activeArmadaName] TIER"
              }
            val syndicatePrefix = if (syndicateTag.isNotBlank()) "[$syndicateTag] " else ""
            Text(
              text = "UID: $permanentUid • ${syndicatePrefix}$callsign • ACTIVE: $tierDesc • PRESENCE: $matchPresencePct%",
              color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              fontSize = 10.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
          }

          Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
          ) {
            if (onResetLocalPilotData != null) {
              Button(
                onClick = onResetLocalPilotData,
                colors =
                  ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                    containerColor = Color(0xFF1E293B),
                    contentColor = Color(0xFFF59E0B),
                  ),
                border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color(0xFFF59E0B)),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                modifier = Modifier.height(36.dp).testTag("dossier_reset_pilot_button"),
              ) {
                Text(
                  text = "↺ RESET PILOT",
                  fontSize = 10.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                )
              }
            }

            Row(
              modifier =
                Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .background(Color(0xFF1A1405))
                  .border(1.dp, Color(0xFFFFD700), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .clickable { onOpenRiftShardsStore() }
                  .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
                  .testTag("dossier_btn_get_rift_shards"),
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "❖ $riftShards",
                color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
                fontSize = 12.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
              Box(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.background(Color(0xFFFFD700), RoundedCornerShape(5.dp))
                    .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
              ) {
                Text(
                  text = "+ GET RIFT SHARDS",
                  color = Color(0xFF05080E),
                  fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                )
              }
            }

            Button(
              onClick = onCloseModal,
              colors =
                ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                  containerColor = Color(0xFF28111B),
                  contentColor = Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
                ),
              border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color(0xFFFF3B4E)),
              shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              modifier = Modifier.height(36.dp).testTag("dossier_close_button"),
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "✕ CLOSE",
                fontSize = 11.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
            }
          }
        }

        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(5.dp))

        // 2. Career Level & XP Progress Card
        Column(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .background(Color(0xCC0D1B30), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
              .border(1.dp, Color(0x6600F0FF), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
              .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 5.dp)
              .testTag("dossier_career_level_card"),
        ) {
          Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          ) {
            Row(
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
            ) {
              Box(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.background(Color(0xFF00F0FF), RoundedCornerShape(6.dp))
                    .padding(horizontal = 8.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
              ) {
                Text(
                  text = "PILOT LVL $pilotLevel / 100",
                  color = Color(0xFF040914),
                  fontSize = 10.5.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
              }

              val xpNeededForNext = (nextLevelXpSpan - currentLevelXp).coerceAtLeast(0L)
              Text(
                text =
                  if (pilotLevel >= 100) {
                    "MAX LEVEL 100 ACHIEVED"
                  } else {
                    "XP: $currentLevelXp / $nextLevelXpSpan ($xpNeededForNext XP TO LVL ${pilotLevel + 1})"
                  },
                color = Color.White,
                fontSize = 10.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }

            Row(
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "CUSTOMIZATION PTS: $availableCustomPts AVAIL ($customizationPointsTotal / 100)",
                color = Color(0xFF00E676),
                fontSize = 10.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
              Text(
                text = "RIFT SHARDS: ❖ $riftShards",
                color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
                fontSize = 10.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
          }

          Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(3.dp))

          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .height(4.dp)
                .clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp))
                .background(Color(0xFF142844))
          ) {
            Box(
              modifier =
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth(levelProgressFraction.coerceIn(0f, 1f))
                  .fillMaxHeight()
                  .background(Color(0xFF00E676), RoundedCornerShape(2.dp))
            )
          }

          Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))

          Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
          ) {
            XpSourceChip(Modifier.weight(1f), "1. BUFFS COLLECTED", xpFromBuffs, Color(0xFF10B981))
            XpSourceChip(Modifier.weight(1f), "2. DAMAGE DONE", xpFromDamage, Color(0xFF38BDF8))
            XpSourceChip(Modifier.weight(1f), "3. ACCURACY", xpFromAccuracy, Color(0xFFF59E0B))
            XpSourceChip(Modifier.weight(1f), "4. BOUNTY EARNED", xpFromBountyEarned, Color(0xFFFFD700))
            XpSourceChip(Modifier.weight(1f), "5. BOUNTY KILLED", xpFromBountyKilled, Color(0xFFF87171))
          }
        }

        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(5.dp))

        // 3. Primary Section Navigation Sub-Tabs
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
          Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
            DossierSectionButton(
              label = "🏆 ARMADA LEADERBOARDS",
              selected = dossierSection == 0,
              accentColor = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
              testTag = "dossier_tab_leaderboards",
              onClick = { dossierSection = 0 },
            )
            DossierSectionButton(
              label = "💀 PEAK BOUNTY & EXECUTIONER",
              selected = dossierSection == 1,
              accentColor = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              testTag = "dossier_tab_peak_snapshot",
              onClick = { dossierSection = 1 },
            )
            DossierSectionButton(
              label = "🏛️ SYNDICATE SERVICE RECORD (${syndicateServiceHistory.size})",
              selected = dossierSection == 2,
              accentColor = Color(0xFF34D399),
              testTag = "dossier_tab_syndicate_history",
              onClick = { dossierSection = 2 },
            )
          }

          // Shared All-Time vs PvP Only Filter for Leaderboards & Peak Bounty Snapshot
          if (dossierSection != 2) {
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp)) {
              DossierTabChip(
                label = "🌐 ALL-TIME",
                selected = activeTab == 1,
                onClick = { activeTab = 1 },
              )
              DossierTabChip(
                label = "⚔️ PVP ONLY",
                selected = activeTab == 0,
                onClick = { activeTab = 0 },
              )
            }
          }
        }

        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(5.dp))

        when (dossierSection) {
          0 -> {
            // Summary KPI Cards + Compact Clickable Hall of Fame Peak Run Banner
            Row(
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
            ) {
              DossierStatBox(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                label = "ALL-TIME KILLS / DEATHS",
                value = "$allTimeKills K / $allTimeDeaths D",
                color = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
              )
              DossierStatBox(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                label = "PVP KILLS / DEATHS",
                value = "$pvpKills K / $pvpDeaths D",
                color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              )
              DossierStatBox(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).clickable { dossierSection = 1 },
                label = "PEAK BOUNTY (TAP FOR RUN)",
                value = "$allTimeBountyPeak BTY ↗",
                color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              )
              DossierStatBox(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                label = "PUBLIC GAME WINS",
                value = "🏆 $convergencesWon WINS",
                color = Color(0xFF00E676),
              )
              DossierStatBox(
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).clickable { dossierSection = 2 },
                label = "SYNDICATE TENURE",
                value = "[$syndicateTag] ↗",
                color = Color(0xFF34D399),
              )
            }

            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(5.dp))

            // Sort + Armada Tier Filter Row
            Row(
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            ) {
              Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp)) {
                DossierTabChip("SORT: BOUNTY", sortMode == 0) { sortMode = 0 }
                DossierTabChip("SORT: PUBLIC WINS", sortMode == 1) { sortMode = 1 }
                DossierTabChip("SORT: K/D", sortMode == 2) { sortMode = 2 }
              }

              Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
                DossierTabChip("ALL TIERS", selectedArmadaTier == 0) { selectedArmadaTier = 0 }
                DossierTabChip("SOLO", selectedArmadaTier == 1) { selectedArmadaTier = 1 }
                DossierTabChip("2-MAN", selectedArmadaTier == 2) { selectedArmadaTier = 2 }
                DossierTabChip("3-MAN", selectedArmadaTier == 3) { selectedArmadaTier = 3 }
                DossierTabChip("4-MAN", selectedArmadaTier == 4) { selectedArmadaTier = 4 }
                DossierTabChip("5-MAN", selectedArmadaTier == 5) { selectedArmadaTier = 5 }
              }
            }

            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(5.dp))

            LazyColumn(
              modifier =
                Modifier.weight(1f)
                  .fillMaxWidth()
                  .background(Color(0x99111C2D), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
                  .padding(8.dp),
              verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
            ) {
              itemsIndexed(unifiedLeaderboard, key = { _, item -> item.userId.ifEmpty { item.id } }) { index, entry ->
                val isSelf = entry.userId == permanentUid || entry.id == permanentUid
                val kills = if (activeTab == 0) entry.pvpKills else entry.allTimeKills
                val deaths = if (activeTab == 0) entry.pvpDeaths else entry.allTimeDeaths
                val bounty = if (activeTab == 0) entry.pvpBounty else entry.allTimeBounty
                val tierBadge =
                  if (entry.armadaTierSize <= 1) "SOLO" else "${entry.armadaTierSize}-MAN ARMADA"

                Row(
                  modifier =
                    Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                      .background(
                        if (isSelf) Color(0xCC143152) else Color(0x990D1B30),
                        RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                      )
                      .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 7.dp),
                  verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                  horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                ) {
                  Row(
                    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
                  ) {
                    Text(
                      text = "#${index + 1}",
                      color = if (index < 3) Color(0xFFFFD700) else Color(0xFF8A99AD),
                      fontSize = 13.5.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                      modifier = Modifier.width(30.dp),
                    )
                    ShipSpritePreview(shipId = entry.shipId.toInt(), sizeDp = 26)
                    Column {
                      Text(
                        text = if (isSelf) "${entry.callsign} (YOU — PINNED)" else entry.callsign,
                        color = if (isSelf) Color(0xFF00F0FF) else Color.White,
                        fontSize = 12.5.sp,
                        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                        fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                      )
                      Text(
                        text =
                          "TIER: $tierBadge • HULL: ${RiftCodex.getShipById(entry.shipId.toInt()).name.uppercase()}",
                        color = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
                        fontSize = 10.sp,
                        fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                      )
                    }
                  }

                  Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)) {
                    Text(
                      text = "PUBLIC WINS: 🏆 ${entry.convergencesWon}",
                      color = Color(0xFF00E676),
                      fontSize = 12.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    )
                    Text(
                      text = "K/D: $kills / $deaths",
                      color = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
                      fontSize = 12.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    )
                    Text(
                      text = "PEAK BOUNTY: $bounty",
                      color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
                      fontSize = 12.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    )
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }

          1 -> {
            // DOSSIER UPGRADE 1: HALL OF FAME — PEAK BOUNTY RUN SNAPSHOT & EXECUTIONER TELEMETRY
            PeakBountyAndExecutionerSection(
              modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
              isPvpOnlyMode = activeTab == 0,
              snapshot = displayedPeakSnapshot,
              currentLifeSnapshot = currentLifeSnapshot,
            )
          }

          2 -> {
            // DOSSIER UPGRADE 2: SYNDICATE AFFILIATION SERVICE RECORD & DIRECT H2H WAR RANKINGS
            SyndicateServiceRecordSection(
              modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
              activeSyndicateTag = syndicateTag,
              entries = syndicateServiceHistory,
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun PeakBountyAndExecutionerSection(
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  isPvpOnlyMode: Boolean,
  snapshot: PeakBountyRunSnapshot?,
  currentLifeSnapshot: PeakBountyRunSnapshot?,
) {
  val dateFormatter = remember { SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", Locale.US) }

  Column(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
        .background(Color(0x99111C2D), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
        .padding(10.dp)
        .testTag("dossier_peak_bounty_section"),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
  ) {
    val headerLabel =
      if (isPvpOnlyMode) {
        "🏆 HALL OF FAME: HIGHEST BOUNTY RUN SNAPSHOT (PVP ONLY)"
      } else {
        "🏆 HALL OF FAME: HIGHEST BOUNTY RUN SNAPSHOT (ALL-TIME)"
      }

    if (snapshot == null) {
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .background(Color(0xCC0D1B30), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
            .border(1.dp, Color(0x44FFD700), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
            .padding(18.dp),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
      ) {
        Text(
          text =
            if (isPvpOnlyMode) {
              "NO PVP PEAK BOUNTY SNAPSHOT RECORDED YET — ENGAGE HOSTILE HUMAN PILOTS IN PUBLIC FFA CONVERGENCE TO RECORD YOUR BEST PVP LIFE!"
            } else {
              "NO PEAK BOUNTY RUN SNAPSHOT RECORDED YET — LAUNCH INTO THE SECTOR TO RECORD YOUR FIRST LIFE TELEMETRY!"
            },
          color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
          fontSize = 11.5.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
      }
    } else {
      // Main Hall of Fame Snapshot Card
      Column(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .background(Color(0xE60B172A), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .border(1.2.dp, Color(0xAAFFD700), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
            .padding(12.dp),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
      ) {
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
          Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
          ) {
            ShipSpritePreview(shipId = snapshot.shipId.coerceIn(1, 10), sizeDp = 36)
            Column {
              Text(
                text = headerLabel,
                color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
                fontSize = 13.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
              Text(
                text =
                  "SHIP FLOWN: ${snapshot.shipFlown.uppercase(Locale.US)} • RECORDED: ${dateFormatter.format(Date(snapshot.recordedAtMs))}",
                color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                fontSize = 10.5.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
          }

          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.background(Color(0xFF2B2106), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .border(1.dp, Color(0xFFFFD700), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp),
          ) {
            Text(
              text = "👑 ${snapshot.bountyReached} BOUNTY",
              color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              fontSize = 15.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
          }
        }

        // Row 1 of Snapshot Metrics
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        ) {
          DossierStatBox(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            label = "TIME SURVIVED",
            value = snapshot.formattedDuration(),
            color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
          )
          DossierStatBox(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            label = "PVP / BOT KILLS",
            value = "${snapshot.pvpKills} PVP • ${snapshot.botKills} BOT",
            color = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
          )
          DossierStatBox(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            label = "HVT SHUTDOWNS",
            value = "👑 ${snapshot.hvtShutdowns} HVTs",
            color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
          )
          DossierStatBox(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            label = "CRATES / BUFFS",
            value = "📦 ${snapshot.buffsCollected} COLLECTED",
            color = Color(0xFF34D399),
          )
        }

        // Row 2 of Snapshot Metrics
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        ) {
          DossierStatBox(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            label = "DAMAGE DEALT",
            value = "${snapshot.damageDealt.toInt()} ⚡",
            color = Color(0xFF00E676),
          )
          DossierStatBox(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            label = "DAMAGE TAKEN",
            value = "${snapshot.damageTaken.toInt()} ⚡",
            color = Color(0xFFF87171),
          )
          DossierStatBox(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            label = "SHOTS FIRED / HIT",
            value = "${snapshot.shotsHit} / ${snapshot.shotsFired}",
            color = Color(0xFFF59E0B),
          )
          DossierStatBox(
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            label = "COMBAT ACCURACY",
            value = "${snapshot.accuracyPercent()}%",
            color = Color(0xFFC084FC),
          )
        }

        // Executioner ("TERMINATED BY") Breakdown Card
        val exec = snapshot.executioner
        val isConvergenceSurvival = exec.survivedToConvergence
        val isOngoingLiveStreak = !isConvergenceSurvival && exec.killerCallsign.isBlank()
        val execBorder =
          when {
            isConvergenceSurvival -> Color(0xFF00E676)
            isOngoingLiveStreak -> Color(0xFF38BDF8)
            else -> Color(0xFFFF3B4E)
          }
        val execBg =
          when {
            isConvergenceSurvival -> Color(0xCC06281E)
            isOngoingLiveStreak -> Color(0xCC0A2239)
            else -> Color(0xCC2A0D16)
          }

        Column(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .background(execBg, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
              .border(1.dp, execBorder, RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
              .padding(10.dp)
              .testTag("dossier_executioner_card"),
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp),
        ) {
          when {
            isConvergenceSurvival -> {
              Text(
                text = "🌀 RUN OUTCOME: SURVIVED TO SECTOR CONVERGENCE",
                color = Color(0xFF00E676),
                fontSize = 12.5.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
              Text(
                text = "Never terminated! Hull remained intact through the 60-minute Public FFA Sector Convergence reset.",
                color = Color(0xFFD1FAE5),
                fontSize = 10.5.sp,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
            }
            isOngoingLiveStreak -> {
              Text(
                text = "🟢 RUN STATUS: ACTIVE UNDEFEATED STREAK IN SECTOR",
                color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                fontSize = 12.5.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
              Text(
                text = "You are currently flying this record-setting life right now! Executioner telemetry will lock if terminated or at Sector Convergence.",
                color = Color(0xFFBAE6FD),
                fontSize = 10.5.sp,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
            }
            else -> {
              Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              ) {
                Column {
                  Text(
                    text = "💀 TERMINATED BY: [${exec.killerSyndicateTag}] ${exec.killerCallsign}",
                    color = Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
                    fontSize = 13.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                  )
                  Text(
                    text = "EXECUTIONER LOADOUT: ${exec.killerShip} • ${exec.killingWeapon}",
                    color = Color.White,
                    fontSize = 11.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                  )
                }

                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                  Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End) {
                    Text(
                      text = "KILLER BOUNTY AT KILL",
                      color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                      fontSize = 9.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    )
                    Text(
                      text = "${exec.killerBountyAtKill} BTY",
                      color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
                      fontSize = 12.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    )
                  }
                  Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End) {
                    Text(
                      text = "BOUNTY EARNED FROM YOU",
                      color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                      fontSize = 9.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    )
                    Text(
                      text = "+${exec.bountyEarnedFromYou} BTY",
                      color = Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
                      fontSize = 12.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                    )
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Current Active Life Telemetry Bar
    if (currentLifeSnapshot != null) {
      Row(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .background(Color(0xCC0D1B30), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
            .border(1.dp, Color(0x5538BDF8), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "⚡ CURRENT ACTIVE SORTIE (${currentLifeSnapshot.shipFlown}):",
          color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
          fontSize = 11.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
        Text(
          text =
            "BOUNTY: ${currentLifeSnapshot.bountyReached} • SURVIVED: ${currentLifeSnapshot.formattedDuration()} • KILLS: ${currentLifeSnapshot.pvpKills + currentLifeSnapshot.botKills} • DMG: ${currentLifeSnapshot.damageDealt.toInt()}⚡ • ACC: ${currentLifeSnapshot.accuracyPercent()}%",
          color = Color.White,
          fontSize = 10.5.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun SyndicateServiceRecordSection(
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  activeSyndicateTag: String = "GUEST",
  entries: List<SyndicateServiceEntry>,
) {
  val context = LocalContext.current
  val localPrefs = remember(context) { LocalPilotPrefs(context) }
  val dateFormatter = remember { SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm", Locale.US) }
  val nowMs = System.currentTimeMillis()
  val ordered = remember(entries) { entries.reversed() }

  val cleanActiveTag =
    remember(activeSyndicateTag) {
      activeSyndicateTag.trim().uppercase().ifEmpty { "GUEST" }
    }
  val myWarRecord =
    remember(cleanActiveTag, entries) {
      localPrefs.getSyndicateWarRecord(cleanActiveTag)
    }

  val (topByWarTrophies, topByCollectiveBounty) =
    remember(cleanActiveTag, entries) {
      val byTag = linkedMapOf<String, SyndicateInfo>()
      val officialLadder =
        listOf(
          SyndicateInfo(
            id = "syn_aex",
            tag = "AEX",
            name = "Apex Vanguard",
            foundryOrigin = "Sector Command Syndicate",
            motto = "First into the Rift, last to yield.",
            memberCount = 18,
            combinedBounty = 14850L,
            isCustom = false,
          ),
          SyndicateInfo(
            id = "syn_obs",
            tag = "OBS",
            name = "Obsidian Core",
            foundryOrigin = "Heavy Siege Syndicate",
            motto = "Unbreakable containment across the sector.",
            memberCount = 15,
            combinedBounty = 12400L,
            isCustom = false,
          ),
          SyndicateInfo(
            id = "syn_sol",
            tag = "SOL",
            name = "Solaris Prime",
            foundryOrigin = "High-Velocity Strike Fleet",
            motto = "Velocity is the ultimate shield.",
            memberCount = 14,
            combinedBounty = 11650L,
            isCustom = false,
          ),
          SyndicateInfo(
            id = "syn_rft",
            tag = "RFT",
            name = "Rift Sentinels",
            foundryOrigin = "Stasis Breach Guardians",
            motto = "Hold the line at x = 4000.",
            memberCount = 12,
            combinedBounty = 10900L,
            isCustom = false,
          ),
        )
      for (custom in localPrefs.getAllSyndicates()) {
        byTag[custom.tag.uppercase()] = custom
      }
      for (seed in officialLadder) {
        if (!byTag.containsKey(seed.tag)) {
          byTag[seed.tag] = seed
        }
      }
      val allPairs =
        byTag.values.map { syn ->
          syn to localPrefs.getSyndicateWarRecord(syn.tag)
        }
      val warSorted =
        allPairs
          .sortedWith(
            compareByDescending<Pair<SyndicateInfo, SyndicateWarRecord>> { it.second.warTrophies }
              .thenByDescending { it.second.warWins }
          )
          .take(4)
      val bountySorted =
        allPairs
          .sortedWith(
            compareByDescending<Pair<SyndicateInfo, SyndicateWarRecord>> { it.first.combinedBounty }
              .thenByDescending { it.first.memberCount }
          )
          .take(4)
      warSorted to bountySorted
    }

  Column(
    modifier =
      modifier
        .background(Color(0x99111C2D), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
        .padding(10.dp)
        .testTag("dossier_syndicate_history_section"),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
  ) {
    // 1. Syndicate Wars Direct Performance Card + 2-Column Ranking Comparison
    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
          .background(Color(0xCC0A1829), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .border(1.dp, Color(0x88F59E0B), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
          .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
          .testTag("dossier_syndicate_war_performance_card"),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(5.dp),
    ) {
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "🏆 SYNDICATE WARS DIRECT PERFORMANCE // [$cleanActiveTag]",
          color = Color(0xFFFBBF24),
          fontSize = 11.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
        )
        Text(
          text =
            "🏆 ${myWarRecord.warTrophies} WAR TROPHIES • ${myWarRecord.warWins}W - ${myWarRecord.warLosses}L • 🔥 ${myWarRecord.warStreak} STREAK",
          color = Color(0xFF00E676),
          fontSize = 10.5.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
        )
      }

      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
      ) {
        // Column 1: Direct Syndicate War Trophies Ladder
        Column(
          modifier =
            Modifier.weight(1f)
              .background(Color(0x9906101E), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .border(0.8.dp, Color(0x55F59E0B), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .padding(6.dp),
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "⚔️ DIRECT H2H WAR TROPHIES (TOP 4)",
            color = Color(0xFFFBBF24),
            fontSize = 9.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          )
          topByWarTrophies.forEachIndexed { idx, (syn, rec) ->
            Row(
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "#${idx + 1} [${syn.tag}] ${syn.name}",
                color = if (syn.tag == cleanActiveTag) Color(0xFF00F0FF) else Color.White,
                fontSize = 8.8.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
              Text(
                text = "🏆 ${rec.warTrophies} (${rec.warWins}W-${rec.warLosses}L)",
                color = Color(0xFFFBBF24),
                fontSize = 8.8.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
          }
        }

        // Column 2: Collective Member Bounty Prestige Ladder
        Column(
          modifier =
            Modifier.weight(1f)
              .background(Color(0x9906101E), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .border(0.8.dp, Color(0x5500F0FF), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .padding(6.dp),
          verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(2.dp),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "📊 COLLECTIVE MEMBER BOUNTY (TOP 4)",
            color = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
            fontSize = 9.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
          )
          topByCollectiveBounty.forEachIndexed { idx, (syn, _) ->
            Row(
              modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "#${idx + 1} [${syn.tag}] ${syn.name}",
                color = if (syn.tag == cleanActiveTag) Color(0xFFFFD700) else Color.White,
                fontSize = 8.8.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
              Text(
                text = "${syn.combinedBounty} BTY (${syn.memberCount}P)",
                color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                fontSize = 8.8.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
      Text(
        text = "🏛️ CHRONOLOGICAL SYNDICATE SERVICE RECORD (MOST RECENT FIRST)",
        color = Color(0xFF34D399),
        fontSize = 12.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
      )
      Text(
        text = "TOTAL COMMISSIONS: ${ordered.size}",
        color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
        fontSize = 10.5.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
      )
    }

    LazyColumn(
      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
    ) {
      itemsIndexed(ordered) { idx, item ->
        val isActive = item.isActive
        Row(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .background(
                if (isActive) Color(0xCC0B2822) else Color(0x990D1B30),
                RoundedCornerShape(9.dp),
              )
              .border(
                1.dp,
                if (isActive) Color(0xFF10B981) else Color(0x33FFFFFF),
                RoundedCornerShape(9.dp),
              )
              .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
          Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1.4f)) {
            Row(
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
            ) {
              Box(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.background(
                      if (isActive) Color(0xFF10B981) else Color(0xFF1E293B),
                      RoundedCornerShape(5.dp),
                    )
                    .padding(horizontal = 6.dp, vertical = 2.dp),
              ) {
                Text(
                  text = if (isActive) "ACTIVE" else "HONORABLE DISCHARGE",
                  color = if (isActive) Color(0xFF04130E) else Color(0xFF94A3B8),
                  fontSize = 8.5.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                )
              }
              Text(
                text = "[${item.syndicateTag}] ${item.syndicateName}",
                color = Color.White,
                fontSize = 12.5.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
            }
            val joinedStr = dateFormatter.format(Date(item.joinedTimestamp))
            val leftStr =
              if (isActive) "PRESENT" else dateFormatter.format(Date(item.leftTimestamp))
            Text(
              text = "ROLE: ${item.role.uppercase(Locale.US)} • COMMISSION: $joinedStr → $leftStr",
              color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
              fontSize = 10.sp,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
          }

          Row(
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          ) {
            Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End) {
              Text("TENURE", color = Color(0xFF94A3B8), fontSize = 8.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
              Text(
                text = item.formatTenure(nowMs),
                color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                fontSize = 11.5.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
            Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End) {
              Text("BANNER KILLS", color = Color(0xFF94A3B8), fontSize = 8.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
              Text(
                text = "${item.totalKills}",
                color = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
                fontSize = 11.5.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
            Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End) {
              Text("PEAK BOUNTY", color = Color(0xFF94A3B8), fontSize = 8.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
              Text(
                text = "${item.peakBountyAchieved}",
                color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
                fontSize = 11.5.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
            Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End) {
              Text("PUBLIC WINS", color = Color(0xFF94A3B8), fontSize = 8.5.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
              Text(
                text = "🏆 ${item.publicGameWins}",
                color = Color(0xFF00E676),
                fontSize = 11.5.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun DossierSectionButton(
  label: String,
  selected: Boolean,
  accentColor: Color,
  testTag: String,
  onClick: () -> Unit,
) {
  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .background(if (selected) accentColor else Color(0xCC101B2D))
        .border(
          1.dp,
          if (selected) accentColor else accentColor.copy(alpha = 0.45f),
          RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
        )
        .clickable { onClick() }
        .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
        .testTag(testTag),
  ) {
    Text(
      text = label,
      color = if (selected) Color(0xFF05080E) else accentColor,
      fontSize = 10.sp,
      fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
      fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
    )
  }
}

@Composable
fun FriendsArmadaModal(
  activeArmadaName: String,
  armadaTierLabel: String,
  armadaSlots: List<ArmadaMemberSlot>,
  friendsList: List<FriendPilotEntry>,
  blockedPilotUids: Set<String> = emptySet(),
  statusBanner: String?,
  onCreateOrRenameArmada: (String) -> Unit,
  onInviteFriendToArmada: (FriendPilotEntry) -> Unit,
  onRequestJoinFriendArmada: (FriendPilotEntry) -> Unit,
  onRemoveArmadaMember: (String) -> Unit,
  onSimulateRosterShift4To2: () -> Unit,
  onLeaveArmadaToSolo: () -> Unit,
  onAddFriendByCallsign: (String) -> Unit,
  onBlockPilot: (uid: String, callsign: String) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  onReportPilot: (uid: String, callsign: String) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  onCloseModal: () -> Unit,
