@Composable
fun SyndicatesModal(
  currentSyndicateTag: String,
  currentSyndicateName: String,
  remainingLockDays: Int,
  remainingLockFormatted: String,
  directoryList: List<SyndicateInfo>,
  rosterMembers: List<SyndicateMemberEntry>,
  activeShipsInSector: List<ShipEntity>,
  achievements: List<PilotAchievement>,
  statusBannerMessage: String?,
  onJoinSyndicate: (SyndicateInfo) -> Unit,
  onLeaveSyndicate: () -> Unit,
  onCreateCustomSyndicate: (tag: String, name: String, motto: String) -> Unit,
  onCloseModal: () -> Unit,
) {
  var activeTab by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
  val isGuestSyndicate = currentSyndicateTag == "GUEST" || currentSyndicateTag == "FREE"

  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        .background(Color(0xB3000000))
        .imePadding()
        .padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 10.dp)
        .testTag("syndicates_modal"),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {
    Surface(
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxSize()
          .border(1.dp, Color(0x6638BDF8), RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)),
      color = Color(0xE60A0F18), // #0A0F18 with 90% opacity glassmorphism
      shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
    ) {
      Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(14.dp)) {
        // 1. Header — Dedicated exclusively to Official Syndicate Allegiance & Standings
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        ) {
          Column {
            Text(
              text = "🏛️ SYNDICATE COMMAND // [$currentSyndicateTag] $currentSyndicateName",
              color = Color.White,
              fontSize = 18.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              letterSpacing = 1.2.sp,
            )
            Text(
              text =
                if (remainingLockDays > 0) {
                  "🔒 15-DAY SYNDICATE ALLEGIANCE LOCK ACTIVE: $remainingLockFormatted REMAINING"
                } else if (isGuestSyndicate) {
                  "⚠️ PLACEHOLDER [GUEST] SYNDICATE (ZERO PERKS / ZERO VAULT) • JOIN OR CHARTER TO UNLOCK"
                } else {
                  "🟢 ALLEGIANCE UNLOCKED (15d 00h COOLDOWN ON SWITCH)"
                },
              color =
                if (remainingLockDays > 0 || isGuestSyndicate) {
                  Color(0xFFF59E0B)
                } else {
                  Color(0xFF38BDF8)
                },
              fontSize = 11.5.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
            )
          }

          Button(
            onClick = onCloseModal,
            colors =
              ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                containerColor = Color(0xFF28111B),
                contentColor = Color(0xFFEF4444),
              ),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color(0xFFEF4444)),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
            modifier = Modifier.height(36.dp).testTag("syndicates_close_button"),
          ) {
            Text(
              text = "✕ CLOSE",
              fontSize = 11.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
            )
          }
        }

        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

        // 4 Dedicated Syndicate Command Tabs (Decoupled from Armada Fleet Deck)
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        ) {
          SyndicateTabButton(
            label = "1. DIRECTORY & JOIN",
            selected = activeTab == 0,
            onClick = { activeTab = 0 },
            tag = "syndicate_tab_directory",
          )
          SyndicateTabButton(
            label = "2. MY SYNDICATE ROSTER",
            selected = activeTab == 1,
            onClick = { activeTab = 1 },
            tag = "syndicate_tab_roster",
          )
          SyndicateTabButton(
            label = "3. SYNDICATE BOUNTIES & MEDALS",
            selected = activeTab == 2,
            onClick = { activeTab = 2 },
            tag = "syndicate_tab_bounties",
          )
          SyndicateTabButton(
            label = "4. CREATE SYNDICATE",
            selected = activeTab == 3,
            onClick = { activeTab = 3 },
            tag = "syndicate_tab_create",
          )
        }

        // Guest Syndicate Placeholder Notice Banner
        if (isGuestSyndicate) {
          Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .background(Color(0xFF1F1608), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .border(1.dp, Color(0x88F59E0B), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
          ) {
            Text(
              text =
                "ℹ️ [GUEST] SYNDICATE FRAMEWORK: Offers zero perks or shared vault benefits. Join or charter an active player Syndicate below to break free from [GUEST] (subject to 15-day allegiance lock).",
              color = Color(0xFFFDE68A),
              fontSize = 11.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
            )
          }
        }

        if (!statusBannerMessage.isNullOrBlank()) {
          Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .background(Color(0xFF102338), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .border(1.dp, Color(0x5538BDF8), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
          ) {
            Text(
              text = statusBannerMessage,
              color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
              fontSize = 12.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
            )
          }
        }

        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

        // Tab Body
        Box(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
          when (activeTab) {
            0 ->
              DirectoryAndJoinPane(
                currentSyndicateTag = currentSyndicateTag,
                remainingLockDays = remainingLockDays,
                remainingLockFormatted = remainingLockFormatted,
                directoryList = directoryList,
                onJoinSyndicate = onJoinSyndicate,
              )
            1 ->
              MySyndicateRosterPane(
                currentSyndicateTag = currentSyndicateTag,
                currentSyndicateName = currentSyndicateName,
                remainingLockDays = remainingLockDays,
                remainingLockFormatted = remainingLockFormatted,
                rosterMembers = rosterMembers,
                onLeaveSyndicate = onLeaveSyndicate,
              )
            2 ->
              BountyCalloutsAndAchievementsPane(
                activeShipsInSector = activeShipsInSector,
                achievements = achievements,
              )
            else ->
              CreateSyndicatePane(
                remainingLockDays = remainingLockDays,
                remainingLockFormatted = remainingLockFormatted,
                onCreateCustomSyndicate = onCreateCustomSyndicate,
              )
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
fun ArmadaFleetModal(
  currentSyndicateTag: String,
  activeArmadaName: String,
  armadaTierLabel: String,
  armadaSlots: List<ArmadaMemberSlot>,
  friendsList: List<FriendPilotEntry>,
  blockedPilotUids: Set<String> = emptySet(),
  statusBannerMessage: String?,
  onCreateOrRenameArmada: (String) -> Unit,
  onInviteFriendToArmada: (FriendPilotEntry) -> Unit,
  onRequestJoinFriendArmada: (FriendPilotEntry) -> Unit,
  onRemoveArmadaMember: (String) -> Unit,
  onSimulateRosterShift4To2: () -> Unit,
  onLeaveArmadaToSolo: () -> Unit,
  onAddFriendByCallsign: (String) -> Unit,
  onBlockPilot: (uid: String, callsign: String) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  onReportPilot: (uid: String, callsign: String) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  onCloseModal: () -> Unit,
) {
  val isDeployedInArmada = activeArmadaName.isNotEmpty() && armadaSlots.size >= 1

  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        .background(Color(0xB3000000))

        .padding(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 10.dp)
        .testTag("armada_fleet_modal"),
    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
  ) {

      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxSize()
          .border(1.dp, Color(0x663B82F6), RoundedCornerShape(16.dp)),
      color = Color(0xE60A0F18),
      shape = RoundedCornerShape(16.dp),
    ) {
      Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(14.dp)) {
        // 1. Header with Explicit Armada Membership Status Indicator
        Row(
          modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        ) {
          Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(
              text = "👥 ARMADA FLEET DECK // 1-TO-5-PLAYER STRIKE TEAM COMMAND",
              color = Color.White,
              fontSize = 18.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              letterSpacing = 1.2.sp,
            )
            Text(
              text =
                if (isDeployedInArmada) {
                  "🟢 [STATUS: DEPLOYED IN ARMADA: $activeArmadaName] (${armadaSlots.size}/5 PILOTS • $armadaTierLabel)"
                } else {
                  "⚡ [STATUS: OPERATING INDEPENDENTLY] (SOLO RIFT • FRIENDLY FIRE ACTIVE AGAINST NON-ALLIES)"
                },
              color = if (isDeployedInArmada) Color(0xFF10B981) else Color(0xFF60A5FA),
              fontSize = 12.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
          }

          Button(
            onClick = onCloseModal,
            colors =
              ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                containerColor = Color(0xFF28111B),
                contentColor = Color(0xFFEF4444),
              ),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color(0xFFEF4444)),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
            modifier = Modifier.height(36.dp).testTag("armada_modal_close_button"),
          ) {
            Text(
              text = "✕ CLOSE",
              fontSize = 11.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
            )
          }
        }

        if (!statusBannerMessage.isNullOrBlank()) {
          Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(6.dp))
          Box(
            modifier =
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .background(Color(0xFF102338), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .border(1.dp, Color(0x553B82F6), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
          ) {
            Text(
              text = statusBannerMessage,
              color = Color(0xFF60A5FA),
              fontSize = 12.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
            )
          }
        }

        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))

        Box(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) {
          ArmadaAndFriendsTabPane(
            activeArmadaName = activeArmadaName,
            armadaTierLabel = armadaTierLabel,
            armadaSlots = armadaSlots,
            friendsList = friendsList,
            blockedPilotUids = blockedPilotUids,
            onCreateOrRenameArmada = onCreateOrRenameArmada,
            onInviteFriendToArmada = onInviteFriendToArmada,
            onRequestJoinFriendArmada = onRequestJoinFriendArmada,
            onRemoveArmadaMember = onRemoveArmadaMember,
            onSimulateRosterShift4To2 = onSimulateRosterShift4To2,
            onLeaveArmadaToSolo = onLeaveArmadaToSolo,
            onAddFriendByCallsign = onAddFriendByCallsign,
            onBlockPilot = onBlockPilot,
            onReportPilot = onReportPilot,
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun DirectoryAndJoinPane(
  currentSyndicateTag: String,
  remainingLockDays: Int,
  remainingLockFormatted: String,
  directoryList: List<SyndicateInfo>,
  onJoinSyndicate: (SyndicateInfo) -> Unit,
) {
  val context = LocalContext.current
  val localPrefs = remember(context) { LocalPilotPrefs(context) }
  // 0 = SYNDICATE WARS (DIRECT H2H), 1 = COLLECTIVE MEMBER PRESTIGE
  var rankingMode by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }

  val mergedDirectory =
    remember(directoryList, currentSyndicateTag, rankingMode) {
      val byTag = linkedMapOf<String, SyndicateInfo>()
      val officialLadder =
        listOf(
          SyndicateInfo(
            id = "syn_aex",
            tag = "AEX",
            name = "Apex Vanguard",
            foundryOrigin = "Sector Command Syndicate",
            motto = "First into the Rift, last to yield.",
            memberCount = 18,
            combinedBounty = 14850L,
            isCustom = false,
          ),
          SyndicateInfo(
            id = "syn_obs",
            tag = "OBS",
            name = "Obsidian Core",
            foundryOrigin = "Heavy Siege Syndicate",
            motto = "Unbreakable containment across the sector.",
            memberCount = 15,
            combinedBounty = 12400L,
            isCustom = false,
          ),
          SyndicateInfo(
            id = "syn_sol",
            tag = "SOL",
            name = "Solaris Prime",
            foundryOrigin = "High-Velocity Strike Fleet",
            motto = "Velocity is the ultimate shield.",
            memberCount = 14,
            combinedBounty = 11650L,
            isCustom = false,
          ),
          SyndicateInfo(
            id = "syn_rft",
            tag = "RFT",
            name = "Rift Sentinels",
            foundryOrigin = "Stasis Breach Guardians",
            motto = "Hold the line at x = 4000.",
            memberCount = 12,
            combinedBounty = 10900L,
            isCustom = false,
          ),
        )
      for (item in directoryList) {
        val clean = item.tag.trim().uppercase()
        if (clean.isNotEmpty()) {
          byTag[clean] = item
        }
      }
      for (seed in officialLadder) {
        if (!byTag.containsKey(seed.tag)) {
          byTag[seed.tag] = seed
        }
      }
      val mapped =
        byTag.values.map { syn ->
          syn to localPrefs.getSyndicateWarRecord(syn.tag)
        }
      if (rankingMode == 0) {
        mapped.sortedWith(
          compareByDescending<Pair<SyndicateInfo, SyndicateWarRecord>> { it.second.warTrophies }
            .thenByDescending { it.second.warWins }
            .thenByDescending { it.first.combinedBounty }
        )
      } else {
        mapped.sortedWith(
          compareByDescending<Pair<SyndicateInfo, SyndicateWarRecord>> { it.first.combinedBounty }
            .thenByDescending { it.first.memberCount }
            .thenByDescending { it.second.warTrophies }
        )
      }
    }

  Column(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        .background(Color(0x99111C2D), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
        .padding(10.dp),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
  ) {
    // Segmented Ranking Mode Toggle: Direct H2H Syndicate Wars vs Collective Member Prestige
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
      Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .background(if (rankingMode == 0) Color(0xFFF59E0B) else Color(0xCC0D1B30))
              .border(
                1.dp,
                if (rankingMode == 0) Color(0xFFF59E0B) else Color(0x66F59E0B),
                RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              )
              .clickable { rankingMode = 0 }
              .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
              .testTag("syndicate_rank_mode_direct_h2h"),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "🏆 SYNDICATE WARS (DIRECT H2H)",
            color = if (rankingMode == 0) Color(0xFF05080E) else Color(0xFFFBBF24),
            fontSize = 10.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
          )
        }
        Box(
          modifier =
            Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .background(if (rankingMode == 1) Color(0xFF00F0FF) else Color(0xCC0D1B30))
              .border(
                1.dp,
                if (rankingMode == 1) Color(0xFF00F0FF) else Color(0x6600F0FF),
                RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              )
              .clickable { rankingMode = 1 }
              .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 6.dp)
              .testTag("syndicate_rank_mode_collective_prestige"),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "📊 COLLECTIVE MEMBER PRESTIGE",
            color = if (rankingMode == 1) Color(0xFF05080E) else Color(0xFF00F0FF),
            fontSize = 10.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
          )
        }
      }

      Text(
        text =
          if (rankingMode == 0) {
            "RANKED BY DIRECT H2H WAR TROPHIES (1–5 STRIKE FLEET & 10v10 STASIS BREACH)"
          } else {
            "RANKED BY COMBINED MEMBER BOUNTY & ROSTER SIZE"
          },
        color = Color(0xFF94A3B8),
        fontSize = 9.5.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
      )
    }

    LazyColumn(
      modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
    ) {
      items(mergedDirectory, key = { it.first.tag }) { (syn, warRecord) ->
        val isMember = syn.tag.equals(currentSyndicateTag, ignoreCase = true)
        Row(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .background(
                if (isMember) Color(0xCC142C4C) else Color(0x990D1B30),
                RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
              )
              .border(
                1.dp,
                if (isMember) Color(0xFFFFD700) else Color(0x3338BDF8),
                RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
              )
              .padding(12.dp),
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        ) {
          Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Row(
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "[${syn.tag}] ${syn.name}",
                color = if (isMember) Color(0xFFFFD700) else Color(0xFF00F0FF),
                fontSize = 15.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
              Text(
                text =
                  "🏆 ${warRecord.warTrophies} WAR TROPHIES • ${warRecord.warWins}W - ${warRecord.warLosses}L • 🔥 ${warRecord.warStreak} STREAK",
                color = Color(0xFFFBBF24),
                fontSize = 11.5.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.ExtraBold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
            }
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(3.dp))
            Row(
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "${syn.memberCount} PILOTS • ${syn.combinedBounty} TOTAL BOUNTY",
                color = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                fontSize = 11.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              )
              Text(
                text = "// ${syn.motto.uppercase()}",
                color = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
                fontSize = 10.5.sp,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
            }
          }

          if (isMember) {
            Box(
              modifier =
                Modifier.background(Color(0xFF1E3E24), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp)
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "✓ ENLISTED",
                color = Color(0xFF00E676),
                fontSize = 11.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
            }
          } else {
            Button(
              onClick = { onJoinSyndicate(syn) },
              enabled = remainingLockDays <= 0,
              colors =
                ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                  containerColor = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
                  contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
                  disabledContainerColor = Color(0xFF1A283B),
                  disabledContentColor = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
                ),
              shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              modifier = Modifier.height(38.dp).testTag("join_syndicate_${syn.tag}"),
            ) {
              Text(
                text =
                  if (remainingLockDays > 0) {
                    "LOCKED ($remainingLockFormatted)"
                  } else {
                    "JOIN [${syn.tag}]"
                  },
                fontSize = 11.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun MySyndicateRosterPane(
  currentSyndicateTag: String,
  currentSyndicateName: String,
  remainingLockDays: Int,
  remainingLockFormatted: String,
  rosterMembers: List<SyndicateMemberEntry>,
  onLeaveSyndicate: () -> Unit,
) {
  Column(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        .background(Color(0x99111C2D), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
        .padding(12.dp)
  ) {
    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
    ) {
      Text(
        text = "ACTIVE ROSTER // [$currentSyndicateTag] $currentSyndicateName (${rosterMembers.size} MEMBERS)",
        color = Color.White,
        fontSize = 16.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
      )

      if (currentSyndicateTag != "FREE" && currentSyndicateTag != "GUEST") {
        Button(
          onClick = onLeaveSyndicate,
          enabled = remainingLockDays <= 0,
          colors =
            ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
              containerColor = Color(0xFF2B121D),
              contentColor = Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
              disabledContainerColor = Color(0xFF1A283B),
              disabledContentColor = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
            ),
          shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
          modifier = Modifier.height(34.dp).testTag("leave_syndicate_button"),
        ) {
          Text(
            text =
              if (remainingLockDays > 0) {
                "LEAVE LOCKED ($remainingLockFormatted)"
              } else {
                "LEAVE SYNDICATE ➔ [GUEST] (15d 00h LOCK)"
              },
            fontSize = 10.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
          )
        }
      }
    }
    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
    LazyColumn(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
      items(rosterMembers, key = { it.uid }) { member ->
        val shipSpec = RiftCodex.getShipById(member.shipId)
        Row(
          modifier =
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
              .background(Color(0x990D1B30), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
              .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        ) {
          Row(
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
          ) {
            ShipSpritePreview(shipId = member.shipId, sizeDp = 30)
            Column {
              Text(
                text = "[$currentSyndicateTag] ${member.callsign} • ${member.role}",
                color = Color.White,
                fontSize = 13.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
              Text(
                text = "HULL: ${shipSpec.name.uppercase()} (${shipSpec.role.uppercase()})",
                color = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
                fontSize = 11.sp,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
            }
          }
          Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(14.dp)) {
            Text(
              text = "KILLS: ${member.kills}",
              color = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
              fontSize = 14.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
            Text(
              text = "BOUNTY: ${member.bountyContribution}",
              color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              fontSize = 14.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun BountyCalloutsAndAchievementsPane(
  activeShipsInSector: List<ShipEntity>,
  achievements: List<PilotAchievement>,
) {
  val hvts =
    remember(activeShipsInSector) {
      activeShipsInSector
        .filter { it.bounty >= RiftGameEngine.HVT_BOUNTY_THRESHOLD }
        .sortedByDescending { it.bounty }
    }

  Row(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
  ) {
    // Left Half: Sector High-Value Targets (Bounty >= 250)
    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.weight(1f)
          .fillMaxSize()
          .background(Color(0x99111C2D), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
          .padding(10.dp)
    ) {
      Text(
        text = "★ SECTOR HIGH-VALUE TARGETS (BOUNTY >= 250)",
        color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
        fontSize = 14.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
      )
      Text(
        text = "ELIMINATE HVTS FOR MASSIVE BOUNTY PAYOUTS & GOLD SONAR PINGS.",
        color = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
        fontSize = 11.sp,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
      )
      Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
      LazyColumn(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
        items(hvts, key = { it.id }) { hvt ->
          Row(
            modifier =
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .background(Color(0x991A1812), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                .padding(8.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          ) {
            Row(
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
            ) {
              ShipSpritePreview(shipId = hvt.shipId, sizeDp = 28)
              Column {
                val armTag = if (hvt.armadaName.isNotEmpty()) "[${hvt.armadaName}]" else "[SOLO]"
                Text(
                  text = "★ $armTag [${hvt.syndicateTag}] ${hvt.callsign}",
                  color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
                  fontSize = 13.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                )
                Text(
                  text =
                    "HULL: ${hvt.spec.name.uppercase()} • SECTOR (${(hvt.x / 500f).toInt()},${(hvt.y / 500f).toInt()})",
                  color = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
                  fontSize = 11.sp,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                )
              }
            }
            Text(
              text = "${hvt.bounty} BTY",
              color = Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
              fontSize = 14.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Right Half: Pilot Achievements
    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.weight(1f)
          .fillMaxSize()
          .background(Color(0x99111C2D), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
          .padding(10.dp)
    ) {
      Text(
        text = "🏆 PILOT COMBAT ACHIEVEMENTS",
        color = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
        fontSize = 14.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
      )
      Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(8.dp))
      LazyColumn(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
        items(achievements, key = { it.id }) { ach ->
          Row(
            modifier =
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .background(
                  if (ach.unlocked) Color(0x990E2938) else Color(0x990D1B30),
                  RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                )
                .padding(8.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
              Text(
                text = if (ach.unlocked) "✓ ${ach.title}" else "🔒 ${ach.title}",
                color = if (ach.unlocked) Color(0xFF00E676) else Color(0xFF00F0FF),
                fontSize = 13.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
              Text(
                text = ach.description.uppercase(),
                color = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
                fontSize = 10.5.sp,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
            }

              text = ach.progressText,
              color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              fontSize = 13.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun CreateSyndicatePane(
  remainingLockDays: Int,
  remainingLockFormatted: String,
  onCreateCustomSyndicate: (tag: String, name: String, motto: String) -> Unit,
) {
  // P0 CRITICAL FIX: Pre-Mount Form Lockout on 15-Day Syndicate Cooldown!
  // Check remainingLockDays > 0 BEFORE enabling form inputs.
  val isCooldownLocked = remainingLockDays > 0

  var tagInput by remember { mutableStateOf("NOVA") }
  var nameInput by remember { mutableStateOf("NOVA VANGUARD") }
  var mottoInput by remember { mutableStateOf("Strike from the event horizon.") }
  var anyFieldFocused by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

  val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
  val keyboardController = LocalSoftwareKeyboardController.current

  Column(
    modifier =
      Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        .background(Color(0x99111C2D), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
        .padding(14.dp),
    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
  ) {
    // Prominent Amber Lock Banner at the top of the tab when 15-day cooldown is active
    if (isCooldownLocked) {
      Box(
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .background(Color(0xFF2B1C08), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
            .border(1.5.dp, Color(0xFFF59E0B), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
            .padding(horizontal = 14.dp, vertical = 10.dp)
            .testTag("syndicate_charter_locked_banner")
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "🔒 Syndicate chartering locked until 15-day cooldown expiry ($remainingLockFormatted REMAINING)",
          color = Color(0xFFF59E0B),
          fontSize = 13.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
        )
      }
    }

    Row(
      modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
      horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
      verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
      Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
        Text(
          text = "CHARTER NEW OFFICIAL SYNDICATE (STRICT 15d 00h ALLEGIANCE LOCK)",
          color = Color.White,
          fontSize = 16.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
        )
        Text(
          text =
            "CREATING A SYNDICATE REGISTERS YOUR 3–4 LETTER [TAG] AND LOCKS ALLEGIANCE FOR 15d 00h.",
          color = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
          fontSize = 11.sp,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
        )
      }

      if (anyFieldFocused && !isCooldownLocked) {
        Button(
          onClick = {
            focusManager.clearFocus()
            keyboardController?.hide()
          },
          colors =
            ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
              containerColor = Color(0xFF00E676),
              contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
            ),
          shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
          modifier = Modifier.height(38.dp).testTag("create_syndicate_done_button"),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "✓ DONE",
            fontSize = 11.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
          )
        }
      }
    }

    // Form container drops opacity to 0.4f and disables all inputs when locked so soft keyboard never opens on tap
    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
          .alpha(if (isCooldownLocked) 0.4f else 1.0f),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
    ) {
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
      ) {
        OutlinedTextField(
          value = tagInput,
          onValueChange = { raw ->
            if (!isCooldownLocked) {
              tagInput = raw.uppercase().replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9]"), "").take(4)
            }
          },
          enabled = !isCooldownLocked,
          readOnly = isCooldownLocked,
          singleLine = true,
          keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(imeAction = ImeAction.Done),
          keyboardActions =
            KeyboardActions(
              onDone = {
                focusManager.clearFocus()
                keyboardController?.hide()
              }
            ),
          label = { Text("TAG (3-4 CHARS)", fontSize = 10.sp, fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif) },
          textStyle =
            TextStyle(
              color = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              fontSize = 14.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            ),
          colors =
            OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors(
              focusedBorderColor = Color(0xFFFFD700),
              unfocusedBorderColor = Color(0xFF2B4C73),
              disabledBorderColor = Color(0xFF1E2D42),
              disabledTextColor = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
              disabledLabelColor = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
            ),
          modifier =
            Modifier.width(160.dp)
              .onFocusChanged { anyFieldFocused = it.isFocused }
              .testTag("create_syndicate_tag_input"),
        )

        OutlinedTextField(
          value = nameInput,
          onValueChange = { raw ->
            if (!isCooldownLocked) {
              nameInput = raw.take(24)
            }
          },
          enabled = !isCooldownLocked,
          readOnly = isCooldownLocked,
          singleLine = true,
          keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(imeAction = ImeAction.Done),
          keyboardActions =
            KeyboardActions(
              onDone = {
                focusManager.clearFocus()
                keyboardController?.hide()
              }
            ),
          label = { Text("SYNDICATE NAME", fontSize = 10.sp, fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif) },
          textStyle =
            TextStyle(
              color = Color.White,
              fontSize = 14.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
            ),
          colors =
            OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors(
              focusedBorderColor = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
              unfocusedBorderColor = Color(0xFF2B4C73),
              disabledBorderColor = Color(0xFF1E2D42),
              disabledTextColor = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
              disabledLabelColor = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
            ),
          modifier =
            Modifier.weight(1f)
              .onFocusChanged { anyFieldFocused = it.isFocused }
              .testTag("create_syndicate_name_input"),
        )
      }

      OutlinedTextField(
        value = mottoInput,
        onValueChange = { raw ->
          if (!isCooldownLocked) {
            mottoInput = raw.take(60)
          }
        },
        enabled = !isCooldownLocked,
        readOnly = isCooldownLocked,
        singleLine = true,
        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(imeAction = ImeAction.Done),
        keyboardActions =
          KeyboardActions(
            onDone = {
              focusManager.clearFocus()
              keyboardController?.hide()
            }
          ),
        label = { Text("SYNDICATE DOCTRINE / MOTTO", fontSize = 10.sp, fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif) },
        textStyle =
          TextStyle(
            color = Color(0xFFD6E4F0),
            fontSize = 12.sp,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
          ),
        colors =
          OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors(
            focusedBorderColor = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
            unfocusedBorderColor = Color(0xFF2B4C73),
            disabledBorderColor = Color(0xFF1E2D42),
            disabledTextColor = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
            disabledLabelColor = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
          ),
        modifier =
          Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            .onFocusChanged { anyFieldFocused = it.isFocused }
            .testTag("create_syndicate_motto_input"),
      )

      Button(
        onClick = { onCreateCustomSyndicate(tagInput, nameInput, mottoInput) },
        enabled = !isCooldownLocked && tagInput.length >= 3 && nameInput.length >= 3,
        colors =
          ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
            containerColor = Color(0xFFFFD700),
            contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
            disabledContainerColor = Color(0xFF1A283B),
            disabledContentColor = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
          ),
        shape = RoundedCornerShape(10.dp),
        modifier = Modifier.height(46.dp).fillMaxWidth().testTag("create_syndicate_submit_button"),
      ) {
        Text(
          text =
            if (isCooldownLocked) {
              "🔒 SYNDICATE CHARTERING LOCKED: COOLDOWN ACTIVE ($remainingLockFormatted REMAINING)"
            } else {
              "🏛️ CHARTER [$tagInput] ${nameInput.uppercase()} & LOCK FOR 15d 00h"
            },
          fontSize = 12.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun ArmadaAndFriendsTabPane(
  activeArmadaName: String,
  armadaTierLabel: String,
  armadaSlots: List<ArmadaMemberSlot>,
  friendsList: List<FriendPilotEntry>,
  blockedPilotUids: Set<String> = emptySet(),
  onCreateOrRenameArmada: (String) -> Unit,
  onInviteFriendToArmada: (FriendPilotEntry) -> Unit,
  onRequestJoinFriendArmada: (FriendPilotEntry) -> Unit,
  onRemoveArmadaMember: (String) -> Unit,
  onSimulateRosterShift4To2: () -> Unit,
  onLeaveArmadaToSolo: () -> Unit,
  onAddFriendByCallsign: (String) -> Unit,
  onBlockPilot: (uid: String, callsign: String) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
  onReportPilot: (uid: String, callsign: String) -> Unit = { _, _ -> },
) {
  val visibleFriends =
    remember(friendsList, blockedPilotUids) {
      friendsList.filter { it.uid !in blockedPilotUids }
    }
  var armadaNameInput by remember(activeArmadaName) {
    mutableStateOf(activeArmadaName.ifEmpty { "APEX_5" })
  }
  var newFriendInput by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
  var inputFocused by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

  // P3: 10-second anti-spam cooldown state map for Semantic Invite & Request buttons
  val buttonCooldownSec = remember { mutableStateMapOf<String, Int>() }

  LaunchedEffect(buttonCooldownSec.keys.toList()) {
    while (buttonCooldownSec.isNotEmpty()) {
      delay(1000L)
      val keys = buttonCooldownSec.keys.toList()
      for (k in keys) {
        val rem = (buttonCooldownSec[k] ?: 0) - 1
        if (rem <= 0) {
          buttonCooldownSec.remove(k)
        } else {
          buttonCooldownSec[k] = rem
        }
      }
    }
  }

  val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
  val keyboardController = LocalSoftwareKeyboardController.current

  Row(
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
  ) {
    // Left Column: Active Named Armada Roster (2 to 5 Players or [SOLO])
    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.width(305.dp)
          .fillMaxHeight()
          .background(Color(0x99111C2D), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
          .padding(12.dp),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
    ) {
      Text(
        text =
          if (activeArmadaName.isEmpty()) {
            "⚡ [STATUS: OPERATING INDEPENDENTLY]"
          } else {
            "🛡️ [STATUS: DEPLOYED IN ARMADA: $activeArmadaName] (${armadaSlots.size}/5)"
          },
        color = if (activeArmadaName.isEmpty()) Color(0xFF60A5FA) else Color(0xFF10B981),
        fontSize = 12.sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
      )

      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
      ) {
        OutlinedTextField(
          value = armadaNameInput,
          onValueChange = { raw ->
            armadaNameInput = raw.uppercase().replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_-]"), "").take(10)
          },
          singleLine = true,
          keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(imeAction = ImeAction.Done),
          keyboardActions =
            KeyboardActions(
              onDone = {
                focusManager.clearFocus()
                keyboardController?.hide()
              }
            ),
          label = { Text("ARMADA TAG", fontSize = 9.sp, fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif) },
          textStyle =
            TextStyle(
              color = Color.White,
              fontSize = 12.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            ),
          colors =
            OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors(
              focusedBorderColor = Color(0xFF38BDF8),
              unfocusedBorderColor = Color(0xFF223B59),
            ),
          modifier =
            Modifier.weight(1f)
              .onFocusChanged { inputFocused = it.isFocused }
              .testTag("armada_name_input"),
        )

        Button(
          onClick = {
            focusManager.clearFocus()
            keyboardController?.hide()
            onCreateOrRenameArmada(armadaNameInput)
          },
          colors =
            ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
              containerColor = Color(0xFF10B981),
              contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
            ),
          shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
          modifier = Modifier.height(44.dp).testTag("form_armada_button"),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = if (activeArmadaName.isEmpty()) "CREATE ARMADA" else "JOIN / RENAME",
            fontSize = 9.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
          )
        }
      }

      LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
      ) {
        if (armadaSlots.isEmpty()) {
          item {
            Box(
              modifier =
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                  .background(Color(0x660B1524), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .padding(10.dp)
            ) {
              Text(
                text =
                  "FLYING [SOLO] IN THE FFA RIFT.\nINVITE FRIENDS ON THE RIGHT TO FORM A 2-TO-5-MAN NAMED ARMADA.",
                color = Color(0xFF8A99AD),
                fontSize = 10.5.sp,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
            }
          }
        } else {
          items(armadaSlots, key = { it.uid }) { slot ->
            Row(
              modifier =
                Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                  .background(Color(0x990D1B30), RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
                  .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 7.dp),
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
            ) {
              Row(
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
              ) {
                ShipSpritePreview(shipId = slot.shipId, sizeDp = 24)
                Column {
                  Text(
                    text = "[${slot.syndicateTag}] ${slot.callsign}",
                    color = if (slot.isLeader) Color(0xFFFFD700) else Color.White,
                    fontSize = 12.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                  )
                  Text(
                    text = if (slot.isLeader) "ARMADA COMMANDER" else "WINGMAN ACTIVE",
                    color = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
                    fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                  )
                }
              }

              if (!slot.isLeader) {
                Button(
                  onClick = { onRemoveArmadaMember(slot.callsign) },
                  colors =
                    ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                      containerColor = Color(0xFF2D1420),
                      contentColor = Color(0xFFFF3B4E),
                    ),
                  shape = RoundedCornerShape(6.dp),
                  modifier = Modifier.height(30.dp),
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text = "DROP",
                    fontSize = 9.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                  )
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // Adaptive Roster Shifting & Solo Controls
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
      ) {
        Button(
          onClick = onSimulateRosterShift4To2,
          colors =
            ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
              containerColor = Color(0xFF162B46),
              contentColor = Color(0xFFFFD700),
            ),
          shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
          modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).height(38.dp).testTag("simulate_roster_shift_button"),
        ) {
          Text(
            text = "⚡ SHIFT 4➔2 TIER",
            fontSize = 9.5.sp,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
          )
        }

        if (activeArmadaName.isNotEmpty()) {
          Button(
            onClick = onLeaveArmadaToSolo,
            colors =
              ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                containerColor = Color(0xFF281520),
                contentColor = Color(0xFFEF4444),
              ),
            border = BorderStroke(1.dp, Color(0xFFEF4444)),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
            modifier = Modifier.height(38.dp).testTag("leave_armada_solo_button"),
          ) {
            Text(
              text = "LEAVE ARMADA",
              fontSize = 9.5.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Right Column: Friends List, [✓ DONE] Keyboard Bar & P3 Semantic Invite Buttons with 10s Anti-Spam Cooldown
    Column(
      modifier =
        Modifier.weight(1f)
          .fillMaxHeight()
          .background(Color(0x99111C2D), RoundedCornerShape(12.dp))
          .padding(12.dp),
      verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
    ) {
      Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
      ) {
        Text(
          text = "ONLINE FRIENDS & ARMADA RECRUITMENT (${visibleFriends.count { it.isOnline }} ONLINE)",
          color = Color.White,
          fontSize = 14.sp,
          fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
          fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
        )

        Row(
          verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
          horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
        ) {
          OutlinedTextField(
            value = newFriendInput,
            onValueChange = { raw ->
              newFriendInput = raw.uppercase().replace(Regex("[^A-Z0-9_-]"), "").take(14)
            },
            singleLine = true,
            keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(imeAction = ImeAction.Done),
            keyboardActions =
              KeyboardActions(
                onDone = {
                  focusManager.clearFocus()
                  keyboardController?.hide()
                }
              ),
            placeholder = {
              Text("SEARCH / ADD CALLSIGN", fontSize = 9.sp, fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif)
            },
            textStyle =
              TextStyle(
                color = Color.White,
                fontSize = 11.sp,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
              ),
            colors =
              OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors(
                focusedBorderColor = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
                unfocusedBorderColor = Color(0xFF223B59),
              ),
            modifier =
              Modifier.width(155.dp)
                .height(46.dp)
                .onFocusChanged { inputFocused = it.isFocused }
                .testTag("friend_search_input"),
          )

          Button(
            onClick = {
              if (newFriendInput.length >= 3) {
                onAddFriendByCallsign(newFriendInput)
                newFriendInput = ""
              }
              focusManager.clearFocus()
              keyboardController?.hide()
            },
            colors =
              ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                containerColor = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
                contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
              ),
            shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
            modifier = Modifier.height(40.dp),
          ) {
            Text(
              text = "+ ADD",
              fontSize = 10.sp,
              fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
              fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
            )
          }

          if (inputFocused) {
            Button(
              onClick = {
                focusManager.clearFocus()
                keyboardController?.hide()
              },
              colors =
                ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                  containerColor = Color(0xFF00E676),
                  contentColor = Color(0xFF05080E),
                ),
              shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
              modifier = Modifier.height(40.dp).testTag("friend_input_done_button"),
            ) {
              Text(
                text = "✓ DONE",
                fontSize = 10.sp,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }

      LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
      ) {
        items(visibleFriends, key = { it.uid }) { friend ->
          val reqKey = "req_${friend.uid}"
          val invKey = "inv_${friend.uid}"
          val reqRem = buttonCooldownSec[reqKey] ?: 0
          val invRem = buttonCooldownSec[invKey] ?: 0

          Row(
            modifier =
              Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                .background(Color(0x990D1B30), RoundedCornerShape(10.dp))
                .padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
          ) {
            Row(
              verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
              horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp),
              modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            ) {
              Box(
                modifier =
                  Modifier.size(10.dp)
                    .clip(CircleShape)
                    .background(if (friend.isOnline) Color(0xFF00E676) else Color(0xFF546E7A))
              )
              ShipSpritePreview(shipId = friend.shipId, sizeDp = 28)
              Column {
                Text(
                  text =
                    if (friend.currentArmadaName.isNotEmpty()) {
                      "[${friend.currentArmadaName}] [${friend.syndicateTag}] ${friend.callsign}"
                    } else {
                      "[SOLO] [${friend.syndicateTag}] ${friend.callsign}"
                    },
                  color = Color.White,
                  fontSize = 13.sp,
                  fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                )
                Text(
                  text = friend.statusText.uppercase(),
                  color = if (friend.isOnline) Color(0xFF8A99AD) else Color(0xFF607D8B),
                  fontSize = 10.5.sp,
                  fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                )
              }
            }

            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
              if (friend.isOnline) {
                // Phase 4.3 Inbound Join Request ([⇥ REQUEST INVITE]): Deep Indigo background with crisp Cyan border (#38BDF8)
                if (friend.currentArmadaName.isNotEmpty() && friend.currentArmadaCount < 5) {
                  val reqLocked = reqRem > 0
                  Button(
                    onClick = {
                      buttonCooldownSec[reqKey] = 10
                      onRequestJoinFriendArmada(friend)
                    },
                    enabled = !reqLocked,
                    colors =
                      ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                        containerColor = if (reqLocked) Color(0xFF332409) else Color(0xFF121A3A),
                        contentColor = if (reqLocked) Color(0xFFF59E0B) else Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                        disabledContainerColor = Color(0xFF332409),
                        disabledContentColor = Color(0xFFF59E0B),
                      ),
                    border =
                      BorderStroke(
                        1.dp,
                        if (reqLocked) Color(0xFFF59E0B) else Color(0xFF38BDF8),
                      ),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                    modifier = Modifier.height(34.dp).testTag("request_join_friend_${friend.callsign}"),
                  ) {
                    Text(
                      text =
                        if (reqLocked) {
                          "⏳ INVITE SENT - ${reqRem}s"
                        } else {
                          "⇥ REQUEST INVITE"
                        },
                      fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                      fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                    )
                  }
                }

                // Phase 4.3 Outbound Recruit ([+ INVITE TO ARMADA]): Bright Emerald Green fill (#10B981, dark text #05080E)
                val invLocked = invRem > 0
                Button(
                  onClick = {
                    buttonCooldownSec[invKey] = 10
                    onInviteFriendToArmada(friend)
                  },
                  enabled = !invLocked,
                  colors =
                    ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                      containerColor = if (invLocked) Color(0xFF332409) else Color(0xFF10B981),
                      contentColor = if (invLocked) Color(0xFFF59E0B) else Color(0xFF05080E),
                      disabledContainerColor = Color(0xFF332409),
                      disabledContentColor = Color(0xFFF59E0B),
                    ),
                  shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                  modifier = Modifier.height(34.dp).testTag("invite_friend_${friend.callsign}"),
                ) {
                  Text(
                    text =
                      if (invLocked) {
                        "⏳ INVITE SENT - ${invRem}s"
                      } else {
                        "+ INVITE TO ARMADA"
                      },
                    fontSize = 9.5.sp,
                    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
                    fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
                  )
                }
              }

              Button(
                onClick = { onReportPilot(friend.uid, friend.callsign) },
                colors =
                  ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                    containerColor = Color(0xFF2B1C08),
                    contentColor = Color(0xFFF59E0B),
                  ),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 8.dp),
                modifier = Modifier.height(34.dp).testTag("report_armada_friend_${friend.uid}"),
              ) {
                Text("⚑", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
              }

              Button(
                onClick = { onBlockPilot(friend.uid, friend.callsign) },
                colors =
                  ButtonDefaults.buttonColors(
                    containerColor = Color(0xFF28111B),
                    contentColor = Color(0xFFEF4444),
                  ),
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 8.dp),
                modifier = Modifier.height(34.dp).testTag("block_armada_friend_${friend.uid}"),
              ) {
                Text("🚫", fontSize = 11.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

@Composable
private fun SyndicateTabButton(
  label: String,
  selected: Boolean,
  onClick: () -> Unit,
  tag: String,
) {
  Box(
    modifier =
      Modifier.clip(RoundedCornerShape(8.dp))
        .background(if (selected) Color(0xFFFFD700) else Color(0x99111C2D))
        .border(
          1.dp,
          if (selected) Color(0xFFFFD700) else Color(0x33FFFFFF),
          RoundedCornerShape(8.dp),
        )
        .clickable { onClick() }
        .padding(horizontal = 10.dp, vertical = 7.dp)
        .testTag(tag),
  ) {
    Text(
      text = label,
      color = if (selected) Color(0xFF05080E) else Color.White,
      fontSize = 10.sp,
      fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
      fontFamily = FontFamily.SansSerif,
    )
  }
}

package com.example.ui.theme

import android.os.Build
import androidx.compose.foundation.isSystemInDarkTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.darkColorScheme
import androidx.compose.material3.dynamicDarkColorScheme
import androidx.compose.material3.dynamicLightColorScheme
import androidx.compose.material3.lightColorScheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext

private val DarkColorScheme =
  darkColorScheme(primary = Purple80, secondary = PurpleGrey80, tertiary = Pink80)

private val LightColorScheme =
  lightColorScheme(
    primary = Purple40,
    secondary = PurpleGrey40,
    tertiary = Pink40,

    /* Other default colors to override
    background = Color(0xFFFFFBFE),
    surface = Color(0xFFFFFBFE),
    onPrimary = Color.White,
    onSecondary = Color.White,
    onTertiary = Color.White,
    onBackground = Color(0xFF1C1B1F),
    onSurface = Color(0xFF1C1B1F),
    */
  )

@Composable
fun MyApplicationTheme(
  darkTheme: Boolean = isSystemInDarkTheme(),
  // Dynamic color is available on Android 12+
  dynamicColor: Boolean = true,
  content: @Composable () -> Unit,
) {
  val colorScheme =
    when {
      dynamicColor && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S -> {
        val context = LocalContext.current
        if (darkTheme) dynamicDarkColorScheme(context) else dynamicLightColorScheme(context)
      }

      darkTheme -> DarkColorScheme
      else -> LightColorScheme
    }

  MaterialTheme(colorScheme = colorScheme, typography = Typography, content = content)
}

### FILE: app/src/test/java/com/example/RiftAuditConsistencyTest.kt
```
package com.example

import android.content.Context
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import com.example.data.LocalPilotPrefs
import com.example.data.UgcModeration
import com.example.engine.AnomalyType
import com.example.engine.RiftCalibrationState
import com.example.engine.RiftCodex
import com.example.engine.RiftGameEngine
import com.example.engine.RiftSoundSynthesizer
import com.example.engine.SpatialAnomalyEntity
import com.example.engine.WallRect
import kotlin.math.hypot
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(sdk = [36])
class RiftAuditConsistencyTest {

  private lateinit var context: Context
  private lateinit var engine: RiftGameEngine

  @Before
  fun setUp() {
    context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext()
    RiftCalibrationState.resetAll(context = null, engine = null)
    engine = RiftGameEngine(sfx = RiftSoundSynthesizer())
    engine.rebuildRosterForMode("FFA")
    engine.anomalies.clear()
  }

  @After
  fun tearDown() {
    RiftCalibrationState.resetAll(context = null, engine = null)
  }

  @Test
  fun `zero friction coasting persists when left stick is released and only brakes via manual button`() {
    engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(1, forceFromHangar = true)
    val player = engine.localPlayer
    player.x = 2000f
    player.y = 2000f
    player.vx = 420f
    player.vy = -160f

    // Ensure no stick drag and no manual brake: velocity must NOT decay over multiple updates
    engine.leftStickActive = false
    engine.leftStickMag = 0f
    repeat(10) { engine.stepSimulation(0.016f) }
    assertFalse(engine.autoBraking)
    assertEquals(420f, player.vx, 1.0f)
    assertEquals(-160f, player.vy, 1.0f)

    // Engaging manual [BRAKE] slows velocity down cleanly
    engine.engageManualBrake()
    assertTrue(engine.autoBraking)
    repeat(15) { engine.stepSimulation(0.016f) }
    assertTrue(hypot(player.vx, player.vy) < hypot(420f, -160f) * 0.7f)
  }

  @Test
  fun `viper phase dash cancels brake raises speed cap and primes overcharge`() {
    engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(1, forceFromHangar = true)
    val player = engine.localPlayer
    player.x = 2200f
    player.y = 2200f
    player.vx = 250f
    player.vy = 0f
    player.angle = 0f
    player.bombTimer = 0f
    player.flux = player.maxFlux
    engine.engageManualBrake()
    assertTrue(engine.autoBraking)

    engine.fireSecondaryBomb(player, 0f)

    assertFalse(engine.autoBraking)
    assertTrue(player.phaseDashTimer > 0.30f)
    assertTrue(player.phaseShieldTimer > 0.50f)
    assertTrue(player.sniperOverchargeReady)
    val speedAfter = hypot(player.vx, player.vy)
    assertTrue("Phase Dash speed should exceed normal topSpeed", speedAfter > player.spec.topSpeed)

    // Advance physics a few frames while Phase Dash window is active: burst speed must not be clamped to topSpeed
    repeat(5) { engine.stepSimulation(0.016f) }
    assertTrue(hypot(player.vx, player.vy) > player.spec.topSpeed)
  }

  @Test
  fun `disruptor cloak and zero-flux decloak emp work on button tap and primary fire pull`() {
    engine.anomalies.clear()
    engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(6, forceFromHangar = true)
    val player = engine.localPlayer
    player.x = 2000f
    player.y = 2000f
    player.flux = 400f
    assertFalse(player.isCloaked)

    // Enemy within 220px radius
    val enemy = engine.ships.first { !it.isLocalPlayer }
    engine.ships.retainAll { it === player || it === enemy }
    enemy.respawnTimer = 0f
    enemy.x = 2120f
    enemy.y = 2000f
    enemy.flux = enemy.maxFlux
    val enemyStartFlux = enemy.flux

    // Tap to cloak
    engine.fireSecondaryBomb(player, 0f)
    assertTrue(player.isCloaked)

    // Drop Flux below 350 (above 150 floor) and pull Primary Fire trigger -> must still detonate EMP at 0 Flux cost
    player.flux = 240f
    player.gunTimer = 0f
    val shockwavesBefore = engine.shockwaves.size
    engine.firePrimaryGun(player)

    assertFalse(player.isCloaked)
    // Only primary gun cost is deducted; EMP Pulse itself costs 0⚡
    assertEquals(240f - player.spec.primaryCost, player.flux, 0.5f)
    assertTrue(engine.shockwaves.size > shockwavesBefore)
    assertTrue("Enemy Flux should drop by 35% Max Flux", enemy.flux < enemyStartFlux)
    assertTrue("Enemy should receive 2.5s EMP recharge lock", enemy.empTimer >= 2.4f)
  }

  @Test
  fun `disruptor 150 flux safety floor breaks cloak without firing emp`() {
    engine.anomalies.clear()
    engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(6, forceFromHangar = true)
    val player = engine.localPlayer
    player.x = 2000f
    player.y = 2000f
    player.isCloaked = true
    player.flux = 152f

    // Isolate target enemy from unrelated AI combat and set Flux below max to verify recharge stays intact
    val enemy = engine.ships.first { !it.isLocalPlayer }
    engine.ships.retainAll { it === player || it === enemy }
    enemy.respawnTimer = 0f
    enemy.x = 2100f
    enemy.y = 2000f
    enemy.empTimer = 0f
    enemy.gunTimer = 5f
    enemy.bombTimer = 5f
    enemy.flux = enemy.maxFlux * 0.5f
    val enemyStartFlux = enemy.flux

    // Tick enough cloak drain to cross <= 150⚡ threshold
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    assertFalse(player.isCloaked)
    assertTrue("Forced uncloak must not drain enemy Flux with EMP", enemy.flux >= enemyStartFlux)
    assertTrue("Forced uncloak must not apply EMP recharge lock", enemy.empTimer <= 0.01f)
  }

  @Test
  fun `ship names codex and ugc moderation adhere to clean rift rules`() {
    val allShips = RiftCodex.getAllTenShips()
    assertEquals(10, allShips.size)
    val legacyPrefix = Regex("^[0-9]+-")
    val forbiddenWords = listOf("Energy", "NRG", "Thor", "Wormhole", "Shotgun", "Missile", "Rocket", "Decoy", "Brick")

    for (s in allShips) {
      assertFalse("Ship ${s.name} must not have numeric prefix", legacyPrefix.containsMatchIn(s.name))
      for (bad in forbiddenWords) {
        assertFalse("Ship title contains $bad", s.primaryTitle.contains(bad, ignoreCase = true))
        assertFalse("Ship secondary contains $bad", s.secondaryTitle.contains(bad, ignoreCase = true))
      }
    }

    assertTrue(UgcModeration.containsProfanity("badshitname"))
    assertFalse(UgcModeration.containsProfanity("APEX_ACE"))
    val masked = UgcModeration.sanitizeUgcText("Good luck fuck that")
    assertFalse(masked.contains("fuck", ignoreCase = true))

    val prefs = LocalPilotPrefs(context)
    prefs.blockPilot("toxic_1")
    assertTrue("toxic_1" in prefs.getBlockedPilotUids())
    assertEquals(1, prefs.reportPilot("toxic_1", "TOXIC_PILOT", "Abusive Comms"))
  }

  @Test
  fun `interdictor ship 9 has 100 point parity and deploys two-way containment bubble`() {
    val interdictor = RiftCodex.getShipById(9)
    assertEquals("Interdictor", interdictor.name)
    assertEquals("INTERDICTOR_DOME", interdictor.bombType)
    assertEquals(
      100,
      interdictor.speedPts +
        interdictor.thrustPts +
        interdictor.turnPts +
        interdictor.maxFluxPts +
        interdictor.rechargePts +
        interdictor.primaryPts +
        interdictor.secondaryPts,
    )
    assertEquals(100, interdictor.totalAllocatedPoints)

    val riftFrame = RiftCodex.getShipById(10)
    assertEquals(10, riftFrame.id)

    engine.walls.clear()
    engine.anomalies.clear()
    engine.interdictorBubbles.clear()
    engine.switchLocalPlayerShip(9, forceFromHangar = true)
    val player = engine.localPlayer
    val enemy = engine.ships.first { !it.isLocalPlayer }
    engine.ships.retainAll { it === player || it === enemy }

    player.x = 2000f
    player.y = 2000f
    player.vx = 0f
    player.vy = 0f
    player.flux = player.maxFlux
    player.bombTimer = 0f

    // Deploy Interdictor Stasis Bubble at (2000, 2000)
    engine.fireSecondaryBomb(player, 0f)
    assertEquals(1, engine.interdictorBubbles.size)
    val bubble = engine.interdictorBubbles.first()
    assertEquals(290f, bubble.radius, 0.1f)
    assertEquals(15.0f, bubble.life, 0.1f)

    // 1. Inside ship attempting to cross outward beyond (radius - 36f = 254f) is clamped inside and reflected
    player.x = 2250f
    player.y = 2000f
    player.vx = 400f
    player.vy = 0f
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    val distInsideAfter = hypot(player.x - bubble.x, player.y - bubble.y)
    assertTrue("Ship inside dome must not escape perimeter", distInsideAfter <= bubble.radius - 35.5f)
    assertTrue("Ship velocity must reflect inward", player.vx < 0f)

    // 2. Outside ship attempting to enter inward within (radius + 36f = 326f) is clamped outside and reflected
    enemy.respawnTimer = 0f
    enemy.x = 2330f
    enemy.y = 2000f
    enemy.vx = -400f
    enemy.vy = 0f
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    val distOutsideAfter = hypot(enemy.x - bubble.x, enemy.y - bubble.y)
    assertTrue("Ship outside dome must not breach perimeter", distOutsideAfter >= bubble.radius + 35.5f)
    assertTrue("Outside ship velocity must reflect outward", enemy.vx > 0f)
  }

  @Test
  fun `flux core mode overcharges carrier and ejects at 1650 px per sec`() {
    engine.deployToRankedMode(com.example.engine.RankedGameMode.FLUX_CORE)
    val player = engine.localPlayer
    engine.ships.retainAll { it === player }

    // Position player outside the Safe Zone right on top of the Flux Core Orb
    player.respawnTimer = 0f
    player.x = engine.fluxCoreOrb.x
    player.y = engine.fluxCoreOrb.y
    player.vx = 0f
    player.vy = 0f
    engine.fluxCoreOrb.pickupImmunitySec = 0f

    // Step simulation so player picks up the Flux Core Orb
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    assertEquals(player.id, engine.fluxCoreCarrierEntityId)
    assertEquals(1, engine.fluxCoreOrb.overchargeTier)

    // Advance holdDurationSec to 25.0s -> Tier 5 (up to Tier 10 at 50s)
    engine.fluxCoreOrb.holdDurationSec = 25.0f
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    assertEquals(5, engine.fluxCoreOrb.overchargeTier)

    engine.fluxCoreOrb.holdDurationSec = 52.0f
    engine.stepSimulation(0.05f)
    assertEquals(10, engine.fluxCoreOrb.overchargeTier)

    // Entering the Safe Zone ejects the Flux Core at 1650 px/s with a 30.0s deceleration timer
    player.x = engine.safeZone.centerX()
    player.y = engine.safeZone.centerY()
    engine.stepSimulation(0.01f)

    assertEquals("", engine.fluxCoreCarrierEntityId)
    assertEquals(-1, engine.fluxCoreOrb.carrierShipId)
    assertTrue("Eject deceleration timer must be ~30.0s", engine.fluxCoreOrb.ejectDecelTimerSec >= 29.9f)
    val ejectSpeed = hypot(engine.fluxCoreOrb.vx, engine.fluxCoreOrb.vy)
    assertEquals(1650f, ejectSpeed, 25f)
  }

  @Test
  fun `stasis breach captures eliminated ships and reactor core breakout releases all prisoners`() {
    engine.deployToRankedMode(com.example.engine.RankedGameMode.STASIS_BREACH, teamSizeBracket = 10)
    assertEquals(8000f, engine.westBrigGeneratorHp, 0.1f)
    assertEquals(8000f, engine.eastBrigGeneratorHp, 0.1f)

    val player = engine.localPlayer // freq = 0 (West Horizon)
    val eastVictim = engine.ships.first { it.freq == 1 }
    val eastRescuer = engine.ships.last { it.freq == 1 && it !== eastVictim }

    // Eliminate eastVictim outside the Safe Zone using a bullet from player
    eastVictim.respawnTimer = 0f
    eastVictim.phaseShieldTimer = 0f
    eastVictim.isInStasisBrig = false
    eastVictim.x = 2000f
    eastVictim.y = 2000f
    eastVictim.flux = 10f

    engine.bullets.clear()
    engine.bullets.add(
      com.example.engine.BulletEntity(
        ownerId = player.id,
        ownerCallsign = player.callsign,
        ownerSyndicateTag = player.syndicateTag,
        ownerArmadaName = player.armadaName,
        ownerIsHuman = true,
        freq = player.freq,
        x = 2000f,
        y = 2000f,
        vx = 0f,
        vy = 0f,
        damage = 250f,
        bouncesLeft = 0,
        life = 1.0f,
        color = 0xFF00F5D4.toInt(),
      )
    )
    engine.stepSimulation(0.02f)

    assertTrue("Eliminated ship in Stasis Breach must be captured in Stasis Brig", eastVictim.isInStasisBrig)

    // Free teammate (eastRescuer) destroys the West Brig Reactor Core (8000f HP) holding East (freq=1) prisoners
    eastRescuer.isInStasisBrig = false
    engine.damageBrigReactorCore(targetBrigFreq = 0, attacker = eastRescuer, rawDamage = 8000f)

    assertFalse("Destroyed Brig Reactor Core must release captured prisoner", eastVictim.isInStasisBrig)
    assertEquals("Brig Reactor Core HP must reset to 8000f after breach", 8000f, engine.westBrigGeneratorHp, 0.1f)
  }

    assertEquals(0L, prefs.getAllTimeKills())
    assertEquals(150L, prefs.getRiftShards("test_uid"))
  }

package com.example.base

import android.content.Context
import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider
import com.google.firebase.FirebaseApp
import com.google.firebase.FirebaseOptions
import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth
import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuthInvalidUserException
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestoreException
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestoreSettings
import com.google.firebase.firestore.MemoryCacheSettings
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.tasks.await
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config
import org.robolectric.annotation.LooperMode

@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(sdk = [36])
@LooperMode(LooperMode.Mode.INSTRUMENTATION_TEST)
abstract class FirestoreEmulatorTestBase {

  protected lateinit var firestore: FirebaseFirestore
  protected lateinit var auth: FirebaseAuth
  protected lateinit var databaseId: String

  @Before
  open fun setUpFirebase() {
    val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<Context>()
    val resId =
      context.resources.getIdentifier("firestore_database_id", "string", context.packageName)
    databaseId = if (resId != 0) context.getString(resId) else "demo-database"

    val app =
      if (FirebaseApp.getApps(context).isEmpty()) {
        val newApp =
          FirebaseApp.initializeApp(
            context,
            FirebaseOptions.Builder()
              .setApplicationId("com.aistudio.riftarena.vxpqzm")
              .setProjectId(PROJECT_ID)
              .setApiKey("fake-api-key-for-emulator")
              .build(),
          )
        val newFirestore = FirebaseFirestore.getInstance(newApp, databaseId)
        newFirestore.useEmulator(EMULATOR_HOST, FIRESTORE_PORT)
        newFirestore.firestoreSettings =
          FirebaseFirestoreSettings.Builder()
            .setLocalCacheSettings(MemoryCacheSettings.newBuilder().build())
            .build()

        val newAuth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance(newApp)
        newAuth.useEmulator(EMULATOR_HOST, AUTH_PORT)
        newApp
      } else {
        FirebaseApp.getInstance()
      }

    val emulatorAvailable = try {
      java.net.Socket().use { socket ->
        socket.connect(java.net.InetSocketAddress(EMULATOR_HOST, FIRESTORE_PORT), 500)
        true
      }
    } catch (_: Exception) {
      false
    }
    org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue(
      "Firestore emulator is not running on $EMULATOR_HOST:$FIRESTORE_PORT",
      emulatorAvailable,
    )

    firestore = FirebaseFirestore.getInstance(app, databaseId)
    auth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance(app)
  }

  @After
  open fun tearDownFirebase() {
    if (::auth.isInitialized) {
      auth.signOut()
    }
  }

  protected suspend fun signInTestUser(email: String): String =
    withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
      withTimeout(AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        val result =
          try {
            auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, DEFAULT_PASSWORD).await()
          } catch (unused: Exception) {
            auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(email, DEFAULT_PASSWORD).await()
          }
        checkNotNull(result.user?.uid) { "User auth failed" }
      }
    }

  protected fun Throwable.unwrapFirestoreException(): FirebaseFirestoreException? {
    var current: Throwable? = this
    while (current != null) {
      if (current is FirebaseFirestoreException) return current
      current = current.cause
    }
    return null
  }

  private companion object {
    const val EMULATOR_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
    const val FIRESTORE_PORT = 8085
    const val AUTH_PORT = 9099
    const val PROJECT_ID = "demo-no-project"
    const val DEFAULT_PASSWORD = "password123"
    const val AUTH_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000L
  }
}

package com.example.data

import com.example.base.FirestoreEmulatorTestBase
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestoreException
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assert.fail
import org.junit.Test
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config

@Config(sdk = [36])
@LooperMode(LooperMode.Mode.INSTRUMENTATION_TEST)
class RiftRepositoryRuleTest : FirestoreEmulatorTestBase() {

  @Test
  fun saveAndObservePilotDossier_authenticatedOwner_succeeds() = runBlocking {
    val uid = signInTestUser(ALICE_EMAIL)
    val repo = RiftRepository(firestore)

    val saveResult =
      withTimeout(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        repo.savePilotDossier(
          PilotDossier(
            userId = uid,
            callsign = "VIPER_ACE",
            preferredShipId = 2L,
            preferredFoundry = "Independent",
            preferredMode = "FFA",
            pvpKills = 8L,
            pvpDeaths = 2L,
            pvpBountyPeak = 640L,
            allTimeKills = 25L,
            allTimeDeaths = 5L,
            allTimeBountyPeak = 1100L,
            convergencesWon = 2L,
          )
        )
      }
    assertTrue("Expected dossier save to succeed: ${saveResult.exceptionOrNull()}", saveResult.isSuccess)

    val emitted =
      withTimeout(FLOW_TIMEOUT_MS) {
        repo.observePilotDossier(uid).first { it != null && it.callsign == "VIPER_ACE" }
      }
    assertNotNull(emitted)
    assertEquals(8L, emitted?.pvpKills)
  }

  @Test
  fun getPilotDossier_crossUserAccess_failsWithPermissionDenied() = runBlocking {
    val aliceUid = signInTestUser(ALICE_EMAIL)
    val aliceRepo = RiftRepository(firestore)
    withTimeout(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS) {
      aliceRepo.savePilotDossier(PilotDossier(userId = aliceUid, callsign = "ALICE_ACE")).getOrThrow()
    }

    signInTestUser(BOB_EMAIL)
    val bobRepo = RiftRepository(firestore)
    val result = withTimeout(DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS) { bobRepo.getPilotDossier(aliceUid) }
    assertTrue("Expected cross-user read to fail", result.isFailure)
    val ex = result.exceptionOrNull()?.unwrapFirestoreException()
    assertNotNull("Expected FirebaseFirestoreException", ex)
    assertEquals(FirebaseFirestoreException.Code.PERMISSION_DENIED, ex?.code)
  }

    val aliceUid = signInTestUser(ALICE_EMAIL)
